tei:titleStmt.tei:title: tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las/chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /ba
tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las/chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /ba

tei:div.tei:p: tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las/ chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/ oṃ swa sti/ sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /bka' gsang zab gter bdun cu'i cha shas las/ /mkha' spyod tsā ri'i gter byon tshe sgrub rmad/ /'chi bdag zil gnon chos sde'i them byang 'god/ de'ang o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi sgrub thabs sna tshogs pa las/ 'di ni 'chi med tshe'i sgrub skor yin la/ de la'ang tshe sgrub rnam bzhi zhes/ tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon/ tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud/ tshe sgrub rdo rje'i go khrab/ tshe sgrub pad+ma gsang thig bcas bzhugs pa las/ tshe sgrub rdo rje'i go khrab dang*/ tshe sgrub pad+ma gsang thig gnyis las pad+ma gsang thig gi cha shas tshe 'gugs tsam las/ gzhan ni da bar lag son ma byung la rigs gsar gyi skabs dpe rgyun chad par snang ngo*/ phyi ma gnyis las khyad par du 'phags pa 'di nyid yul nyer bzhi'i nang tshan dā+e wi ko tri ste/ bod yul gnas mchog yongs kyi rgyal po dag pa shrī'am dpal gyi tsā ri ṭa zhes/ thugs kyi gnas mchog mthong thos dran reg byang chub la sbyor ba'i gnas mchog de'i lte bar/ zil chen gsang phug tu ma hā gu ru yab yum gyis bla gter du sbas par mdzad pa'i/ tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon dang*/ de'i bar chad sel thabs rta mgrin khro rgyal stobs 'dus/ rgyud lung man ngag them byang sogs/ lam gyi nyams len ma tshang ba med cing zab khyad rmad du byung ba'i chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang 'god pa la/ ka) tshe sgrub chen mo'i snang gsal rig pa'i me long le'u rtsis tho ut+pal phreng rgyan/ kha) tshe sgrub yang snying 'chi bdag zil gnon las: rgyud gsang ba'i ti ka dmar po/ ga) tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: dbang chog ut+pa la'i phreng ba'i lo rgyus me tog phreng mdzes/

nga) tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: tshe 'dzin srog sgrub 'khor lo/ ca) tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil non las: man ngag gnad kyi gdams pa/ cha) tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: 'pho ba dpag chen mda' mo/ ja) tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: dbang chen ut+pa la'i phreng ba/ nya) tshe sgrub yang snying 'chi bdag zil gnon las: dbang 'bring 'ja' tshon phreng ba/ ta) tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: tshe bdud zhags pa gcod pa'i gdams pa/ tha) tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: bdud bzhi'i zhu lan 'gyur khug da) tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon las/ gsol 'debs 'chi med dpal ster/ na) tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: tshe chog ye shes lnga ldan 'ja' tshon phreng ba/ pa) tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: byin 'bebs gdangs ring dbyangs can 'gyur khug /pha) bdud rtsi lag mchod/ ba) tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: dmigs pa'i 'dzab dgongs bsdus pa bskyed rdzogs rang gsal/ ma) tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: bskang ba yon tan kun 'byung rin chen phreng ba/ tsa) tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: bla med yang gsang sgrub pa rdo rje rmang gzhi/ tsha) tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: yang gsang sgrub pa rdo rje rmang gzhi khrigs su bsdebs pa/ dza) tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon las/ h+ya ghṛ wa khro rgyal stobs 'dus kyi gsol 'debs tshe 'phrang g.yul rgyal/ wa) tshe sgrub yang snying 'chi bdag zil gnon las: h+ya ghṛ wa khro rgyal stobs 'dus kyi las byang*/ zha) khro rgyal stobs 'dus kyi bdud rtsi lag mchod dngos grub kun 'byung*/ za) tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: h+ya ghṛ wa'i hūm̐ sgrub/ 'a) tshe sgrub yang snying 'chi bdag zil gnon las: h+ya ghṛ wa khro rgyal stobs 'dus kyi gsang sgrub/ ya) tshe sgrub yang snying 'chi bdag zil gnon las/

h+ya ghṛ wa khro rgyal stobs 'dus kyi gsang sgrub 'don khrigs/ ra) tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: h+ya ghṛ wa'i smad las bdud dpung tshar gcod/ la) tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las/ 'chi bslu tshe bdud zhags gcod bklag chog tu bkod pa/ sha) tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: glud rabs nyams chag lam bsgyur bcas chos tshan nyer bdun bzhugs so/ rlung sgrub 'ja' lus 'od dpung dkar chag nang du gsal yang dper ma rnyed/ slar smras pa/ sngon tshe mā ra ti kar tshe bsgrubs pas/ /skye 'chi med par rdo rje'i sku ru grub/ /pad 'byung tshe dpag med mgon dbyer med gyur/ /tshe sgrub mang bstan snying byang 'di ko bsngags/ /de slad dpal mgon bla ma yi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs phyir dang*/ /gang la me tog phog pa yi/ /gnam lcags zab gter gang de'i gtsos/ /rgyun dkon gsung rab bsdu skrun dang*/ /chad nye'i smin grol rgyun spel slad/ /'di yang bkam̐' gtem̐r srim̐ zhum̐ ru/ /em̐ waṃm̐ dpem̐ skrunam̐ kham̐ng nas bsgrubs/ /des kyang snying po'i ring lugs 'di'i/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /snyigs ma'i rgud pa yongs su zhi/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog /

ces pa'ang sgo chen sprul ming pas gnam lcags zab gter yongs rdzogs 'phrul par du drangs shing*/ glegs bam re la brgya phrag lnga'i grangs kyi dpe skrun bgyis skabs rang gi 'dod don gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'grub par gyur cig/ // ka) ༈ tshe sgrub chen mo'i snang gsal rig pa'i me long le'u rtsis tho ut+pal phreng rgyan bzhugs so: tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon gyi le'u'i tho las: tshe chog ye shes lnga ldan: (1) byin 'bebs gdangs ring dbyangs can: (2) dmigs pa'i 'dzab dgongs: (3) 'pho ba dpag chen: (4)bskang ba yon tan kun 'byung : (5) h+ya ghṛ wa khro rgyal stobs 'dus: (6) bdud rtsi lag mchod: (7) h+ya gh+ri wa'i hūm̐ sgrub: (8) man ngag gnad kyi gdams pa: (9) h+ya gh+ri wa'i smad las bdud dpung tshar gcod: (10) bla med yang gsang sgrub pa rdo rje'i rmang gzhi: (11) rlung sgrub 'ja' lus 'od dpung : (12) stobs 'dus kyi gsang sgrub: (13)tshe 'dzin srog sgrub: (14) dbang chog ut+pa la'i phreng ba'i lo rgyus: (15) dbang chen ut+pa la'i phreng ba: (16) tshe bdud zhags pa gcod pa: (17) bdud bzhi'i zhu lan 'gyur khug: (18) rgyud gsang ba'i ti ka dmar po/ (19) dbang 'bring 'ja' tshon phreng ba/ (20) glud rabs nyams chag lam bsgyur/ (21) bdud bzhi'i zhus lan 'gyur khug /(22) bdud rtsi lag mchod/ zil gnon chen mo'i le'u sa brgyad thob rten 'brel nyi ma rang shar zhu ba'o/ bkra shis/ mkha' mnyam yongs la tshe yi bde skyid 'dzoms/ kha)༈ tshe sgrub yang snying 'chi bdag zil gnon las: rgyud gsang ba'i ti ka dmar po bzhugs pa'i dbu'o: snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur ba'i sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma kho bo pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: yang zab tshe sgrub gsang ba'i rgyud mchog bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:

e maḥ snang mtha' mkha' klong yangs pa'i dbus: brdal khyab ka dag chos sku'i klong du sna tshogs rdo rje mi shigs pa'i khrir bzhugs so: de yi tshe thugs ka nas mar me gcig la gnyis mched kyi tshul du: rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas: lho nub 'o ma can gyi mtshor 'khrungs: brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas dur khrod kun tu bskyod cing : mchog gi rig 'dzin mngon du gyur: khyad par brag phug mā ra ti ka ru bzhugs pa'i tshe: gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon dang rdo rje'i go khrab dngos gnang nas lung bstan te: rgya gar 'di'i lung pa byang du dag pa shrī bya ba'i gangs ri sku gsum gyi mtshon pa yod: de yi nub ḍāk+ki gsang ba'i gnas mchog zil chen gsang phug bya ba'i gnas yod: der yul nyi shu rtsa brgyad: gnas sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi mkha' 'gro dngos su 'du: 'chi med rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i gnas yin: der sgrub pa'i rten 'brel zungs zhes pa'i lung bstan: de nas slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang : mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gnyis rdzu 'phrul gyis byon te: zil chen gsang ba'i gnas su bzhugs: tshe sgrub brgya dang rtsa brgyad mdzad: brag la dngos su tshe chu rdol: tshe bum rang byung mi tshad gnyis long ba tsam gyur: de yi tshe: tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor te: mkha' spyod zhing gi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dngos su byon: khyad par gangs gnyan nyi shu rtsa gcig gi zhing skyong rnams dbang du bsdus shing dam la bzhag: tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon dang rdo rje'i go khrab la sogs pa zab pa'i mthar thug mang du gsungs: tshe ril dang tshe chu rnams dum bur bgos te bsgrub pa'i rdzas su bzhag: lha lcam gyis gu ru'i gsungs bzhin mkha' 'gro brda yi yi ger bris: dam rdzas dang shog dril la chas gwa'ur dril te gu rus rab tu gnas par mdzad de: tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon tsā ri zil chen sgrub pa'i gnas su:

brag tshe bum rang byon gyi g.yon du rgya rim pa lnga dang bcas nas sbas: gter srung zhing skyong kun dga' gzhon nu la bcol: rta mgrin khro rgyal stobs 'dus: g.yon gyi shug pa'i gong du sbas te: sgrub pa'i gnas rta mgrin rong dbu rtser brag chos 'byung 'dra ba ru lung bstan: gter srung rgyal po mdung dmar can la gnyer gtad: gu ru'i gsung bzhin kho mo lha lcam bdag gis gter du sbas pa'o: tshe sgrub rdo rje'i go khrab: g.ya' ma lung du bzhugs pa'i tshe: sngon gyi sgrub gnas dang mthun pa'i mdo smad wa lung bya ba yod gsungs te lung bstan: de bzhin du brag tshe bum 'dra ba'i gong du rgya rim pa lnga dang bcas nas sbas so: gter srung yang lha bdud btsan klu la bcol: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: tshe sgrub zab mo'i yang snying skor rnams bzhag: lnga brgya tha ma nyi shu la nye zhing : mi rnams tshe thung glo bur dus min 'chi: sgrub la long med dgong mo'i grib so 'dra: de phyir snyigs dus tshe 'phrang sgrol ba yi: yang gsang bsgrub pa 'chi bdag zil gnon nyid: gsang sgrub rdo rje snying po'i go khrab mchog: myur zab snying thig tshig nyung don chen 'brel: zab gnad gsang rgya thugs rje'i 'od zer can: sgrub cing spel bas tshe yi rig 'dzin 'thob: dam rdzas tshe ril myong rnams 'ja' lus 'grub: de phyir kun gyi snying po gcig dril nyid: ma 'ongs lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: pad+ma gter bdag gling dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas me sprel lor tsā ri zil chen gsang phug nas gdan drangs te/ lo drug gsang rgya bsdams nas glang lor sbas tshal pad+ma bkod du shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ yi ge pa yang chos nyid bdud 'dul rtsal zhes so/ e ka prat+ti ts+tsha/ maṅga laṃ// // ga) tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las:

dbang chog ut+pa la'i phreng ba'i lo rgyus me tog phreng mdzes bzhugs so: snang mtha' 'od ma'i 'gyur ba'i sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: 'chi med tshe sgrub zab mo 'chi bdag zil gnon gyi dbang gi lo rgyus bstan pa la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las: sngon 'gro dbang gi cha lag: dngos gzhi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gnad du bsgril ba: rjes chog dbang gi bskur thabs dang gsum las: de yang slob dpon dang slob ma yi byed las gnyis po so sor phye ba yin te: bdag don du sgrub cing dbang bzhi len pa slob dpon gyi byed las dang : gzhan don du rjes su gnang ba slob ma yi byed las gnyis yin zhing : de yang gzhi ma grol ba grol bar byed pa'i chos dang : lam 'khrul pa gnad du bsnun pa'i khrid dang : 'bras bu ma smin pa smin par byed pa'i dbang dang gsum las: dbang la yang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum yod pa las: rgyas pa dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba dbang chen yongs rdzogs: 'bring po dbang lnga mtha' rten dang bcas: bsdus pa sku gsung thugs dam byin rlabs kyi mtha' bka' bsgo la 'dus shing : lag len bskur thabs rdzas kyi bkram lugs sogs rgyud sde spyi dang : pra khrid chen mo ltar phyag len mngon du bya'o: gnyis pa lo rgyus cung zad spro na: 'o da lam khyed rang rnams la bka' gsang bzhi las khyad par du 'phags pa: yang gsang bla na med pa theg pa spyi long gi yang rtse gar gyi dbang phyug pad+ma'i mgon po 'chi bdag zil gnon gyi dbang bskur ba yin te: de'ang rgyud las: nyan pa po rnams dma' ba'i sa la 'dug: zhwa thod skra lo la sogs mdun du phab: mig gi dbang pos chos smra'i zhal la blta: rna ba'i dbang po ma yengs gsung la nyan: yid kyi dbang pos tshig bzung don la blta: zhes gsungs pa ltar: bslab bya de lta bu dang ldan pas gsan 'tshal: gsan par bya ba'i chos ni: mi zad rgyud kyi ti ka sogs sngon byung lung gi khyer so:

man ngag gnad kyi them byang : byin rlabs chu bo ma chad pa'i lo rgyus dang bzhi las: mi zad rgyud kyi ti ka ni: sngon snang mtha' mkha' klong yangs pa'i dbus: brdal khyab ka dag chos sku'i klong du sna tshogs mi shigs pa'i khrir thog ma'i mgon po bzhugs so: de'i tshe thugs ka nas mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du: rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas: lho nub 'o ma can gyi mtshor sku 'khrungs: brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas dur khrod kun tu byon cing : mchog gi rig 'dzin mngon du gyur: khyad par brag phug mā ra ti ka ru bzhugs pa'i tshe: gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gros tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon dang : rdo rje'i go khrab dngos su gnang ste lung bstan te: rgya gar 'di yi lung pa byang phyogs su dag pa shrī bya ba gangs ri sku gsum gyi mtshon pa yod: 'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub pa'i gnas yin: gzhan yang rgya gar gyi gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas pa 'di ru: gangs ri mtsho mo dur khrod gtsug lag ljon shing sogs bsgrub pa'i gnas khyad 'phags rnams dang : yang le shod sogs sku gsum gyi gnas dang : gzhan yang ti se la phyi tsā ri: gze rgyal rong btsan sogs gangs can gyi gnas khyad du 'phags pa yin pas: de dag rnams su ma 'ongs pa'i dus na sgrub gnas dang : zab gter rnams 'gro don dpag med 'byung ba'i rten 'brel zungs shig ces lung bstan: de nas slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang lha lcam grub pa'i rgyal mo man+da ra ba gnyis kyis lung bzhin: mā ra ti kar 'chi med tshe'i sgrub pa mdzad pas: phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob ste: mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa dngos su zhal mjal zhing lung bstan par mdzad: gdams pa bzhi skor gyi rgyud lung man ngag dang bcas pa dngos su gnang : yab yum spyi bor tshe'i bum pa bzhag: bskal pa chags nas 'khor ba ma stongs bar: yab yum sku la bgres rgud med dbang bskur:

skyi 'chi med pa mchog gi rig 'dzin gyur: zhes gsungs shing tshe dpag med slob dpon yab yum la thim: yab yum gnyis kyang phyi ltar tshe dpag med: nang ltar rnga sgra yi rgyal po: gsang ba ltar dbang chen yab yum sku dngos su gyur: gdams pa bzhi skor gyi man ngag rnams zab khyad mi 'dra ba du ma dang bcas: kha byang lung byang them byang man ngag gnad kyi lde'u mig dang bcas pa ma 'ongs 'gro ba'i don du smon lam gyis rgyas btab nas: mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod du bzhugs shing dag pa rig 'dzin rnams la gnyer du gtad: de rnams ni mi zad rgyud kyi ti ka ru grags so: sa ma ya: sngon byung lung gi khyer so ni: bod yul mun pa'i smag rum du: dam pa'i chos kyi sgron me 'degs pa'i ched du: 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po'i gdul byar gyur cing : de yang 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi thugs kyi sprul pa: bod kyi chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis bod khams chos la 'god par dgongs nas: chos khrims rgyal khrims thang khrims gsum du mdzad cing : dam pa'i chos kyi srol gtod phyir: bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs par: bka' 'bangs dang gros shing gzhi gting bas: bod kyi lha 'dre gdug pa can rnams kyis sgrub tu ma ster bas: mkhan chen zhi ba mtsho gtsos pa'i mkhas chen sde gsum bod du byon pas rgyal por lung bstan par: rig 'dzin pad+ma kā ra bod yul du gdan drangs nas: rgyal po'i dgongs pa 'grub par gsungs: de nas rgyal pos slob dpon gdan drangs shing lha srin dam la btags: rjes 'brangs nyer lnga smin grol lam la bkod cing bod khams yongs la chos kyi nyi ma shar bar mdzad nas: dbu rtse'i bar khang du: bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i dbang bskur ba'i tshe: rgyal pos rin po che'i maṇ+ḍal dang bcas nas zhus pa: slob dpon chen po lags skye 'chi med pa tshe yi rig 'dzin brnyes pa:

slob dpon nyid lta bu 'byung ba'i rgyu gang lags: bdag la yang de lta bu'i gdams pa zhig gnang bar zhu zhes zhus pa dang : slob dpon gyi zhal nas nga nyid lta bu 'chi med rig 'dzin rnyed pa ni: khyad par dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mnga' gsol: 'jig rten dbang phyug gis lung bstan: mgon po tshe dpag med pas dbang bskur ba yin zhing : de lta bu ni rgyal po g.yeng ba che bas 'grub par dka' ste: 'on kyang mi yul du brgya dang bcu gcig bzhugs par bya'o gsungs nas: brag dmar g.ya' ma lung gi gsang phug tu byon nas: 'chi med tshe yi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes: phra men gyi bum pa rtsi bcud kyis bkang nas: zla ba gcig bsgrubs pas: mgon po tshe dpag med dngos su zhal bstan: de yi tshe slob dpon gyis rgyal po la tshe yi dbang bskur ba dang tshe chu 'dren ran par dus la bab pa gzigs nas: mi ṭa kan+dhi ka ra dang : bā+e rin chen mchog dang : gnyis bsam yas su byon: rgyal po'i spyan sngar slob dpon gyi gsung bzhin zhus pas: rgyal po yang thugs rab tu dgyes shing 'byon par chas: rta khal lnga bcu la gser dngul ja dar gos sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams bkal te sngon la brdzang bar byas: rgyal po dang nang blon phyi nas 'byon par bgros: rta mchog ngang pa gser ldan la chibs sga bkra shis rgyan can sgron: rin po che dang dar sna yis brgyan te: rgyal po chibs kyi khar phebs: blon po ye shes 'byung gis sna khrid de shar sgo rnam thar sgo gsum gyi mdun du phyin pa'i tshe: phyi blon bzhi dang lha 'dres sprul pa mi ru brdzu ba blon 'bangs 'ga' zhig gis khri srong lde'u btsan chibs nas bzung ste 'di skad zhus so: rgyal po blo sna mang na rgyal srid sprang pos 'khyer ba'i skyon che: khar sang zla ba sngon ma'i tshes pa bcu gsum gyi nyin: rgya gar a tsa ra ngan pa tsi dug khur ba dpon g.yog gsum song zer ba kun gyi thos te:

nged rnams la bca' kha gzab par gyis zer mkhan mang zhig byung : mi 'ga' zhig shing thu zhing yod pa rnams kyis mthong nas: a tsa ras dug pha bong la byugs pas dum bu mang zhig tu gas pa mthong : dug yod pa'i rtags su brag bzo rigs dang yi ge yod par 'dug: nged blon po rnams kyi dpral ba'i mig: khog pa'i snying : srog gi khrag: 'dzam gling kun gyi mgo 'dren pa'i rgyal po khyed yin pa la: mtha' mi dge sbyong ngan pa mgo skor mkhan gyi khar brgyugs nas mi chen gyis dug 'thung na: rgyal po tshe 'di'i sku srog mi phangs kyang : rgyal khrims mgo nas zhig: blon po bar nas 'thor: mi sde rnams kyang kha bshad ngan pa las mi yong bar 'dug pas: cis kyang mi 'byon par zhu zer nas ngam stag ra klu gong gis chibs kha nas bzung ste ma btang : rgyal po yang nub mo'i mnal lam shin tu legs pa byung ba yin kyang : snang ba'i ri mo 'di yang bslu brid mkhas pa dang : blon po 'di rnams kyang phan sems kyi tshig 'dra ba mang zhig byung snyam ste: the tshom skyes te re zhig nang du log ste slar rim gyis brtag par dgongs nas gros te gzim chung bar khang du log: rgyal po'i thugs la yang 'di nyid mi srid dam dgongs shing : 'on kyang rgyal kha blon gyis bsgyur te ma byon: de'i tshe slob dpon mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis mkhyen te: tshe bum bhan+dha bcas zhal kha phye bas: g.ya' ma lung stod smad khyab pa'i dri bzang dang : 'ja' 'od kyi gur phub me tog gi char babs pa sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas dpag med byung zhing : mgon po tshe dpag med dang : lha mo tsaṇ+ḍa lī'i sku dngos su bstan te: 'jig rten 'di na tshe yi snod dkon pas: de bzhin tshe la dbang ba nyi zla tsam: gal srid skyes bu tshe yi snod ldan na: tshe chu 'di 'thung lo stong phrag gcig thub: ces gsungs nas 'ja' ltar yal lo: de nas tshe la dbang ba slob dpon gyis tshe chu dang tshe ril rnams dum bu brgyad du bgos nas:

tshe sgrub zab pa re re dang bcas nas: phyis ma 'ongs pa'i bod 'bangs skyobs pa'i ched dang : rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i chos skal du dmigs nas: sgrom bu dang la cha'i bum pa: rdza'i dha ha: zangs kyi gwa'u: bswe yi li ta ka: rlung gi par bu sogs mi 'dra ba mang po'i nang du rgya rim pa bdun nam gsum gyis rgya btab nas: rje 'bangs rnams dang 'phrad pa'i smon lam mtshams sbyar: bod kyi mgur lha shin tu gnyan pa re re la gnyer du gtad de: lha lcam gyis gu ru'i gsung bzhin mi 'gyur ba'i gnas brgyad la gter du sbas: khyad par tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon dang : de'i bar chad ser thabs khro rgyal stobs 'dus: rgyud lung man ngag them byang dang bcas pa: tsā ri zil chen gsang phug tu sngon gyi lung byang ltar gter du sbas: gter srung kun dga' gzhon nu dang : gnod sbyin mdung dmar can la bcol lo: de dag ni lung gi khyer so ru grags pa yin no: sa ma ya: man ngag gnad kyi them byang ni: gzhi yi dbang la 'dus shing : de yang snod kyi gang zag brtag pa: dbang gi bskur thabs bstan pa: phan yon dang 'bras bu bstan pa: gsum las dang po gang zag brtag pa ni: rgyud las snying rje mos gus shes rab gsum tshang ba gang zag snod du rung dang : zhabs rdol kha sbub kha chod can gsum snod du mi rung bar gsungs shing : de yang snying rje med na chos kyi rtsa ba rul: mos gus med na yon tan skyon du mthong : shes rab med na chos kyi shan mi 'byed: ces gsungs pa dang : snying rje can gyis 'gro drug pha mar mthong : mos gus can la bla mar ma gyur med: shes rab can la 'khor 'das chos kyi gzhi: zhes gsungs pa dang : snying rje can ni gzhi yi rang bzhin no: mos gus can ni lam gyi 'khrul pa bral: shes rab can la 'bras bu rang bzhin rdzogs: zhes gsungs pa ltar: snod rung gi gang zag brtag pa gces: gzhan yang lung las: zhabs rdol can ni drad po rang mthong can:

kha sbub can ni log lta smra bshad mkhan: kha chod can ni mu stegs gol ba'i lam: zhes gsungs pa ltar: zhabs rdol bcud blugs rang bzhin nyes pa bsags: kha sbub can la bcud kyi snod ma yin: kha chod can la bcud kyi gzhi ma grub: ces gsungs pa ltar: snod min gyi gang zag la dbang bskur gyi snod mi rung ngo : de'i phyir las dang skal par ldan pa rnams la bskur bar bya ste: de yang smin byed kyi rgyud las: sku yi dbang lnga spyi bo'i gtsug tu bskur: gsung gi dbang lnga mgrin pa'i gnas su bskur: thugs kyi rje dbang lnga snying kha'i gnas su bskur: yon tan dbang lnga lte ba'i gnas su bskur: phrin las dbang lnga yan lag lnga la bskur: lha dbang chen mo lha dang gnyis med bskur: chos tshang tshig mtshon brda don lus la brgyan: rdzas dbang thabs shes ma bral lag la gtad: ces gsungs pa ltar: gnas lnga so so yi dbang don sdom nyi shu rtsa lnga 'byung ba yin te: de dag re re la yang dgos ched tshig don rdzas sngags smon lam phyag rgya lnga lnga tshang ba ni: bla med kyi dbang chen du gtogs shing : thabs mchog g.yas nas bskur ba bya ba'i rgyud: shes rab g.yon nas bskur ba spyod pa'i rgyud: gnyis med zung 'jug dbang bzhi bla med rgyud: phyi mchod rnam lnga bstan pa bya ba'i rgyud: nang mchod rnam lnga bstan pa spyod pa'i rgyud: sgrol mchod sman raka gtor gsum bla med rgyud: thig le 'od kyi dkyil 'khor bya ba'i rgyud: pho brang pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor spyod pa'i rgyud: zla gam chos 'byung rtsibs mtshon bla med rgyud: ces gsungs pa ltar: nyams su len dgos shing bdag don gzhan don gyi man ngag rnams gnad du khel bar bya'o: de yang dbang bskur thob pa'i phan yon: ma thob pa'i nyes dmigs gnyis las: bka' yi thang yig las: lo re bzhin tu dbang re thob pas na: lo brgya song nas dbang brgya thob pa yin: phyi ma dud 'gror skyes kyang dbang chen 'gyur:

zhes gsungs pa yin te: de yang rang bzhin gyi dud 'gror skye ba ma yin te: sems can gyi lus yin kyang gzhan don nus pa snying rje yi sems 'byung ba: smon lam gyi dbang dang ldan pa: glang bu cang shes dang legs skya lta bu'i lus su skye bar gsungs so: ma thob pa'i nyes dmigs ni: dbang bskur rtsa ba'i rgyud las: dbang ma bskur ba la gsang sngags chos snod min: dper na rdza so ma btang chu blugs 'dra: zhes gsungs pa dang : dbang bskur thob na chos kyi bdag po yin: de phyir gsang sngags dbang la 'jug par bya: zhes gsungs pa dang : dbang lnga thob na sku lnga'i sangs rgyas 'grub: ces gsungs pa dang : phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob pa ni: phan yon dang 'bras bu bstan pa'o: 'di kun man ngag gnad kyi them byang du grags pa yin: sa ma ya: byin rlabs chu bo ma chad pa'i lo rgyus ni: sngon brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas su: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang : mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal dang : gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes: dge slong nam mkha' snying po: lo chen bai ro tsa na dang grogs bzhis slob dpon chen po la: rin po che'i maṇ+ḍal dang bcas nas zhus pa: kyaiḥ slob dpon chen po lags: da lta'i dus 'dir skal pa yar ldan kyang : ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga brgya'i dus kyi tshe: da lta'i chos dang gdams ngag zab khyad rnams: 'gro don gar 'byung chos ka gang la byed: 'brel tshad don ldan 'byung ngam ji ltar lags: bdud sprul bstan pa'i ru tra ji ltar 'byung : bstan 'dzin skyes bu 'gro don ji ltar 'byung : rje 'bangs grogs rnams 'dul bya gang du 'byung : slob dpon nyid kyi sprul pa ci ltar 'byung : zhes zhus pas: slob dpon 'khrul med zhal nas 'di skad gsungs: bai ro tsa na ye shes grogs gsum nyon: tshe sgrub yang snying gcig dril zab gnad kyi: bdag gi snying byang dum bur bgos pa 'di: da lta spel ba'i dus min gter du sbos:

dus mtha' sum cu kha dar nyi shu dus: mi rnams rang phung dug lnga spyod pa'i dus: sa gter mi thub gter ston mang 'byung zhing : sangs rgyas bstan pa dbus nub mtha' bzhi rtsod: dam chos gsang sngags dkyil 'khor chu la dor: so skye bdud sprul dbus gtsang khrag mtsho 'khyil: bying nang grum nas dbus su mi gad sdib: chos rgyal gdung rgyud mtha' bzhi 'dul zhing 'byung : steng 'khrug 'og 'khrug lha srin rnams kyang 'khrugs: mtha' bzhi 'khrugs nas 'dre rgod yul la chags: mi rnams stod smad rgya hor dmag gis 'ded: rong chen bzhi la bros pa'i gab ri btsal: bod khams mi rnams lho mon rong du bros: nor rnams dgra yi za zhing hab sha gcod: zog po khrims ral dam nyams lung pa 'gengs: tshul bzhin spyod pa nyin mo'i skar ma tsam: sum cu kha ral nyi shu la nye bas: ma 'ongs de dus chos brgyud mtha' skyong ba: da lta'i dpal chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi: skye ba 'khrul med mdo khams phyogs nas 'byung : rgyal khams rngam sgra nag po yul gyi ming : bya nag gshog rdeb gcan gzan ngar ba'i rong : rtsi shing mdung rtse gzengs pa lta bu'i tshal: yum bral gshed bzhi zhe sdang lo 'dzin pa: shes rab blo ldan zab gsang las sad pa'i: lus la brda rtags ri mo sha mtshan ni: drag po rtags rgya spyi gtsug me ris brgyan: rgyud smin dbang rdzogs so zho tshe bum ldan: stong nyid don ldan snying khar sme bas brgyan: tshig rnams pad+ma'i brda yig shes rab ldan: gsang bar hūm̐ mthing karma las 'brel gling : mi 'gyur rtags ldan sku lnga'i chos la dbang : ma nges brtul zhugs smyon pa lta bur spyod: phyogs med 'gro don rgyal khams rlung bzhin rgyu: gter sgro g.ya' lung brag gsum nas bzung ste: rong chen lnga yi zab gter rtags bdun dbang : bka' gsang shog dril bdun bcu don lnga 'di: dbang bzhir blang zhing phab nas yang gter sbos:

gsang ba'i bka' rgya bka' srung drag por gtod: dam rdzas byin rlabs phab rgyun ma gtogs pa: 'du tir skyel zhing smon lam zab par thob: rten 'brel dus kyi smon lam ma gtogs par: lo bcu bar du gsang rgya dam par gyis: dus kyi sa rtags thams cad shar ba'i tshe: smon lam dus bab 'gro don dus der che: rdzogs brda chos kyi smin grol byang chub myur: de yang phrin las nga nyid drung du 'ong : sa ma ya: zhes gsungs pa yi: lung byang de lta bu dang ldan pa: rig 'dzin chen po gar gyi dbang phyug gnam lcags rdo rje sogs gsang mtshan dgu dang ldan pa'i rig 'dzin de nyid kyis: lung byang ltar mdo khams spa rong sa yi lte bar: rigs ni dbang chen: rus ni rlangs chen dpal gyi seng gi gdung la gtogs pa yi: skyes mchog de nyid chung byis pa'i dus nas: sngon sbyangs las 'phro sad pa'i rtags mtshan du ma dang ldan zhing : dgung lo lnga yi kha nas nyams dang rmi lam mngon sum la yang slob dpon dang mtsho rgyal gyis chos gsung lung bstan dbang bskur ba sogs nyams snang du ma shar zhing : bka' gter srung ma rnams kyis kyang : rogs dan phrin las sgrub pa sogs zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi yi las bsgrub pa'i dam bca' dang : srog snying phul ba sogs 'byung zhing : de nas rim bzhin kha byang lung gi dngos grub thob: shing pho rta yi lo nas dbu bzung ste: a mye mu khri nas

dang po gter gyi kha byang skor: gzho stod ti sgro nas mkha' 'gro'i chos bzhi dang pad+ma khrag 'thung skor: tsā ri zhing skyong zil chen nas tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon skor: mon sha 'ug stag sgo nas yang phur gwa'u skor: yar stod sham po gangs nas gza' bdud dug mtsho khol ma'i skor: bsam yas mchims phu nas bla sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus skor: brag gsum gnam lcags brag nas phyag rdor dregs pa kun 'dul skor: rga rgyal rin chen spungs pa nas drag po kī la ya dang pad+ma gsang thig skor: mkha' 'gro snying phug nas tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud skor: gze rgyal gangs ri nas bdud 'dul drag mo dang zhing skyong chos skor: ri rtse drug nas rta phag yi bzhin nor bu'i chos skor: rag ne brag nas rdo rje gro lod chos skor: wa zhabs brag nas tshe sgrub rdo rje'i go khrab skor: lcags kha dge bsnyen pho brang nas nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po'i chos skor: sbas yul rngam pa rong nas dbal sras gsang ba tha nag gi chos skor: mdong chu gtsug lag nas drag po gnam lcags 'khor lo'i chos skor: dar sna pha wang rta mgo nas rta mgrin nā ga klu 'dul chos skor: gsang lung phyag rdor bla mtsho nas phag mo rigs lnga dang ma ning chos skor: brag skas pad+ma shel phug nas thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon chos skor: seṅge gnam rdzong nas pad+ma bkod lam yig dang gsang rgya 'ga' bzhugs: mye bo lha mo brag: 'di gsang rgya ma grol: khrom gzigs me 'bar bla mtsho nas 'jam dpal dug ri'i chos skor: rkung lung g.yu mtsho nas dam rdzas gsang gter bka' rgya 'ga' zhig: bal phu yar 'brog mtsho nas bla ma rig 'dzin chos skor la sogs te gter bdag gter gnas khyad 'phags can de rnams nas:

sku tshab shog ser dam rdzas phyag mtshan la sogs pa zab gter khyad 'phags du ma can spyan drangs shing : khyad par sbas yul yar 'brog mtsho mo nas: bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil non gyi chos skor gyi sgrom bu gter sgrom mthong ba don ldan: rgyu bram ze snying po'i dbu klad las grub pa: rin po che ru bya'i mdog las grub pa'i mdangs ldan sgo gsum dang ldan pa: sgo dang po rdzogs chen bla med snying po: zhi khro na rag dong sprugs: phyi rgyud theg pa rim dgu dang bcas nas bzhugs pa: sgo bar ma la bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs rgyud lung man ngag las mtha' dang bcas pa bzhugs pa: sgo 'og ma dregs pa'i srog thig nag po man ngag las mtha' dang bcas pa bzhugs pa: de'i cha lag sku tshab pad+ma mthong grol: dam rdzas khro 'dus ril bu: a thaṃ ma bsgoms sangs rgyas: phyag mtshan rdo rje rtse dgu: las phur bdud dpung zil gnon: mkhan slob gsum gyi na bza': gos ber mtsho rgyal dbu skra: gzhan yang gsang gter 'ga' zhig dang bcas pa gdan drangs shing : gdul bya rnams smin grol la bkod par mdzad pa yi: rig 'dzin chen po de nyid kyi zab gter tshe sgrub chen po 'chi bdag zil gnon gyi dbang bskur ba yin te: de la yang byin rlabs kyi bla ma brgyud pa ni: nye brgyud dang ring brgyud gnyis las: ring brgyud ni 'dir spyi lung chen po ltar: chos sku kun tu bzang po: longs sku rgyal ba rigs lnga: drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen: ston pa rdo rje sems dpa': gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje: sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje: rig 'dzin rdo rje chos mchog: rig 'dzin lha dbang brgya byin: rig 'dzin klu rgyal 'jog po: dza in+d+ra bho dhi: mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo: slob dpon brgyad kyi rgyud lung gcig tu dril ba mkhas mchog 'jam dpal bshes gnyen: rig 'dzin shrī singha: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas: bal po bha su dha ra:

gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes: nye brgyud gsang ba ltar na: chos sku snang ba mtha' yas: longs sku 'jigs rten dbang phyug: sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes: gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje: des bdag la gnang ba'o: zhes sogs sbyar: dbang 'di yi skabs su nye rgyud ltar 'jug par rigs so: de ltar dbang gi lo rgyus me tog phreng mdzes zhes bya ba 'di la: tshe sgrub rnam bzhi'i rgyud lung gcig tu dril ba yin zhing : rgyud 'chi bdag zil gnon: lung lcags kyi rgya mdud: man ngag rdo rje'i go khrab: lo rgyus pad+ma gsang thig: rnam bzhi chos gcig dril ba yin no: 'di yi tshig gong 'og gcod mtshams phran bu dang : rgyud gzhung gzhan gyi tshig cung zad ma gtogs gter gzhung dngos la tshig bslad spu tsam ma song zhing : de phyir yid ches pa yis gnad du zungs shig: sa ma ya: ྀatsha: 'di nyid rgyas bsdus dgos na rgyud lung man ngag lo rgyus bzhin: gang bab skabs dang bstun nas 'phrul bar bya'o: dbang chog ut+pa la yi 'grigs chags 'di nyid sbas gnas pad+ma bkod kyi nye 'dabs gsang sngags chos gling du lo ha badz+ra gyi sdes gter gzhung nas bsdus pa dge /bkra shis par shog/ // nga) ༈ tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: tshe 'dzin srog sgrub 'khor lo bzhugs so: 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: rig 'dzin srog sgrub 'khor lo'i gdams pa bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: sa ma ya: de yang rdzas dang bri thabs dus bstan te: dang po rdzas kyi rim pa 'di lta ste: dzā ti li shi sug smel a ru ra: gi waṃ rgya mtshal gur gum li khri dang : tsan dan dkar dmar dbang lag snying zho sha: dkar dmar byang sems rin chen sna lnga'i rdzas: bkra shis le brgan dar ram 'jam shog la:

rab ni rin chen zhun ma'i khu ba dang : yang na rgya mtshal rgya snag dag gis ni: bkra shis yar tshes bzang ba'i skabs su bris: 'bri tshe bzang ngan gang gis bar ma chod: yi ge dbu can tsheg med lhag chad spang : gdan dkar steng du zhal kha shar du gyu: rtsa sngags dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po yis: rab tu gnas shing lus la 'chang ba'i tshe: dus bzang yar tshes dge ba rab tu gces: lus la 'chang nas zhag bdun ma song bar: dbang po mi nyams srog bcad mi dge 'dzem: rgyun du mi 'bral dam du 'chang bar bya: sa ma ya: dang po thig rtsa len pa'i tshe: oṃ ga ṇi ka in+ḍa bha wi ta swā hā: de nas 'bri ba'i tshe: oṃ ak+ṣo dh+ri ka sa ti swa ra muṇ+ṭi swā hā: zhes lan gsum mam nyer gcig gis: dang po dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar: oṃ hūm̐ tshe bh+rūm̐: rdo rje'i rtsibs bzhir: oṃ bh+rūm̐: swā bh+rūm̐: ā bh+rūm̐: hā bh+rūm̐: de yang dkar ser dmar ljang mthing : rtsibs mchan la: ha bh+rūm̐: ri bh+rūm̐: ni bh+rūm̐: sa bh+rūm̐: de'i phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ ma hā gu ru pad+ma kā ra ā yur+dzñā na dzī wan dza ya ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa ṇi ma ma tshe bh+rūm̐ g.yu bh+rūm̐ trām̐ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra tsakra hūm̐: bdag 'chang ba po'i tshe dang bsod nams thams cad rgyas par gyur cig: oṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: de'i phyi rol 'dab bzhi la: oṃ badz+ra ā yur+dzñā na hrīḥ oṃ rat+na ā yur+dzñā na hrīḥ oṃ pad+ma ā yur+dzñā na hri'aḥ oṃ karma ā yur+dzñā na hrīḥ rtsibs mchan la: oṃ rā ga ra ti dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ra ti dzaḥ oṃ dhe wa ra ti dzaḥ oṃ tā re ra ti dzaḥ de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na a nu bha wa aṣa tsar+ya ma hā pra mo ti ri su khaṃ a pa ra mi ta a tsar+ya ak+ṣo bh+ya aṣ+ṭa mnyaṭa sa ti ā' yur dharma pā ti a tiṣ+ṭha na sid+dhi dza dzaḥ 'dir 'dod gsol bsgyur: de'i phyi rol rtsibs brgyad la: oṃ a ṇi hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ dzaḥ

rtsibs mchan la: oṃ rā ga su khaṃ dza dzaḥ de'i phyi rol du: oṃ badz+ra ā yur+dzñā na tsit+ta hri dha ya pā da te dz+wa ra dza ya swā hā: dbyangs gsal gyi mthar: bdag 'chang ba po la brtan g.yo snang srid kyi tshe bsod thams cad 'dus shing rgyas par gyur cig swā hā: de'i phyi rol du: oṃ hūm̐ ā yur+dzñā na badz+ra pad+ma rā ga lak+ṣa ṇa su khaṃ ma hā puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rten 'brel snying po'i mthar: bdag 'chang ba pos snang srid lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'dus par gyur cig pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: de yi phyi rol rdo rwa'i gur: de yi phyi rol g.yung drung gur: de yi phyi rol me ri'i gur: rab gnas sngags ni: oṃ a bh+yā naṇ+ṭaṃ tiṣ+ṭha pā dhe badz+ra ye swā hā: zhes pas rab tu gnas: bkra shis la: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na dha ra ḍāk+ki lak+ṣa su khaṃ pa ti ye maṅga laṃ a swā hā: brgya'am stong gis me tog 'thor: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug mchog: 'chi med tshe yi 'khor lo 'di: gang gis 'chang ba'i skal ldan la: 'chi ba rnam brgyad mi 'byung zhing : pha rol rgol ba dag kyang zhi: gzhan gyis byams shing thams cad 'du: tshe bsod dbang thang longs spyod rgyas: snyan grags dpal du rab 'bar nas: bkra shis 'dod don lhun gyis 'grub: de bas 'di nyid shin tu gces: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra u rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lor tsā ri zil chen gsang phug nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos 'khor gling du shog ser las dag par zhal bshus so/ bkra shis// // ca) ༈ tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil non las: man ngag gnad kyi gdams pa bzhugs so: 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: 'chi med tshe sgrub za yig bstan: 'di nyid bri ba'i lag len ni: rgya shog 'jam pa'i ngos dag la: rgya snag gam ni rgya mtshal gyis: yi ge dbu can tsheg med bris:

dus bzang tshes bcu dag la brtsam: rdzas kyi rim pa bstan pa ni: khye'u lo brgyad byang sems dang : bud med mtshan ldan bcu gsum ma'i: zla mtshan sbyar te ga pur dang : rgya mtshal li khri cu gang dang : tsan+dan dkar dmar bcas pa nyid: zhib tu 'thag ste legs par byug: dus bzang dag gi mgo la za: za yig tshe dpag yab yum bsgoms: snying dbus pad+ma'i steng du gsal: zhag bdun bar du srog gcod spang : mal sa mgo mjug ldog mi bya: grib dang mi gtsang rnams kyang 'dzems: sa ma ya: dang po sngags ni 'di ltar 'god: snga dro za: nyin phyed za: dgong mo za: 'di rnams thams cad mjug nas yar dril: rab gnas tshe gzungs sngags ring bya: zab pa'i yang snying bla na med: gzhan la ma spel sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan gter bdag gling pas tsā ri nas gdan drangs te shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ slar yang yi ge pa ni chos nyid bdud 'dul rtsal gyis bgyis pa'o// // cha) ༈ tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: 'pho ba dpag chen mda' mo bzhugs: nasga nasacad+yan : ma bsgoms par sangs rgyas pa'i gdams pa 'pho ba dpag chen mda' mo zhes bya ba dbyings rig gcig tu bsre ba'i thabs: lus ngan lus bzang 'jug cing 'pho ba'i thabs: mtsho rgyal gyis gdams pa nyung ngu don bsdus gsal gdab kyi dmigs rim phran bu'i skor la: rang nyid gnas 'gyur mkha' 'gro ma: ye shes mtsho rgyal dran rdzogs su: dkar mo bcu drug lo lon tshul: snang stong sgyu ma'i sku ru bsgom: skad cig snying dbus g.yung drung steng : rlung sems ngo bo rgya sran tsam: dbu ma'i lam nas dpag chen mda' 'phangs ltar: rigs bdag gu ru pad+ma'i thugs kar 'phros: dmigs pa zhal shes: e maḥ mkha' dbyings spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan: gu ru snang srid zil gnon gyis: bde chen 'khor lo'i chos sgo phyes: myur lam mkha' spyod gnas su drongs: zung 'jug 'od lnga'i pho brang nas:

mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mo yis: longs spyod 'khor lo'i rtsa sgo phyes: skal ldan tshe 'das zhes kha bsgyur bas 'thus/ thar pa'i lam la drongs: mi 'gyur g.yung drung mkha' dbyings su: rig 'dzin hūm̐ nag drag rtsal gyis: chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa sgo phyes: skal ldan thar pa'i lam la drongs: myur du sangs rgyas thob pa yi: 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs: phaṭḥ rang nyid sbyang na hikaḥgis bskul: ma bsgoms sangs rgyas gdams pa'o: zhes tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon gyi/ khog byung mkha' 'gro'i gsang rgya 'di/ o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i gter ma'o// // ja) tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: dbang chen ut+pa la'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: de yang tshe sgrub rnam bzhi'i dbang don gcig tu bsgril ba 'chi bdag zil gnon gyi dbang chen ut+pa la'i phreng ba zhes bya ba dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba yin te: de la dgos ched lag len man ngag gdams pa ni: thig rdul tshon: dkyil 'khor gyi rnam dbye rdzas kyi bkram lugs sogs spyi gzhung pra khrid ltar dang : slob dpon gyi phyag len mthong brgyud ltar: sngon du 'gro zhing zab gnad kyi man ngag rnams lag len du khel bar bya'o: rdo rje slob dpon zhi ba'i rgyan dgu: drag po'i chas dgu dang : dgos ched kyi rdzas rnams bsham zhing dbang gi sta gon la 'jug pa ni: slob bu rnams gos dkar gyon te sgrub khang gi phyi nas bskor ba lan gsum bya: de nas sgo drung du bgegs gtor bsngo zhing shar sgo'i phyi rol du: ging dkar nag gis rdo thun brab cing bgegs bskrad: me chus mtshams bcad: de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis zab lam ye shes lnga yi dkyil 'khor du 'khrid pa ni: slob ma rnams kyis sgo drung nas 'di ltar zhu: kyaiḥ mi shigs rdo rje'i thugs ldan pa: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i che mchog bdag:

khrag 'thung dpa' bo dgongs su gsol: gzhan yang ye shes las grub pa: dbang phyug ging dang laṅka dang : gter bdag chos skyong dam can tshogs: sgo skyong srung ma dgongs su gsol: bdag cag skal ldan dam tshig can: las dang smon lam ldan byed de: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sgo nang du: 'jug cing dbang mchog bskur du gsol: bdag cag skal ldan e ma hoḥ zhes lan gsum zhu: de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis: hoḥ gsang 'dus 'chi med rdo rje yi: pho brang dbyings kyi bdag nyid ma: nga ni che mchog dbang gi rgyal: drag rtsal dkyil 'khor gsum dang ldan: las dang skal ldan khyod yin na: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nang 'jug rung : gang zhig sngags la mi mos shing : gnyis 'dzin log lta'i gnas ma yin: de nas slob mas: hoḥ bdag ni rdo rje'i dam tshig tu: ngo mtshar gsang ba'i pho brang la: legs mos skal ldan rjes su zungs: dam tshig dpral ba'i mig ltar bsrung : de nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs yol ba phyes nas phyag gsum 'tshal zhing : dam tshig gi smon lam ni: e ma hoḥ yang gsang sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor tshogs: 'chi med rig 'dzin rgyal sras la: deng bzung byang chub bar du skyabs: bdag gzhan don gnyis lhun grub nas: dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog:

ces phyag 'tshal zhing maṇ+ḍal bcas nas gral du 'khod: de nas slob mas: hoḥ bla med dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i mchog: snang mtha' 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku: zab gsang tshe yi dkyil 'khor du: skal ldan slob ma smin mdzad phyir: gtso bos rjes bzung byin brlabs nas: 'jug cing dbang mchog bskur bar stsol: de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis: khyed cag skal ldan las can la: dbang bskur smin grol 'jug par bya: khyed rnams legs gnang bka' ru bsgom: de nas slob bu rnams kyis: mchod pa thogs la: kyaiḥ bla med yang gsang che ba'i mchog: snang mtha' 'chi med tshe yi dal: sra brtan thabs mchog 'jug pa'i lam: rig 'dzin tshe yi dal 'jug stsol: de nas me tog thogs nas: dkyil 'khor du dor ba ni: dzaḥ shar phyogs sgo ma lcags kyu ma: dkar mo tshe bdag 'bum gyis bskor: dam tshig las kyi dbang mo ches: pho brang shar du 'jug pa'i tshe: tshe rabs yi dam lha dang sprod: hūm̐ḥ lho phyogs sgo ma zhags pa ma: ser mo tshe bdag 'bum gyis bskor: dam tshig las kyi dbang mo ches: pho brang lho ru 'jug pa'i tshe: tshe rabs yi dam lha dang sprod: baṃḥ nub phyogs sgo ma lcags sgrog ma: dmar mo tshe bdag 'bum gyis bskor: dam tshig las kyi dbang mo ches: pho brang nub tu 'jug pa'i tshe: tshe rabs yi dam lha la sprod: hoḥ byang phyogs sgo ma dril bu ma: ljang mo tshe bdag 'bum gyis bskor: dam tshig las kyi dbang mo ches: pho brang byang du 'jug pa'i tshe: tshe rabs yi dam lha la sprod: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gsang chen tshe yi dal: 'chi med 'ja' lus gur khang du: 'dun pa'i me tog 'di dor bas: dkyil 'khor lha dang bdag sprod cig: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe badz+ra ma nu ha pū dza hoḥ zhes phyogs bzhi nas dbus su dor: de nas so shing thogs nas: hoḥ gsang ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du: dam tshig bla med brtan pa'i phyir: so shing 'di nyid dor bar bya: las bzhi phrin las rtags ltar sprod:

oṃ hrī badz+ra ha ri ni sa hūm̐: de nas phyogs bzhi dbus lnga gang du babs pa rang rang gi las 'grub: 'phar na bshags pa dang bskang ba tshogs brgya bya: de nas bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis bum chu byin gyis brlabs te slob bu rnams la khrus bya ba ni: hūm̐: 'di ni dam tshig gsang ba'i chu: ye shes khrus mchog bla med rdzas: skal ldan tshe rabs da lta'i bar: shes bya nyon mongs bag chags bkru: oṃ badz+ra bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas srung skud dkar dmar gnyis dril la: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na nṛ tsakra satwaṃ: de nas pho g.yas mo g.yon dpung par 'dogs: hoḥ mi shigs 'khor lo rtags kyi rgya: ā yur tshe yi g.yung drung gis: mi shigs rdo rje'i mkha' ltar gdab: cis kyang mi shigs rak+sha hūm̐: zhes btags: de nas ku sha 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la rgya gram bcings nas gtad: hūm̐: sngon tshe rgyal sras rig 'dzin gyis: rtswa mchog la stan dngos grub thob: 'di dag gtad pas sngas su zhog: rtags tshad rmi lam brtag par gyis: zhes ku sha gtad: de nas sdig sgrib sbyang phyir rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom lung 'bog pa ni: hūm̐: rang rig spyi bor nyi zla seng khri'i steng : bcom ldan rdor sems shel sgong dwangs ma'i mdog: rdor dril bsnol thabs snyems ma yum dang sbyor: rdo rje skyil krung longs spyod phrin las rdzogs: thugs ka'i hūm̐ mthar yig brgyas g.yas g.yon bskor: bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bdag lus ltem gyis gang : tshe rabs bag chags kun dag 'od lus bsgom: oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya: tshang bar bzlas: de nas rten 'brel rmi lam brtag pa ni: rtswa mchog de dum bu gnyis bya zhing sngas pa dang mjug tu bzhag: nub mo seṅge nyal stabs kyis dkyil 'khor la mgo bstan nas gsol ba btab ste gnyid log: rmi lam bzang rtags byung na las dang ldan zhing las 'phro bzang ba'i brda:

rmi lam ngan na las 'phro med pa'o: chos skyong mi mnyes pa yin pas: tshogs bsham skong bshags legs par ma byas na: dbang bskur bgyis kyang byin rlabs mi 'jug: de bas rten 'brel rmi lam yang shin tu gtso che: 'di'i yan sngon 'gro sta gon gyi byed las so: sa ma ya: de nas dngos gzhi'i dbang la 'jug pa ni: slob ma rnams gos dkar gyon zhing gral la 'khod: bgegs bskrad srung 'khor bsgom zhing khrus chab bstsal: maṇ+ḍal phyi nang gsang gsum rgyas par phul: de nas bum pa thogs la: dam chu sbyin pa ni: hūm̐: 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: de ring khyod la 'di dag sbyin: dam tshig nyams na gshin rje yi: lcags sdig nag pos snying khrag 'jib: bsrungs na 'ja' lus 'chi med kyis: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'grub: oṃ sa ma ya in+te na ra kan: de nas slob ma rnams phyag thal mo sbyar nas: kyaiḥ gsang ba mchog gsum dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag skal ldan las can te: 'jug cing yang dag dbang bskur stsol: smin grol zab lam myur thob shog: ces rang lus maṇ+ḍal dang bcas nas zhu'o: de nas slob dpon gyis: hoḥ e ma ngo mtshar khyad du 'phags: tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i lam: 'chi med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di: ya mtshan 'og min zhing dang mnyam: kun gyi yang zab dkyil 'khor mchog: rta rmig lcags kyis g.yogs nas kyang : 'jig rten btsal kyang rnyed mi 'gyur: des kyang khyed cag skal par ldan: de nas slob mas mi 'da' ba'i dam tshig dang bcas nas: kyaiḥ bla ma sangs rgyas mchog tu rig: dam tshig rdo rje srog tu gces: bdag cag sngon gyi 'phro mtha' sad: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bskur du gsol: de nas slob dpon gyis: hoḥ de ltar yin na las 'phro ldan: skal ldan bsod nams legs par bsags: smin pa'i dbang mchog bdag gis bskur: dkyil 'khor gzhal yas 'di la ltos: de nas slob ma rnams la mig dar g.yogs nas 'di skad zhu'o:

kyeḥ bdag cag ma rig las ngan gyis: bag chags sgrib g.yogs 'thug po bsgribs: khyed nyid ye shes spyan gyi bdag: bdag gi ma rig ling thog phyes: de nas slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang gser thur thogs la: hoḥ sa mkhan thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'chang : nga ni rig pa he ru kaḥ khyed kyi ma rig sgrib mun bsal: dag pa ye shes spyan ldan shog: badz+ra tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭḥ zhes mig dar grol: de nas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor ngo sprad pa ni: hoḥ skal ldan gyi skyes bu rnams legs par ltos: bla ma gsang ba'i pho brang chen po 'di nyid kyi: brda don dkrol zhing ngo sprad pas: dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dmar la mdangs kyi lte ba rgyas pa ni: snang mtha'i dbyings la 'gyur ba med pa'i brda: kha dog legs shing bkra la mdzes pa ni: 'ja' lus rdo rje 'chi med ston pa'i brda: lnga ldan rtsig pa phra zhing rgyas pa ni: ye shes lnga ldan klong lnga zang thal mtshon pa'i brda: 'dod snam dmar po lha mo'i mchod sprin gtibs pa ni: phyogs dus rgyal kun mnyes mchod dgyes pa'i brda: pha gu gser zhing ser la dwangs pa ni: gzhal yas khang la 'dod rgu mtshon pa'i brda: mun nag drwa ba'i rgyan 'phyang mdzes pa ni: ma rig sgrib bsal shes rab lta mdzes brda: mda' yab dkar po pu shu bkram pa ni: rnam dag a ti phyogs ris bral ba'i brda: ka ba ka rgyan rang mdog mdzes rgyan 'di: tshad med bzhi ldan dran rdzogs gsal pa'i brda: ku gur nag la bsnums shing 'khyil ba 'di: bag chags a 'thas sgrib g.yogs bral ba'i brda: rta babs rnam bzhi 'byung lnga brtsegs thabs ni: ye shes gzhal yas longs sku'i rtsal snang brda: chos 'khor bang rim bcu gsum brtan pa ni: mi shigs rdo rje bcu gsum mtshon pa'i brda: ri dwags pho mos chos sgra nyan pa ni: nyan thos theg dman sa lam gong bgrod brda: pho brang rdzas brgyad rtag kun sbreng ba ni: longs sku tshe bdag zad bral 'byed pa'i brda:

rdo rje'i rmang gzhi sra mkhregs ldan pa ni: ye shes dbyings la g.yo med brtan pa'i brda: pad phreng dur khrod rdo rwa mdzes pa ni: phrin las bzhi ldan 'gro ba 'dul ba'i brda: me ri lnga ldan phyogs su 'khrigs pa ni: tshe dus bdud kyi bar chad gzhom pa'i brda: nang du tshe lha yongs rdzogs bzhugs pa ni: sprul sku sna tshogs rang rtsal 'gyed pa'i brda: ma 'dres dbyings la 'ja' ltar shar ba ni: gang 'dul der ston 'gro ba 'dul ba'i brda: stong nyid rang sgra 'dzab dbyangs sgrogs pa ni: tshe yi rig 'dzin mi zad rgyun 'byung brda: gzhan yang phyogs bzhi bum pa bhan+dha dang : me long dkyil 'khor rgyal mtshan bzhi ldan ni: dbyings kyi pho brang sprul skur 'byung ba'i brda: ral gri phur pa me long mda' dar dang : tshon skud drwa ba stag sham rgyan 'phyang du mas brgyan pa ni: chos sku'i rtsal snang longs sku zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i brda: de ltar ngo mtshar mchog gi pho brang du 'jug cing : dbang rtags las kyi gsang mtshan btags pa skal pa shin tu che'o: de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis cod pan thogs nas: hūm̐: mdzes pa'i rgyan ldan cod pan 'di dag ni: skal ldan skyes bu khyod kyi spyi bor brgyan: tshe rabs 'di nas ma 'ongs dus kun tu: dam tshig las kyi ming 'di legs par zungs: zhes gtad: de nas dkyil 'khor gyis khyed kyi ming gang yin 'dri'o: slob mas: 'chi med pad+ma'i snying po yin zhes smra'o: de nas rgyud ma dag pa sbyang phyir dag pa lha yi bskyed rim 'bog pa ni: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las spyi bo'i gtsug tu pad+ma nyi zla 'od du 'bar ba'i steng du: 'chi med tshe yi bdag po pad+ma rā ga'i mdog can zhal gsum dmar chags dkar bzhad mthing la dgyes 'dzum ste bag dro ldan pa: dbu la longs sku'i rgyan dang cod pan 'phur ba: phyag drug g.yas gsum rdo rje rin chen 'khor lo 'dzin cing :

g.yon gsum pad+ma rgya gram tshe bum bsnams pa: dar tshon bklubs shing skyil krung gis bzhugs te: gsang ye dmar mo mda' dar bhan+dha 'dzin pas mgul nas 'khyud pa'o: phyogs bzhir tshe bdag rig 'dzin yab yum sgo skyong dang bcas pa snang la rang bzhin bral bar sgoms shig: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs spyan drangs: de nas rol mo sna tshogs spos bcas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: mkha' spyod klong yangs nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor nas: lhag pa'i lha mchog rig 'dzin tshe dpag med: 'chi med mgon po yab yum rol rtsal mchog: mgyogs ma la sogs dbang phyug tshe bdag rnams: byin chen dbab phyir thugs dam dbyings nas bskul: sku yi gzi brjid 'od 'phro chi li li: gsung gi sgra dbyangs snyan char kyu ru ru: thugs kyi dgongs brda ma 'gags sha ra ra: mdzes pa'i lha rdzas rgyan 'phyang spungs se spung : ma tshogs mkha' 'gro brda gar lings se ling : dpa' bo rig 'dzin gar thabs shigs se shig: tshe yi las byed pho nya khyugs se khyug: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho byin rlabs me re re: dam rdzas rgya mtsho bcud ldan kyi li li: skal ldan dad mos snang ba sangs se sang : dam ldan pho mo dga' spro ya la la: dbang chen pho brang zer thag sbrengs se sbreng : bgegs srin dam sri tshar gcod lams se lam: dbang bzhi chu bo rgyun 'bab na ra ra: skal ldan bu la byin 'bebs thibs se thib: gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin chen myur du phob: 'chi med sgrub la rig 'dzin stsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya a be sha ya phaiṃ phaiṃḥ dza dzaḥ de nas ye shes pa brtan phyir rdo rje rgya gram gyis: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hrī dha ya tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: zhes pas brtan par bya: de nas slob mas 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod: hoḥ bla ma rig 'dzin dbyings nas gshegs: skal ldan mos pa'i bu la bzhugs: sgo gsum phyag 'tshal dbang pos mchod:

sdig bshags 'gro don chos 'khor bskor: dbang gis smin grol dngos grub stsol: de nas slob dpon gyis rim bzhin dbang gi tshig don ngo sprad cing phyag len mthong rgyud ltar bya: de nas bum pa thogs te: hūm̐: bum pa yang gsang tshe yi mkha': bdud rtsi 'chi med ngo bo'i lha: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: bskyed rim sku yi dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas bhan+dha thogs la: hūm̐: bhan+dha dbyings phyug gsang ba'i mkha': bdud rtsi dam tshig shes rab dngos: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: gnyis med gsang dbang thob par shog: oṃ badz+ra wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas me long thogs la: hūm̐: chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid: skye 'gag bral ba 'chi med lha: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: yang dag rdzogs rim dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐: 'chi med rdzas mchog rmad du byung : yon tan kun 'byung ngo bo nyid: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: phyi nang sgrub pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ gu na sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas sngags phreng thogs te: hūm̐: bla med dkyil 'khor bzung ba'i phyir: phrin las bzlas brjod sngags kyi phreng : skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: yongs rdzogs las mtha' thob par shog: oṃ gu h+ya karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas lha dbang rgyas pa bskur ba ni: tshe lha yab yum thogs la: hūm̐: rang byung dbyings rig longs spyod rdzogs: gsang ye shes rab gnyis med 'khril: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: 'chi med tshe yi dbang thob shog: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas sgo skyong thogs la: hūm̐: ye shes 'khor lo brdal khyab kyi: sgo skyong yab yum he ru kaḥ skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: bdud bzhi tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ pad+ma kro ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rdo rje tshe dpag med thogs la:

hūm̐: bcom ldan rdo rje tshe dpag med: yum mchog sangs rgyas spyan ma sbyor: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: rdo rje tshe yi dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rat+na tshe dpag med thogs la: hūm̐: bcom ldan rat+na tshe dpag med: gsang ba mā kī yum dang sbyor: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: rin chen tshe yi dbang thob shog: oṃ rat+na ā yu ṣe a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas pad+ma tshe dpag med thogs la: hūm̐: bcom ldan pad+ma tshe dpag med: gos dkar lha mo yum dang sbyor: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: pad+ma tshe yi dbang thob shog: oṃ pad+ma ā yu ṣe a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas karma tshe dpag med thogs la: hūm̐: bcom ldan karma tshe dpag med: yum mchog dam tshig sgrol ma sbyor: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: karma tshe yi dbang thob shog: oṃ karma ā yu ṣe a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rig 'dzin yab yum thogs la: hūm̐: rnam smin sar gnas tshe dbang sogs: gsang ba'i yum mchog drug dang sbyor: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog: oṃ bhi dho dha ra ā yu ṣe a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

de nas rig ma bcu drug thogs la: hūm̐: gsang ye rig ma bcu drug tshogs: mnyen lcug 'khril ldan gar stabs bsgyur: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: 'ja' lus tshe yi dbang thob shog: oṃ ḍāk+ki ā yu ṣe mu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas sgo ma bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: 'chi med bcud 'dzin pho nya mo: dkar ser dmar ljang mkha' 'gro bzhi: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: phrin las bzhi ldan dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas chas dbang rgyas par bskur ba ni: dang po prog zhu thogs la: hūm̐: ye shes lnga yi dbang rtags phyir: rin chen 'bar ba'i prog zhu 'di: de ring skal ldan spyi bor brgyan: lta ba ye grol dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra rat+na to sid+dhi ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas cod pan thogs la: hūm̐: sku lnga lhun grub dbang rtags phyir: dar tshon sna lnga'i cod pan 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi spyi bor brgyan: sgom pa rgya yan dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra mu ku ṭa dha ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas stod g.yogs thogs la: hūm̐: tshad med grol bzhi'i dbang rtags phyir: sna tshogs spel ba'i stod g.yogs 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi dpung par brgyan: spyod pa 'dzin med dbang thob shog: oṃ bhi dza ya ar+bha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas ga shal thogs la: hūm̐: bde stong zag med dbang bstan phyir: drwa ba 'phrul gyi ga shal te: skal ldan khyod kyi steng du brgyan: gnyis med zung 'jug dbang thob shog: om̐ rū pa kaṇ+ṭhi ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rus rgyan thogs te: hūm̐: phar phyin drug gi dbang rtags te: dur khrod rus pa'i rgyan cha 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi chas su brgyan: grol ba bzhi yi dbang thob shog: oṃ go ro tsa ya ma li ti a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas snyan rgyan sogs rin chen gdub bu rnams thogs la: hūm̐: rten 'brel sna tshogs dbang rtags phyir: skal ldan khyod kyi gzugs su brgyan:

sa lam rab rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ bhi shwa rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: smad dkris thogs la: hūm̐: 'khor 'das zil gnon dbang rtags phyir: bde chen klub pa'i ang rag 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi smad du dkri: 'bras bu ka dag dbang thob shog: oṃ a tra bha su pra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas gsang dbang rdzas dbang bskur ba ni: rdzas kyi pra khrid gzhung ltar bshams shing bskur ba ni: de nas rdzas lnga thogs la: hūm̐: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor gyi: khrag gi khams nas tshe nyams na: chu yi khams nas bcud bsdus la: skal ldan bdag gi spyi bor bstim: chu shel ha la tshe sba'o: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na kā ya ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: hūm̐: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor gyi: drod kyi khams nas tshe nyams na: me yi khams nas bcud bsdus la: skal ldan bdag gi mgrin par bstim: me shel a la tshe sba'o: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na wāk+ka ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: hūm̐: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor gyi: sems kyi khams nas tshe nyams na: nam mkha'i klong nas bcud bsdus la: skal ldan bdag gi snying khar bstim: baiḍūr nṛ la tshe sba'o: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na tsit+ta ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: hūm̐: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor gyi: sha yi khams nas tshe nyams na: sa yi khams nas bcud bsdus la: skal ldan bdag gi lte bar bstim: puṇ+ṭa pa la tshe sba'o: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na gu na ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: hūm̐: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor gyi: dbugs kyi khams nas tshe nyams na: rlung gi khams nas bcud bsdus la: skal ldan bdag gi gsang bar bstim: ke ru ha la tshe sba'o: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na gu h+ya ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: de nas sman lnga thogs la: hūm̐: ma rig dug lngas tshe nyams na: sman mchog lnga yi bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la bstim: ye shes lnga yi gter sba'o: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na pañtsa ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā:

de nas bcud kyi rdzas lnga thogs la: hūm̐: rtsa thig rlung lnga'i tshe nyams na: rdzas mchog lnga yi bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub la khyad par bstim: bde stong drod kyi tshe sba'o: oṃ su khaṃ swa bhā dz+wa la ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: de nas rig 'dzin lnga'i phyag mtshan thogs la: hūm̐: rdo rje tshe dpag ngo bo nyid: rig 'dzin dngul gyi me long 'di: a dār+sha ya tshe yi rten: bgres rgud med par tshe 'jug go: skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra ā yur+dzñā na ru bya a dār+sha tiṣ+ṭha nṛ bh+rūm̐ swā hā: hūm̐: pad+ma tshe dpag ngo bo nyid: rin chen tshe yi bum pa ni: sor rtog ye shes tshe yi rten: bgres rgud med pa'i tshe 'jug go: skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ pad+ma ā yur+dzñā na rā ga lak+ṣa nṛ bh+rūm̐ swā hā: hūm̐: bud+dha tshe dpag ngo bo nyid: rin chen mu tig cod pan 'di: chos dbyings ye shes tshe yi rten: bgres rgud med pa'i tshe 'jug go: skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ bud+dha ā yur+dzñā na mug ti ku mu ku ṭa tiṣ+ṭha nṛ bh+rūm̐ swā hā: hūm̐: rat+na tshe dpag ngo bo nyid: rin chen gser gyi 'khor lo 'di: mnyam nyid ye shes tshe yi rten: bgres rgud med pa'i tshe 'jug go: skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ rat+na ā yur+dzñā na swa na tsakra nṛ bh+rūm̐ swā hā: hūm̐: karma tshe dpag ngo bo nyid: rin chen g.yu yi rdo rje 'di: bya grub ye shes tshe yi rten: bgres rgud med pa'i tshe 'jug go: skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ karma ā yur+dzñā na bai ro tsa na badz+ra nṛ bh+rūm̐ swā hā: de nas rgyal srid sna bdun thogs la: hūm̐: tshe chos snyan grags spel ba 'di: 'khor lo rin chen rgyas gdab bo: longs spyod dpal 'byor char bzhin 'bebs: nor bu rin chen rgyas gdab bo: srid dang mnga' thang char bzhin 'bebs: btsun mo rin chen rgyas gdab bo:

khams gsum dbang bsdus bran du bkol: blon po rin chen rgyas gdab bo: brjid chags bang khang phyugs kyi rdzas: glang po rin chen rgyas gdab bo: rtsal chen phrin las myur mgyogs ldan: rta mchog rin chen rgyas gdab bo: bdud bzhi bar gcod log 'dren gzhom: dmag dpon rin chen rgyas gdab bo: rgol ba tshar gcod dpa' rtsal ldan: phyag rgya bdun gyis rgyas gdab bo: brtan cing rab tu gnas gyur cig: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na dza ye puṇ+ye sa bha su pra tiṣ+ṭha bh+rūm̐ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swā hā: de nas bkra shis rtags brgyad thogs la: hūm̐: mi nub rgyal mtshan rin po che: skal ldan lus la bkra shis shog: tshangs dbyangs chos dung rin po che: skal ldan ngag la bkra shis shog: byang sems dpal be'u rin po che: skal ldan yid la bkra shis shog: gser gyi 'khor lo rin po che: skal ldan zung 'jug bkra shis shog: dgos 'byung nor bu rin po che: skal ldan bsam 'phel bkra shis shog: kun khyab gdugs mchog rin po che: skal ldan mkha' khyab bkra shis shog: thabs shes gser nya rin po che: skal ldan don gyi bkra shis shog: skyon bral pad+ma rin po che: skal ldan rten 'brel bkra shis shog: bkra shis rtags brgyad don dang dgu: theg pa rim dgu'i bkra shis shog: oṃ maṅga la wa na a su pra tiṣ+ṭha ya bha wan+tu swā hā: de nas tshe'i ril bu dang 'brang rgyas thogs la: hūm̐: sngon byon drang srong rig 'dzin gyis: bla med mchog gi rdzas la brten: 'chi med tshe yi ril bu 'di: de ring skal ldan bu la sbyin: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas tshe chang thogs la: hūm̐: dam tshig ye shes mkha' 'gro yis: rang byung gsang ba'i rdzas la brten: 'ja' lus grub pa'i bdud rtsi nyid: de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta aṇ+ṭa sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas skabs 'dir byin rlabs bka' bsgo dbang bskur ba la gsum:

de yang rgyud lung man ngag gsum yin te lung gi bka' bsgo rjes su mdzad pa yin kyang da lam rgyud dang man ngag gi bka' bsgo yang gsang ltar na gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐: sngon tshe 'og min bde chen mkha' spyod du: snang mtha' mgon po gsang ba ye shes gnyis: zab dbyings 'od gsal dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i tshe bsgrubs pas: bgres rgud med pa'i rig 'dzin 'ja' lus grub: de yi byin rlabs dbang bskur deng 'dir stsol: de 'og gsang chen ma la 'bar ba'i gnas: rta mchog dbang chen rdo rje phag mo gnyis: khro rgyal stobs 'dus rtsa gsum zhal phyes nas: skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i tshe bsgrubs pas: bgres rgud med pa'i rig 'dzin 'ja' lus grub: de yi byin rlabs dbang bskur deng 'dir stsol: de 'og mā ra ti ka'i gnas mchog ru: pad+ma 'byung gnas man+da ra ba gnyis: yang gsang tshe yi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i tshe bsgrubs pas: bgres rgud med pa'i rig 'dzin 'ja' lus grub: de yi byin rlabs dbang bskur deng 'dir stsol: de 'og yang rdzong shel gyi brag phug tu: sangs rgyas ye shes dhe wa dha ra gnyis: zab gsang bla med dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i tshe bsgrubs pas: bgres rgud med pas rig 'dzin 'ja' lus grub: de yi byin rlabs dbang bskur deng 'dir stsol: de 'og tsā ri zil chen gsang ba'i gnas: gnam lcags rdo rje gsang ba'i rig ma gnyis: 'chi bdag zil gnon dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: 'chi med rig 'dzin rdo rje'i tshe bsgrubs pas: bgres rgud med pa'i rig 'dzin 'ja' lus grub: rlung sems rten 'brel 'khrul 'khor gnad du pheb: de yi byin rlabs dbang bskur deng 'dir stsol: hūm̐: sngon dus tshe yi khungs yang bzang : bar du bka' gtad smon lam zab: da lta rten 'brel gnad kyang 'grigs:

phyis 'byung mtshams sbyor 'phro mtha' btsan: de phyir sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin la: skye 'chi bgres rgud med par stsol: mnga' thang longs spyod snyan grags spel: chos dang brgyud 'dzin srid kyang skyongs: mchog dang thun mong dbang bskur stsol: oṃ: sku yi lha dbang lus la bskur: āḥ gsung gi sngags dbang ngag la bskur: hūm̐: thugs kyi chos dbang sems la bskur: hrīḥ yongs rdzogs dbang bskur bstsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhrī badz+ra ā yur+dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas mtha' rten tshe 'gugs shing rgyas gdab pa ni: mda' dar thogs la: hūm̐: shar gyi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: phyag na lcags kyu mda' dar 'dzin: mgyogs ma dkar mo bye ba 'bum: 'byung lnga gling bzhi'i bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la bstim: skye 'chi bgres rgud med par stsol: hūm̐: lho yi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: phyag na zhags pa mda' dar 'dzin: mgyogs ma ser mo bye ba 'bum: 'byung lnga gling bzhi'i bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la bstim: skye 'chi bgres rgud med par stsol: hūm̐: nub kyi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: phyag na lcags sgrog mda' dar 'dzin: mgyogs ma dmar mo bye ba 'bum: 'byung lnga gling bzhi'i bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la bstim: skye 'chi bgres rgud med par stsol: hūm̐: byang gi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: phyag na dril bu mda' dar 'dzin: mgyogs ma ljang mo bye ba 'bum: 'byung lnga gling bzhi'i bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la bstim: skye 'chi bgres rgud med par stsol: hūm̐: dbus kyi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: phyag na mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: mgyogs ma sngon mo bye ba 'bum: 'byung lnga gling bzhi'i bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la bstim: skye 'chi bgres rgud med par stsol: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na sid+dhi dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas rgyas gdab pa ni:

mda' dar gnas lngar reg cing : hūm̐: dang po chos dbyings nyag gcig rgya: gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgya: gsum pa sku gsung thugs kyi rgya: bzhi pa tshad med bzhi yi rgya: lnga pa ye shes lnga yi rgya: drug pa rig 'dzin drug gi rgya: bdun pa sangs rgyas rab bdun rgya: brgyad pa nye ba'i sras brgyad rgya: dgu pa theg pa rim dgu'i rgya: bcu pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rgya: yab yum bcu yi rgyas btab pas: nam yang mi 'gyur brtan pa yi: yang dag ye shes gter sba'o: om̐ ā yur+dzñā na tiṣ+ṭha ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: zhes rgyas gdab cing : rjes su bkra shis brjod cing me tog 'thor: de nas rjes shes lag len gyi dam tshig bstan pa ni: hoḥ deng 'dir khyed rang rnams kyi dbang chen u pa la'i phreng ba zhes bya ba thob pa yin pas: sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig dang mi 'bral zhing bsnyen sgrub 'bad rtsol 'chad rtsom sogs kyi phyi nang gi go rim byed du rung ba yin no: de nas dam tshig khas len gyi rjes zlos bya ba ni: hoḥ gtso bos ci ltar bka' stsal pa: de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi: khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na: khyed kyi slob mar bzung ba dang : cha yi kyang ni spyad du gsol: zhes lan gsum gyis dam bca'o: de nas bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul: tshe'i dam tshig gzhung bzhin bsrung : spang bya rnams kyang rgyud ltar bya'o: sa ma ya: bdud bzhi dpung bcom 'chi med sgrub pa'i dbang : zab gsang gdams pa bzhi skor man ngag mchog: smin grol rgyud lung gcig dril chu bo'i rgyun: skal ldan rgyud rnams grol zhing mngon rdzogs shog: ces pa tshe sgrub rnam bzhi'i man ngag gcig tu dril ba zab khyad khyad 'phags can yin zhing : lung dang mthun pa'i rnal 'byor skal ldan ma gtogs snod min gang rung la bskur mi rung : khyad par rdzas dbang rnams ni yang gsang gi dbang yin pas: bsgrub pa'i bdag 'jug len pa dang :

gnad 'gag che ba ma gtogs mi bskur: dbang chen 'di lan gcig thob pas 'chi med mgon po pad 'byung gi bka' bzhin 'byung bar gdon mi za: 'di nyid bka' yi rjes gnang ma thob pa'i: bka' rku ba lung dkrugs pa rang mthong can rnams kyi lag tu ma shor cig: gal srid shor na bka' srung dregs pa mthu rtsal can rnams kyis snying khrag dron mo dga' ston du rol cig sa ma ya: ྀatsha: tshe sgrub rnam bzhi'i rgyud tshig rdo rje'i glu dbyangs kyi rtsa tho zung 'brel bcas/ bdud 'dul sngags gling du rdo rje bdud 'dul rtsal gyis bgyis pa dge'o// // nya) ༄༅/ tshe sgrub yang snying 'chi bdag zil gnon las: dbang 'bring 'ja' tshon phreng ba bzhugs so: 'chi med rig 'dzin pad 'byung sku la 'dud: e maḥ bdag 'dra pad 'byung gis: dbang mchog 'ja' tshon phreng ba bstan: zab rgya thugs kyi ti la kaḥ las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: thog mar dbang gi chas bsags pa ni: bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings tshang ba'i nang du bum rdzas nyer lnga chu dang sbyar te sum gnyis bkang : rigs lnga bhan+dha shel phreng tsakli tshe gtor sogs gzhung bzhin bshams: las byang gzhung bsrangs grub rjes su: slob ma khrus bya gos dkar g.yogs nas gral du 'khod: maṇ+ḍal phul nas 'di skad zhus:

kyai: 'chi med rig 'dzin tshe yi bdag: gsang ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag skal ldan 'jug tu gsol: bla mas: hoḥ khyed rnams dam tshig ldan lags sam: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i pho brang 'di: dam med rnams la bstan mi bya: slob mas: kyaiḥ nged rnams sngon sbyangs las can ste: lam mchog 'dir mos dam la gnas: srog la bab kyang mi 'da' 'tshal: de nas bum pa thogs te dam chu sbyin: hūm̐: 'di ni dam tshig bla med chu: bsrungs na 'chi med rig 'dzin thob: nyams na dmyal ba'i sa bon nyid: de bas dam srungs chu 'di 'thung : oṃ sa ma ya i dan+te na ra kan: de nas ma dag pa rgyud sbyang phyir bskyed rim 'bog pa ni: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las spyi bo'i gtsug tu pad+ma nyi zla 'od du 'bar ba'i steng du: 'chi med tshe yi bdag po pad+ma rā ga'i mdog can zhal gsum dmar chags dkar bzhad mthing la dgyes 'dzum ste bag dro ldan pa: dbu la longs sku'i rgyan dang cod pan 'phur ba: phyag drug g.yas gsum rdo rje rin chen 'khor lo 'dzin cing : g.yon gsum pad+ma rgya gram tshe bum bsnams pa: dar tshon bklubs shing skyil krung gis bzhugs te: gsang ye dmar mo mda' dar bhan+dha 'dzin pas mgul nas 'khyud pa'o: phyogs bzhir tshe bdag rig 'dzin yab yum sgo skyong dang bcas pa snang la rang bzhin bral bar sgoms shig: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs spyan drangs: phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: slob mas: kyai: bla ma tshe dpag med pa yi: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bzhi stsol: slon dpon gyis: ho: dbang bskur rjes su gnang mdzad nas: dam tshig chen po la gnas pa'i: skal ldan smin par mdzad du gsol: de nas bum pa thogs te: hūm̐: bum pa yang gsang tshe yi mkha': bdud rtsi 'chi med ngo bo'i lha: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro:

bskyed rim sku yi dbang thob shog: oṃbadz+ra kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas bhan+dha thogs la: hūm̐: bhan+dha dbyings phyug gsang ba'i mkha': bdud rtsi dam tshig shes rab dngos: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: gnyis med gsang dbang thob par shog: oṃ badz+ra wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas me long thogs la: hūm̐: chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid: skye 'gag bral ba 'chi med lha: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: yang dag rdzogs rim dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐: 'chi med rdzas mchog rmad du byung : yon tan kun 'byung ngo bo nyid: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: phyi nang sgrub pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ gu na sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas sngags phreng thogs te: hūm̐: bla med dkyil 'khor bzung ba'i phyir: phrin las bzlas brjod sngags kyi phreng : skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: yongs rdzogs las mtha' thob par shog: oṃ gu h+ya karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rigs lnga thogs la: hūm̐: ye shes lnga ldan tshe yi lha: 'chi med yab yum gnyis su med: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: yongs rdzogs tshe yi dbang thob shog: om̐ ā yur+dzñā na pañtsa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas sgo ma bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: 'chi med bcud 'dzin pho nya mo: dkar ser dmar ljang mkha' 'gro bzhi: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: phrin las bzhi ldan dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas bkra shis rtags brgyad thogs te: hūm̐: rgyal mtshan dung dang dpal be'u: nor bu gser nya pad+ma dung : gdugs dang g.yung drung bum pa yis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: om̐ maṅga bhi shwa aṇ+ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas tshe'i ril bu dang 'brang rgyas thogs la: hūm̐: sngon byon drang srong rig 'dzin gyis: bla med mchog gi rdzas la brten: 'chi med tshe yi ril bu 'di: de ring skal ldan bu la sbyin:

oṃ ā yur+dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas tshe chang thogs la: hūm̐: dam tshig ye shes mkha' 'gro yis: rang byung gsang ba'i rdzas la brten: 'ja' lus grub pa'i bdud rtsi nyid: de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta aṇ+ṭa sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas mda' dar thogs la tshe 'gugs gzhan du gsal rgyas gtab ni: hūm̐: ting 'dzin mi shigs rdo rje yi: skal ldan gnas lngar rgya yis gdab: tshe srog g.yung drung brtan par tshugs: 'chi med 'ja' lus 'grub par shog: om̐ badz+ra maṇ+ṭa ra tri dzñā na pañtsa tiṣ+ṭha ye swā hā: de nas bka' bsgo bya: bkra shis brjod: me tog 'thor zhing slob ma la bstim par bya'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma: kho bo bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: yang zab dbang mchog 'ja' tshon phreng ba bzhag: ma 'ongs lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: tshe yi bar chad rkyen kha hrag pa'i tshe: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob pa'i rten 'brel chos: 'di yi dbang thob lung ltar sgrub pa rnams: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par the tshom med: de phyir sgrub la brtson zhing snying po longs: yang mtha' dus tshod nyi shu'i mgo tshugs tshe: pad+ma gter bdag gling dang 'phrad par shog: bka' yi rgya 'di kun dga' gzhon nus srungs: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: u rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos me sprel lor tsā ri zil chen gsang ba'i phug pa brag tshe bum 'dra ba'i logs nas gdan drangs shing pad+ma bkod tshal du shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ta) ༈ tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: tshe bdud zhags pa gcod pa'i gdams pa bzhugs so: 'chi med tshe yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo: sa ma ya: e maḥ rgya gar mkhas pa pad+ma 'byung gnas ngas: phyi rabs don du zab pa'i yang snying bstan: bdud bzhi tshe yi bar chad skyob byed pa: kun las khyad 'phags thugs tig gsang rgya can: gdams ngag mang yang man ngag 'di 'dra dkon:

gang phyir 'chi ltas phog gam rtsub rtags shar: 'byung bzhi mi snyoms nad rtags rmi lam dang : nyin mo phal cher lus zing shin tu skyo: phyi dro phal cher mi rtag lhang lhang dran: nub mo phal cher dngangs skrag mang du 'byung : sngar gyi lus gshis spyod 'gros phal cher 'gyur: don med mi rnams kun la dpyad ris byed: rang gshis rgod po 'jam na 'chi ba'i rtags: 'jam po rgod cing sdang na 'chi ba'i rtags: phal cher bzhin gyi bkrag mdangs nyams na 'chi: rgyun du snying rtsa 'phar na 'chi ba'i ltas: pho rtsa mo yis 'phrog na 'chi ba'i ltas: mo rtsa pho gdon zhugs na 'chi ba'i ltas: 'byung ba tsha grang go ldog 'chi ba'i ltas: mkhal rtsa mchin par ldang na 'chi ba'i ltas: snying rtsa mtsher par ldang na 'chi ba'i ltas: glo rtsa rgyu mar ldang na 'chi ba'i ltas: srog rtsa mkhris par ldang na 'chi ba'i ltas: srin rtsa pho khar ldang na 'chi ba'i ltas: rus bcud khrag la thim na 'chi ba'i ltas: mkhris pa khu bar thim na 'chi ba'i ltas: de phyir ma nges 'chi rtags sna tshogs kyis: lus kyi 'byung bzhi 'khrugs nas 'chi ltas phog: glo bur bar gcod bdud dang bsdong ba'i tshe: tshe bdud zhags pa gcod pa'i gdams pa gces: tshe zad dus la bab kyang ring du bsring : dus min 'chi ba'i bdud las rab tu bsgral: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: da lta spel ba'i gnas min sbas pa gnad: ma 'ongs yang mtha' nyi shu'i mgo tshugs tshe: tshe la long med bar chod rkyen gyis sdang : chos byed rnams kyang glo bur bdud kyis g.yeng : so so'i skye bo bsod nams rim par dman: sems can nyon mongs hrag pas ngan 'gror lhung : ma 'ongs de dus bod 'bangs skyob pa yi: tshe sgrub zab mo 'chi bdag zil gnon gyi: gnad kyi gdams pa zhun thig bzhag pa 'di: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya:

dang po bca' gzhi lag len ni: shin tu 'jam pa'i sa dag la: stegs bu 'dom bskor tshad du bya: de la thig chen bcu drug gdab: de steng srid pa'i rus sbal bkod: spar sme lo zla'i mtshon yang bsgyur: dbus su mañdzi khri yi khar: 'bru nag dpal gyi gtor ma bsham: de la mar rgyan rtsang yang 'dzugs: rus sbal mgo la phung bdud ser: rtsib g.yon nyon mongs bdud dmar po: mjug mar 'chi bdag bdud nag po: rtsib g.yas lha bu'i bdud dkar po: mtshams bzhir skye rga na 'chi bzhi: yan lag bzhi la sku glud bzhi: shar lhor pho nya lo yi gzugs: lho nub pho nya zla ba'i mgo: nub byang pho nya zhag gi mgo: byang shar pho nya dus kyi mgo: gzugs kyi yan lag de bzhin no: de yi phyi rol rim pa bzhin: pho mo gang yin glud dang ni: mar me changs bu ting lo dang : gtor chung sha dum 'brang rgyas rnams: thams cad bcu drug bcu drug go: de yi phyi rol rim pa bzhin: nam mkha' rgyang bu mda' dang 'phang : gri khram shing ris bcas pa rnams: thams cad bcu drug bcu drug go: de yi phyi rol mdos dkris rgyab: mdos gzhi de yi mdun du ni: snam bu 'dom pa bcu drug pa: dkar nag mtshams nas dmar pos sbrel: snam bu dkar po de yi steng : sngon mo 'bru yi g.yung drung bris: dkar po'i steng na rim pa bzhin: g.yung drung brgyad du dod par bya: nag po'i gdan gyi steng du ni: hom gzugs khram gyis bskor ba bris: nag po'i steng du rim pa bzhin: hom yang brgyad po 'bru nag bya: pho mo gang yin sbyin bdag ste: hom khung de yi mdun du nyal: snam bu dkar nag mtshams de ru: zangs ngam shing gi gzhong pa ru: zam pa phyed dkar phyed nag bya: zam pa dkar po de yi khar: nad pa'i bla rtags gang yin bzhag: zam pa nag po de yi khar: mi lus lo shing mgo can bzhag: bla rtags de yis 'khyer tshul gyis: zhags pa bzung ste 'khrid par bya: gzhan yang bla 'bod byed pa yi:

g.yas g.yon pho mo mang du 'tshogs: shel tshig khri dkar stong nag dang : khram shing pho mtshan mo mtshan dang : shwa rdel dkar nag la sogs pa: brgya yi grangs las ma nyung bya: gdan nag steng du nad pa'am: ma lcogs gzugs 'gros dkar po bzhag: gzhi dkar steng gi g.yung drung la: tshe dpag med kyi sku bshams nas: dar dkar thag pa'i bla rten bzung : tshe yi mda' dar de la btags: phye mar zas dkar sna tshogs bsham: gzhan yang mdos kyi phyogs bzhi na: snal ma bzhi yi thag pa ni: nad par btags pa'i tshul du bya: sa ma ya: yar gzhi dkar po dag gi steng : dpa' bo rta mgrin gdong gtor dang : tshe bum dang bcas dbang gtor bsham: phyi nang mchod pa gzhung bzhin no: tshe sgrub dang ni rta mgrin gyi: las byang rdzogs par sngags la bskyal: sa ma ya: dang po mdos gzhi chu gtsang gis bran la: oṃ sarba pra phywaṃ shwa dha na ye swā hā: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: de nas mdun bskyed pa ni: oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i mdun du: gling bzhi ri rab rol mtsho de la 'byung ba lnga yis bskor ba de la yongs su rdzogs pa: de yi dbus su ma hā gser sbal chen po gan rkyal du nyal ba'i mgo bo lhor bstan pa: de yi dbus su khro rgyal tshe bdag nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: shin tu khro zhing dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa: phyag g.yas dbyug pa dang g.yon pas lcags sgrog 'dzin pa: zhabs dor stabs dang ldan zhing bskal pa'i me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong du bzhugs pa: tshe bdud 'byung po thams cad dbang du bsdus shing zil gyis gnon par gyur: oṃ badz+ra tsan+ḍa aḥyu ṣe ma hā kro ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ hoḥ srid pa'i rus sbal chen po'i glo g.yas shing las grub pa'i steng du: lha'i bdud dkar po ral gri dang zhags pa 'dzin pa: mgo bo me las grub pa'i steng du: phung po'i bdud ser po ral gri dang khram shing 'dzin pa:

glo g.yon lcags las grub pa'i steng du: nyon mongs pa'i bdud dmar po ral gri dang nad rkyal thogs pa: mjug ma chu las grub pa'i steng du: 'chi bdag gi bdud nag po g.yas ral gri dang g.yon shwa rde'u thogs pa: shar lhor srid pa'i bud med nag mo skye ba'i sdug bsngal phru gu btsas pa: lho nub tu las kyi khyo gzugs rgas shing 'khog ste 'khar ba thogs pa: nub byang du na ba'i sdug bsngal gzhogs phab nas nyal ba: byang shar shi ba'i sdug bsngal bam ro gan rkyal: rus sbal gyi lag pa g.yas su lo rgyal po'i glud dkar po: lag pa g.yon du zla ba blon po'i glud ser po: rkang pa g.yas su zhag dmag mi'i glud dmar po: rkang pa g.yon du dus tshod mtshon cha'i glud nag po: de yi shar lhor lo bdud kyi pho nya lo bdag gi mgo can: 'di nas lo gang yin bsgyur dgos so: g.yas satwa re dang g.yon khram baṃ thogs pa: lho nub tu zla ba bdud gcod pho nya zla ba'i mgo can: gong bzhin: g.yas zor ba dang g.yon nad rkyal thogs pa: nub byang du zhag gi bdud gcod kyi pho nya zhag gi mgo can: gong ltar: g.yas tho ba dang g.yon zhags nag thogs pa: byang shar du dus tshod bdud gcod kyi pho nya dus tshod kyi mgo can: gong ltar/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon mi lag thogs pa: de'i phyi rol du sku glud rin chen bcu drug: mtshams rnams su rim pa bzhin mar me changs bu ting lo gtor chung sha dum 'brang rgyas te bcu drug bdun gyis bskor ba: de'i phyi rol du nam mkha' rgyang bu mda' bkra 'phang bkra gri dmar khram nag bzlog pa'i shing ris sna tshogs bcu drug bdun gyis bskor ba: de yi phyi rol du 'byung lnga'i rgya chings dang ldan pa: gzhan yang srid pa'i gtor glud yas la dbang ba'i mgron rnams kyis bskor ba gsal bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra ṭāk+ki rā dza hūm̐ dzaḥ de nas bden stobs brjod cing lan gsum 'gugs: na moḥ mchog gsum rtsa brgyud bla ma dang :
