yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam tshig can: sgrub pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya'i ting 'dzin gyi: bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs nus pa yis: bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag la: gnod par byed pa'i tshe bdud bar chod dang : lo zla zhag dus za ma dus tshod kyi: 'chi bdag las kyi pho nya bgegs rigs rnams: gtor glud gzugs brnyan 'di la mchis par gyur: oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ rat+na pā sha hūm̐: pad+ma s+pho ṭa baṃ: karma ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ de nas bden pa'i tshig bton cing glud rab gnas bya ba ni: (ka) hūm̐: nga ni thog ma'i sangs rgyas snang mtha' yas: nga ni mgon po 'chi med tshe yi bdag: nga ni dus gsum sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung : nga ni dbang chen khro rgyal he ru kaḥ nga ni srid gsum gdug pa sgrol ba'i mchog: nga ni snang srid kun gyi gnyen po che: 'chi bdag zhag dus lo zla'i pho nya rnams: mchog gsum dkon mchog bden pa'i bka' la nyon: ting 'dzin bla med sngags kyi don la ltos: sangs rgyas rkang gnyis gtso ste bden pa'i mchog: chos nyid chags dang bral te bden pa'i mchog: tshogs gnyis dge 'dun 'dus te bden pa'i mchog: deng 'dir 'dus pa'i rig 'dzin bden pa'i tshig: rtsa gsum bka' la mi nyan gang yang med: zab mo don la mi sems gang yang med: mna' dang khrims la mi 'dzem gang yang med: rgyu 'bras las la mi gzhig gang yang med: skye 'gro lam la mi bgrod gang yang med: rgya mtsho'i chu la mi 'thung gang yang med: 'phang ba'i srog la mi 'dzem gang yang med: byams pa'i tshig la mi mgu gang yang med: gdung ba'i gnyen la mi skyo gang yang med: de bas dam tshig bka' las 'da' ma byed: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ

gsum pa: (ga) hūm̐: tshogs drug 'khrul pa'i bdud rnams legs par nyon: bdag ni 'chi med khro rgyal he ru kaḥ bdud bzhi gcod pa'i ral gri rno dbal mchog: bar chod khyod kyis dbang du btang mi 'tshal: yon bdag 'di yi bla srog tshur thongs la: phyin chad 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig: bzhi pa: (ca) hūm̐: nyon cig rig 'dzin sngags 'chang tshig la nyon: nga ni dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos: nga yi tshig 'di mi shigs rdo rje'i gsung : rgyu 'bras las 'di 'khor 'das kun la khyab: mu stegs rnams kyang g.yung drung bon la nyan: brgya byin nag pos tshangs pa'i gsung la rtsi: ru tra sde dgu dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal 'jigs: thar pa nag pos tha ma rgyu 'bras bsam: bya rigs sna tshogs grib ma thang la 'gro: mkha' lding rgyal pos srid pa'i chu la 'thung : sgra gcan rlung gis nyon mongs rlung yang gcod: log lta can yang rgyu 'bras chos kyis grol: khrel med rnams kyang rang 'dod gnyen rnams skyong : bdud bzhi'i bar chad 'ja' lus 'grub ste zhi: dus la bab kyang bden pa'i tshig gis bsring : 'od gsal snying rjes bdud bzhi'i dpung rnams 'joms: ma rig rkyen dbang bdud la ngas mi gtong : de bas bdud bzhi bden gnyis tshig la nyon: ma rig 'joms pa'i dam chos nyi 'od gsal: 'khrul gzugs bdud rnams lta bas rang sar grol: kun brtags rang gi lus la dpe longs la: bdag med gzhan la gnod par ma byed cig: ces snying rje yang dag gi ngang la bstan par bya'o: de nas byung khungs bshad pa ni: (ja) hūm̐: nyon cig bdud bzhi pho nya rnams: glud dang mdos kyi byung khungs bzang : 'dzam gling 'di yi bkod pa las: de ring bshams pa'i glud 'di che: sngon tshe 'og min zhing mchog tu: lha bu don gsal legs 'byung la: sna tshogs 'gyu ba'i bdud bzhi byung : ma rig dus kyi pho nyas sdang : 'chi ltas bar chad brtsams pa'i tshe: thog ma'i sangs rgyas snang mtha' yis:

gti mug rnam rtog bdud bzhi rnams: snying rje bla med byams sems kyis: ye shes bzhi sbyor dkyil 'khor bshams: kun gzhi klong yangs sems bskyed byas: gang shar 'dzin med mchod sbyin gyis: ma rig bdud bzhi dbyings su grol: de bas sngon gyi tha tshig nyon: de 'og tshangs pa'i gnas mchog tu: lha yi dbang po brgya byin la: nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa yis: rtag lta bar chod bdud bzhi byung : 'dzin pa dus kyi pho nyas sdang : 'chi ltas bar chad brtsams pa'i tshe: longs sku 'dzin med dbang phyug gis: kun shes ye grol dkyil 'khor bshams: ma 'gags 'dzin med ting 'dzin bsgoms: du ma ro gcig sems yang bskyed: dran rig lta ba'i mchod sbyin gyis: bag chags bdud bzhi rang sar grol: de bas sngon gyi tha tshig nyon: de 'og dpal gyi bsam yas su: chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan la: rnam g.yeng 'khrul ba 'byams pa yi: bag chags 'khrul gzugs bdud bzhi byung : nyon mongs rlung gi pho nyas sdang : 'chi ltas bar chod brtsams pa'i tshe: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: 'od gsal gnyug ma'i dkyil 'khor bshams: dbyings rig ka dag ting 'dzin bsgoms: nyag gcig theg chen sems bskyed nas: zang thal dmigs med mchod sbyin bsngos: le lo rnam g.yeng bdud bzhi grol: de bas sngon gyi tha tshig nyon: ma 'ongs da lta'i dus bskal du: skal ldan yon gyi bdag po 'di: phra rags rtog par ngar 'dzin pa'i: dug lnga hrag pa'i bdud bzhi byung : rlung lnga ma snyoms pho nyas sdang : 'chi ltas bar chad brtsams pa la: rig 'dzin sngags 'chang rnal 'byor gyis: kun snang 'phrul gyi dkyil 'khor bshams: dran rig rang shar ting 'dzin bsgom: tshad med bzhi ldan sems bskyed de: spros bsgyur du ma'i mchod sbyin gyis: deng nas kun rtog re kha khengs: bdud bzhi bdag med chos kyis grol: sbyin bdag bsod nams tshogs kyis bslu: de bas bdud bzhi pho nya rnams:

chos nyid rang byung tshig la nyon: phan sems byang chub ldan gyur cig: de nas spyi glud bsngo ba ni: hūm̐: srid pa'i mdos glud chen po 'di: de ring gtong ba'i yul smos pa: shar phyogs dung mkhar ldem pa nas: srid pa'i lha bdud mi bo dkar: 'chi bdag lo yi pho nya dang : srid par skyes pa'i mya ngan can: shar phyogs bdud kyi tshogs bcas la: sbyin bdag bla tshe bslu ba yi: 'dod yon yas stags sna tshogs bsngo: snang gsal 'od kyi sgron me 'di: yon bdag sems kyi tshab tu gtong : changs bu lo skor tshang ba 'di: yon bdag ngag gi tshab tu gtong : dkar nag spel ba'i 'brang rgyas 'di: yon bdag bla dwags tshab tu gtong : ro mchog rgyan gyi ting lo 'di: yon bdag lus kyi tshab tu gtong : bcud ldan sha khrag dum bu 'di: yon bdag nor gyi tshab tu gtong : sna tshogs mdzes pa'i nam mkha' 'di: yon bdag rgyan gyi tshab tu gtong : rgyang bu 'od zer ldan pa 'di: yon bdag yul zhing tshab tu gtong : mda' bkra 'ja' ris 'khyugs pa 'di: yon bdag pho yi glud du 'bul: 'phang bkra ldem zhing khyug khyug 'di: za ma mo yi glud du gtong : go mtshon ral gri 'bar ba 'di: yon bdag go mtshon tshab tu gtong : las kyi khram shing nag po 'di: lo yi bar chad tshab tu gtong : dmod pa'i shing bkra nag po 'di: dus la bab pa'i tshab tu gtong : sku glud rin chen rgyan ldan 'di: yon bdag bslu ba'i tshab tu gtong : gling bzhi tshang ba'i mdos gdan 'di: de ring bdud dang pho nyar bsngo: deng phyin yul la ma chags shig: bla med mchod sbyin 'di bsngos pas: 'chi bdag zhags pa nag po chod: bla tshe yal ba myur du khug: tshe yi 'ju thag dbyings la mthud: srog gi rten phur sa la tshugs: tshe yi g.yung drung brtan gyur cig: oṃ aḥhūm̐ hrīḥswā hā: hūm̐: srid pa'i mdos glud chen po 'di: de ring gtong ba'i yul smos pa: lho phyogs gser mkhar ldem pa nas:

phung po bdud kyi rgyal po ser: 'chi bdag zla ba'i pho nya dang : rgas pa'i sdug bsngal nyon mongs pa: lho phyogs bdud kyi tshogs bcas la: sbyin bdag bla tshe bslu ba yi: 'dod yon yas stags sna tshogs bsngo: snang gsal 'od kyi sgron me 'di: yon bdag sems kyi tshab tu gtong : changs bu lo skor tshang ba 'di: yon bdag ngag gi tshab tu gtong : dkar nag spel ba'i 'brang rgyas 'di: yon bdag bla dwags tshab tu gtong : ro mchog rgyan gyi ting lo 'di: yon bdag lus kyi tshab tu gtong : bcud ldan sha khrag dum bu 'di: yon bdag nor gyi tshab tu gtong : sna tshogs mdzes pa'i nam mkha' 'di: yon bdag rgyan gyi tshab tu gtong : rgyang bu 'od zer ldan pa 'di: yon bdag yul zhing tshab tu gtong : mda' bkra 'ja' ris 'khyugs pa 'di: yon bdag pho yi glud du 'bul: 'phang bkra ldem zhing khyug khyug 'di: za ma mo yi glud du gtong : go mtshon ral gri 'bar ba 'di: yon bdag go mtshon tshab tu gtong : las kyi khram shing nag po 'di: lo yi bar chad tshab tu gtong : dmod pa'i shing bkra nag po 'di: dus la bab pa'i tshab tu gtong : sku glud rin chen rgyan ldan 'di: yon bdag bslu ba'i tshab tu gtong : gling bzhi tshang ba'i mdos gdan 'di: de ring bdud dang pho nyar bsngo: deng phyin yul la ma chags shig: bla med mchod sbyin 'di bsngos pas: 'chi bdag zhags pa nag po chod: bla tshe yal ba myur du khug: tshe yi 'ju thag dbyings la mthud: srog gi rten phur sa la tshugs: tshe yi g.yung drung brtan gyur cig: oṃ aḥhūm̐ hrīḥswā hā: hūm̐: srid pa'i mdos glud chen po 'di: de ring gtong ba'i yul smos pa: nub phyogs zangs mkhar ldem pa nas: nyon mongs bdud kyi rgyal po dmar: 'chi bdag zhag gi pho nya dang : na ba'i sdug bsngal gzhogs phab pa: nub phyogs bdud kyi tshogs bcas la: sbyin bdag bla tshe bslu ba yi: 'dod yon yas stags sna tshogs bsngo:

snang gsal 'od kyi sgron me 'di: yon bdag sems kyi tshab tu gtong : changs bu lo skor tshang ba 'di: yon bdag ngag gi tshab tu gtong : dkar nag spel ba'i 'brang rgyas 'di: yon bdag bla dwags tshab tu gtong : ro mchog rgyan gyi ting lo 'di: yon bdag lus kyi tshab tu gtong : bcud ldan sha khrag dum bu 'di: yon bdag nor gyi tshab tu gtong : sna tshogs mdzes pa'i nam mkha' 'di: yon bdag rgyan gyi tshab tu gtong : rgyang bu 'od zer ldan pa 'di: yon bdag yul zhing tshab tu gtong : mda' bkra 'ja' ris 'khyugs pa 'di: yon bdag pho yi glud du 'bul: 'phang bkra ldem zhing khyug khyug 'di: za ma mo yi glud du gtong : go mtshon ral gri 'bar ba 'di: yon bdag go mtshon tshab tu gtong : las kyi khram shing nag po 'di: lo yi bar chad tshab tu gtong : dmod pa'i shing bkra nag po 'di: dus la bab pa'i tshab tu gtong : sku glud rin chen rgyan ldan 'di: yon bdag bslu ba'i tshab tu gtong : gling bzhi tshang ba'i mdos gdan 'di: de ring bdud dang pho nyar bsngo: deng phyin yul la ma chags shig: bla med mchod sbyin 'di bsngos pas: 'chi bdag zhags pa nag po chod: bla tshe yar ba myur du khug: tshe yi 'ju thag dbyings la mthud: srog gi rten phur sa la tshugs: tshe yi g.yung drung brtan gyur cig: oṃ aḥhūm̐ hrīḥswā hā: hūm̐: srid pa'i mdos glud chen po 'di: de ring gtong ba'i yul smos pa: byang phyogs lcags mkhar ldem pa nas: srog bdag bdud kyi rgyal po nag: 'chi bdag dus kyi pho nya dang : shi ba'i sman chung gzhon nu ma: byang phyogs bdud kyi tshogs bcas la: sbyin bdag bla tshe bslu ba yi: 'dod yon yas stags sna tshogs bsngo: snang gsal 'od kyi sgron me 'di: yon bdag sems kyi tshab tu gtong : changs bu lo skor tshang ba 'di: yon bdag ngag gi tshab tu gtong : dkar nag spel ba'i 'brang rgyas 'di: yon bdag bla dwags tshab tu gtong :

ro mchog rgyan gyi ting lo 'di: yon bdag lus kyi tshab tu gtong : bcud ldan sha khrag dum bu 'di: yon bdag nor gyi tshab tu gtong : sna tshogs mdzes pa'i nam mkha' 'di: yon bdag rgyan gyi tshab tu gtong : rgyang bu 'od zer ldan pa 'di: yon bdag yul zhing tshab tu gtong : mda' bkra 'ja' ris 'khyugs pa 'di: yon bdag pho yi glud du 'bul: 'phang bkra ldem zhing khyug khyug 'di: za ma mo yi glud du gtong : go mtshon ral gri 'bar ba 'di: yon bdag go mtshon tshab tu gtong : las kyi khram shing nag po 'di: lo yi bar chad tshab tu gtong : dmod pa'i shing bkra nag po 'di: dus la bab pa'i tshab tu gtong : sku glud rin chen rgyan ldan 'di: yon bdag bslu ba'i tshab tu gtong : gling bzhi tshang ba'i mdos gdan 'di: de ring bdud dang pho nyar bsngo: deng phyin yul la ma chags shig: bla med mchod sbyin 'di bsngos pas: 'chi bdag zhags pa nag po chod: bla tshe yar ba myur du khug: tshe yi 'ju thag dbyings la mthud: srog gi rten phur sa la tshugs: tshe yi g.yung drung brtan gyur cig: oṃ aḥhūm̐ hrīḥswā hā: 'di yi skabs su bla bslu zhu lan bya ba ni: bla 'bod byed pa'i pho mo rnams 'tshogs shing : (nya) hūm̐: bdud bzhi'i pho nya sdug bsngal zhi: rten 'brel bcu gnyis bdag po'i tshogs: sngags 'chang rig 'dzin bdag la nyon: sbyin bdag tshe 'di bslu ba yi: dgyes pa'i yas stags sna tshogs tshang : chags pa'i bu lon sha 'khon 'khor: mi dang yas gnyis brje ba'i dus: bla dang glud gnyis brje ba'i dus: dkar nag gdan sa bgo ba'i dus: bla 'bod pho nya 'gyed pa'i dus: bdud bzhi'i zhal kha bsgyur ba'i dus: 'chi bdag zhags pa gcod pa'i dus: tshe bdud dur kha bzlog pa'i dus: sbyin bdag tshe thar gtong ba'i dus: 'chi bdag bdud kyi sde tshogs kyis: sbyin bdag 'di yi bla thongs 'tshal: gnyis pa sbyin bdag la 'dri ba ni: (tha)

hoḥ sbyin bdag skal bar ldan nam: sbyin bdag chos dang mthun nam: sbyin bdag tshe srog gcod par 'dzem mam: sbyin bdag mi dge bcu por 'dzem mam: mtshams med pa lngar 'dzem mam: las ngan pa'i dbang du gyur par 'dzem mam: tshe bdud bar chad kyi dbang du mi 'gro bar byed dam: 'chi bdag bdud kyi dbang mi gtong bar 'gyur ram: bla rang gnas su 'gug gam: 'chi bdag bdud kyi zhags pa gcod dam: khyod kyi srog gi glud du tshe thar mang po gtong ngam: dge bcu'i sna thag bsring ngam: gsum pa: (na) hūm̐: nyon cig tshe bdud bar chad rnams: skal ba ldan pa'i sbyin bdag 'di: legs lam dge bcu dag dang ldan: bskal pa yar ldan bzang po'i mi: rten 'brel sna tshogs 'dzoms pa'i lus: tshe tshad stong phrag dag dang ldan: dus gsum sangs rgyas smon lam gyis: tshe 'phrang dbang du mi 'gyur zhing : 'ja' lus rdo rje'i srog dang ldan: dam tshig ldan pa'i yon bdag 'di: mi tshe ring ste chos ring nas: skal ldan 'di yi bla 'di thongs: khyed rnams dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi: spyan sngar khas blangs dam ma bkral: dam tshig gnyan gyi grogs po rnams: skye med ting 'dzin don yang bstan: snying rje drag po'i rdzongs btab nas: phyogs med chos sku'i klong du skyol: de bas ji ltar khas len 'tshal: (pha) bzhi pa bla 'gugs pho nya gtong ba ni: rigs bzang pho mo gnyis kyis rigs lnga dang rgyan chas spras la: tshe mda' dang rdo rje 'dzin: gser skyems sbreng zhing mi mang rnams kyis phyi rol nas bla 'bod gtong : bla khug rtags byung nas tshe lam la khrid: bla khug pa'i rtags su bla byang 'phar ba: rlung gis sil bur bskyod pa: tshag sgra don pa sgra 'bir ba: 'gugs mtshams su mi mang nang du log pa: zas dang longs spyod chas ka sogs khyer ba nyams la dngos su bla rtags phyin pa sogs byung na rab yin: ma byung na yang yang bskyal: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ mi mngon nam mkha'i klong yangs nas:

ma yum chen thugs las sprul pa'i sras: tshe bdag rdo rje rnam 'byor ma: tshe 'dzin dpa' bo dpa' mos bskor: yang sprul rigs bzhi pho nyar 'gyed: dbu skra thor tshugs shigs se shig: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: rus pa'i rgyan cha khro lo lo: g.yer kha dril bu si li li: myur mgyogs gar stabs khyugs se khyug: byin rlabs 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: thugs rje'i glog dmar tshubs se tshub: nus rtsal gzi brjid spungs se spung : bla 'gugs mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum: thugs dam bzhengs bskul dus la bab: phud rgod gser skyems 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag gi: bla tshe bdud kyis 'phrog pa rnams: da lta nyid du khug la shog: lha srin 'byung po'i rigs rnams kyis: bla 'di sba 'am brkus pa rnams: phyogs bcur khyab pa'i pho nya yis: gab skung phud de khug la shog: rgyal bsen sman mo 'dre rgod kyis: bar du gcod cing gnod srid na: rtsal chen drag pos chad pa phob: las kyi mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum: mi bla bdud la ma bskur 'tshal: bla rten srog mkhar 'di la khug: don med bla 'khyams ma 'ded par: dmod pa'i bla 'di khug la shog: ming dang gzugs phung 'di la khug: gnas dang mal sa 'di la khug: srog dang rten phur 'di la khug: tshe yi dar thag rgyud nas khug: srog gi mda' mo'i rgyud nas khug: bla yi rdo rje'i rgyud nas khug: ming gi mtshan byang rgyud nas khug: ma sring mkha' 'gro mthu ma chung : rbad pa'i pho nya rtsal ma zhan: mngags pa'i ra mda' bang ma bul: 'khyams pa'i bla 'di khug la shog: steng 'og phyogs bcu'i bdud gzhom pa'i: me dpung tshwa tshwas khongs la shog: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: oṃ badz+ra muṃ wā ra hī ḍāk+ki nī ha ri ni sa dzaḥ ā yur+dzñā na ṇi badz+ra aṃ ku sha ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

zhes mda' dar g.yab cing mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum gyis phyogs bcur khyab ste: bla tshe yal ba thams cad bsdus shing : chaig la bstim par bsam: de nas nad pa'i glud gzugs de hoṃ re re'i kha nas drangs: hūm̐: ma sring rgyal mo tshe 'dzin ma: de ring skal ldan rigs kyi bu: 'chi bdag nyon mongs tshang nas bshig: bdud zhags chod la tshe 'phrang sgrol: dang po 'chi dal nag po nas: gdan bgos yar la spo bar gyis: 'chi bdag zhags pa nag po chod: gnyis pa bdud kyi lag nas spo: 'chi bdag zhags pa nag po chod: gsum pa btsan gyi lag nas spo: 'chi bdag zhags pa nag po chod: bzhi pa klu yi lag nas spo: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa chod: lnga pa gnod sbyin lag nas spo: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa chod: drug pa ma mo'i lag nas spo: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa chod: bdun pa rgyal po'i lag nas spo: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa chod: brgyad pa srin po'i lag nas spo: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa chod: dgu pa lha bdud lag nas spo: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa chod: bcu pa sman mo'i lag nas spo: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa chod: bcu gcig dmu yi lag nas spo: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa chod: bcu gnyis gza' yi lag nas spo: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa chod: bcu gsum the'u rang lag nas spo: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa chod: bcu bzhi bgegs kyi lag nas spo: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa chod: bco lnga dri za'i lag nas spo: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa chod: bcu drug gshin rje'i lag nas spo: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa chod: bcu bdun bdud kyi yul nas thar: de nas 'chi bdag bdud bzhi'i zhags pa bcad cing : zam bgo gdan bgo bya ba ni: hūm̐: ma rig nyon mongs lha yi bdud: rtag par lta ba'i zhags pa chod: nga rgyal khengs sems phung po'i bdud: chad par lta ba'i zhags pa chod: nyon mongs 'dod chags srid pa'i bdud:

dngos por lta ba'i zhags pa chod: phrag dog khengs sems 'chi bdag bdud: rmongs par lta ba'i zhags pa chod: tshe 'phrang bdud kyi zhags pa chod: de nas zhags pa bcad cing gdan bgo zam bgo ni: hoḥ tshe bdud nag po mgo bo can: de ring sbyin bdag bla thongs la: 'chi bdag dus kyi pho nya zlog: 'dzin pa'i zhags pa nag po chod: oṃ raṃ raṃ ṭa ṭa phaṭḥ ces bcad/ hūm̐: tshe 'dzin srung ma 'khor bcas kyis: bla rtags sor chud yar la khrid: pha rol bdud kyi lag nas thar: tshe yi dar thag yar la 'then: mi 'gyur g.yung drung gdan la bzhugs: ā yur+ṣe tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas zam shab cing : dkar nag srid pa lha yi zam: lhan cig skyes pa lha dang bdud: rgyu 'bras dkar nag las kyi gdan: de ring bgo ba'i dus la bab: lhan cig skyes pa'i srung ma lha: lha zam dkar po yar la 'then: bdud kyi zam pa mar la ldog: 'byung ba me yis mtshams chod cig: srung ma tshe 'dzin mkha' 'gro ma: lha gdan dkar po yar la 'dzin: bdud kyi bshos gdan mar la ldog: 'byung ba chu yis mtshams chod cig: dgra gshed sprad pa'i mtshams bcad do: tshe yi bdud gcod bzlog tu gsol: oṃ raṃ tsakra khaṃ tsakra ye swā hā: de nas thams cad kyis 'di skad do: hoḥ bla thar ro: tshe thar ro: zhes so: de nas gdan nag po de mdos lam du dpyang : sne mor dkar gtor bzhag: de yi gong du pho nya de la glud kyis bskor: de nas rim bzhin skabs dang bstun: mdos sgo phyes shing bsngo ba ni: shel tshig gtor la: hūm̐: gling bzhi'i pho brang la gnas pa'i: mdos dang yas kyi bdag po rnams: rdzongs 'debs drag po 'di khyer la: sgo phyes lam bstan dus la bab: shar phyogs pho brang bdag po mchog: lha bu'i bdud kyi tshogs bcas rnams: shel tshig khri dkar stong nag 'bul: sgo phyes shar du lam bstan no: shar phyogs srid pa'i yul rtse ru: dung mkhar ldem pa'i nang shed na: dung las grub pa'i 'jig rten chags:

'dod yon zang zing zad pa med: ting 'dzin zag med de ru mngon: gnas der khyod kyi lam bstan no: mun pa'i steng du gdan spo 'tshal: zhes lha bdud rang shar gyi mdos gdan nag tu bskyal: de nas lho ru: hūm̐: lho phyogs pho brang bdag po mchog: phung po bdud kyi tshogs bcas rnams: dkar nag khram shing stong nag 'bul: sgo phyes lho ru lam bstan no: hūm̐: lho phyogs srid pa'i yul de ru: gser mkhar ldem pa'i nang shed na: gser las grub pa'i 'jig rten chags: khengs sems nga rgyal zad mtha' med: mnyam nyid ye shes de ru mngon: gnas der khyod la lam bstan no: mun pa'i steng du gdan spo 'tshal: zhes phung bdud lho phyogs thams cad gdan nag tu bskyal: nub phyogs su: hūm̐: nub phyogs pho brang bdag po mchog: nyon mongs bdud kyi tshogs bcas rnams: pho mtshan mo mtshan stong nag 'bul: sgo phyes nub tu lam bstan no: hūm̐: nub phyogs srid pa'i yul rtse ru: zangs mkhar ldem pa'i nang shed na: zangs las grub pa'i 'jig rten chags: chags 'dzin sbyor ba zad mtha' med: sor rtog ye shes de ru mngon: gnas der khyod la lam bstan no: mun pa'i steng du gdan spo 'tshal: nyon mongs bdud g.yog 'khor bcas gdan spo zhing bsgril: byang phyogs su: hūm̐: byang gi pho brang bdag po mchog: 'chi bdag bdud kyi tshogs bcas rnams: shwa rde'u dkar nag stong nag 'bul: sgo phyes byang du lam bstan no: hūm̐: byang phyogs srid pa'i yul rtse ru: lcags mkhar ldem pa'i nang shed na: lcags las grub pa'i 'jig rten chags: phrag dog bkol spyod zad mtha' med: rtog med shes pa de ru mngon: gnas der khyod kyi lam bstan no: mun pa'i steng du gdan spo 'tshal: 'chi bdag bdud g.yog 'khor rnams gdan spo: de nas rdzongs 'debs bya ba ni: hūm̐: nga ni rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung : nga ni rdo rje bdud 'dul rtsal: nga yi bka' la ma 'da' bar:

rdzongs 'debs drag po 'di khyer la: bdud bzhi rang rang gnas su bskyal: shel tshig khri dkar stong nag 'di: ye shes ting 'dzin zas yin no: de yang khyod la rdzongs su 'debs: 'chi bdag pho nya bzlog tu gsol: khram shing dkar nag stong nag 'di: sna tshogs sgyu ma'i rgyan yin no: de yang khyod la rdzongs su 'debs: 'chi bdag pho nya bzlog tu gsol: 'jig rten srid pa'i mtshan rtags 'di: chags med ye shes rdzas yin no: de yang khyod la rdzongs su 'debs: 'chi bdag pho nya bzlog tu gsol: dkar nag shwa rde'u stong nag 'di: bslu brid bral ba'i rdzas yin no: de yang khyod la rdzongs su 'debs: 'chi bdag pho nya bzlog tu gsol: mi kha chod pa'i yas stags 'di: snang srid re kha kheng ba'i rdzas: de yang khyod la rdzongs su 'debs: 'chi bdag pho nya bzlog tu gsol: rgyan dang shing bkra sna tshogs 'di: bag chags sbyong ba'i rdzas yin no: de yang khyod la rdzongs su 'debs: 'chi bdag pho nya bzlog tu gsol: sku glud rin chen rgyan ldan 'di: yon bdag phung po bslu ba'i rdzas: de yang khyod la rdzongs su 'debs: 'chi bdag pho nya bzlog tu gsol: mun pa'i lam 'di 'od gsal rgyu: de yang khyod la rdzongs su 'debs: 'chi bdag pho nya bzlog tu gsol: lo bdag lo gshed sna khrid mkhan: de yang khyod la rdzongs su 'debs: 'chi bdag pho nya bzlog tu gsol: me chu gnyis yang mtshams gcod rdzas: de yang khyod la rdzongs su 'debs: dmar nag gtor ma 'dod pa'i rdzas: de yang khyod la rdzongs su 'debs: 'chi bdag pho nya bzlog tu gsol: snang srid re kha kheng du gsol: tshe bdud dal kha dgra la sgyur: bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: hūm̐: bstan pa'i lam de ma gtogs par: sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid kyi: g.yas g.yon phyogs mtshams thams cad kun: me ri mtshon cha rdul ltar 'khrigs: tshe bdag khro bos drag sngags ldir: rbad pa'i pho nya skar ltar 'khrugs:

khro chu khol ma'i zhun ma 'khyil: gdon bgegs gab pa'i srid khung skem: ci ste gdug sems sdang gyur tshe: dus gsum sangs rgyas bka' yang bcag: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dam yang 'gal: na raka ngan song dmyal bar ltung : de bas dam las ma 'da' cig: hūm̐: bdud bzhi 'jigs byed tshogs rnams kun: khyed rnams byang sems ma mchis na: rigs drug pha ma'i rang bzhin ste: ro gcig dri med sems la ltos: khyed rnams snying rje ma mchis na: bdag gzhan rten 'brel rgyu gcig pas: bdag med 'od gsal sems la ltos: khyed rnams dga' ba ma mchis na: dug lnga sor rtog bde stong ngang : chags med gnyug ma'i rang bzhin skyongs: khyed rnams bde stong ma mchis na: thig le chen po mtha' dbus med: khyab brdal dmigs med ngang la zhog: khyed rnams lam mchog ma mchis na: zang thal phyogs bcu 'od gsal zhing : 'gro 'ong bral ba'i shes pa skyongs: bdud bzhi sems kyi cho 'phrul khyod: ye nas ma grub stong pa la: nam mkha' gzugs su ga la reg: sgyu ma'i sprul bsgyur zhig pa bzhin: khyed rnams phyogs med klong du gshegs: lhan skyes ye shes don rtogs shog: ces bdud bzhi chos nyid kyi klong du grol te: snying rje phan sems kyi ngang du 'gro bar sems so: de nas zor bzlog dang yas rnams btegs shing : hūm̐: khyab brdal rol pa drag po e yi klong : gru gsum thod mkhar 'bar ba'i pho brang nas: tshe bdud zlog byed khro bo las la bskul: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdud bzhi bar chod sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ ma rig las gyur bslu brid lha bu'i bdud: de ring mdos dang dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa phung po'i bdud: de ring mdos dang dmar nag gtor mas zlog: 'dzin chags srid pas bcings pa nyon mongs bdud: de ring mdos dang dmar nag gtor mas zlog: phrag dog bsad bcad gtub pa 'chi bdag bdud:

de ring mdos dang dmar nag gtor mas zlog: ma dag mngal du skye ba lan chags bdud: de ring mdos dang dmar nag gtor mas zlog: sdug bsngal tshe ring smon lam log pa'i bdud: de ring mdos dang dmar nag gtor mas zlog: lus la gcong nad tshe rabs bsags pa'i bdud: de ring mdos dang dmar nag gtor mas zlog: dus min 'chi ba bar chod rkyen gyi bdud: de ring mdos dang dmar nag gtor mas zlog: lo bdud pho nya 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i bdud: de ring mdos dang dmar nag gtor mas zlog: zla bdud pho nya rnam rtog 'khrugs pa'i bdud: de ring mdos dang dmar nag gtor mas zlog: zhag bdud pho nya grib dang 'bag pa'i bdud: de ring mdos dang dmar nag gtor mas zlog: dus bdud pho nya lha srin 'gyu ba'i bdud: de ring mdos dang dmar nag gtor mas zlog: hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: sdug bsngal srid pa bcu gnyis kyis: bar chod dgra ru sdang ba zlog: dbyug gu drug cu re bzhi yis: rtsis dang khram la btab pa zlog: bdud po mtshon thogs bcu gsum gyis: dur kha gshed kha sdang ba zlog: srid pa'i bskos mkhan mi brgyad kyis: tshe bdud za kha ston pa zlog: gab rtse thogs pa'i ma mo dgus: bla tshe byad du bcug pa zlog: dmag mi sum brgya drug cu yis: za kha rtsis kha ston pa zlog: hūm̐: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog: glo bur dgu bcu rtsa gcig zlog: skag rigs bdun rgya nyer lnga zlog: dus min 'chi ba bco brgyad zlog: pho bdud dal kha g.yas su sgyur: mo bdud dal kha g.yon du sgyur: spyi bdud dal kha mkha' la zlog: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba kro dha ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ raṃ bh+yoḥ drag bh+yoḥ gzer bh+yoḥ thun bh+yoḥ ya ma bh+yoḥ mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog: gnod byed 'byung po tshe bdud thams cad u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ

ces bdud bzhi rang rang phyogs su bskyal: lo bdud dang gtor zlog de phyogs chen du 'phang : khyad par khro bo'i lha tshogs rnams kyis gnod byed gdon bgegs thams cad bsregs shing ded nas rang gnas phyogs med rgya mtsho'i pha mthar bskrad par bsam mo: phyi mig mi lta bar nang du log: sgo mtshams su tho cog bya: de nas nad pa g.yung drung steng du bzhag nas: dang po gdan rim pa bzhin khrus tshar re byed: khrid nas gdan che ba'i thog tu bzhag: bum pa thogs nas: hūm̐: 'di ni 'chi med lha yi chu: dag byed gaṅgā bsil ba'i rgyun: skal ldan bu la khrus bstsal bas: pha rol bdud kyis bla 'phrog pa'i: bag chags ngan pa dag gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: de nas rim bzhin: hūm̐: dang po bla tshe 'gugs pa yi: 'chi med g.yung drung gyen la 'dzegs: gnyis pa bla tshe gso ba yi: mi 'gyur dar thag gyen la 'dzegs: gsum pa chad pa rab mthud pa'i: tshe mda' sgro dkar rgyas kyis btab: bzhi pa gas pa sbyor ba yi: dam tshig rdo rje spyi bor reg: lnga pa yo ba bsrang ba yi: tshe zan longs spyod rgyan la rol: drug pa mi 'gyur brtan pa yi: tshe chang bdud rtsi bcud la myong : bdun pa 'chi med thob pa yi: rin chen phye mar myong zhing byug: brgyad pa rab tu gnas pa yi: 'bru mchog nas kyi me tog 'thor: dgu pa bkra shis bgyis pa yi: lus la dri spos sman bzang byug: bcu pa rdo rje'i sku 'thob phyir: rin chen bum pas dbang bskur ro: bcu gcig 'byin 'jug brtan pa'i phyir: grags stong sngags kyis dbang bskur ro: bcu gnyis 'ja' lus srog bsgrub phyir: dkyil 'khor me long dbang bskur ro: bcu gsum yon tan mthar phyin phyir: rmad byung gtor mas dbang bskur ro: bcu bzhi phrin las yongs rdzogs phyir: rgyan dang phyag mtshan dbang bskur ro: bco lnga dge legs 'byung ba'i phyir:

sna tshogs rdo rjes rgyas btab bo: bcu drug mi 'gyur gdeng ldan phyir: smon lam g.yung drung gdan du 'khor: 'jigs med rdo rje'i tshe ldan shog: oṃ āḥbh+rūm̐: tshe bh+rūm̐: g.yu bh+rūm̐: g.yu tshe bh+rūm̐: ā yur+dzñā na sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes thams cad kyis bstod cing dga' ston bya: dar dkar dmar de tshe mdud brgyab nas 'chang : tshe mda' mi la sbyin mi rung : snam dkar mi la sbyin mi rung : glud gtor dkar po de khang pa'i thog tu bskyal: bla byang de rgyun du brten: 'chi bdag gi gdan nag po de rnam rtog mi bya na sngags 'chang rang gis khyer: mi mos kyang sbyin bdag rang gis blang mi rung : zhag gsum la chu chen mi brgal: bud med mi spyod: 'thab rtsod kyi sa ru mi 'gro: srog gcod nam yang spang : zhag gsum la shig tsam yang mi gsod: sdig can las ngan rnams kyang lo gsum la 'dzem sdig pa ma spangs pa la 'di yi dkyil 'khor mi bsham: byas kyang bka' chad 'ong : sa them pa dgu yod sar mthur du mi 'gro: mi mang po shi dur du mi nyal: gos nag po mi gyon: gdan nag po mi 'ding : rdzun dang phra ma'i mna' mi bya: de rnams zhib tu sbyin bdag la lan gsum dris nas dam tshig thub pa rnams la bya: ser mo ba yin na shin tu phan thogs shing tshe yang 'phel: las ngan sdig to can rnams dam tshig bral bas skyob par dka': khyad par dam tshig gtso che: tshe sgrub dang sbrags pa'i dus su 'di nyid brtsam na shin tu stobs che ba yin: sa ma ya: rjes bsngo smon bya zhing bkra shis mtshams sbyar: gtang rag gtor 'bul sogs rang gzhung bslad med par bsrang : nub mo sbyin bdag la rmi lam brtag bcug: rmi lam legs pa sgrub pa'i skabs dang mtshungs: ngan na lan gcig la tshe sgrub bskyar: rgyud kyi nang ltar 'chi med tshe 'dzin srung ba btags: bla ma la yon kyang tshe yi rdzas rin po che snam dkar ma gtogs: chag gas grum dang nag po sogs ming ngan pa yod pa'i rdzas mi 'bul:

spyir rten 'brel gtso che'o: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro kun mnyes par tshogs bskang dgos: sgrub pa po byang sems dang ldan pa gtso che: las mtha' dkyil 'khor bsdu ba sogs rgyas shing kha tshang la gting 'dril bar bya'o:

sa ma ya: e ma hoḥ bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba'i phyir: 'chi bdag zhags gcod 'chi med srog sgrub bzhag: ma 'ongs lnga brgya nyi shu mar 'grib tshe: gnubs kyi ston pa sangs rgyas ye shes khyod: pad+ma gter bdag gling zhes yong grags nas: mon yul sha 'ug gnas dang tsā ri sogs: rong chen lnga yi zab gter sgo 'byed 'byung : dus der zab chos 'di dang 'phrad par shog: gter srung drag po zhing skyong seṅge'i gdong : dam chos 'di la bya ra lhang lhang gyis: zil chen gsang phug gnas mchog-i atsha rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pas/ me sprel lor tsā ri zil chen gsang phug nas gdan drangs shing glang lor sbas yul gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus pa dge'o/ bkra shis par shog/ // tha) ༈ tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: bdud bzhi'i zhu lan 'gyur khug bzhugs so: zhu lan bya ba ni: (kha) kyaiḥ dpa' bo chen po snyan gsan 'tshal: nged bdud bzhi dus kyi pho nya ste: sngags 'chang rgyal pos bos phyir 'ong : dus gsum sangs rgyas sgra tshig la: log par lta ba ma nges kyang : rnam rtog srid pa'i skye bo rnams: tshogs drug 'khrul par a 'thas te: tshul bzhin spyod par ma lags na: rnam rtog sems kyi bdud bzung pas: de phyir nged rnams dgra ru langs: rjes shes bag yod ma ldan pas: dug lnga 'khrul rgyun so mar spyad: dge ba'i las dang mi ldan pas: le lo bag med yon bdag 'di: nged kyi gnas su gtong bar zhu: mi 'os kha 'dzin mi mdzad 'tshal: gnyis pa: (nga) kyaiḥ dpa' bo chen po gsan cing dgongs su gsol: nged rnams bdud kyi dpung tshogs chen po ste: bka' dang dam la gnas par mi 'os kyang : sngon nas da bar rgyal ba'i dka' ma nyan: dus drug bdud kyi dpung 'dis 'tshe ba'i khung : mu stegs nag pos sangs rgyas bka' mi nyan:

brgya byin nag pos rgyal ba'i gsung mi rtsi: ru tra sde dgus mna' dang khrel mi 'jigs: thar pa nag pos rgyu 'bras don mi sems: bya rigs sna tshogs skye 'gro'i lam mi snyogs: mkha' lding rgyal pos yur ba'i chu mi 'thung : snang srid rlung gis 'phang ba'i srog mi 'dzems: log lta can gyis byams pa'i chos mi nyan: khrel med rnams kyis nye ba'i gnyen mi skyong : bdud bzhi'i bar chad sngags 'chang bshol mi thebs: dus la bab pas sdod pa'i yul ma mchis: bdud bzhi nged kyis dbang du gtong bar gyis: gsum pa: (cha) kyaiḥ dpa' bo chen po snyan gsan 'tshal: bdag gis ci phyir bka' nyan gyi: mi las lhag pa'i tshab thongs 'tshal: nor las lhag pa'i phyugs thongs 'tshal: zas las lhag pa'i bcud thongs 'tshal: (ta) nged rnams las kyis grub pa'i bdud: sbyin bdag bshol ba'i rdzongs yag go: sbyin bdag bshol ba'i rdzongs mdzes so: gal te bla 'di gtong lags na: sbyin bdag byang sems ldan lags sam: phyi 'phro chos la bskyal lags sam: srog gcod sdig par 'dzem lags sam: tshe yi dam tshig bsrung lags sam: nges par skal ba ldan lags na: sngags 'chang slob dpon bka' bzhin mchis: 'on kyang skal ngan sdig can rigs: bla 'di gtong bar mi rigs kyi: nged rnam dus gsum sangs rgyas la: skal yod tshe sring skal med bkums: de ltar tha tshig bgyis pa ste: ma rig gti mug myos pa yis: dkar po khyad du gsod pa'i rigs: zang zing rgyu yis bslus pa rnams: lha bdud nga dang 'bral glags med: le lo can gyi bdud yin pas: lo yi pho nyas de ltar sdang : ma rig dbang gis srid par skye: sdug bsngal shugs kyis rang bzhin grub: snying ring de yi bla mi gtong : zhe sdang nga rgyal las dbang gis: srog gcod gtub dang mtshams med las: mi dge'i zas la longs spyod rnams: phung bdud nga la 'bral blag med: khong khro can gyi bdud yin pas: zla ba'i pho nyas de ltar sdang :

bag med las la rgas shing 'khog: mya ngan phung bdud shugs la byung : rigs ngan de yi bla mi gtong : 'dod sred chags pa'i las dbang gis: chags 'dzin ser sna 'khrig zhing sbyor: dug lnga kho nar spyod pa rnams: nyon mongs bdud la 'bral glags med: bdag 'dzin can gyi bdud yin pas: zhag gi pho nyas de ltar sdang : gnyis 'dzin rnam rtog rkyen dbang gis: nyam thag zug rngu shugs las 'byung : dam med de yi bla mi gtong : khro 'khrug phrag dog las dbang gis: rgyu 'bras dkar nag tshad du bor: mtshams med bcu la spyod pa rnams: 'chi bdud nga la 'bral glags med: khengs sems can gyi bdud yin pas: dus tshod pho nyas de ltar sdang : sngon las 'phral rkyen dbang gi 'chi: rigs drug duḥkha'i thag pa myong : skal med de yi bla mi gtong : de ltar sngags 'chang rgyal po yi: yon bdag 'di yi gdeng len 'tshal: lnga pa: (da) ho ldan lags: mthun lags: spang ngo : spang ngo : spang ngo : spang ngo : mdzod lags: legs zhu: skyel lags: gcod lags: tshe thar ro: legs par bgyi'o: drug pa: (pa) kyaiḥ sngags 'chang rig 'dzin snyan gsan 'tshal: phun sum tshogs pa'i sbyin bdag rnams: nged rnams sngags 'chang bka' la nyan: rgyu 'bras las kyi chos la brtsi: khas blangs dam tshig don dang ldan: ting 'dzin chos kyi brda la nyon: bla 'di nga yis btang ba yis: phyogs med gnas su 'khyams srid pas: pho nya bskul la ming nas bos: zhags pa gcod pa'i ral gri phyungs: hom̐ khung bcu drug gdan 'di spos: las ngan 'khor ba'i zam pa shobs: rgyu 'bras dkar nag sa mtshams phyes: rnam rtog lo dgra gnas su rdzongs: g.yung drung gdan du bzhag khrus gsol: rang mal gnas su skyel bar gyis: nged rnams bla med lam bstan 'tshal: mi zad longs spyod rdzong 'debs 'tshal: rang rang mthun pa'i chas bstan 'tshal: 'og min zhing du ma sleb bar: grogs dang ra mda' skyel ma 'tshal: ci ltar bka' stsal bgyis lags so:

de nas rdzong 'debs bya ste so so'i phyogs su bskyel bar bya: 'di 'don pa'i dus su gab ma nor ba sprad dgos/ tshe sgrub zhu len khol phyung byas pa'o/ o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas/ tsā ri zil chen gsang phug nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ bkra shis shog/ // da) tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon las/ gsol 'debs 'chi med dpal ster bzhugs so/ 'chi med mgon po tshe'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ skyabs yul mdun mkhar dmigs byas la/ /mos gus gdung shug drag po yi/ /bdag dang mkha' khyab sems can gyi/ /rtse gcig dad pa'i gsol 'debs dmigs/ e ma ho/ 'chi med rtag pa dam pa'i klong yangs nas/ /'chi med mgon po chos sku'i lha tshogs la/ /'chi med gnyug ma'i ngang nas gsol ba 'debs/ /'chi med 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa'i gzhal yas su/ /rang snang longs sku tshe lha rigs lnga la/ /rang byung lhun grub ngang nas gsol ba 'debs/ /rang grol 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin stsol/ /bde chen pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas/ /bde gshegs kun 'dus sprul sku pad 'byung la/ /bde stong dbyer med ngang nas gsol ba 'debs/ /bde mchog 'gyur med tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /dbang drag khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas/ /dbang chen rta phag yab yum sprul 'khor la/ /dbang yul 'dzin med ngang nas gsol ba 'debs/ /dbang bzhi rtsal rdzogs tshe dpal mthar phyin stsol/ /mkha' dbyings gdal ba chen po'i klong yangs nas/ /mkha' 'gro dpa' bo rdo rje'i chos srung la/ /mkha' khyab 'gro grol ngang nas gsol ba 'debs/ /mkha' spyod la sogs grub gnyis dngos grub stsol/ /'pho bcas rdo rje lus kyi rtsa rlung thig /'pho med rdo rje gsum gyi rgyas gdab pa'i/ /'pho bral gnyug ma'i ye shes rdo rje'i khams/ /'pho chen 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dpal thob shog / ces pa'ang mkhyen yon dge ba sprul sku bstan 'dzin 'gyur med kyi ngor blun po gnam lcags bstan 'dzin gyi gang dran hor gtam du smras pas bskul ba pos 'phral mar bris pa dge bar gyur cig/

// na) ༈ tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: tshe chog ye shes lnga ldan 'ja' tshon phreng ba bzhugs so: singha saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du: ā yur sa dā ma hi ma ra si ta a bhi bhu ya ye: ā yur dā hi dzñā na pañtsa pa na aṇ+ṭa tsa pa ma li ta sid+dhi na ma: bod skad du: tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon gyi tshe chog ye shes lnga ldan 'ja' tshon phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bla med yang gsang theg pa kun gyi gdams pa gcig tu 'dus pa'i snying po srog thig zab rgya'i gter mdzod 'dzin pa 'chi med pad+ma 'byung gnas sku la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ sa ma ya: 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na: 'og min chos dbyings su bkod pa rab 'byams lhun gyis grub pa'i zhing khams lta na sdug pa'i khyab bdag chen po ye shes klong gi pho brang du: dug lnga ma spangs gnas su dag pa'i ye grol chen po skyon bral pad+ma dang chags med thabs shes spel ba'i nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du: kun tu gshis lugs thog ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba snang mtha' 'chi med tshe yi bdag po: thugs rjes 'gro la chags pa'i mdangs brda'i mtshon pa sku mdog dmar po pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ltar 'od zer cher 'bar ba: gnyis su med pa'i sku lta ba drang po bsrangs te: bde stong skyil mo krung du bcas te: mtha' bral gyi spyan gnyis zang thal gyis nam 'khar gzigs te: lhan ne lham mer lhag ge brda brgyud kyi 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs so: yang de'i tshe: thog ma'i mgon pos skye med kyi rang sgra las: a a āḥ gsang ba chen po stong pa che: rang sgra smra brjod blo las 'das: snang ba sku de ye shes che: kun tu gnyis med zung du 'jug: brda de mtshon gyi rang bzhin 'gyur: 'khor lo lnga ldan dkyil 'khor rdzogs: rang bzhin thig le 'od chen po: sku ste phyag mtshan sa bon rgyas: snang ba bskyed la stong pa rdzogs: sgyu ma'i gar gyis sprul bsgyur nyid:

bden pa gnyis te zung 'jug ngang : sna tshogs rtsal gyis byed las kyang : bsdus bya dag pa 'od kyi sku: kun grags phung khams stong pa nyid: spros bsdus bye brag 'khrul 'khor gyis: sa mkhan legs par ston pa po: yang dag bla med de ltar gnas: gzhi yi cho 'phrul lam du shar: brda de gnas pa mngon du phyung : gdams pa de ltar gzungs kyis zungs: sa ma ya: thog ma'i mgon pos dga' rab rdo rje la dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa bstan pa'i brda brgyud gsal byed: snyan brgyud ma hā gu ru'i tshig brgyud shog ser la bkod pa rgyas par bstan pa'o: ྀatsha e ma bdag 'dra kho bo pad+ma 'byung gnas ngas: kun gyi yang bcud tshe sgrub zab mo yi: man ngag don gsal 'phrul gyi me long bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: ma 'ongs lnga brgya nyi shu mgo tshugs tshe: lo tsā'i mchog gyur sangs rgyas ye shes kyi: sprul pa pad+ma gter bdag gling zhes pa'i: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i rim pa ni: dbang gi sa gzhi dmar zhing snum pa la: dal bcag 'jam zhing lag mthil ltar mnyam bya: thig skud dal gyi nyis 'gyur tshad tsam gyis: 'debs pa'i ri mo dkar po dag tu 'dod: sgrub pa po ni dkyil 'khor nub tu 'khod: bkra shis mtshan ldan rig ma rgyan can de: shar du sdod la thig skud sne mo gtad: de yang thig skud rdo rje pad+ma mtshon: dang po mkha' la ye shes dal thig gdab: thig skud rig ma'i spyi bor gru gang gtad: hoḥ gsang ba dbyings kyi mkha' lam du: bden gnyis 'bras bu ston pa'i phyir: rig pa rdo rjes thig gdab bo: rang byung ye nas pho brang gsal: oṃ dharma badz+ra swa bhā hūm̐: de nas rig ma'i brang la gtad: shes rab yum gyi bha ga ru: thabs kyi kun da sbreng bar bsam: hoḥ stong nyid ye shes rgyun lam du:

zag med dga' bzhi bskyed pa'i phyir: zung 'jug bde chen thig gdab bo: sna tshogs lnga ldan lhun gyis grub: oṃ pradzñā su khaṃ pra mo ti ri hūm̐: de nas dkyil 'khor dag la gdab: hūm̐ lā s+ye sgeg mo yid 'ong ma: dbyangs can mnyen lcug 'khril zhing ldem: bkra shis lha mo tshe 'dzin grogs: mkha' dbyings pad+ma'i tshe dal du: kun 'byung nor bus thig gdab bo/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ dzñā na saṃ tri ta maṇ+ḍa la mu tra dhe wa dha ra hūm̐ swā hā: zhes pas cha tshang legs par gdab: lag len rdzas sogs pra khrid ltos: de nas dkyil 'khor bsham pa ni: zlum zhing rgyas pa'i bum pa la: sna tshogs dar gyi mgul chings sbyar: sum gnyis bdud rtsi sman gyis bkang : gzung thag kha rgyan dung bcas gzugs: mtshan ldan bhan+dhar sman phud gtams: me long thabs shes dkyil 'khor dang : tshe gtor rigs lnga stod g.yogs dang : ang rag dar dpyangs cod pan sogs: dkyil 'khor dbang rdzas pang g.yogs dang : mchod pa la sogs spyi mthun bsham: 'di ru ma smras rim pa ni: gzhung dang pra khrid gnyis la ltos: 'di nyid khol phyung cho ga ste: dbang chen la sogs phral ba'o: sa ma ya: ci ltar las rim byed mos kyang : 'khrugs dang gab sbas mang 'dug pa'i: skal ldan rnams kyis don rtogs kyang : dbang po rmongs pa'i rjes 'jug gis: ci ltar tshad du ma phebs nas: dkrugs 'don nyes pa bsags kyis dogs: ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma la: tshad ldan gang zag dkon lags pas: de phyir lag len ldan pa zungs: dngos su gter ston mjal dus su: bu slob ngo mas shes lags kyang : rim nas 'khrugs bsdebs lag len 'chug: re zung tsam gyis sgrub mos kyang : the tshom yid gnyis ngang la spyod: yong grags rnams la zhu kha dog: brgyud 'dzin tsam gyis lag len chad: de phyir khungs btsun 'byung ba dang : grub mtha' ngan pas mi khrel phyir: gab sbas 'khrugs med gsal bkod 'di: rig 'dzin pad 'byung sku la bshags:

gter 'di gab sbas che ba'i don: snod min spyod yul min pa dang : gang zag chos la sbyor ba dang : bla ma mkhas par bstan pa dang : chos dang chos min 'byed pa dang : bzang ngan grub mtha' phyed pa dang : bdud rigs rnams kyis mi rtogs phyir: rgyud dkrugs lung bcos tshig rnams sbas: gab 'khrugs dgos pa'i mtshan nyid don: dbang lung slob dpon med pa la: ras chod 'don du ga la rung : gab 'khrugs med pa'i slob dpon bsten: nges par chos la mos pa rnams: bla ma slob dpon ma rnyed na: bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin dbang bzhi blang : dgongs brgyud dbang bzhi rdzogs par bshad: sa ma ya: thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni: e ma hoḥ dran rig mngon gyur yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas: gang shar rol pa'i thugs rje ye shes chos: sna tshogs bdag 'dzin bral ba'i dge 'dun tshogs: ro gcig tha dad 'dzin med skyabs su mchi: de nas sems bskyed pa ni:

na mo: mtha' yas 'gro drug byams shing brtse ba'i ma: snying rje bskyed do srid pa'i rigs drug tshogs: dga' chen khyod bdag bsten pa'i blo gros kyis: thams cad btang snyoms lam la 'god par bya: dkar gtor gang rung bsngo'o: dang po bgegs gtor bsang sbyang ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis spel: rang nyid dbang chen gsal btab ste: hūm̐: nga nyid ye nas khro bo'i rgyal: dbang chen h+ya ghṛ wa'i sku: thugs las 'od zer pho nya ni: phyogs dang bar mtshams khyab par 'phros: deng 'dir tshe yi dkyil 'khor du: sgrub la mi dbang bgegs kyi tshogs: 'byung po glags lta gang yin pa: mchod sbyin gtor ma len phyir du: skad cig myur du 'dir 'dus shig: oṃ badz+ra ṭāk+ki rā dza bigh+nān ta kri hūm̐ bh+yoḥ gnod byed 'byung po a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ de nas kha phyir bstan la: hūm̐: nyon cig gdon bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs: zad med mchod sbyin 'di longs la: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'tshe byed na: bdag nyid khro rgyal thugs khros te: sku sprul khro bos nam mkha' gang : gsung sprul khro mos sa gzhi khyab: thugs sprul khro chung bar snang g.yogs: skar ltar 'khrugs pa'i mtshon char 'bebs: gzi brjid me dpung glog ltar 'khyug: drag sngags rdo rje'i thog ser 'bebs: bar mtshams khyab pa'i me dpung 'khrigs: thun rdzas tshwa tshwa tho ro ro: bgegs kyi lus ngag yid gsum la: brdegs pas phye ma rdul phran bzhin: ming med brlag par gdon mi za: de bas rang rang gnas su dengs: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra kī li kī la ya baṃ kro ti hūm̐ bh+yoḥ gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas thun gyis brab ste mtha' yi rgya mtsho'i pha rol du bskrad par bsam: gnyis pa mtshams gcod ni: hūm̐: nga nyid ye nas khro bo'i rgyal: gdod nas dpal chen he ru kaḥ snying rje rngam tshul bzhad pa po:

ma rig gnyis 'dzin mtshams gcod phyir: spros pa'i khro tshogs grangs med 'phros: steng 'og kun nas mtshams chod cig: oṃ badz+ra kro ta kro ti bigh+nān bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ gsum pa srung ba'i gur khang bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las phyag mtshan sa bon 'phros: khor yug bar khyams srung ba'i gur khang ni: nang rnams gzhal yas 'ja' tshon lug rgyud gtibs: phyi rol mtshon cha me dpung khyab par 'khrigs: phra mo rlung yang 'gyu ba mi rigs pa'i: sra mkhregs gnam lcags sprul pa'i gur khang bsgom: oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ maṇ+ḍal tsaṇ+ḍa tsakra tsakra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: oṃ khaḍ+ga ka ra ti ka daṇ+ṭa muṃ ra ga ā yu dha ka la rak+ṣa raṃ dz+wa la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: ces mi shigs pa rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin rnams kyi gur khang du gyur par bsgom: bzhi pa phyi mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: skye med khyab brdal chen po'i snod mchog tu: rang byung tshogs drug sna tshogs sgyu ma'i sku: mchod sprin lha mo me tog bdug spos dang : mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo'i sgra: sgeg mo glu mo gar mo bzhad pa mo: dkyil 'khor dgyes pa bskyed phyir byin gyis rlobs: kun bzang bla med mchod sprin rgya mtsho gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da lā s+ye mā l+ye gīrti nīrti āḥhūm̐: lnga pa sman mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: mtshan ldan bhan+dha stong nyid yangs pa'i snod: dug lnga rang byung ye shes sku lnga'i rdzas: sha lnga rdzas lnga sman lnga snying po lnga: 'bru lnga dri lnga la sogs snying po lnga: khams lnga dbang po drug gis spyod pa'i yul: dkyil 'khor rgyas pa bskyed phyir byin gyis rlobs: kun bzang bla med mchod sprin rgya mtshor gyur: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐: drug pa rak+ta byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: dung chen bde ba chen po'i snod mchog tu: stong gsal dga' bzhi bla med rak+tas bkang :

thabs shes dpa' bo'i rlung gis bskyod pa yis: shes rab chags med gsang ba'i mkha' lam nas: zung 'jug gu h+ya rak+ta phyu ru ru: lan gsum dkrugs pas dmar gsal mdangs dang ldan: dkyil 'khor dgyes pa bskyed phyir byin gyis rlobs: kun bzang bla med mchod sprin rgya mtshor gyur: oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ.oṃ āḥhūm̐: bdun pa gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: snang srid 'byung lnga rang byung gtor gzhong du: phung khams skye mched rnam dag gtor ma bshams: don snod rdzas chen bcu drug gtor kyus bskor: ga ṇa tshogs kyi mchod pa ri ltar spungs: spyan gzigs sna tshogs dpag yas khor yug khengs: sbyor sgrol rmad byung gtor chen rgya mtsho 'di: dkyil 'khor dgyes pa bskyed phyir byin gyis rlobs: kun bzang ngo mtshar mchod sprin rgya mtshor gyur: oṃ ma hā bha ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta ta bha la bha te tsakra gu h+ya sarba māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta king ni ri ti hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ.oṃ āḥhūm̐: brgyad pa tshe bum rdzas rnams byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings nyag gcig las byung bum pa'i nang : yid kyi chu bo byang sems bdud rtsis bkang : ye shes lnga ldan sgro dang ku sha rtswa: sprul sku phrin las bzhi ldan rdo rje'i gzungs: yon tan kun 'byung mda' dar tshe chang zan: rigs lnga la sogs mchod rdzas sna tshogs nyid: dkyil 'khor dgyes pa bskyed phyir byin gyis rlobs: kun bzang bla med mchod sprin rgya mtshor gyur: oṃ ka le sha gha lak+ṣa auṇ+ṇa ṇa pañtsa ā yur gar+bha hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ dgu pa byin dbab pa ni: gsang ba'i lha mo bcu drug rgyan gyis spras: ḍā ru dril bu thogs te 'cham stabs su: dkyil 'khor mtha' nas lan gsum bskor: rol mo bya: spos dud btang : skad pi waṃ gling bus gdangs ltar snyan pas byin dbab pa ni: hūm̐: mkha' klong ye shes pho brang nas:

snang mtha' sangs rgyas thog ma'i mgon: tshe 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: brda gar rgyan cha khro lo lo: byin rlabs sprin chen thibs se thib: gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: 'dir 'tshogs skal ldan pho mo rnams: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī phaiṃ phaiṃ: a be sha ya a āḥ byin 'bebs rgyas pa 'dir bya mchan/ bcu pa brda sgo dbye ba ni: hūm̐: ma rig blo rtog srid pa'i sgo bcad de: kun nas dran rig ye shes 'char sgo phyes: gdod ma'i gshis lugs dbyings kyi lha zhal mjal: gnyis med ye shes ngo bo 'ja' ltar lhags: oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ bcu gcig pa brda'i spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: skye med ka dag rang byung klong yangs nas: snang mtha' 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: kun snang sgyu ma'i ngo bo rtsal 'gyed phyir: ma skyes stong pa'i rang mdangs dbyings nas gshegs: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bcu gnyis pa brda'i phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: dbyings rig ngo bo stong gsal lhag ge ba: nyag gcig dran rig gnyug ma'i gdan la bzhugs: 'chi med ngo bo kun byed tshe dpag med: brda rtags rol pa'i gar gyis phyag 'tshal bstod: oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ bcu gsum pa brda'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐: tshogs brgyad rnam dag stong nyid bcu drug dang : snang stong grags stong gsal stong bde stong ngang : dmigs bral rgya yan sprul pa'i mchod sbyin tshogs: 'chi med brtan phyir brda yi mchod pa 'bul: oṃ pra ti pū dza hoḥ bcu bzhi pa brda'i bshags pa ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe yi dam lha dang ngo bo gcig: bar du re dogs gnyis 'dzin rlung gis bsgyur: tha mal zhen pa'i rnam rtog ci mchis pa: de don nges tshig rtogs phyir gdung bas bshags: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe āḥ bco lnga brda'i bstod pa ni: hūm̐: blo bral chos sku mtshan ma'i dbyibs las 'das:

smra bsam brjod med rang byung dri med pa: skye 'gag gnas dang phyogs lhung rgya chad bral: legs par rtogs phyir brda yis rab tu bstod: oṃ badz+ra pū ru sha ya hoḥ bcu drug pa dam bca' bzung ba ni: hūm̐: gdod nas rnam dag chags med skyon bral ba: sku lnga lhun grub 'chi med dkyil 'khor lha: bag yod rtse gcig lta ba'i ting 'dzin gyis: gshis lugs ngo bo de ltar mi gtong bzung : oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tsit+ta hūm̐: zhes pas dam bca'i dkyil 'khor bzung bar bya: sa ma ya: dang po kun tu ngo bo nyid kyi ting 'dzin ni: hūm̐: ka dag khregs chod blo las 'das: brdal khyab mu mtha' bral ba ste: dngos po dngos med gshis lugs so: snang mtha' mgon pos de ltar smras: oṃ dharma dhā tu gar+bhe āḥ gnyis pa rtsal snang ma 'gags rol pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni: hūm̐: zang thal chen po'i ngang nyid las: kun rgyu phra mo'i rtsal snang shar: gdod nas snang zhing ngo bo stong : 'chi med mgon pos de ltar smras: oṃ badz+ra dzñā na sarba hoḥ gsum pa lha tshogs bskyed pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni: hūm̐: ye shes sna tshogs cho 'phrul las: stong pa'i dbyings la yi ge shar: bskyed pa'i sa bon hrīḥdang muṃ: ma 'gags gnyug mas de ltar gsal: oṃ dzñā na swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ hrī muṃ āt+ma ko3 haṃ: bzhi pa 'byung ba rim brtseg ni: hūm̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐ hrī muṃ hoḥ nam mkha' rlung me sa chu las: 'byung ba rim brtsegs gzhal yas khang : ma bcos gdod nas lhun grub pa: dran rdzogs wal gyis pho brang gsal: lnga pa gdan dang sa bon ni: hūm̐: e nam mkha' mthing nag kun tu bzang mo'i mkha': yam̐ rlung ri rgya gram dam tshig sgrol ma'i mkha': ram̐ sreg byed 'bar mched gos dkar mo yi mkha': kham̐ rgya mtsho rlabs 'khyil mā ma kī yi mkha': sum̐ rdo rje sa gzhi sangs rgyas spyan ma'i mkha': keṃ mi shigs rdo rje keng rus mkhar chen brtsegs:

bh+rūm̐ ye shes gzhal gsal rang byung lhun gyis grub: hrīḥdabus su 'chi med mgon po tshe yi bdag: mum̐ gsang ba'i lha mo dbyings phyug bde stong 'khril: hoḥ zung 'jug dga' bzhi spros bral sprul pa'i sras: oṃ bh+rūm̐ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la: ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la: a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la: hrī pad+ma ā yur ma ma muṃ shwa ri phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ: rā ga ya hoḥ rā ga ya mi: dza hūm̐ baṃ ho: hri hri hri hri: hri hri hri hri: hri hri hri hri: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: mum̐ mum̐ mum̐ mum̐: mum̐ mum̐ mum̐ mum̐: mum̐ mum̐ mum̐ mum̐: bam̐ bam̐ bam̐ bam̐: oṃ dzñā na tsa tur dā sha ya hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: drug pa gzhal yas bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las ye shes gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi phrin las lhun gyis grub: rtsig pa rin chen kha dog sna lnga la: 'dod snam dmar por mchod pa'i lha mo gar: gser gyi pha gu mdangs ldan khor yug khyab: mu tig chun po'i drwa ba drwa phyed spras: dril bu rnga yab dar dpyangs pu ru ru: shel gyi mda' yab rin chen pu shu mdzes: rnam thar brgyad ldan byang sems ka ba la: stong nyid bcu drug snying po'i gdung ma bres: bslab pa sde gsum phra mo'i dral lcam gtams: nang rnams bla bre 'phan gdugs lhub kyis 'phyangs: dbang po sgo dgu'i mthongs skar nyi zlas brgyan: tshad med bzhi yi rta babs bang rim ldan: theg chen bcu gsum chos 'khor nyi zla'i tog: thog steng thams cad dar dpyangs ba dan phyar: rin chen gdugs dang rgyal mtshan sna tshogs bsgrengs: 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i 'od zer khor yug gtibs: phyi rol rdo rwa pad phreng dur khrod dang : srung ba'i gur dang me ri bsnol thabs 'bar: mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs gzhal yas chen por gsal: oṃ badz+ra dzñā na maṇ+ḍa la bh+rūm̐ āt+ma ko3 haṃ: bdun pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha bskyed pa ni:

hūm̐: mu khyud 'khor lo pad+ma mdzes pa la: dbus su zla gam dmar po sgo gcig pa: de nang nyi zla'i g.yung drung ljang gsal steng : hrīḥlas 'chi med mgon po tshe dpag med: dmar gsal mdangs ldan dri med rā ga'i mdog: zhal gsum dmar chags dkar bzhad mthing gsal brjid: dbu skra thor tshugs spyi bor rta dbus brgyan: rigs lnga'i prog zhu dar dpyangs cod pan 'phur: sku stod lha rdzas dar mthing stod g.yogs mdzes: g.yas gnyis rdo rje rin chen yu ba 'dzin: g.yon gnyis pad+ma rgya gram yu ba 'dzin: rtsa gnyis 'khor lo tshe bum yum la 'khyud: sku smad le brgan lha reg dmar po bklubs: zhabs gnyis bde stong rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: gsang ye dmar mo dga' bzhi pang du 'khyud: mda' dar mgul 'khyud tshe bum yab la stob: zhab gnyis zung 'jug dpa' bo'i sked la 'khril: yab yum gsal stong 'dzin med lhag ger bsgom: hūm̐: zla gam sgo skyong dbang chen he ru kaḥ dmar nag rab khros spyi bor rta skad 'tsher: dbyug to thod khrag 'dzin cing dur khrod chas: rdo rje phag mo mthing nag yum dang sbyor: gri thod mgul 'khyud zhabs gnyis sked la 'khril: sku las skyes pa'i me dpung klong du gsal: hūm̐: de yi phyi rol pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i steng : shar du rdo rje tshe dpag sku mdog dkar: lho ru rat+na tshe dpag sku mdog ser: nub tu pad+ma tshe dpag sku mdog dmar: byang du karma tshe dpag sku mdog ljang : thams cad zhi tshul sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras: zhal phyag rgyan rdzogs gtso bo'i cha lugs bsgom: spyan ma mā kī gos dkar sgrol ma rnams: gtso mo'i cha lugs yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: bde stong zung 'jug dga' bzhi ldan par bsgom: hūm̐: de yi phyi rol pad+ma 'dab drug steng : rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin sku mdog mthing : sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin sku mdog dkar: tshe la dbang pa'i rig 'dzin sku mdog ser:

phyag rgya chen po rig 'dzin sku mdog dmar: lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin sku mdog ljang : bde ba chen po'i rig 'dzin sku mdog smug: zhal gcig phyag bzhi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas: khro 'dzum mdangs ldan sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras: g.yas g.yon dang po pad phreng tshe bum bsnams: mtha' gnyis rdo rje bhan+dha yum la 'khyud: zhabs gnyis phyed skyil rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi rigs: sangs rgyas sna tshogs mkha' 'gro drug rnams ni: dkar ser dmar ljang mthing la sngo ba'o: mda' dar tshe bum yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: zhabs gnyis bde stong zung 'jug sked la 'khril: yab yum 'ja' tshon skur snang stong gsal bhai: hūm̐: de yi phyi rol pad skor bcu drug la: puṣ+pe dkar mos me tog mda' dar 'dzin: dhū pe ser mos spos phor mda' dar 'dzin: ā lo dmar mos mar me mda' dar 'dzin: gan+dhe ljang mos dung chos mda' dar 'dzin: nai wi sngon mos zhal zas mda' dar 'dzin: lā s+ye dkar mos me long tshe bum 'dzin: mā l+ye ser mos phreng ba tshe bum 'dzin: gīrti dmar mos pi waṃ tshe bum 'dzin: nīrti ljang mos gling bu tshe bum 'dzin: sgra snyan sngon mos rdza rnga tshe bum 'dzin: gzugs mdzes dkar mos shel dung pad phreng 'dzin: sgra snyan ser mos ting ting pad phreng 'dzin: chos ma dmar mos po ti pad phreng 'dzin: reg bya ljang mos lha rdzas pad phreng 'dzin: thabs kyi gsang ye dkar mos byang sems 'dzin: shes rab gsang ye dmar mos rak+ta 'dzin: gsang ba'i ḍāk+ki rig ma bcu drug ni: mnyen lcug 'khril ldan gzhon nu'i lang tsho ldan: brda skad sgra sgrogs nu ma bha ga rgyas: bde ba'i rang bzhin sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras: brkyang bskum tshul ldan mdzes pa'i gar stabs bsgyur: stong nyid bcu drug snang stong rang bzhin gsal: hūm̐: de yi phyi rol sgo bzhi skyong mdzad pa:

rdo rje gar dbang rin chen gar dbang dang : pad+ma gar dbang las kyi gar dbang bzhi: dkar ser dmar ljang phyag g.yas rang rtags bsnams: g.yon pas bhan+dha thogs shing khro 'dzum tshul: gsang ye sgo skyong rigs bzhi sku la 'khril: rang mdog rgyan ldan mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: zung 'jug bde stong zhabs gnyis yab la 'khril: dpa' bo'i gar thabs sgeg pa'i cha lugs bsgom: hūm̐: gzhan yang phyi nang tshe 'dzin bye ba 'bum: sna tshogs dpag yas nyi zer rdul ltar 'khrigs: 'ja' 'od thig le lug rgyud sprin ltar gtibs: gsal la 'dzin med chu zla'i snang tshul bzhin: ma bcos stong pa'i dbyings la 'ja' ltar shar: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis: dag pa mkha' spyod 'og min zhing khams kyi: 'chi med rig 'dzin tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: rang bzhin ye shes klong nas spyan drangs gyur: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ a be sha ya a āḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

dang po spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min ka dag lhun grub pho brang nas: snang mtha' yab yum sgo skyong gshegs su gsol: zang thal rnam dag bde chen pho brang nas: tshe bdag rigs bzhi yab yum gshegs su gsol: dbyings rig gsal stong ma 'gags pho brang nas: rig 'dzin yab yum bcu gnyis gshegs su gsol: zab lam rnam dag mkha' spyod pho brang nas: gsang ba'i lha mo bcu drug gshegs su gsol: tshad med rnam bzhi lhun grub pho brang nas: sgo ba tshe bdag yab yum gshegs su gsol: zil gnon dkyil 'khor dbang gi pho brang nas: phyi nang sprul pa yang sprul gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ sgrub pa'i dus su 'dir byin 'bebs bya: gnyis pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: zil gnon dbang chen tshe yi pho brang nas: glang chen rta mchog rma bya shang shang dang : seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng : 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs bzhugs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya a be sha ya satwaṃ: gsum pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: rtse gcig gdung ba mi phyed gus pa yis: zil gnon dbang chen tshe yi lha tshogs la: 'chi med rig 'dzin 'ja' lus 'grub pa'i phyir: zung 'jug bde stong gar gyis phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ bzhi pa phyi mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: tshogs drug reg na bde ba mchog stair ba: me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab ma: zhal zas sil snyan rol mo dbyangs ldan ma: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la 'bul: bzhes nas 'ja' lus tshe yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza āḥhūm̐: lnga pa dbang po drug la mchod pa ni: hūm̐: gzugs mdzes lang ling gar mo sgra snyan ma: dri mchog lnga ldan ro mngar reg bya dang : chos sogs rdo rje'i mchod pa sna tshogs 'di: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la 'bul: bzhes nas 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she dharma pū dza āḥham̐'u:

drug pa glu dbyangs gar gyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: yid 'phrog dpa' mo gzugs mdzes lta na sdug: glu ma gar ma sgeg mo phreng 'dzin ma: bzhad pa pi waṃ gling bu rdza rnga ma: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la 'bul: bzhes nas 'ja' lus tshe yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye mā l+ye gīrti nīrti waṃ se pū dza āḥhūm̐: bdun pa rgyal srid sna bdun 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: chos kyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong mu khyud can: dwang ba'i yid mtshar bkod pa'i yon tan ldan: gser gyi 'khor lo gzi 'od cher 'bar 'di: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la 'bul: bgrang yas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol: oṃ tsakra rat+na pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: hūm̐: yid kyi khyon kun 'gengs pa'i gter chen po: zad med dgos 'byung 'phags pa'i nor bdun phyug: bsam 'phel nor bu rin chen dam pa 'di: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la 'bul: bsod nams bla med tshogs chen yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ ma ṇi rat+na pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: hūm̐: reg na mi bzod bde ba mchog ster ma: yid 'phrog dga' bzhi gzugs 'dzin shes rab can: zag med ye shes ston mdzad btsun mo 'di: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la 'bul: zab lam mkha' spyod 'ja' lus 'grub par shog: oṃ wasti rat+na pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: hūm̐: mi dbang rig pa'i rgyal srid brtan byed pa: 'gyu ba'i klung gis legs bskyod dbang sgyur te: don gnyis srid 'dzin blon po rin chen 'di: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la 'bul: kun brtags ma rig mun rum bcom par shog: oṃ pu ru kha rat+na pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: hūm̐: mi g.yo rdo rje ri rab ltar brtan pa: nam yang g.yo med bde ba'i ting 'dzin mchog: rtsal chen shugs 'chang glang po rin po che: 'chi med mgon po tshe'i lha la 'bul: dran rig lta ba'i rgyal sa zin par shog: oṃ hastī rat+na pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā:

hūm̐: ye shes mkha' la zang thal rab 'gyu ba'i: rig pa'i cang shes rlung gi shugs 'chang ba: thar lam bgrod byed rta mchog rin chen 'di: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la 'bul: theg chen phyir mi ldog pa'i lam thob shog: oṃ a shwa rat+na pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: hūm̐: smon lam bden bzhi'i dpung tshogs rab bskyed pa: srid pa'i 'khrul 'khor bcom phyir dpa' bar 'gro: dug lnga g.yul las legs rgyal dmag dpon 'di: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la 'bul: tshe rabs mnar ba'i duḥkha mi 'byung shog: oṃ khaḍ+ga rat+na pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: brgyad pa bkra shis rtags brgyad 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: gang zhig bkra shis 'byung ba'i lha rdzas che: rin chen gdugs dang chos dung g.yas su 'khyil: pad+ma 'dab stong rnam rgyal bum pa zlum: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la 'bul: rgyu yi tshogs rdzogs bkra shis dge legs shog: oṃ maṅga la ā yur tsa tur rat+na pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: hūm̐: gang zhig bkra shis 'byung ba'i lha rdzas che: mi nub rgyal mtshan mdzes pa'i dpal be'u: rin chen 'bar ba gser gyi 'khor lo mchog: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la 'bul: 'bras bu tshogs rdzogs bkra shis dge legs shog: oṃ maṅga la ā yur tsa tur rat+na pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: dgu pa sman mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bhan+dha mtshan ldan bum ril dum gcig nang : dug lnga nad sel sna tshogs sman mchog sbyor: rang byung ye shes lnga ldan mchod pa 'di: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la 'bul: bzhes nas 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ dzñā na aṇ+ṭau pū dza khā hi: bcu pa nang mchod las bdud rtsi 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: mi sha rta sha khyi sha glang chen sha: dri chen dri chu dmar chen byang sems bkang : ye nas rang byung bla med bdud rtsi 'di: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la 'bul: bzhes nas 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi:

bcu gcig pa bdud rtsi lag mchod 'bul ba ni: phyag g.yas kyis bhan+dha 'dzin te: g.yon gyi srin lag gis 'thor zhing 'di skad do: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ hūm̐: snang srid rdo rje ka pā la: snod bcud pad+ma'i bdud rtsis gtams: thabs mchog lag pa g.yas su thogs: shes rab g.yon gyi mtheb srin sbyar: sor bcu'i yig 'brus byin gyis brlabs: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ḥ rā ga ya hoḥ rā ga ya mi: dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mu tra la a haṃ: a mṛ ta pañtsa hoḥ hūm̐: bde chen g.yas kyi sor mo ru: sa bon gnas gyur lha ru gsal: mthe bong oṃ las tshe yi bdag: mdzub mo hūm̐ las rdo rje sems: gung mo trām̐ las rin chen 'byung : srin lag hrī las snang mtha' yas: mthe'u chung ā las don yod grub: dpa' bo thabs kyi sku ru gsal: hūm̐: stong gsal g.yon gyi sor rtse ru: mthe bong mūm̐ las gsang ye ma: mdzub mo lām̐ las sangs rgyas spyan: gung mo mām̐ las mā ma kī: srin lag pām̐ las gos dkar mo: mthe'u chung tām̐ las dam tshig sgrol: dpa' mo shes rab sku ru gsal: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rā ga ho yis rgyud bskul nas: rā ga ya yis rjes su gnas: dza zhes yab yum phyag gis 'dzin: hūm̐ zhes zung 'jug thabs shes sbyor: baṃ zhes mnyen lcug dam du 'khril: ho zhes mkha' gsang sprad de srub: mu tras bskul te g.yo zhing phab: a haṃ dkar dmar rgyun chen babs: a mṛ ta yis dam ye bsres: pañtsa ho zhes rigs lnga zhu: lan gsum dkrugs pas ye shes ngang : zag med bdud rtsi ngo mtshar che: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum dkrugs te g.yon gyi srin lag gis 'thor zhing : hūm̐: bdud rtsi rang bzhin chos dbyings skye med ngang : bdud rtsi ngo bo yi dam lha yi dngos: bdud rtsi'i don ni mchog gi dngos grub stsol: steng du gtor bas khro bo'i gur khang gyur: 'og tu 'thor bas dgra bgegs tshar du gcod:

phyogs bcur 'thor bas rgyal ba sras bcas mnyes: lus la 'thor bas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du: lce la myong bas 'chi med rig 'dzin 'thob: rang byung ye shes rang bzhin e ma hoḥ de nas rim bzhin 'thor zhing : hūm̐: rigs lnga yab yum 'od zhu bdud rtsi dngos: bde stong bla med mchod mchog sprin chen po: maṇ+ḍal g.yas kyis reg pa'i bdud rtsi 'di: srin mdzub shes rab ḍāk+ki'i gar gyis mchod: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrī ṭhā kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: snang mtha' mgon po rigs lnga sangs rgyas stong : dbyings kyi ma sring mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag tshogs: rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa thams cad la: zag med rnam dag bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dga' rab shrī sing 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang : pad+ma 'byung gnas mtsho rgyal man+da ra: brda brgyud snyan khung brgyud pa thams cad la: zag med rnam dag bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sangs rgyas ye shes dhe wa dha ra dang : nam mkha'i snying po dpal gyi seṅge sogs: tshig brgyud shog ser brgyud pa thams cad la: zag med rnam dag bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ e haṃ lo ha badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa hūm̐: in+t+ra ma hā badz+ra ku mu ṭa: ā yur dha ra dhe wi la sogs pa: bka' bab lung bstan brgyud pa thams cad la: zag med rnam dag bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: tshe bdag rigs lnga rta phag rig 'dzin drug: rig ma bcu drug sgo ba gter srung bcas: 'chi bdag zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: zag med rnam dag bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: thugs rjes rtser dgongs 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐:

bka' bab chos bdag rig 'dzin sum cu gnyis: thugs kyi sras brgyad rten 'brel sras bzhi sogs: drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma thams cad la: zag med rnam dag bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: grub thob drang srong brgyud 'dzin bye ba 'bum: phyi rabs 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur rjes 'jug la: zag med rnam dag bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gzhan yang snang srid snod bcud skye 'gro'i tshogs: 'chi med rig 'dzin lha tshogs skur gsal nas: zag med rnam dag bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par shog: oṃ āḥham̐'u: bla med bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod kyis: rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig: dam tshig nyams chag sol gyur cig: rigs drug lan chags byang gyur cig: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta: kā ya sid+dhi: wāk+ka sid+dhi: tsit+ta sid+dhi: ghu na sid+dhi: ghu h+ya sid+dhi: hūm̐: zhes mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam: bdud rtsi'i gnas lngar thig le bya: bcu gnyis pa rak+ta'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐: dung mar shes rab gsal ba'i snod nang du: nyon mongs rgyud drug bsgral ba'i rak+tas bkang : chags med bde ba chen po'i mchod pa 'di: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la 'bul: bzhes nas 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ dzñā na rak+ta pañtsa la kha kha khā hi: bcu gsum pa gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: phyi snod yangs pa 'jig rten gtor gzhong du: nang bcud sems can dam rdzas gtor mar bskyed: ye nas rang byung bla med gtor ma 'di: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la 'bul: bzhes nas 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ ma hā bha ling+ta pū dza la kha kha khā hi: bcu bzhi gsang ba'i mchod pa las sbyor mchod 'bul ba ni:

hūm̐: dbyings phyug bzang mo'i gsang ba'i bha ga ru: zung 'jug thabs mchog spyod pa'i rdo rje yi: mkha' las babs pa'i dkar dmar byang sems 'di: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la 'bul: bzhes nas 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ su khaṃ swa bhā me thu na aṇ+ḍa rā ga pū dza hoḥ bco lnga pa spro na sbyor ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: snang mtha' mgon po tshe dpag med: yum mchog gsang ye gnyis med sbyor: zung 'jug bde stong 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa bzhes: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ rā ga bho ga yo ga mu tra pū dza ho: hūm̐: bcom ldan rdo rje tshe dpag med: yum mchog sangs rgyas spyan ma sbyor: zung 'jug bde stong 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa bzhes: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ rā ga bho ga yo ga mu tra pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: bcom ldan rat+na tshe dpag med: gsang ba mā kī yum dang sbyor: zung 'jug bde stong 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa bzhes: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ rā ga bho ga yo ga mu tra pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: bcom ldan pad+ma tshe dpag med: gos dkar lha mo yum dang sbyor: zung 'jug bde stong 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa bzhes: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ rā ga bho ga yo ga mu tra pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: bcom ldan karma tshe dpag med: yum mchog dam tshig sgrol mar sbyor: zung 'jug bde stong 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa bzhes: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ rā ga bho ga yo ga mu tra pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: bcom ldan dbang chen he ru kaḥ gsang ba phag mo yum dang sbyor: zung 'jug bde stong 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa bzhes: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol:

oṃ rā ga bho ga mu tra pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin mchog: yum mchog rdo rje spyod byed sbyor: zung 'jug bde stong 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa bzhes: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ rā ga bho ga yo ga mu tra pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin mchog: yum mchog rdo rje bskul byed sbyor: zung 'jug bde stong 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa bzhes: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ rā ga bho ga yo ga mu tra pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin mchog: yum mchog rdo rje bde byed sbyor: zung 'jug bde stong 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa bzhes: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ rā ga bho ga yo ga mu tra pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin mchog: yum chen rdo rje brda 'byin sbyor: zung 'jug bde stong 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa bzhes: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ rā ga bho ga yo ga mu tra pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin mchog: yum mchog rdo rje 'beb byed sbyor: zung 'jug bde stong 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa bzhes: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ rā ga bho ga yo ga mu tra pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: bde ba chen po'i rig 'dzin mchog: yum mchog rdo rje gsal byed sbyor: zung 'jug bde stong 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa bzhes: 'ja' lus rdo rje dngos grub stsol: oṃ rā ga bho ga yo ga mu tra pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: gsang ba'i rig ma bcu drug tshogs: mnyen lcug nu 'bur bha ga rgyas: tshe bdag dpa' bo'i tshogs la 'bul: zung 'jug bde stonga'akhrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa bzhes: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol:

oṃ rā ga bho ga yo ga mu tra pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: dpa' bo rdo rje gar gyi dbang : yum chen lcags kyu dkar mor sbyor: zung 'jug bde stong 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa bzhes: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ rā ga bho ga yo ga mu tra pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: dpa' bo rat+na gar gyi dbang : yum chen zhags pa ser mor sbyor: zung 'jug bde stong 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa bzhes: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ rā ga bho ga yo ga mu tra pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: dpa' bo pad+ma gar gyi dbang : yum chen lcags sgrog dmar mor sbyor: zung 'jug bde stong 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa bzhes: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ rā ga bho ga yo ga mu tra pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: dpa' bo karma gar gyi dbang : yum chen dril bu ljang mor sbyor: zung 'jug bde stong 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa bzhes: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ rā ga bho ga yo ga mu tra pū dza hoḥ

bcu drug pa sgrol ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: ma rig ngar 'dzin srid pa'i ru tra la: dran rig ting 'dzin phur bu btab pa yis: dug lnga dbyings su bsgral ba'i mchod pa 'di: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la 'bul: bzhes nas 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ dzñā na mu tra pū dza hoḥ māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta king ni ri ti la kha kha khā hi: bcu bdun pa dkyil 'khor lha la bstod pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ chos dbyings klong nas rnam sprul drwa ba'i gar: rigs kyi bdag po snang mtha' tshe dpag med: rnga sgra'i rgyal po pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs: dmar gsal nyi zer 'bum gyis 'khyud pa'i mdangs: 'gro mgon 'chi med tshe yi lha la bstod: sku gsum mtshon phyir zhal gsum dkar dmar mthing : theg chen lam ston dbu skra spyi bor bcings: ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga'i cod pan 'phur: rtog med chos sku'i rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog: rin chen snyan rgyan lha rdzas stod g.yogs gsol: pha rol phyin drug ldan pa'i phyag gi rtser: tshe bdag mgon po rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan thogs: sku smad lha yi reg bya dmar po dkris: tshad med bzhi ldan zhabs gnyis skyil krung bzhugs: 'ja' lus drwa ba mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar ba: rigs bdag tshe yi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ hrīḥ chags med skyon bral dbang gi 'khor lo can: gsang ba shes rab dri med me shel mdog: mdzes 'dzum chags pa'i spyan mdangs zim me ba: dbu skra thor tshugs lcang lo zur phud 'phyangs: rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dar ljang cod pan 'phur: phyag g.yas mda' dar bde chen mgul nas 'khyud: g.yon pas zag med bdud rtsi yab la stob: rin chen dang ni rus pa'i rgyan drug mdzes: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem nu 'bur bha ga rgyas: zhabs gnyis zung 'jug yab kyi sku la 'khril: dga' bzhi mi bzod rgyas pa'i bcud g.yo ma: gsang ba'i yum chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:

hūm̐ hrīḥ ye shes 'khor lo'i brdal khyab zla gam gyi: sgo skyong yang dag bla med he ru kaḥ snying rje khros pas sku mdog dmar nag rngam: dur khrod chas brgyad gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan: phyag g.yas dbyug tos tshe bdud klad pa skem: phyag g.yon bhan dmar dug lnga'i khrag la dgyes: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar gyis sa gsum g.yo: sku las skyes pa'i me dpung phyogs bcur 'bar: dbang chen he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ gsang ba'i yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: sku mdog mthing nag skye med don dang ldan: khro gnyer sgeg mo ye shes dpa' mo che: phyag g.yas gri gug skye 'chi nyon mongs gcod: g.yon pa'i dung khrag yab la dgyes par stob: rus pa'i rgyan ldan phar phyin drug ldan rdzogs: zung 'jug brkyang bskum yab kyi sku la 'khril: yum chen phag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gzugs kyi phung po ma spangs gnas su dag: chu shel mdangs ldan dkar dmar mthing zhal 'dzum: longs sku'i rgyan ldan mdzes pa'i cha lugs rdzogs: phar phyin drug ldan phyag gi sor rtse ru: 'chi med dbang rdzas sku lnga'i phyag mtshan bsnams: zhabs gnyis skyil krung tshad med ngo bo nyid: lha bu'i bdud bcom rdo rje tshe dpag med: me long ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: tshor ba'i phung po ma spangs gnas su dag: sa snying mdangs ldan ser dkar mthing zhal 'dzum: longs sku'i rgyan ldan mdzes pa'i cha lugs rdzogs: phar phyin drug ldan phyag gi sor mo ru: 'chi med dbang rdzas sku lnga'i phyag mtshan bsnams: zhabs gnyis skyil krung tshad med ngo bo nyid: phung po'i bdud bcom rat+na tshe dpag med: mnyam nyid ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: 'du shes phung po ma spangs gnas su dag: byi ru'i mdangs ldan dkar dmar mthing zhal can: longs sku'i rgyan ldan mdzes pa'i cha lugs rdzogs: phar phyin drug ldan phyag gi sor mo ru:

'chi med dbang rdzas sku lnga'i phyag mtshan bsnams: zhabs gnyis skyil krung tshad med ngo bo nyid: nyon mongs bdud bcom pad+ma tshe dpag med: sor rtog ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: 'du byed phung po ma spangs gnas su dag: mar gad mdangs ldan ljang dmar mthing zhal 'dzum: longs sku'i rgyan ldan mdzes pa'i cha lugs rdzogs: phar phyin drug ldan phyag gi sor rtse ru: 'chi med dbang rdzas sku lnga'i phyag mtshan bsnams: zhabs gnyis skyil krung tshad med ngo bo nyid: 'chi bdag bdud bcom karma tshe dpag med: bya grub ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sa yi khams rnams ma spangs gnas su dag: si ta'i mdog can mdzes 'dzum chags pa mo: phyag g.yas mda' dar g.yon pas bdud rtsi bsnams: rin chen rus rgyan dar dpyangs ga shal 'phur: 'jo sgeg dpa' mo shes rab rang bzhin can: bde chen rgyal ba'i sku la 'khril mdzad yum: gzugs khams 'jig rten gnas rnams stong mdzad ma: sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: chu yi khams rnams ma spangs gnas su dag: ru bya'i mdog can mdzes 'dzum chags pa mo: phyag g.yas mda' dar g.yon pas bdud rtsi bsnams: rin chen rus rgyan dar dpyangs ga shal 'phur: 'jo sgeg dpa' mo shes rab rang bzhin can: bde chen rgyal ba'i sku la 'khril mdzad yum: 'dod khams 'jig rten gnas rnams stong mdzad ma: mā ma kī yi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: me yi khams rnams ma spangs gnas su dag: rā ga'i mdog can mdzes 'dzum chags pa mo: phyag g.yas mda' dar g.yon pas bdud rtsi bsnams: rin chen rus rgyan dar dpyangs ga shal 'phur: 'jo sgeg dpa' mo shes rab rang bzhin can: bde chen rgyal ba'i sku la 'khril mdzad yum: gzugs med 'jig rten gnas rnams stong mdzad ma: gos dkar mo yi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rlung gi khams rnams ma spangs gnas su dag: mar gad mdog can mdzes 'dzum chags pa mo:

phyag g.yas mda' dar g.yon pas bdud rtsi bsnams: rin chen rus rgyan dar dpyangs ga shal 'phur: 'jo sgeg dpa' mo shes rab rang bzhin can: bde chen rgyal ba'i sku la 'khril mdzad yum: skye mched mu bzhi'i gnas rnams dag mdzad ma: dam tshig sgrol ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: ser sna'i rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: nī la'i mdog can sgeg bzhad dgyes pa po: g.yas gnyis pad phreng rdo rje thabs shes ldan: g.yon gnyis tshe bum bhan+dha bde stong ngang : longs spyod rdzogs sku sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras: zhabs gnyis phyed skyil rol stabs 'gying tshul can: sbyin pa'i go cha legs 'chang dpa' bo che: yi dwags 'jig rten sdug bsngal skyob mdzad pa: rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin la phyag 'tshal: hūm̐: tshul 'chal rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: ru bya'i mdog can sgeg bzhad dgyes pa po: g.yas gnyis pad phreng rdo rje thabs shes ldan: g.yon gnyis tshe bum bhan+dha bde stong ngang : longs spyod rdzogs sku sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras: zhabs gnyis phyed skyil rol stabs 'gying tshul can: tshul khrims go cha legs 'chang dpa' bo che: mi yi 'jig rten sdug bsngal skyob mdzad pa: sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin la phyag 'tshal: hūm̐: khong khro'i rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: swa na'i mdog can sgeg bzhad dgyes pa po: g.yas gnyis pad phreng rdo rje thabs shes ldan: g.yon gnyis tshe bum bhan+dha bde stong ngang : longs spyod rdzogs sku sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras: zhabs gnyis phyed skyil rol stabs 'gying tshul can: bzod pa'i go cha legs 'chang dpa' bo che: lha min 'jig rten sdug bsngal skyob mdzad pa: tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin la phyag 'tshal: hūm̐: g.yeng ba'i rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: gru ma'i mdog can sgeg bzhad dgyes pa po: g.yas gnyis pad phreng rdo rje thabs shes ldan: g.yon gnyis tshe bum bhan+dha bde stong ngang : longs spyod rdzogs sku sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras:
