zhabs gnyis phyed skyil rol stabs 'gying tshul can: bsam gtan go cha legs 'chang dpa' bo che: lha yi 'jig rten sdug bsngal skyob mdzad pa: phyag rgya chen po rig 'dzin la phyag 'tshal: hūm̐: le lo'i rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: yam shwa'i mdog can sgeg bzhad dgyes pa po: g.yas gnyis pad phreng rdo rje thabs shes ldan: g.yon gnyis tshe bum bhan+dha bde stong ngang : longs spyod rdzogs sku sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras: zhabs gnyis phyed skyil rol stabs 'gying tshul can: brtson 'grus go cha legs 'chang dpa' bo che: byol song 'jig rten sdug bsngal skyob mdzad pa: lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin la phyag 'tshal: hūm̐: shes 'chal rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: kriṇa'i mdog can sgeg bzhad dgyes pa po: g.yas gnyis pad phreng rdo rje thabs shes ldan: g.yon gnyis tshe bum bhan+dha bde stong ngang : longs spyod rdzogs sku sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras: zhabs gnyis phyed skyil rol stabs 'gying tshul can: shes rab go cha legs 'chang dpa' bo che: dmyal ba'i 'jig rten sdug bsngal skyob mdzad pa: bde ba chen po'i rig 'dzin la phyag 'tshal: hūm̐: zhe sdang rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: sku mdog dkar mo mda' dar tshe bum bsnams: gzhon nu lang tsho ldan pa'i cha lugs can: lta na sdug cing yid 'phrog rgyan gyis mdzes: dpa' bo'i sku la 'khril ba'i bde bskyed yum: shes bya'i sgrib pa ma lus sbyong mdzad ma: rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: nga rgyal rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: sku mdog ser mo mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: gzhon nu lang tsho ldan pa'i cha lugs can: lta na sdug cing yid 'phrog rgyan gyis mdzes: dpa' bo'i sku la 'khril ba'i bde bskyed yum: nyon mongs sgrib pa ma lus sbyong mdzad ma: rin chen mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: 'dod chags rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag:

sku mdog dmar mo mda' dar tshe bum bsnams: gzhon nu lang tsho ldan pa'i cha lugs can: lta na sdug cing yid 'phrog rgyan gyis mdzes: dpa' bo'i sku la 'khril ba'i bde bskyed yum: las kyi sgrib pa ma lus sbyong mdzad ma: pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: phrag dog rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: sku mdog ljang mo mda' dar tshe bum bsnams: gzhon nu lang tsho ldan pa'i cha lugs can: lta na sdug cing yid 'phrog rgyan gyis mdzes: dpa' bo'i sku la 'khril ba'i bde bskyed yum: bag chags sgrib pa ma lus sbyong mdzad ma: las kyi mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gti mug rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: sku mdog mthing ka mda' dar tshe bum bsnams: gzhon nu lang tsho ldan pa'i cha lugs can: lta na sdug cing yid 'phrog rgyan gyis mdzes: dpa' bo'i sku la 'khril ba'i bde bskyed yum: kun nas bslang ba'i sgrib pa sbyong mdzad ma: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sdug bsngal rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: sku mdog smug mthing mda' dar tshe bum bsnams: gzhon nu lang tsho ldan pa'i cha lugs can: lta na sdug cing yid 'phrog rgyan gyis mdzes: dpa' bo'i sku la 'khril ba'i bde bskyed yum: ma rig sgrib pa ma lus sbyong mdzad ma: sna tshogs mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dbu la mchod 'bul ma: puṣ+pe dkar mos me tog mda' dar 'dzin: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gar mo lang ling gzugs: dbyangs can brda 'byin yid 'ong mdzes ma 'phro: gsang ba'i rig ma me tog 'dzin la bstod: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs shangs la mchod 'bul ma: dhū pe ser mos spos phor mda' dar 'dzin: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gar mo lang ling gzugs: dbyangs can brda 'byin yid 'ong mdzes ma 'phro: gsang ba'i rig ma spos phor 'dzin la bstod: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs spyan la mchod 'bul ma:

ā lo dmar mos mar me mda' dar 'dzin: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gar mo lang ling gzugs: dbyangs can brda 'byin yid 'ong mdzes ma 'phro: gsang ba'i rig ma zhun mar 'dzin la bstod: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor la sogs ljags la mchod 'bul ma: gan+dhe ljang mos dung chos mda' dar 'dzin: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gar mo lang ling gzugs: dbyangs can brda 'byin yid 'ong mdzes ma 'phro: gsang ba'i rig ma dung chos 'dzin la bstod: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor lha yi zhal la mchod 'bul ma: nai wi sngon mos zhal zas mda' dar 'dzin: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gar mo lang ling zugs: dbyangs can brda 'dzin yid 'ong mdzes ma 'phro: gsang ba'i rig ma zhal zas 'dzin la bstod: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs sku la mchod 'bul ma: lā s+ye dkar mos me long bum pa 'dzin: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gar mo lang ling gzugs: dbyangs can brda 'byin yid 'ong mdzes ma 'phro: gsang ba'i rig ma me long 'dzin la bstod: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gsung la mchod 'bul ma: mā l+ye ser mos phreng ba tshe bum 'dzin: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gar mo lang ling gzugs: dbyangs can brda 'byin yid 'ong mdzes ma 'phro: gsang ba'i rig ma phreng ba 'dzin la bstod: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs la mchod 'bul ma: gan+dhe dmar mos pi waṃ tshe bum 'dzin: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gar mo lang ling gzugs: dbyangs can brda 'byin yid 'ong mdzes ma 'phro: gsang ba'i rig ma pi waṃ 'dzin la bstod: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs yon tan mchod 'bul ma: nīrti ljang mos gling bu tshe bum 'dzin: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gar mo lang ling gzugs: dbyangs can brda 'byin yid 'ong mdzes ma 'phro: gsang ba'i rig ma gling bu 'dzin la bstod: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs phrin las mchod 'bul ma: sgra chen sngon mos rdza rnga tshe bum 'dzin: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gar mo lang ling gzugs:

dbyangs can brda 'byin yid 'ong mdzes ma 'phro: gsang ba'i rig ma rdza rnga 'dzin la bstod: hūm̐: maṇ+ḍal kā ya bde bas tshim byed ma: gzugs mdzes dkar mos shel dung pad phreng 'dzin: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gar mo lang ling gzugs: dbyangs can brda 'byin yid 'ong mdzes ma 'phro: gsang ba'i rig ma dung shel 'dzin la bstod: hūm̐: maṇ+ḍal wāk+ka bde bas tshim byed ma: sgra snyan ser mos ting ting pad phreng 'dzin: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gar mo lang ling gzugs: dbyangs can brda 'byin yid 'ong mdzes ma 'phro: gsang ba'i rig ma ting ting 'dzin la bstod: hūm̐: maṇ+ḍal tsit+ta bde bas tshim mdzad ma: chos ma dmar mos po ti pad phreng 'dzin: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gar mo lang ling gzugs: dbyangs can brda 'byin yid 'ong mdzes ma 'phro: gsang ba'i rig ma po ti 'dzin la bstod: hūm̐: maṇ+ḍal ghu na bde bas tshim mdzad ma: reg bya ljang mos lha rdzas pad phreng 'dzin: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gar mo lang ling gzugs: dbyangs can brda 'byin yid 'ong mdzes ma 'phro: gsang ba'i rig ma lha rdzas 'dzin la bstod: hūm̐: maṇ+ḍal ghu h+ya bde bas tshim mdzad ma: thabs shes gsang ye dkar mos byang sems 'dzin: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gar mo lang ling gzugs: dbyangs can brda 'byin yid 'ong mdzes ma 'phro: gsang ba'i rig ma byang sems 'dzin la bstod: hūm̐: maṇ+ḍal rā ga bde bas tshim byed ma: shes rab gsang ye dmar mos rak+ta 'dzin: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gar mo lang ling gzugs: dbyangs can brda 'byin yid 'ong mdzes ma 'phro: gsang ba'i rig ma rak+ta 'dzin la bstod: hūm̐: lus kyi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: sgo skyong gar dbang badz+ra he ru kaḥ sku mdog dkar po sgeg bzhad dgyes pa ston: lcags kyu bhan+dha 'dzin cing dpal gyi chas: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar stabs tshe bdud 'joms: byams pa tshad med zhi ba'i dpa' bo che: rdo rje gar dbang sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:

hūm̐: ngag gi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: sgo skyong gar dbang rat+na he ru kaḥ sku mdog ser po sgeg bzhad dgyes pa ston: zhags pa bhan+dha 'dzin cing dpal gyi chas: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar stabs tshe bdud 'joms: snying rje tshad med rgyas pa'i dpa' bo che: rin chen gar dbang sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: yid kyi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: sgo skyong gar dbang pad+ma he ru kaḥ sku mdog dmar po sgeg bzhad dgyes pa ston: lcags sgrog bhan+dha 'dzin cing dpal gyi chas: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar stabs tshe bdud 'joms: dga' ba tshad med dbang gi dpa' bo che: pad+ma gar dbang sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: 'gyu rtog rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: sgo skyong gar dbang karma he ru kaḥ sku mdog ljang khu sgeg bzhad dgyes par ston: dril bu bhan+dha 'dzin cing dpal gyi chas: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar stabs tshe bdud 'joms: btang snyoms tshad med drag po'i dpa' bo che: las kyi gar dbang sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: mig gi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: sgo skyong dkar mo mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: bde stong zung 'jug nu ma bha ga rgyas: dga' bzhi las byed brtan g.yo dbang du sdud: 'khyud pa'i dpa' mo zag med skyed pa'i yum: yid 'ong mdzes pa'i sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras: rtag par lta ba'i sdug bsngal skyob mdzad ma: lha mo lcags kyu ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rna ba'i rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: sgo skyong ser mos zhags pa tshe bum 'dzin: bde stong zung 'jug nu 'bur bha ga rgyas: dga' bzhi'i las byed brtan g.yo dbang du sdud: 'khyud pa'i dpa' mo zag med skyed pa'i yum: yid 'ong mdzes pa'i sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras: chad par lta ba'i sdug bsngal skyob mdzad ma: lha mo zhags pa ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sna yi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: sgo skyong dmar mos lcags sgrog tshe bum 'dzin:

bde stong zung 'jug nu ma bha ga rgyas: dga' bzhi'i las byed brtan g.yo dbang du sdud: 'khyud pa'i dpa' mo zag med skyed pa'i yum: yid 'ong mdzes pa'i sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras: bdag tu lta ba'i sdug bsngal skyob mdzad ma: lha mo lcags sgrog ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: lce yi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: sgo skyong ljang mos dril bu tshe bum 'dzin: bde stong zung 'jug nu ma bha ga rgyas: dga' bzhi'i las byed brtan g.yo dbang du sdud: 'khyud pa'i dpa' mo zag med skyed pa'i yum: yid 'ong mdzes pa'i sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras: gzhan 'dzin 'tshe ba'i sdug bsngal skyob mdzad ma: lha mo dril bu ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gzhan yang bar khyams khor yug la gnas pa'i: dbang phyug zhing skyong ging dang laṅka dang : gnas nyul ma sring phra men shugs 'gro sogs: sku mdog ma nges dgyes pa'i cha byad can: rdzu 'phrul shugs 'chang las kyi bya ra mkhan: tshe yi pho nya yang sprul mgyogs ma sogs: 'chi bdag zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: 'chi med rig 'dzin bstsal phyir gus pas bstod:

dzap bskul ni/ hūm̐: de ltar bstod cing sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: mgon mchog khyed kyi thugs dam rgyud bskul nas: bdud bzhi tshe yi bar chad dbyings su sol: rtsa rlung thig le'i bkrag mdangs yar la skyed: brtan g.yo 'gro ba'i tshe bsod bcud bsdus nas: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus ngag yid la stims: nam yang 'pho 'gyur med par rgyas gtab ste: 'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i srog sgrub pa'i: dbang bzhi tshe yi rig 'dzin deng 'dir stsol: bsnyen dmigs ni/ hūm̐: snying po brtan par gyur pa yi: dbang chen rdo rje'i sa gzhi che: mi 'gyur dbyings kyi mkha' klong dbus: rang rig dbang chen rta mgrin sku: dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: khro 'dzum sgeg pa'i cha byad can: phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje bsnams: g.yon pas dril bu dku la brten: phyag rgya dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'gying 'gros thabs: yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: khro 'dzum rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras: gri thod 'dzin cing mgul nas 'khyud: zhabs gnyis zung 'jug sked la 'khril: yab yum gzi brjid dpal 'bar ldan: hūm̐: gsang ba yab kyi thugs ka ru: lnga ldan mchong gur smug po'i dbus: pad+ma dmar po 'dab bzhi'i steng : dran rig ngo bo ka dag las: snang mtha' mgon po 'od mi 'gyur: dmar gsal pad+ma rā ga'i mdog: mnyam bzhag skyil krung tshe bum bsnams: 'ja' zer lug rgyud skur snang ba'i: thugs dbus rlung gi g.yung drung ni: ljang sngon dwangs ma lnga yi steng : thabs shes nyi zla gwa'u sbyor: de nang srog gi dwangs ma ni: dam tshig ye shes ngo bo nyid: hrīḥdamar nṛ ljang gyen la langs: de la ye shes lnga ldan ni: 'ja' 'od lug rgyud sprin ltar gtibs: nyi mar 'od zer 'bum kyud ltar: rtsa ba'i sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor: nyi zla gwa'u'i phyi rol du: dbang chen rtsa ba'i sngags phreng 'khor:

'bar ba'i gzi byin cher g.yos nas: phyi nang bgegs tshogs 'byung po gzhom: mchong gur smug po'i phyi rol du: phrin las rnam bzhi'i sngags phreng 'khor: don gnyis 'bras bu'i rang bzhin gyis: zer 'phros yum gyi thugs kar phog: yum gyi baṃ yig 'od du 'bar: rtsa ba'i sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor: slar yang de las spros pa yi: tshe yi pho nya grangs med 'phros: phyogs bcur khyab pa'i rtsal 'gyed las: 'byung ba lnga yi 'dzin pa yin: brtan g.yo snang srid skye 'gro'i bcud: gsang ba'i tshe 'dzin pho nya yi: 'od zer sbu gus 'ub kyis sdus: ye shes lnga yi rnam par drangs: yum gyi mkha' klong baṃ la thim: de yang bcud mchog dwangs ma'i tshogs: bde stong 'od zer sbu gu yis: yum gyi thugs las yab la drangs: yab kyi thugs kar hri'aḥnṛr thim: skye med rdo rje'i srog bsgrubs nas: 'ja' lus ye shes sku ru gyur: rtsa sngags ni: oṃ hrī badz+ra ā yur+dzñā na nṛ bh+rūm̐ rā ga dha ra sid+dhi dza dzaḥ las sngags ni: oṃ ā yur ṇi bh+rūm̐ a bh+ya naṇ+ṭa tiṣ+ṭha sa dh+yā hūm̐: slar yang 'od zer sngags phreng 'khor: yab yum lus kun bde bas khyab: zung 'jug zer las spros pa yi: mchod sprin lha mo grangs med 'phros: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas la: bde stong gnyis kyi mchod pa 'bul: sangs rgyas byang sems thugs ka nas: byin rlabs dpag yas sprin phung gtibs: rgyal ba'i byin rlabs lha mo rnams: khab len rdo dang lcags phye bzhin: tshur 'dus yum gyi sku la bstim: yab yum rtsa dang ba spu'i khung : rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro kun: til gyi gang bu kha phyes ltar: kun snang khyab pa'i gar stabs bsgyur: rang sngags 'dzab dbyangs 'u ru ru: rtsa gsum lha tshogs thugs dam bskul: spro bsdu tshe yi rig 'dzin sgrub: bde stong ye shes ngo bo nyid: zung 'jug 'chi med tshe yi sku: nam yang mi 'gyur g.yu drung dbyings:

sra brtan mi shigs gnas par bsgom: oṃ ā yur hri nṛ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha bh+rūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ ā yur pad+ma rā ga tsar+ya sid+dhi hūm̐ dzaḥ snying po sgrub pa'i sngags ni: oṃ ā yur sa ma dhi ak+ṣo bh+ya ṇi ya na sid+dhi hūm̐ hrīḥ yang snying sngags ni: oṃ ṇi su khaṃ tso dā na tiṣ+ṭha swā hā: gsang ba'i sngags ni: oṃ nṛ gu h+ya pra mo ti ri mu tra pa shaṃ dza swā hā: rtsa ba'i spyi dril sngags ni: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na nṛ bh+rūm̐ sid+dhi hrīḥ zhes sngags rnams lhag chad med par gcong rong bri ba'i gtsang chu ltar si li li bzla: de yang sngags rnams rang gang mos re re bsgrub kyang chog: spyi lugs sngags ni 'bum phrag gsum tsam bzla: de nas sgrub pa dang po'i skabs su gsang sgrub kyi las rim dang rdo rje'i go khrab tsam gang rung gi gzhung bsrangs te: rtsa sngags kyang de ga'i sgrub pas 'thus: 'don dus kyang las tshogs kha sgyur 'dod na: gzhung 'di'i sngags rim pa ltar bya: rtsa sngags kyis srog sgrub cing brtan: las sngags kyis rtsa rlung bde ba rgyas: snying po sgrub sngags kyis ting 'dzin mchog gi dngos grub thob: yang snying sngags kyis kun gyis mthong na byams shing dung dung bgyid: gsang ba'i sngags kyis pha rol dbang du 'du: khyad par du ma sring rigs rnams 'khor te: kun gyi snang ba 'phrog nus pa 'byung : srog gi pho brang tshugs nas 'chi med rig 'dzin 'thob: de ltar las sbyor la sogs rang gang mos bzhin bsgrub kyang rung : so sor phral bas chog: sa ma ya: de nas tshe'i bla rten bzhag pa ni: gzhi dkar po'i kha ru: nas kyi g.yung drung bris: bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings tshang ba gcig gi nang du bdud rtsis bkang : mda' mo sgro gsum mtshal gyis brgyan pa gcig la: sku yi tshe rten du dngul gyi me long : gsung gi tshe rten du byi ru'i bum pa: thugs kyi tshe rten du mu tig chun po:

ma rnyed na mu men: yon tan gyi tshe rten du gser gyi 'khor lo: phrin las kyi tshe rten du g.yu yi rdo rje rtse lnga: ye shes lnga yi dar thag ni: dkar dmar mthing ser ljang khu sogs dar sna lnga: tshe'i rdzas lnga ni: cu gang rgya mtshal rgya mtsho'i lbu ba li khri gi waṃ dang lnga'o: de rnams mda' dar la dril lam gang rung snod du bzhag: tshe'i bcud lnga ni: sbrang bu ram ka ra mar dang chang lnga'o: tshe'i sman lnga ni: dza ti a ru ra ga pur gur gum li shi dang lnga'o: de rnams rin chen snod du bdud rtsis gtams: tshe'i rdzas lnga ni: chu shel me shel bai ḍūr+ya: puṇ+ḍa ri ka: ke ke ru dang lnga'o: de rnams dbang gi rdzas su bsags te: bhan+dha snod du bsham: bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid sna bdun gyi tsakli dang bcas pa bkram: tshe'i 'bru lnga ni: nas 'bras gro khre til dang ma lnga ste: phye ma ril bu dril te bhan+dhar bskyil: rang nyid khrus bstsal gos dkar po gyon zhing : gdan rdo rje rgya gram yod pa'i khar sdod: gsang ba'i rig ma yod na rig ma'i phyag tu phul: med na grogs dam tshig can la bstsal: sa ma ya: bum pa sbyang ba ni: oṃ: ye shes lnga ldan zlum po'i bum pa ru: āḥ zag med bdud rtsi sku lnga'i rdzas kyis bkang : hūm̐: byin brlabs rigs lnga'i sa bon yongs su gyur: hrīḥ 'chi med tshe yi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gsal: dzaḥ ye shes spyan drangs dam tshig dbyer med gyur: hūm̐: brtan par bzhugs shing gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: baṃ mnyes mchod 'bul lo tshe yi lha la 'bul: hoḥ dbang bzhi stsol zhing tshe srog brtan gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ ā yur+dzñā na sarba phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dza a be sha ya a āḥ zhes byin gyis brlabs shing bum par lha bskyed: mchod rdzas rnams sngags 'dis byin gyis brlabs la: oṃ: sarba dharma ya du dzñā na pañtsa hūm̐: tshe 'gugs shing bcud bsdu ba ni/ hūm̐:

sngon tshe 'og min bde chen mkha' spyod du: snang mtha' mgon po gsang ba ye shes gnyis: zab dbyings 'od gsal dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i tshe bsgrubs pas: bgres rgud med pa rig 'dzin 'ja' lus grub: de yi byin rlabs dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: de 'og gsang chen ma la 'bar ba'i gnas: rta mchog dbang chen rdo rje phag mo gnyis: khro rgyal stobs 'dus rtsa gsum zhal phyes nas: skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i tshe bsgrubs pas: bgres rgud med pa rig 'dzin 'ja' lus grub: de yi byin rlabs dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: de 'og mā ra ti ka'i gnas mchog tu: pad+ma 'byung gnas man+da ra ba gnyis: yang gsang tshe yi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i tshe bsgrubs pas: bgres rgud med pa rig 'dzin 'ja' lus grub: de yi byin rlabs dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: de 'og yang rdzong shel gyi brag phug tu: sangs rgyas ye shes dhe wa dha ra gnyis: zab gsang bla med dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i tshe bsgrubs pas: bgres rgud med pa rig 'dzin 'ja' lus grub: de yi byin rlabs dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: de 'og tsā ri zil chen gsang ba'i gnas: gnam lcags rdo rje gsang ba'i rig ma gnyis: 'chi bdag zil gnon dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: 'chi med rig 'dzin rdo rje'i srog bsgrubs pas: rlung sems rten 'brel 'khrul 'khor gnad du phebs: de yi byin rlabs dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: hūm̐: sngon dus tshe yi khungs yang bzang : bar du bka' gtad smon lam zab: da lta rten 'brel gnad kyang 'grigs: phyis 'byung mtshams sbyor 'phro mtha' btsan: de phyir sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin la: skye 'chi bgres rgud med par stsol: mnga' thang longs spyod snyan grags spel: chos dang brgyud 'dzin srid kyang skyongs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol:

oṃ: sku yi lha dbang lus la bskur: āḥ gsung gi sngags dbang ngag la bskur: hūm̐: thugs kyi chos dbang sems la bskur: hrīḥ yongs rdzogs dbang bskur stsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī badz+ra ā yur+dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: shar gyi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: phyag na lcags kyu mda' dar 'dzin: mgyogs ma dkar mo bye ba 'bum: 'byung lnga gling bzhi'i bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la stims: skye 'chi bgres rgud med par stsol: hūm̐: lho yi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: phyag na zhags pa mda' dar 'dzin: mgyogs ma ser mo bye ba 'bum: 'byung lnga gling bzhi'i bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la stims: skye 'chi bgres rgud med par stsol: hūm̐: nub kyi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: phyag na lcags sgrog mda' dar 'dzin: mgyogs ma dmar mo bye ba 'bum: 'byung lnga gling bzhi'i bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la stims: skye 'chi bgres rgud med par stsol: hūm̐: byang gi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: phyag na dril bu mda' dar 'dzin: mgyogs ma ljang mo bye ba 'bum: 'byung lnga gling bzhi'i bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la stims: skye 'chi bgres rgud med par stsol: hūm̐: dbus kyi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: phyag na mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: mgyogs ma ljang mo bye ba 'bum: 'byung lnga gling bzhi'i bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus stims: skye 'chi bgres rgud med par stsol: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na sid+dhi dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rgyas gdab pa ni: hūm̐: dang po chos dbyings nyag gcig rgya: gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgya: gsum pa sku gsung thugs kyi rgya: bzhi pa tshad med bzhi yi rgya: lnga pa ye shes lnga yi rgya: drug pa rig 'dzin drug gi rgya: bdun pa sangs rgyas rab bdun rgya: brgyad pa nye ba'i sras brgyad rgya: dgu pa theg pa rim dgu'i rgya:

bcu pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rgya: yab yum bcu yi rgyas btab pas: nam yang mi 'gyur brtan pa yi: yang dag ye shes gter sba'o: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na tiṣ+ṭha ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: zhes thams cad reg tsam gyis byin rlabs bya: rgyun du dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten 'brel snying po mchod bstod bcas bya/ mchan/ sku yi tshe rten 'dzugs pa la: bum pas dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings yangs pa'i dbus: rnam dag 'od gsal pho brang nas: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha: rigs lnga la sogs tshe 'dzin 'bum: deng sang thugs dam gnad nas bskul: ā yur tshe yi rig 'dzin stsol: oṃ ma ma hri nṛ su puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: bum pa ye shes gzhal yas khang : zang thal phyi nang mtha' dbus bral: bum pa'i bdud rtsi 'chi med rdzas: ro bcud yon tan lnga dang ldan: bum pa'i kha rgyan dpag bsam ljon: dgos 'dod 'byung zhing dbyings la khyab: bum pa'i sgro mdangs sku lnga'i mchog: dug lnga ma rig ka nas dag: bum pa'i gzungs thag 'od zer phreng : 'ja' gur lug rgyud sprin ltar gtibs: bum pa'i mgul chings lha rdzas gos: bkrag mdangs gzi brjid 'od du 'bar: bum pa'i gdan ni g.yung drung 'khyil: mi shigs rdo rje'i dbyings dang ldan: phyag rgya bdun gyis btab pa 'di: skal ldan spyi bor dbang bskur bas: tshe srog brtan cing gnas gyur cig: chos kyi dbyings su tshe 'dzugs so: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na dharma khaṃ ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: zhes bum pa'i chu myong : 'di yan dbang gi skabs yin: de nas dbang rdzas lnga thogs la: hūm̐: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor gyi: khrag gi khams nas tshe nyams na: chu yi khams nas bcud bsdus la: skal ldan bdag gi spyi bor stims: chu shel haṃ la tshe sba'o: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na kā ya ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: hūm̐: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor gyi:

drod kyi khams nas tshe nyams na: me yi khams nas bcud bsdus la: skal ldan bdag gi mgrin par stims: me shel a la tshe sba'o: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na wāk+ka ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: hūm̐: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor gyi: sems kyi khams nas tshe nyams na: nam mkha'i khams nas bcud bsdus la: skal ldan bdag gi snying khar stims: bai ḍūr+ya'i ṇir tshe sba'o: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na tsit+ta ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: hūm̐: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor gyi: sha yi khams nas tshe nyams na: sa yi khams nas bcud bsdus la: skal ldan bdag gi lte bar stims: puṇ+ḍa swa la tshe sba'o: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na ghu na ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: hūm̐: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor gyi: dbugs kyi khams nas tshe nyams na: rlung gi khams nas bcud bsdus la: skal ldan bdag gi gsang bar stims: ke ru ha la tshe sba'o: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na gu h+ya ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: tshe yi ril bu thogs la: hūm̐: phung po lnga yi tshe nyams na: 'bru mchog lnga yi bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la stims: longs spyod dpal gyi tshe sba'o: oṃ gha na la ā yur+dzñā na ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: tshe chang thogs la: hūm̐: dbang po lnga yi tshe nyams na: dkar mngar ro mchog bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la stims: zag med bcud kyi gter sba'o: oṃ a mṛ ta ā yur+dzñā na ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā:

sman lnga thogs la: hūm̐: ma rig dug lngas tshe nyams na: sman mchog lnga yi bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la stims: ye shes lnga yi gter sba'o: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na pañtsa ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: rdzas lnga thogs la: hūm̐: rtsa thig rlung gi tshe nyams na: rdzas mchog lnga yi bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub la khyab par stims: bde stong drod kyi tshe sba'o: oṃ su khaṃ swa bhā dza la ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: rin chen lnga thogs la: hūm̐: rdo rje tshe dpag ngo bo nyid: rin chen dngul gyi a dar+sha: me long ye shes tshe yi rten: bgres rgud med par tshe 'dzugs so: skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra ā yur+dzñā na ru bh+ya a dar+sha tiṣ+ṭha nṛ bh+rūm̐ swā hā: hūm̐: pad+ma tshe dpag ngo bo nyid: rin chen byi ru'i bum pa 'di: sor rtog ye shes tshe yi rten: bgres rgud med par tshe 'dzugs so: skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ ka ma la ā yur+dzñā na rā ga lak+ṣa nṛ bh+rūm̐ swā hā: hūm̐: bud+dha tshe dpag ngo bo nyid: rin chen mu tig cod pan 'di: chos dbyings ye shes tshe yi rten: bgres rgud med pa'i tshe 'dzugs so: skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ bud+dha ā yur+dzñā na mu ti ka ku mu ku ṭa tiṣ+ṭha nṛ bh+rūm̐ swā hā: hūm̐: rat+na tshe dpag ngo bo nyid: rin chen gser gyi 'khor lo 'di: mnyam nyid ye shes tshe yi rten: bgres rgud med pa'i tshe 'dzugs so: skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ rat+na ā yur+dzñā na swa na tsakra nṛ bh+rūm̐ swā hā: hūm̐: karma tshe dpag ngo bo nyid: rin chen g.yu yi rdo rje 'di: bya grub ye shes tshe yi rten: bgres rgud med pa'i tshe 'dzugs so: skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ karma ā yur+dzñā na bā+ai ro tsa badz+ra nṛ bh+rūm̐ swā hā: mda' dar thogs la: hūm̐: yum chen spyan ma'i ngo bo nyid:

le brgan dkar po dar chen 'di: srog rnams rab tu brtan pa'i rdzas: chu rlung dkar po'i tshe 'dzugs so: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra ḍāk+ki gang ga yaṃ shrī ra si si ta tiṣ+ṭha ṇi bh+rūm̐ swā hā: hūm̐: yum chen gos dkar ngo bo nyid: le brgan dmar po'i dar chen 'di: lus 'di rab tu dgyes pa'i rdzas: me rlung dmar po'i tshe 'dzugs so: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob gyur cig: oṃ pad+ma ḍāk+ki raṃ yaṃ shrī ta si ra ga ta tiṣ+ṭha ni bh+rūm̐ swā hā: hūm̐: yum chen dbyings phyug ngo bo nyid: le brgan sngon po'i dar chen 'di: dbang thang rab tu 'phel ba'i rdzas: mkha' rlung sngon po'i tshe 'dzugs so: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob gyur cig: oṃ bud+dha ḍāk+ki e khaṃ yaṃ shrī si ni laṃ tiṣ+ṭha ṇi bh+rūm̐ swā hā: hūm̐: yum chen mā kī'i ngo bo nyid: le brgan ser po'i dar chen 'di: rlung rta rab tu bskyed pa'i rdzas: sa rlung ser po'i tshe 'dzugs so: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob gyur cig: oṃ rat+na ḍāk+ki bh+rūm̐ mi yi shrī ra si ti tiṣ+ṭha ṇi bh+rūm̐ swā hā: hūm̐: yum chen sgrol ma'i ngo bo nyid: le brgan ljang gu'i dar chen 'di: sme ba mi nyams gnas pa'i rdzas: dam tshig rlung ljang tshe 'dzugs so: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob gyur cig: oṃ karma ḍāk+ki yaṃ shrī ra si marga tiṣ+ṭha ṇi bh+rūm̐ swā hā: tshe mda' thogs la: hūm̐: tshe yi bla rten mda' mo 'di: smyug ma lho bal rong nas byung : thang dkar rgod sgro dbyings nas byung : mtshal 'di nag po rgya nas byung : lcags mde'u bod yul rdo las byung : spyan rgyus rkang bzhi phyugs la byung : stong 'di sngags 'chang bdag gis bcos: phyag rgya bdun gyis mtshon pa'i mda': rgyus dar 'ja' tshon gshib pa 'dra: zhi ba'i phrin las 'grub pa'i mda': smyug ma gser gyi thur bzang mda': rgyas pa'i phrin las 'grub pa'i mda': rgya mtshal mkha' dbyings byang sems 'dra:

dbang gi phrin las 'grub pa'i mda': lcags mde'u khro chus phur pa 'dra: drag po'i phrin las 'grub pa'i mda': sgro gshog lho sprin phyug mo 'dra: gnas lugs chos skur mtshon pa'i mda': stong kha had po nam mkha' 'dra: zang thal longs skur mtshon pa'i mda': spyan rnams thugs rje lcags kyu 'dra: rjes 'dzin sprul skur mtshon pa'i mda': de phyir phyag rgya bdun dang ldan: mi 'gyur g.yung drung dkyil 'khor du: mda' 'di tshe yi rten du 'dzugs: mi 'gyur mi 'phro gnas gyur cig: oṃ sha ta sho ta ā yur+dzñā na pradzñā na prañtsa na ṇa ṇi tiṣ+ṭha bh+rūm̐ swā hā: rgyal srid sna bdun thogs la: hūm̐: tshe chos snyan grags spel ba yi: 'khor lo rin chen rgyas gdab bo: longs spyod dpal 'byor char bzhin 'bebs: nor bu rin chen rgyas gdab bo: srid dang mnga' thang char bzhin 'bebs: btsun mo rin chen rgyas gdab bo: khams gsum dbang sdud bran du khol: blon po rin chen rgyas gdab bo: brjid chags dbang thang phyugs kyi rdzi: glang po rin chen rgyas gdab bo: rtsal chen phrin las myur mgyogs ldan: rta mchog rin chen rgyas gdab bo: bdud bzhi bar chod log 'dren bcom: dmag dpon rin chen rgyas gdab bo: rgol ba tshar gcod dpa' rtsal ldan: phyag rgya bdun gyi rgyas gdab pas: brtan cing rab tu gnas gyur cig: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na dza ye puṇ+yai sa bha mu tra sa bha su pra tiṣ+ṭha bh+rūm̐ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swā hā: bkra shis rtags brgyad thogs la: hūm̐: mi nub rgyal mtshan rin po che: skal ldan lus la bkra shis shog: tshangs dbyangs chos dung rin po che: skal ldan ngag la bkra shis shog: byang sems dpal be'u rin po che: skal ldan yid la bkra shis shog: gser gyi 'khor lo rin po che: skal ldan zung 'jug bkra shis shog: dgos 'dod nor bu rin po che: skal ldan bsam 'phel bkra shis shog: kun khyab gdugs mchog rin po che:

skal ldan dbu la bkra shis shog: thabs shes gser nya rin po che: skal ldan don gnyis bkra shis shog: skyon bral pad+ma rin po che: skal ldan rten 'brel bkra shis shog: bkra shis rtags brgyad don dang dgu: theg pa rim dgu'i bkra shis shog: oṃ maṅga laṃ wa na ya su pra tiṣ+ṭha ye bha wan tu swā hā: slar yang yab yum sku las spros pa yi: rang 'dra'i khro bo khro mos snang srid gang : gar dgu'i 'od zer me dpung glog dmar 'khyugs: drag sngags hūm̐ sgra 'ur chem 'brug ltar sgrog: tshe bdud la sogs gnod byed gdon bgegs rigs: bsngangs nas yad yed dbang med bun gtor te: sreg cing gzhom pa'i tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs: gdon bgegs 'byung po glags lta tshar gcod pa'i: mi bzad khro bo rngam pa'i gur khang gsal: srung ba'i sngags sgra ldir ldir sgrog par bsam: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa baṃ kro ti ā yur bh+rūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swā hā: hūm̐: khro bo'i gur khang ye shes lnga yi klong : rigs lnga tshe bdag 'bum dang ma sring tshogs: sgo skyong rigs bzhi rnams kyi srung ba'i gur: dbang chen tshe yi mkha' klong chen por bsgom: oṃ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma ha ri ni sa ā yur+dzñā na dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ yab kyi rtsa ba'i sngags phreng ni: oṃ h+ya ghṛ wa ak+ṣo bh+ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ yum la sngags ni: oṃ baṃ wā ra hī pad+ma tsar+ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ gtso bo la: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na pad+ma rā ga da ra swā hā: pho nya bzhi'i sngags ni: oṃ ā yur puṇ+yai su khaṃ pra mo ti ri dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshe dbang du bsdus pa ni: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na sarba pa shaṃ ma ma thun dzaḥ tshe bsod spel ba'i sngags ni: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na puṣ+ṭiṃ pha la sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings yangs pa'i dbus sogs/ zhes sngags rnams rang rang skabs dang bstun: cung zad gab sprad slob dpon zhal las shes: khyad par gwa'u kha sbyor sgrub pa 'di:

rtsa gsum snying po'i yang dril bla na med: 'di la khyad chos bzhi yod man ngag bshad: 'byin 'jug rlung la brten pa zur du gsal: khyad par tshe sgrub chos ka mang lags kyang : yang gsang gwa'u 'di 'dra sbas pa med: snying gi thig le yang zab srog dang 'dra: lung zin skal ldan las can ma yengs par: shin tu gsang zhing gud du sba bar gyis: snying srung gsang ba'i ḍāk+ki+-i atsha rgya: rdo rje'i bstod ring ni: 'di nyid dbang chen lta bur spyod byed na: dam tshig sde snod bstod pa bstan pa ni: phyag rgya dam tshig lnga dang ldan pa'i ngang : ma bcos spros bral ngang la 'di ltar ro: hūm̐: rdo rje chos dbyings ngo bo nyid: rdo rje ka dag chen po'i sku: phyag 'tshal tshe bdag mgon po la'o: na mo ā yur+dzñā na hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje me long ngo bo nyid: rdo rje khros pas zhe sdang 'joms: phyag 'tshal rdo rje tshe dpag la'o: na mo ā yur badz+ra hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje mnyam nyid ngo bo nyid: rdo rje bzhad pas nga rgyal 'joms: phyag 'tshal rat+na tshe dpag la'o: na mo ā yur rat+na hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje sor rtog ngo bo nyid: rdo rje dgyes pas 'dod chags 'joms: phyag 'tshal pad+ma tshe dpag la'o: na mo ā yur pad+ma hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje bya grub ngo bo nyid: rdo rje gtum pos phrag dog 'joms: phyag 'tshal karma tshe dpag la'o: na mo ā yur karma hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje dpa' bo g.yo ba mo: rdo rje rang byung snang ba che: phyag 'tshal dbyings phyug tshe 'dzin la'o: na mo ā yur mum̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje dpa' bo khyab pa mo: rdo rje ye nas stong pa che: phyag 'tshal sangs rgyas spyan ma la'o: na mo ā yur laṃ ha hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje dpa' mo stong pa mo: rdo rje rab tu gsal ba che: phyag 'tshal mā ma kī la'o: na mo ā yur bam̐ hrī hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje dpa' mo dgyes pa mo: rdo rje chags med grol ba che: phyag 'tshal gos dkar mo la'o: na mo ā yur saṃ nṛ hoḥ

hūm̐: rdo rje dpa' mo mi pham ma: rdo rje rab tu gnas pa che: phyag 'tshal dam tshig sgrol ma la'o: na mo ā yur taṃ pa hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje 'jigs byed skur ston pa: rdo rje dam tshig skyong ba che: phyag 'tshal dbang chen khro rgyal la'o: na mo ā yur kro ta hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje gtum mo ston chen mo: rdo rje 'bar las 'dzin ma che: phyag 'tshal rdo rje phag mo la'o: na mo ā yur dhe wi hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje stong nyid ngo bo 'chang : rdo rje kun tu gnas pa che: phyag 'tshal smin pa'i rig 'dzin la'o: na mo yo gi ni laṃ hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje 'od gsal ngo bo 'chang : rdo rje kun la khyab pa che: phyag 'tshal sar gnas rig 'dzin la'o: na mo yo gi si ta hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje ka dag ngo bo 'chang : rdo rje khyon las 'das pa che: phyag 'tshal tshe dbang rig 'dzin la'o: na mo yo ga sa ti hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje kun tu ngo bo 'chang : rdo rje gzhal du med pa che: phyag 'tshal phyag rgya rig 'dzin la'o: na mo yo ga ri ti hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje rig pa'i ngo bo nyid: rdo rje mtha' dbus med pa che: phyag 'tshal lhun grub rig 'dzin la'o: na mo yo ga marga hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje zang thal ngo bo 'chang : rdo rje blo 'das dag pa che: phyag 'tshal bde ba'i rig 'dzin la'o: na mo yo ga krir+ṇa hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje snang stong dgyes pa mo: rdo rje ngo bo rab byed ma: phyag 'tshal sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro la'o: na mo bud+dha ḍāk+ki ho: hūm̐: rdo rje grags stong dgyes pa mo: rdo rje kun la rab dgyes mo: phyag 'tshal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la'o: na mo badz+ra ḍāk+ki hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje tshor stong dgyes pa mo: rdo rje grol ba rab byed ma: phyag 'tshal rin chen mkha' 'gro la'o: na mo rat+na ḍāk+ki hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje bde stong dgyes pa mo: rdo rje stong pa rab byed ma: phyag 'tshal pad+ma mkha' 'gro la'o: na mo pad+ma ḍāk+ki hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje gsal stong dgyes pa mo:

rdo rje dga' bar rab byed ma: phyag 'tshal las kyi mkha' 'gro la'o: na mo karma ḍāk+ki hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje las stong dgyes pa mo: rdo rje g.yo ba rab byed ma: phyag 'tshal sna tshogs mkha' 'gro la'o: na mo bhi shwa ḍāk+ki hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje mdzes pa'i cod pan 'chang : rdo rje dri zhim g.yo ba mo: phyag 'tshal me tog bdug spos ma: na mo puṣ+pe dhū pe hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje snang ba rab gsal mo: rdo rje dag byed bcud ldan mo: phyag 'tshal mar me dri chab mo: na mo ā lo ke gan+dhe hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje ro mchog kun ldan ma: rdo rje rab tu sgeg pa mo: phyag 'tshal zhal zas sgeg pa mo: na mo nai wi d+ye lā s+ye hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje rab tu bzhad pa mo: rdo rje glu dbyangs len pa mo: phyag 'tshal bzhad mo glu mo la'o: na mo mā l+ye gīrti hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje gling bu snyan pa mo: rdo rje 'ur 'ur sgra sgrogs ma: phyag 'tshal gar mo ging mo la'o: na mo nīrti tshu dhi hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje sing sing brda yi skad: rdo rje sna tshogs chos ston la: phyag 'tshal sgra ma chos la'o: na mo shab+da dharma hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje bde stong tshim mdzad ma: rdo rje spyod dang thabs ldan ma: phyag 'tshal shes rab gsang spel ma: na mo spar+she su khaṃ hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje kun bskyed shes rab ma: rdo rje bcu drug thig le rdzogs: phyag 'tshal shes rab gsang ye ma: na mo pradzñā shud+dhe hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje byams pa las byed ma: rdo rje brtse bar bskyed pa po: phyag 'tshal rdo rje rin chen la'o: na mo badz+ra rat+na hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje dga' ba che ba'i mchog: rdo rje btang snyoms las kyi bdag: phyag 'tshal pad+ma las rab la'o: na mo pad+ma karma hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje drwa ba zer 'gyed ma: rdo rje 'ching ba las grol ma: phyag 'tshal lcags kyu zhags pa la'au: na mo dza hūm̐ dā ya hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje kun spyod gnas pa mo: rdo rje mnyam nas zung 'jug ma: phyag 'tshal lcags sgrog dril bu la'o:

na mo baṃ ho dā ya hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: bdag gis rab tu bstod cing rgyud bskul bas: 'chi med rdo rje sku mchog 'grub gyur te: don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par mdzad du gsol: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na ḍāk+ki sarba sa ma ya swā hā: 'di yi skabs su tshe yi gzungs ring spyi mthun lan bdun bzlas: zhes pas bstod cing dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs thob nas rgyas gdab bya: sa ma ya: de nas tshogs bya ba ni: chu gtsang gi ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ bgyis pas bag chags bkrus: dang po ni: hūm̐: rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis: chos sku 'dzin med rtogs pa'i phyir: ye grol chen po rab tu gnas: rab rib mun pa ka nas dag: oṃ dharma swa bhā wa hūm̐: gnyis pa ni: hūm̐: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis me rlung chu'i: bag chags 'khrud phyir tshogs la phog: bzang ngan sme bar 'dzin pa rnams: sbyangs bkrus gtor bas bdud rtsir bsgyur: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsum pa ni: hūm̐: phyi snod ye nas rang byung gtor gzhong du: nang bcud rigs drug 'khor 'das tshogs su bsgyur: 'byung lnga rnam dag sku lngas byin gyis rlobs: rmad byung dgyes pa bskyed pa'i rdzas chen po: zag med nam mkha'i mdzod du spel bar gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ga ṇa tsakra sarba pū dza ma hā me gha hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ

bzhi pa ni: hūm̐: ka dag lhun grub 'og min pho brang nas: snang mtha' tshe yi bdag po yab yum rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbyings rig zang thal ma 'gags pho brang nas: longs sku tshe bdag rigs bzhi yab yum rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rnga yab dpal ri 'od kyi pho brang nas: pad 'byung mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho tshogs bcas rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sna tshogs ma 'gags bde chen pho brang nas: dag pa rig 'dzin yab yum 'khor bcas rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gsang chen dbang drag rol pa'i pho brang nas: rta mchog khro rgyal stobs 'dus lha tshogs rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul drwa ba'i pho brang nas: gsang ba ye shes ḍāk+ki rig ma'i tshogs: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: zil gnon pho brang 'bar ba'i gnas mchog nas: sgo skyong gar dbang rigs bzhi yab yum rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rtsub 'gyur dur khrod 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: zhing skyong dpal 'bar yab yum 'khor bcas rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: bka' dang dam tshig dbang gi gnas mchog nas: gter srung bka' sdod yongs rdzogs 'khor bcas rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: zil gnon rig 'dzin tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: dbu skra mdzes pa'i thor tshugs shigs se shig: gsung dbyangs drug cu'i brda skad lhangs se lhang : dar dpyangs cod pan sna tshogs pu ru ru: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i byin rlabs thibs se thib: yi dam lha tshogs hūm̐ sgra di ri ri: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i brda skad lhangs se lhang : dpa' bo rnams kyi gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' mo'i tshogs kun glu dbyangs kyu ru ru: chos skyong dam can gad rgyangs ya la la: ging chen pho mos bro rdung khrabs se khrab:

rnga sgra dung gling sna tshogs 'u ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u g.yer kha si li li: gsang ba'i lha mo lang ling mkha' la 'gro: sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin phung chi li li: dri zhim spos kyi ngad pa thu lu lu: dkyil 'khor rdzas chen bag dro me re re: tshe yi lha tshogs bkrag mdangs kyi li li: gnas 'dir skal ldan dga' bro ya la la: dbang chen pho brang zer thag springs se spring : byin rlabs bdud rtsi char chen na ra ra: gnas 'dir byin phob mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sarba sa mā ya dza dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: lnga pa tshogs mchod ni: hūm̐: ma ḍāk+ki gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma: rigs lnga'i thor tshugs shigs se shig: sku la rgyan cha pu ru ru: zhabs gnyis brda 'gros khyugs se khyug: phyag rgya'i lag na thogs pa yi: gser dngul rin chen bhan+dha'i snod: stong gsum khyon ltar yangs pa'i nang : rmad byung longs spyod tshogs kyis bkang : 'dod yon mchod sprin bla na med: phyag rgya bde stong gar gyis 'bul: dkyil 'khor dgyes pa bskyed gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos sku tshe bdag yab yum la: zhal zas tshogs kyis mchod pa 'bul: longs sku dag pa rig 'dzin la: zhal zas tshogs kyis mchod pa 'bul: sprul sku pad 'byung yab yum la: zhal zas tshogs kyis mchod pa 'bul: yi dam dbang chen yab yum la: zhal zas tshogs kyis mchod pa 'bul: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la: zhal zas tshogs kyis mchod pa 'bul: sgo skyong gar dbang yab yum la: zhal zas tshogs kyis mchod pa 'bul: dpal 'bar zhing skyong yab yum la: zhal zas tshogs kyis mchod pa 'bul: chos skyong gter srung yongs rdzogs la: zhal zas tshogs kyis mchod pa 'bul: hūm̐: tshe bdag dbang gi dkyil 'khor gyi: lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : zhal zas tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang : bdud rtsi sman gyis thugs dam bskang : rak+ta dmar gyis thugs dam bskang :

sgra dbyangs rol mos thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i mchod pas thugs dam bskang : spyan gzigs du mas thugs dam bskang : sna tshogs mchod pas thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: chos dbyings klong yangs rin po che: dug lnga ye shes ngo bo nyid: dgag sgrub spang blang re dogs dang : bdag gzhan kun slong mthol lo bshags: phyin chad ye grol la gnas shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi khā hi: oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: zhes yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang : drug pa bsgral ba ni: liṅga bzhag la: na mo: rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gsum rgyal ba'i bka': rig 'dzin bdag gi sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthus: deng 'dir sgrub la bar chod log 'dren bgegs: ma rungs gdug pa'i tshe bdud 'byung po rnams: gnam sa gling bzhi stod smad gar gnas kyang : rang dbang med pa gzugs ling 'di la khug: oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha ya dgra bgegs 'byung po khug dza dzaḥ phur bu thogs la: hūm̐: bdag nyid dbang chen thugs las spros pa yi: sras mchog las byed badz+ra kī la ya: sku stod khro bo zhal gsum phyag drug pa: gnam lcags rdo rje phur bu 'dril thabs gdengs: sku smad zur gsum lcags bsregs dbal chen rngam: thog ltar babs pas byad ma rdul du rlog: dgra bo'i don snying dbang por kī la ya: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra kī li kī la ya: dgra bgegs nṛ tri mā ra ya rbad bh+yoḥ bdun pa gtub cing 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dbang chen 'dus pa tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: rtog med rngam yangs chos dbyings zhal phyes shig: rgyud drug dug lnga bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: zag med bde stong ye shes klong du hoḥ

oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ra tsa na bha su ta kha kha khā hi: brgyad pa tshogs la rol: hoḥ ye nas sku gsum 'du 'bral med: dug lnga ma rig dbyings su yal: rtog med rang byung rdzas chen po: ya mtshan spang blang bral la rol: a la la hoḥ zhes pas dngos grub zhu: dga' ston la rab tu dgyes te rol: dgu pa tshogs lhag gtong ba ni: hūm̐: dang po phud bdag rig 'dzin tshe yi lha: bar du tshogs bdag yi dam dkyil 'khor lha: tha ma lhag sdud ma sring phra men ma: gnas 'dir gshegs la dpal gyi pha 'bab longs: hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan rol pa'i lhag sdud ma: dbang phyug ging dang laṅka sha za'i tshogs: gnas nyul la sogs bran g.yog yang 'khor bcas: dur khrod tshogs khang skyong ba'i las byed ma: la las zhal zas tshogs kyi lhag ma sdud: la las bdud rtsi chang gi lhag ma sdud: la las dmar chen rak+ta'i lhag ma sdud: la las māṃ sa sha chen lhag ma sdud: la las zhe sdang rus pa'i lhag ma sdud: la las sgeg bzhad lang ling mkha' la 'gro: la las khro gtum 'jigs gzugs stong khams nyul: la las gnas nyul ma mo'i tshogs khang 'grim: la las dam nyams dgra bgegs bla srog 'phrog: la las chos mdzad rnams kyi drod tshad nyul: don la kun bzang ma gcig sprul pa te: dam tshig can gyi bka' skyong bya ra mdzad: las kyi gzugs can dam gnas ma sring tshogs: 'dod yon pha 'bab lhag ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i mel tshe mdzod: oṃ ma mo ma tri ya sarba bhak+ṣa si i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: dang po thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med rang byung pho brang nas: thog ma'i mgon po snang mtha' tshe yi bdag: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: mi mngon brtse ba'i dbyings nas thugs dam bskul: rang bzhin ye shes mkha' nas gzi byin skyed: 'jigs brgyad bdud bzhi 'dul ba'i dus la bab: bar chad tshe 'phrang sgrol ba'i dus la bab:

mi mthun rkyen ngan 'joms pa'i dus la bab: don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i dus la bab: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: 'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub pa'i phrin nas mdzod: hūm̐: 'og min ka dag lhun grub pho brang nas: bla ma chos sku'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskul: lhun grub bde chen dbyings kyi pho brang nas: bla ma longs sku'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskul: sna tshogs rtsal chen ma 'gags pho brang nas: bla ma sprul sku'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskul: gsang chen he chen brdal ba'i pho brang nas: yi dam dbang chen yab yum thugs dam bskul: mkha' spyod zab dbyings rnam dag pho brang nas: yum chen ma sring mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskul: baṃ ri me rlung 'khrugs pa'i pho brang nas: zhing skyong dpal 'bar 'khor bcas thugs dam bskul: khrag mtsho thod mkhar 'bar ba'i pho brang nas: bka' gter srung ma yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskul: hūm̐: zhi ba'i lha tshogs rgyal ba thugs dam can: 'gro drug 'khor ba'i g.yang sa che 'di ru: lhung nas bdud bzhi g.yeng ba'i duḥkha myong : 'byung pos tshe la sdang zhing glags ltas na: 'byung bzhi 'du ba sna tshogs 'khrugs lags pas: bar chad nyon mongs dbang du shor ra re: dus min 'chi ba bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: drag po lha tshogs rgyal ba thugs dam can: ma 'ongs lnga brgya tha ma'i dus 'di ru: chos bzhin bsgrubs kyang 'tshe ba'i bdud sprul gyis: gsang sngags gnyan gyi bstan la dgra dar bas: bshig bcom bsnub cing brlag par shom lags pas: log 'dren bdud kyi dbang du gtong ra re: ma rungs gdug pa'i dmag dpung bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: bskul lo bzhengs shig gzi byin dus 'dir skyed: mthu chen khyod kyi nus rtsal mi dbyung na: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin gang la skyabs shig btsal: sngon gyi rten 'brel thugs rje'i smon lam gyis: byin rlabs dpa' ba'i brtul zhugs deng 'dir skyed:

tshe nyams dbang thang ral ba gsos su gsol: rtsa rlung khams dang dbang po'i ljon shing skyed: tshe srog brtan pa'i ba dan mkha' la tshugs: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku ru rgyas gdab ste: nam yang g.yo med rang bzhin dbyings lta bur: brtan par bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: gnyis pa chad mdo ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: thog ma'i mgon po snang mtha' yab yum gyis: tshe yi mkha' klong dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: ma sring mkha' 'gros khas blangs tha tshig bzhin: sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam bca' ma g.yel bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og mā ra ti ka'i gnas mchog tu: pad+ma 'byung gnas man+da ra ba gnyis: zab gsang 'chi med dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dbang phyug ging sman khas blangs tha tshig bzhin: sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam bca' ma g.yel bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og brag dmar ār+ya pa gling du: rig 'dzin chen po pad 'byung yab yum gyis: gnam lcags rdo rje zhes su mnga' gsol nas: kha byang lung gi bka' brgya gtad pa'i tshe: bka' srung dam can khas blangs tha tshig bzhin: sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam bca' ma g.yel phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma ru: tsā ri zil chen gsang phug gnas mchog nas: gter bdag gling pa gsang bdag mkha' 'gro gnyis: zab chos 'chi bdag zil gnon gdan drangs tshe: zhing skyong la sogs gter srung khas blangs bzhin: sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam bca' ma g.yel phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: sngon tshe rgyal bas mi 'gyur ting 'dzin gyis: tha tshig bzhi yis dam la btags pa yi: gter srung gter bdag chos skyong thams cad kyis: bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma chad dam: bstan pa'i mel tshe byed par ma chad dam: bcol pa'i phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam:

sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam bca' ma g.yel bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ ma hā kā la k+ṣe ṭa pa la ma tri pa la a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hi khā hi: gsum pa brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis ni: bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma: dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong : gangs dkar sha med rdo rje kun tu bzang : 'brog chen 'khor 'dus rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso: gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje g.yu bun ma: kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum: gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje klu mo skyong : rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal: kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong : btsan la rol pa'i rdo rje sman gcig ma: mo btsun ug chos rdo rje g.yar mo sil: g.yu yi dril bu rdo rje si le ma: ma sring chen mo skyong ma bcu gnyis ni: yang 'khor sprul pa'i sman phran 'bum dang bcas: lhab lhub na bza' dar dpyangs pu ru ru: rin chen sna tshogs rgyan cha khro lo lo: rol mo sgra snyan mang po si li li: glu len bro rdung bshugs sgra kyu ru ru: sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa'i bya ra ma g.yel ba: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ pra mo li tsa tur yak+ṣa li tsa tur ma tri li tsa tur ya sarba i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi khā hi: bzhi pa rta bro bya ba ni: hūm̐: kun gzhi chos dbyings pho brang nas: rig pa rdo rje'i bro brdungs pas: ma rig nga bdag dbyings su yal: lnga ldan thig le'i pho brang nas: gnas lugs ye shes bro brdungs pas: kun tu brtags pa'i dug lnga 'joms: 'ja' lus mkha' spyod pho brang nas: 'chi med rig 'dzin bro brdungs pas: 'khrul gzugs bdud bzhi rtsad nas gcod: mi bzad rngam glog pho brang nas: rta mchog dbang chen bro brdungs pas:

mtshan 'dzin phung po ka nas dag: las bzhi lhun grub pho brang nas: gter srung pho nyas bro brdungs pas: a 'thas dgra bgegs phye mar bshig: 'chi bdag zil gnon pho brang nas: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bro brdungs pas: 'jigs brgyad mi mthun phye mar brlag: hūm̐: sngon yang ye shes chen po'i bro: deng 'dir rang byung 'dzin med bro: 'khor 'das ro gcig khyab bdal bro: gnod byed bgegs srin ye nas stong : de bzhin ka dag bro rdung ngo : oṃ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: satwaṃ bha ya nan: mā ra ya nan: dharma swa bhā haṃ swā hā: lnga pa dngos grub blang ba ni: tshe rdzas thogs la: hūm̐: sngon tshe 'og min bde chen mkha' spyod du: snang mtha' mgon po gsang ba ye shes gnyis: zab dbyings 'od gsal dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i tshe bsgrubs pas: bgres rgud med pa rig 'dzin 'ja' lus grub: de yi byin rlabs dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: de 'og gsang chen ma la 'bar ba'i gnas: rta mchog dbang chen rdo rje phag mo gnyis: khro rgyal stobs 'dus rtsa gsum zhal phyes nas: skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i tshe bsgrubs pas: bgres rgud med pa rig 'dzin 'ja' lus grub: de yi byin rlabs dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: de 'og mā ra ti ka'i gnas mchog tu: pad+ma 'byung gnas man+da ra ba gnyis: yang gsang tshe yi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i tshe bsgrubs pas: bgres rgud med pa rig 'dzin 'ja' lus grub: de yi byin rlabs dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: de 'og yang rdzong shel gyi brag phug tu: sangs rgyas ye shes dhe wa dha ra gnyis: zab gsang bla med dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i tshe bsgrubs pas: bgres rgud med pa rig 'dzin 'ja' lus grub: de yi byin rlabs dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: de 'og tsā ri zil chen gsang ba'i gnas: gnam lcags rdo rje gsang ba'i rig ma gnyis:

'chi bdag zil gnon dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: 'chi med rig 'dzin rdo rje'i srog bsgrubs pas: rlung sems rten 'brel 'khrul 'khor gnad du phebs: de yi byin rlabs dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: hūm̐: sngon dus tshe yi khungs yang bzang : bar du bka' gtad smon lam zab: da lta rten 'brel gnad kyang 'grigs: phyis 'byung mtshams sbyor 'phro mtha' btsan: de phyir sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin la: skye 'chi bgres rgud med par stsol: mnga' thang longs spyod snyan grags spel: chos dang brgyud 'dzin srid kyang skyongs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ: sku yi lha dbang lus la bskur: āḥ gsung gi sngags dbang ngag la bskur: hūm̐: thugs kyi chos dbang sems la bskur: hrīḥ yongs rdzogs dbang bskur stsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī badz+ra ā yur+dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: shar gyi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: phyag na lcags kyu mda' dar 'dzin: mgyogs ma dkar mo bye ba 'bum: 'byung lnga gling bzhi'i bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la stims: skye 'chi bgres rgud med par stsol: hūm̐: lho yi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: phyag na zhags pa mda' dar 'dzin: mgyogs ma ser mo bye ba 'bum: 'byung lnga gling bzhi'i bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la stims: skye 'chi bgres rgud med par stsol: hūm̐: nub kyi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: phyag na lcags sgrog mda' dar 'dzin: mgyogs ma dmar mo bye ba 'bum: 'byung lnga gling bzhi'i bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la stims: skye 'chi bgres rgud med par stsol: hūm̐: byang gi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: phyag na dril bu mda' dar 'dzin: mgyogs ma ljang mo bye ba 'bum: 'byung lnga gling bzhi'i bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la stims: skye 'chi bgres rgud med par stsol: hūm̐: dbus kyi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma:

phyag na mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: mgyogs ma ljang mo bye ba 'bum: 'byung lnga gling bzhi'i bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus stims: skye 'chi bgres rgud med par stsol: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na sid+dhi dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

rgyas gdab pa ni: hūm̐: dang po chos dbyings nyag gcig rgya: gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgya: gsum pa sku gsung thugs kyi rgya: bzhi pa tshad med bzhi yi rgya: lnga pa ye shes lnga yi rgya: drug pa rig 'dzin drug gi rgya: bdun pa sangs rgyas rab bdun rgya: brgyad pa nye ba'i sras brgyad rgya: dgu pa theg pa rim dgu'i rgya: bcu pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rgya: yab yum bcu yi rgyas btab pas: nam yang mi 'gyur brtan pa yi: yang dag ye shes gter sba'o: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na tiṣ+ṭha ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: drug pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hoḥ rang shar rang grol dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: mtha' nas dbus yal sa bon stong pa'i dbyings: dam tshig gnyis med bskyed rdzogs spros bral ngang : dmigs med ka dag rang byung āḥru ldang : a a āḥ zhes ma bcos rang rig rgya yan thal lam shes par skyongs: bdun pa bsngo ba ni: hoḥ dpag yas khyon ltar grangs med bsags pa yi: legs pa'i dge tshogs mtha' yas rab spungs nas: yang dag dga' ston theg mchog mngon gyur tshogs: ring lugs sor mar bzhag pa'i rgyur don bsngo: brgyad pa smon lam ni: hoḥ bdag gi bsgrubs pa'i yon tan sa bcu'i gter: rab 'byams rtsa gsum dge legs thugs rje'i gar: sgyur mdzad rgyal dbang pad+ma kā ra yis: brgyud 'dzin smin grol dga' ston 'gyed gyur cig: ces bsngo smon gang rung gis legs par rgyas gdab: dgu pa bkra shis bya ba ni: hūm̐: chos sku'i bkra shis snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur: skye 'chi bgres rgud med pa'i bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis rigs lnga tshe yi bdag: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis pad 'byung rig 'dzin 'dus: brgyud 'dzin phyogs bcur khyab pa'i bkra shis shog: yi dam bkra shis dbang chen he ru kaḥ dgos 'dod yid bzhin char 'bebs bkra shis shog: mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma:

bde drod gsang ba'i rig mar bkra shis shog: chos skyong bkra shis legs ldan seṅge'i gdong : log 'dren dgra bgegs tshar gcod bkra shis shog: zab chos bkra shis zil gnon 'dus pa'i dpal: nam mkha'i mtha' las khyab pa'i bkra shis shog: gter gnas bkra shis mkha' spyod tsā ri ṭaḥ byin chags 'brel tshad don ldan bkra shis shog: rten 'brel bkra shis tshes bcu yar ldan dus: gegs med snyan grags khyab pa'i bkra shis shog: oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sarba maṅga laṃ: sa ma ya: e maḥ bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: kun gyi yang bcud snying po bla med chos: bod yul sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig ma: ma 'ongs lnga brgya yang mtha' bsngags te sbas: zab gnad cha tshang don dril khyad par can: skal ldan las 'phro can gyi don du bzhag: bka' yi rgya 'di legs ldan mgon pos srungs: dam nyams snod min bdud la ma shor bar: smon lam rig ldan thugs kyi sras la sprod: zil chen ḍāk+ki gsang phug-i atsha rgya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra kho bo gter bdag gling pas/ me sprel lor tsā ri zil chen gsang phug nas gdan drangs shing*/ glang lor sbas yul pad+ma'i tshal gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ tshe sgrub rang gzhung la skyabs sems mi 'dug pas las gzhung smad las khro rgyal stobs 'dus nas kha gsab cing mchod pa'i go rim 'khrugs bsdebs phran bu bcas gu h+yas sri zhu bsgrubs pa'o/ maṅga laṃ// // pa) ༈ tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: byin 'bebs gdangs ring dbyangs can 'gyur khug bzhugs so: 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: byin 'bebs thugs rje'i sprin phung bstan: 'di nyid dgos chad rnam pa gsum: rtsa gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams: mos gus snyan pa'i dbyangs la 'khor: dkyil 'khor bkram pa'i rdzas chen yang : bag dro tshig gi gzi byin chags:

'dus pa'i rig 'dzin skal ldan rnams: byin 'bebs rol mos dbang po g.yo: 'tshe ba'i bdud kyi bar chad las: thugs rje'i 'od kyis drangs par gsol: de bas byin 'bebs mchog tu gces: las byang bsnyen sgrub kun la bsngags: sa ma ya: byin 'bebs ni spos bsregs nas rol mo dbyangs snyan gyis 'di ltar ro: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings khyab bdal pho brang nas: snang mtha' thog ma'i mgon pos byin phob cig: ka dag bde chen lhun grub pho brang nas: 'chi med tshe bdag mgon pos byin phob cig: rnga yab dpal ri sprul pa'i pho brang nas: rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas byin phob cig: shes rab rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga nas: ḍāk+ki man+da ra was byin phob cig: ke'u ri mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas mchog nas: gsang ye ye shes mtsho rgyal byin phob cig: yang rdzong dpal gyi shel brag gnas mchog nas: mthu stobs sangs rgyas ye shes byin phob cig: gnas mchog tsā ri zil chen gsang phug nas: 'chi bdag zil gnon lha tshogs byin phob cig: yang dag ye shes tshe yi sgrub gnas nas: rgyal ba brgyud bcas rnams kyis byin phob cig: hūm̐: bsgrub pa'i rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams: ye shes dbyings nas thugs rje skur bzhengs la: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i rdzas la byin phob cig: gzi brjid g.yo ba'i gar dgu ston pa'i phyir: dbu skra mdzes pa'i thor tshugs shigs se shig: sna tshogs dar dpyangs cod pan pu ru ru: prog zhu rigs lnga'i rgyan tshogs spungs se spung : ḍā ru g.yer kha'i sgra ldan 'u ru ru: gsung dbyangs brda skad sna tshogs kya ma kyu: mnyen lcug mdzes pa'i gar thabs khyugs se khyug: 'ja' gur gzi brjid bkrag mdangs ta la la: dpa' bo ging chen bro rdung khrabs se khrab: ma sring tshogs ni glu len kyu ru ru: dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin 'bebs sha ra ra: gnas 'dir dbang chen bskur la byin chen phob:

gsang 'dus mkha' klong ye shes pho brang 'dir: mi shigs rdo rje bh+rūm̐ gyur stsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ a be sha ya a āḥ zhes rol mo dang bcas nas byin dbab: byin 'bebs rtags su spu gzeng ba dang : lus 'bir zhing chem chem g.yo ba dang : gzhan yang 'phar 'dar 'khrab pa dang : nyams dang bde ba 'bar ba la sogs pa 'byung : rtags byung nas ye shes pa brtan phyir me tog 'thor ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs: rten 'brel dam tshig rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor la: brtan par bzhugs shing byin gyis brlab tu gsol: 'grub par gyur cig badz+ra sa ma ya: oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: zhes me tog 'thor: rgyas gdab brtan pa'i dmigs pa yang yang bya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas/ me sprel lor tsā ri zil chen gsang phug nas gdan drangs shing*/ gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser du bsgyur ro/ maṅga laṃ// // pha) ༈ sman mchod 'bul ba ni/ kun bzang yab yum rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ /snang ba mtha' yas dgongs brgyud bla ma la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo 'chi med dngos grub stsol/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ dga' rab rdo rje rig 'dzin shrī sing*/ /bi ma mi tra brda brgyud bla ma la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo 'chi med dngos grub stsol/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ /pad+ma kā ra mtsho rgyal man+da ra/ /rje 'bangs la sogs snyan brgyud bla ma la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo 'chi med dngos grub stsol/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ sangs rgyas ye shes rtsa gsum gling pa dang*/ /mi 'jigs snyan grags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /sman mchod 'bul lo 'chi med dngos grub stsol/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ khyad par chos sku tshe dpag yab yum dang*/ /longs sku tshe lha rigs lnga mgyogs ma bzhi/

/sman mchod 'bul lo 'chi med dngos grub stsol/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ sgeg phreng la sogs sgo srung khro bo bzhi/ /tshe yi lha tshogs ji snyed shar rnams la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo 'chi med dngos grub stsol/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ yi dam dbang chen gar mo sgo skyong btsan/ /bka' gter gnas gzhi dkar phyogs skyong rnams la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo 'chi med dngos grub stsol/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ bdud rtsi'i ngo bo sku gsum gnas bzhi dngos/ /gnas gsum rig pas mchog gi dngos grub thob/ /dngos po med las dngos grub blang bar bya/ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ ba) ༈ tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: dmigs pa'i 'dzab dgongs bsdus pa bskyed rdzogs rang gsal: 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: dang po chos sku'i 'dzab dgongs ni: hūm̐: kun gzhi ma bcos klong yangs nas: rang rig lta ba'i sangs rgyas lha: dbyings rig 'od gsal 'du 'bral med: ma 'gags zang thal chos kyi sku: lta bas rang rig snang mtha' yas: phyogs lhung bral ba'i shes pa nyid: zag med snang ba blo las 'das: gzhal ba'i mu mtha' ris su med: lhan skyes chen po ngo mtshar che: thog ma'i chos sku dbyings la khyab: gdod ma'i chos sku rang la gnas: snang ba mtha' yas gzhan du med: ma skyes grags stong de ltar shar: gang 'dul thugs rje'i don ston du: rang byung 'dzab kyi sngags sgra sgrog: oṃ a mi dhe wa ā yur+dzñā na gu h+ya ḍāk+ki hri da ya su khaṃ sid+dhi dza dzaḥ oṃ ā yur+dzñā na gu h+ya ḍāk+ki hrīḥ gnyis pa bla ma longs sku'i 'dzab dgongs ni: hūm̐: ka dag dbyings rig klong yangs nas: zangs thal longs sku'i rtsal snang shar: grags stong spros bral 'du 'bral med: rtse gcig lhan skyes rdzogs pa'i sku: rang rig 'chi med tshe yi lha: gsal stong 'dzin med sems la ltos: 'gyu ba phra rags stong pa'i dbyings:

gang shar 'dzin med ta la la: 'gro 'ong sdod pa'i sa mtshams bral: gtad med bya bral ngang rgyun can: sna tshogs longs sku'i rtsal las shar: sprul bsgyur longs sku ngang la gnas: tshe dpag longs sku gzhan la med: smra brjod bral bas longs spyod rdzogs: grags stong snying po'i sgra dang ldan: longs sku sgra tshig blo las 'das: 'gro ba'i don du so sor ston: 'dzab kyi 'phro 'du lhun gyis grub: oṃ ma hā ā yur sid+dhi hūm̐: tshe bsod dbang thang puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: gsum pa bla ma sprul sku'i 'dzab dbyangs ni: hūm̐: yang gsang skye med klong yangs nas: sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul bral ba yis: cho rol ma 'gags rtsal gyi lha: snang stong ye shes 'du 'bral med: ma skyes dbyings la rang rtsal rdzogs: gdod ma'i gshis lugs dran stong 'gyur: cha lugs mi mnga' sgyu mar snang : stobs bcu'i rang bzhin he ru kaḥ dug lnga ro gcig khrag la dgyes: rang rig dbang chen rta mchog dpal: chu zla 'ja' tshon byad la ltos: cir snang sprul sku sha ra ra: thugs rje dbang bskur rlabs po che: nyams dang gar dgu lhun gyis grub: gzhi gcig lam gnyis sku gsum rdzogs: drang don dbang chen dbyings la gnas: nges don dbang chen rang la gnas: sprul sku rta mchog gzhan na med: bdag med ye shes ngo mtshar che: bsdus bya gzugs su ma grub pas: 'ja' lus rdo rje srog dang ldan: de phyir skye med sprul sku'i mchog: bde stong rang byung snying po'i sgra: thabs shes zung 'jug thugs dam bskul: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra baṃ kro ti bha ra hi hūm̐ bh+yoḥ oṃ kro ta kī la ya baṃ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ bzhi pa dam tshig bskul ba ni: hūm̐: yang gsang zil gnon dkyil 'khor du: deng 'dir bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i lha: bla med thugs dam dbyings nas bskul: 'od zer phyogs bcur spros pa yis: rgyal ba rig 'dzin mchod pas mnyes:

gzi byin bdag la tshur 'dus pas: mchog thun dngos grub dbang bzhi thob: slar 'phros snang srid zhi khro'i lhas: gang bas dgra bgegs tshar bcad nas: tshur 'dus skye 'gro dbang du bsdus: thams cad bran 'khor ci bzhin gyur: lta bas rang rig rtsa gsum lha: sgom pas snang stong lhun gyis grub: spyod pas ma sring brda skad bsgyur: gsal bas 'chi med srog bsgrubs te: lus la rdo rje'i go khrab gyur: zil gnon bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di: nam yang mi gtong snying po bzung : thabs shes bde stong mtha' dbus bral: rdo rje srin po nam langs nye: zag med dga' bzhi lhung ba bzhin: dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la bab: 'dzab kyis thugs dam dbyings nas bskul: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma ma ā yur+dzñā na hri'aḥ h+ya ghṛ wa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes skabs su thugs dam bskul zhing dngos grub zhu: phyi nang bskyed rdzogs sngags bzlas ma bcos lhun grub kyi ngang du bya: sa ma ya: e ma: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: thugs dam rgyud kyis bskul ba'i gnad: sku gsum ngo sprod 'dzab dgongs bzhag: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos me sprel lor tsā ri zil chen gsang phug nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas phab pa'o// // ma) ༈ tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: bskang ba yon tan kun 'byung rin chen phreng ba bzhugs so: 'chi med tshe yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra gar dbang rig 'dzin pad 'byung gis: zab don snying po bskang bshags rim par bstan: 'di la dgos ched rim pa rnam gsum ste: tshe 'phrang bdud kyis sdang na bskang bshags brtsam: dkyil 'khor dam tshig 'gal na bskang bshags brtsam: pho nya chos skyong 'khu na bskang bshags brtsam:

de yis sor chud dam tshig gtsang bar 'gyur: sa ma ya: dang po bskang bshags bya ba'i rim pa ni: rin chen pad gzhong mdzes ldan yangs pa'i nang : gling bzhi'i ri rab mtshon pa'i dpal bshos btsugs: tshe bum tshe 'brang phud sna gang 'byor dang : bkra shis rtags brgyad sna bdun mdzes mtshon bya: tshe ril pad kyu rnams kyis legs par bskor: 'ja' 'od gur dang nyi zla shing lo sbyar: gzhan yang phyi mchod sna tshogs legs par bsham: sa ma ya: dang po bskang rdzas la chu gtsang bran la: hūm̐: gling bzhi ri rab bkod pa'i khyon yangs las: bkram pa'i bskang rdzas sna tshogs sprin ltar gtibs: thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas mchog la dmigs te: sku gsum yig 'bru'i zer phog dpag yas spel: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā bha ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ lā s+ye mā l+ye gīrti nīrti āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba a haṃ pañtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐:

gnyis pa: hūm̐: mkha' dbyings rnam dag rang byung pho brang nas: tshe bdag rgyal ba rigs lnga gshegs su gsol: bde chen sku lnga lhun grub pho brang nas: dbang chen rig 'dzin yab yum gshegs su gsol: gsang 'dus zil gnon tshe yi pho brang nas: lha mo bcu drug sgo skyong gshegs su gsol: thugs rjes brtse bar dgongs te gshegs nas kyang : chags bral sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: mos gus gdung shugs yid kyis phyag 'tshal bstod: phyi nang gsang gsum bla med mchod pa 'bul: rmad byung ting 'dzin rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: thog ma'i sangs rgyas snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur: sku mdog dmar gsal pad+ma rā ga'i mdog: longs sku'i rgyan rdzogs zhal gsum phyag drug mnga': gsang ye dmar mo bde stong sku la 'khril: zhabs bzhi skyil krung dri med pad zlar bzhugs: chos dbyings lhun grub rang byung ngo bo nyid: 'chi med mgon po yab yum thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: me long ye shes 'chi med tshe yi lha: rdo rje tshe dpag yab yum thugs dam bskang : mnyam nyid ye shes 'chi med tshe yi lha: rat+na tshe dpag yab yum thugs dam bskang : sor rtog ye shes 'chi med tshe yi lha: pad+ma tshe dpag yab yum thugs dam bskang : bya grub ye shes 'chi med tshe yi lha: karma tshe dpag yab yum thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: gsal stong ye shes 'chi med tshe yi lha: smin pa'i rig 'dzin yab yum thugs dam bskang : snang stong ye shes 'chi med tshe yi lha: sa gnas rig 'dzin yab yum thugs dam bskang : bde stong ye shes 'chi med tshe yi lha: tshe dbang rig 'dzin yab yum thugs dam bskang : 'da' ka ye shes 'chi med tshe yi lha: phyag rgya rig 'dzin yab yum thugs dam bskang : dbyings rig ye shes 'chi med tshe yi lha: lhun grub rig 'dzin yab yum thugs dam bskang : ngo bo ye shes 'chi med tshe yi lha:

bde ba'i rig 'dzin yab yum thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: phyi yi snang ba'i gzugs rnams stong pa nyid: lha mo me tog 'dzin ma'i thugs dam bskang : nang gi 'dzin pa'i sems nyid stong pa nyid: lha mo spos phor 'dzin ma'i thugs dam bskang : phyi nang 'gyur ba'i dngos po stong pa nyid: lha mo mar me 'dzin ma'i thugs dam bskang : gzhal du med pa chen po stong pa nyid: lha mo dri chab 'dzin ma'i thugs dam bskang : don la mtshan mar ma grub stong pa nyid: lha mo zhal zas 'dzin ma'i thugs dam bskang : phyogs lhung bral ba mtha' 'das stong pa nyid: lha mo me long 'dzin ma'i thugs dam bskang : 'gro 'ong dor ba med pa'i stong pa nyid: lha mo phreng ba 'dzin ma'i thugs dam bskang : rang rig 'od gsal gdod nas stong pa nyid: lha mo pi waṃ 'dzin ma'i thugs dam bskang : rtag chad dngos po med pa stong pa nyid: lha mo gling bu 'dzin ma'i thugs dam bskang : thog mtha' med pa ye nas stong pa nyid: lha mo rdza rnga 'dzin ma'i thugs dam bskang : chos rnams sgyu ma'i gzugs brnyan stong pa nyid: lha mo shel dung 'dzin ma'i thugs dam bskang : ngo bo de bzhin ka dag stong pa nyid: lha mo ting ting 'dzin ma'i thugs dam bskang : rnam pa dbyibs su ma grub stong pa nyid: lha mo rang bzhin 'dzin ma'i thugs dam bskang : byed las skyon gyis ma gos stong pa nyid: lha mo le brgan 'dzin ma'i thugs dam bskang : rang bzhin mtshan mas ma bcings stong pa nyid: lha mo byang sems 'dzin ma'i thugs dam bskang : thugs rje bdag med 'od gsal stong pa nyid: lha mo rak+ta 'dzin ma'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: gsal la 'dzin pa ma zhugs stong pa nyid: badz+ra gar dbang yab yum thugs dam bskang : bde ba'i nyams la ma zhen stong pa nyid: rat+na gar dbang yab yum thugs dam bskang : mi rtog rtsi la ma chags stong pa nyid: pad+ma gar dbang yab yum thugs dam bskang : gshis lugs thig le kun khyab stong pa nyid:

karma gar dbang yab yum thugs dam bskang : 'khor 'das snang srid kun kyang stong pa nyid: tshe lha'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: gzhan yang thugs dam skong ba'i dam rdzas ni: spyan gyi dbang po tshim pa'i mchod sprin phyir: me tog ri ltar spungs pas thugs dam bskang : shangs kyi dbang po tshim pa'i mchod sprin phyir: dri zhim dud sprin gtibs pas thugs dam bskang : shes bya nyon mongs gsal ba'i mchod sprin phyir: sgron me nyi ltar gsal bas thugs dam bskang : sku la khrus chab bstsal ba'i mchod sprin phyir: dri chab mtsho ltar 'khyil bas thugs dam bskang : ljags kyi dbang po tshim pa'i mchod sprin phyir: zhal zas ri ltar brjid pas thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: sku yi dam tshigs nyams pa gso ba'i phyir: me long pad phreng sna tshogs thugs dam bskang : gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa gso ba'i phyir: pi waṃ gling bu rdza rngas thugs dam bskang : thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa gso ba'i phyir: shel dung ting ting shags kyis thugs dam bskang : yon tan dam tshig nyams pa gso ba'i phyir: chos dang lha reg sna tshogs thugs dam bskang : phrin las dam tshig nyams pa gso ba'i phyir: byang sems bde ba dkar dmar thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: rgyu 'bras bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs phyir: ga ṇa tshogs kyi mchod pas thugs dam bskang : rten pa'i dam tshig gnyan po yin pa'i phyir: gtor mchod mkha' ltar mnyam pas thugs dam bskang : bsgrub pa'i dam rdzas gnyan po yin pa'i phyir: bdud rtsi sman raka phud kyis thugs dam bskang : mchod pa'i dam rdzas gnyan po yin pa'i phyir: dza gad gser skyems sbreng bas thugs dam bskang : snying po brten pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: bla rdo srog 'khor rnams kyis thugs dam bskang : mnyes pa'i dam rdzas gnyan po yin pa'i phyir: tshe yi sgrub rdzas sna tshogs thugs dam bskang : snang srid dbang sdud pho nyar mtshon pa'i phyir:

tshe mda' dar mtshon brgyan pas thugs dam bskang : sna tshogs rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i phyir: spyan gzigs sprin ltar gtibs pas thugs dam bskang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed pa'i phyir: kun tshang bla med mchod pas thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag dag gyur nas: bar chad bsal zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: bskang du med de skye med ngang la bskang : mchod du med de gnyis med rol par mchod: sbyor du med de zung 'jug ngang la sbyor: bsgral du med de ye shes chen por sgrol: ye sbyor ye sgrol chen po'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: gsum pa bshags pa ni: hūm̐: 'chi med mgon po gsan cing dgongs su gsol: gdod nas snang srid chos dbyings yin pa la: ma rtogs ris su phyes pa mthol lo bshags: sku lnga sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa la: ye shes gzhan nas btsal ba mthol lo bshags: tshogs drug lhug bzhag spyod lam yin pa la: rnam rtog blang dor bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: ci snang bag med sgyu ma yin pa la: 'dzin pas ris su bsgrubs pa mthol lo bshags: nyon mongs dug lnga ye shes yin pa la: ma rtogs spang blang bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: legs nyes gang shar dngos grub yin pa la: bzang rlom dmigs gtad bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: sgo dgu ma bkag mthong lam yin pa la: tshogs drug nang du 'dzin pa mthol lo bshags: dga' bzhi ngo bo byang sems yin pa la: rtag chad mu bzhir 'dzin pa mthol lo bshags: re dogs snang ba chad lta yin pa la: gnyis 'dzin lha 'dre sgrub pa mthol lo bshags: rang sems ngo bo sangs rgyas yin pa la: 'bad stsol gzhan la bgyis pa mthol lo bshags:

sangs rgyas sems can gzhi gcig yin pa la: 'khor 'das ris su phyes pa mthol lo bshags: thugs phrad ro snyom spyod pa yin pa la: dgag sgrub lhan pa gtab pa mthol lo bshags: lha 'dre sems kyi cho 'phrul yin pa la: gnyen po dmigs gtad btsal ba mthol lo bshags: rang lus rnam dag gzhal yas yin pa la: gdos bcas tha mal 'dzin pa mthol lo bshags: rtsa 'khor dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yin pa la: lta ba'i rang zhal ma mjal mthol lo bshags: bza' ltung longs spyod tshogs 'khor yin pa la: bka' thub sdug bsgur bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: cir snang lha sku'i rang bzhin yin pa la: yi dam spong len bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: de ltar bla med cho ga'i bshags pa yis: 'gro kun 'dzin pa'i sgrog las rab grol te: ma rig mun pa'i smag rum sel bar shog: theg dman nyan rang so thar sgor zhugs nas: 'gog lam rtsa ltung nyes pa lnga la sogs: tshogs dang mchod rdzas phud lhag 'bags shing 'dres: dkyil 'khor khas blangs srog 'dzin snying po nyams: tshe yi dam tshig srog bcad gzhan la 'tshe: sbyor sgrol spyod lam gol sar 'byams pa dang : bag med a 'thas mi dge'i las chen bsags: bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gnad du ma khel dang : bskyed rdzogs snying po'i don chen g.yel ba sogs: tshe rabs snga phyi bsags pa'i sgrib pa kun: mthol lo bshags so mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: ces yi ge brgya pa bzla zhing lhag chad bkang : dam tshig thugs dam g.yel dang bar chad sogs: rmi lam log dang mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig bral na: de tshe skong bshags 'di nyid brtson par bya: sa ma ya: e maḥ yang zab kha skong rim pa lag len tshang : yid ches khungs btsun gnad kyi gzer bu mchog: byin rlabs thugs rje'i man ngag gong bu bzhag: ma 'ongs thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: u rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lor/

tsā ri zil chen gsang phug nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // tsa) ༈ tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: bla med yang gsang sgrub pa rdo rje rmang gzhi bzhugs: 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: 'chi med 'ja' lus bsgrub pa'i thabs: yang zab gnad kyi man ngag bstan: lha lcam brda yi yi ger gzugs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: tshe sgrub bya ba'i rim pa ni: bkra shis byin chags dge ba'i yul: dngos gzhi snang ba dben pa'i gnas: phun tshogs zla gam dbang phug tu: dmar zhing 'jam pa'i sa gzhi la: dal bcag thig gdab dkyil 'khor bris: yang na 'bru tshom legs par bkod: dbus su bum pa mtshan ldan nang : rdzas chen nyer lnga'i chu dang sbyar: sum gnyis bkang zhing kha rgyan spras: mtshan ldan bhan+dha'i nang du ni: tshe gtor nor bu pad+mas mtshan: rgyan ldan sku 'bag tsakli gzugs: gzhan yang mchod pa gzhung bzhin bsham: sngon 'gro la sogs gtong ba ni: rdo rje'i go khrab nang nas blang : de nas dngos gzhi gzhal yas dang : lha bskyed bya ba'i rim pa ni: 'dzin med gsal stong 'di ltar bsgom: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las chos dbyings ye shes sku: rang byung rin chen tshe yi pho brang ni: gru bzhi sgo bzhi phyi nang bkod pa rdzogs: 'ja' gur lug rgyud me tog chun pos spras: ma bcos rang byung 'od zer sna lnga gtibs: dbus su zla gam dmar po sgo gcig pa: de nang pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan: rin chen sna tshogs mdzes pa'i khri steng du: gser gyi rdo rje hrīḥyig dmar pos mtshan: gnas 'gyur rang rig 'chi med mgon po ni: dmar gsal mdzes ldan dri med rā ga'i mdog: zhal gsum phyag drug 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku: g.yas dkar g.yon sngo dbus dmar zhi 'dzum mdzes: sna tshogs rin chen dbu rgyan cod pan 'phur:

g.yas g.yon dang pos rdo rje bhan+dha bsnams: bar gnyis 'khor lo pad phreng yu ba 'dzin: mtha' gnyis rin chen rdo rje rgya gram 'dzin: lha rdzas gos kyi stod g.yogs smad dkris brgyan: zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang phyed skyil stabs: gsang ba'i yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: dmar gsal mdangs ldan rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol: mda' dar tshe bum yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: zung 'jug zhabs gnyis bde stong sked la 'khril: yab yum 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku ru gsal: gnas gsum thugs rje 'od zer 'phros pa yis: 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'chi med rig 'dzin tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: dbyings nas skur bzhengs gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: ma chags skyon bral pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs: rtse gcig mi 'bral gdung bas phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: phyi mchod sna tshogs yid 'ong lha mo'i tshogs: nang mchod bdud rtsi pañtsa a mṛ ta: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med mchod pa 'di: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la 'bul: bzhes nas rig 'dzin 'ja' lus 'grub par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pañtsa pū dza āḥhūm̐: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang byung dbyings rig longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: rin chen dbu rgyan ye shes lnga dang ldan: dar dmar cod pan a mi dhe wa'i rtsal: g.yas zhal bde ba thabs kyi rang bzhin dkar: g.yon zhal stong nyid shes rab rang bzhin mthing : rtsa zhal dmar gsal chags pa'i rang bzhin mdangs: zhal gsum sku gsum ye nas 'du 'bral med: spyan dgu a ti'i theg pa rim dgu rdzogs: grags stong ma 'gags 'dzab dbyangs 'u ru ru: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la bstod: pha rol phyin drug phyag sor rtse mo ru: thabs shes rang bzhin tshe bdag rigs lnga rdzogs:

phyag mtshan sa bon nyi zer 'bum phrag mdangs: longs spyod rdzogs sku rin chen rgyan gyis spras: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la bstod: tshad med bzhi ldan dga' bzhi'i phyed skyil ngang : sprul sku'i dbang pos dar tshon yug gos gsol: pad zla'i gdan bzhugs bde chen longs spyod rdzogs: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la bstod: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: sku mdog dmar gsal shes rab drwa ba'i gar: g.yas pas mda' dar ma sring mkha' 'gro sdud: g.yon pas tshe bum sgrub la 'chi med stsol: rus pa'i rgyan mdzes mnyen lcug 'khril ldem ma: nu ma rgyas shing bha ga bde drod 'khyil: yab la zhal sbyor dgyes chags zil bu'i mdangs: zhabs gnyis yab 'khril bde stong dga' bzhi'i ngang : rnal 'byor dmar mo gsang ye ḍāk+kir bstod: hūm̐: 'chi med yab yum rig 'dzin tshe yi lha: thugs dam rgyud bskul snying po sngags sgra sgrog: 'ja' lus 'od gsal rdo rje'i srog 'grub nas: nam yang mi shigs bgres rgud bral ba yi: sra brtan 'khor lo mkha' ltar gnas gyur cig: oṃ a mi dhe wa ā yur+dzñā na gu h+ya ḍāk+ki hrīḥdha ya su khaṃ sid+dhi dzaḥ oṃ ā yur+dzñā na gu h+ya ḍāk+ki hrīḥ
