zhes sngags ring thung gang 'os bya zhing skabs dang bstun: ma grub bar du srog gi dam bca' bzung : zhag bdun lha zhal mthong gyur the tshom med: de phyir 'ja' lus tshe yi sgrub pa gces: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: 'chi med 'ja' lus srog sgrub bzhag: yang gsang mkha' 'gro'i bka' rgya can: lha lcam ḍāk+kis yi ger thob: zil chen gsang ba'i phug tu sbos: ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma ru: kho bo'i thugs sras pad+ma'i ming : gter bdag gling dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos/ me sprel lor tsā ri zil chen gsang phug nas gsang gter du bgyis te gdan drangs nas glang lor sbas yul pad+ma rong du shog ser nas zhal bsgyur ro// // tsha) ༈ tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: yang gsang sgrub pa rdo rje rmang gzhi khrigs su bsdeb pa bzhugs so/ 'chi med rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung*/ /'chi med sku brnyes lha lcam sogs/ /'chi med dkyil 'khor la 'dud de/ /'chi med gsang sgrub chog khrigs spel/ de'ang gzhung las/ tshe sgrub bya ba'i rim pa ni: bkra shis byin chags dge ba'i yul: dngos gzhi snang ba dben pa'i gnas: phun tshogs zla gam dbang phug tu: dmar zhing 'jam pa'i sa gzhi la: dal bcag thig gdab dkyil 'khor bris: yang na 'bru tshom legs par bkod: dbus su bum pa mtshan ldan nang : rdzas chen nyer lnga'i chu dang sbyar: sum gnyis bkang zhing kha rgyan spras: mtshan ldan bhan+dha nang du ni: tshe gtor nor bu pad+mas mtshan: rgyan ldan sku 'bag tsakli gzugs: gzhan yang mchod pa gzhung bzhin bsham: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ sbyor ba'i cha rnams legs par grub ste dngos gzhi la/ thog mar skyabs yul skad cig gis gsal btab nas skyabs sems dngos ni/ hrīḥ bla ma tshe dpag med pa dang : tshe dbang rig pa 'dzin rnams la:

sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: 'gro ba sems can kun don du: 'chi med tshe la dbang ba yi: rig 'dzin thob par sems bskyed do: de nas bgegs gtor byin rlob ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa brlabs la/ sarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa dzaḥ sa bkug /na maḥsarbba liṃ d+ye swā hā/ bsngos shing bka' bsgo ba ni/ hūm̐: dbang chen thugs las khro tshogs mtshon char 'phros: dkyil 'khor sgrub la mi dbang glag lta'i rigs: gtor ma khyer la rang rang gnas su dengs: gnod 'tshe brtsam na rdul du brlag par 'gyur: oṃ badz+ra kro ta he ru ka raṃ raṃ kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ de nas srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las sprul pa'i gur khang ni: steng 'og phyogs mtshams me ri rdo rje'i klong : dum bu rim dgu sra mkhregs pha lam ltar: nam yang mi shigs badz+ra rak+ṣa bh+rūm̐: de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gling bzhi srid pa'i khyon ltar yangs pa yi: rin chen 'khor yug drwa ba'i klong yangs su: mchod sprin lha mo rang rtags phyag rgya can: gzugs mdzes gar mo lang ling bye ba 'bum: spyan gzigs phyi nang gsang mchod sna tshogs rnams: dkyil 'khor dgyes pa bskyed pa'i rdzas su gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha hūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta āḥhūm̐: de nas byin 'bebs ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam ḍāk+ki chos skyong rnams: mi mngon dag pa mkha' spyod dbyings nas bzhengs: sgrub rdzas dkyil 'khor 'di la byin chen phob: dbang bzhi mchog thun stsol bar mdzad du gsol: oṃ ma hā gu ru ḍāk+ki dzñā na sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ de nas dngos gzhi gzhal yas dang*/ lha bskyed bya ba'i rim pa ni/ 'dzin med gsal stong 'di ltar bsgom/ hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las chos dbyings ye shes sku: rang byung rin chen tshe yi pho brang ni:

gru bzhi sgo bzhi phyi nang bkod pa rdzogs: 'ja' gur lug rgyud me tog chun pos spras: ma bcos rang byung 'od zer sna lnga gtibs: dbus su zla gam dmar po sgo gcig pa: de nang pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan: rin chen sna tshogs mdzes pa'i khri steng du: gser gyi rdo rje hrīḥyig dmar pos mtshan: gnas 'gyur rang rig 'chi med mgon po ni: dmar gsal mdzes ldan dri med rā ga'i mdog: zhal gsum phyag drug 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku: g.yas dkar g.yon sngo dbus dmar zhi 'dzum mdzes: sna tshogs rin chen dbu rgyan cod pan 'phur: g.yas g.yon dang pos rdo rje bhan+dha bsnams: bar gnyis 'khor lo pad phreng yu ba 'dzin: mtha' gnyis rin chen rdo rje rgya gram 'dzin: lha rdzas gos kyi stod g.yogs smad dkris brgyan: zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang phyed skyil stabs: gsang ba'i yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: dmar gsal mdangs ldan rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol: mda' dar tshe bum yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: zung 'jug zhabs gnyis bde stong sked la 'khril: yab yum 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku ru gsal: gnas gsum thugs rje 'od zer 'phros pa yis: 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ de nas spyan 'dren bzhugs phyag ni/ hūm̐: 'chi med rig 'dzin tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: dbyings nas skur bzhengs gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: ma chags skyon bral pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs: rtse gcig mi 'bral gdung bas phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod sna tshogs yid 'ong lha mo'i tshogs: nang mchod bdud rtsi pañtsa a mṛ ta: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med mchod pa 'di: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la 'bul: bzhes nas rig 'dzin 'ja' lus 'grub par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pañtsa pū dza āḥhūm̐:

de nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rang byung dbyings rig longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: rin chen dbu rgyan ye shes lnga dang ldan: dar dmar cod pan a mi dhe wa'i rtsal: g.yas zhal bde ba thabs kyi rang bzhin dkar: g.yon zhal stong nyid shes rab rang bzhin mthing : rtsa zhal dmar gsal chags pa'i rang bzhin mdangs: zhal gsum sku gsum ye nas 'du 'bral med: spyan dgu a ti theg pa rim dgu rdzogs: grags stong ma 'gags 'dzab dbyangs 'u ru ru: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la bstod: pha rol phyin drug phyag sor rtse mo ru: thabs shes rang bzhin tshe bdag rigs lnga rdzogs: phyag mtshan sa bon nyi zer 'bum phrag mdangs: longs spyod rdzogs sku rin chen rgyan gyis spras: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la bstod: tshad med bzhi ldan dga' bzhi'i phyed skyil ngang : sprul sku dbang po dar mtshon yug gos gsol: pad zla'i gdan bzhugs bde chen longs spyod rdzogs: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la bstod: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: sku mdog dmar gsal shes rab drwa ba'i gar: g.yas pas mda' dar ma sring mkha' 'gro sdud: g.yon pas tshe bum sgrub la 'chi med stsol: rus pa'i rgyan mdzes mnyen lcug 'khril ldem ma: nu ma rgyas shing bha ga bde drod 'khyil: yab la zhal sbyor dgyes chags zil bu'i mdangs: zhabs gnyis yab 'khril bde stong dga' bzhi ngang : rnal 'byor dmar mo gsang ye ḍāk+kir bstod: dzap bskul ni/ hūm̐: 'chi med yab yum rig 'dzin tshe yi lha: thugs dam rgyud bskul snying po sngags sgra sgrog: 'ja' lus 'od gsal rdo rje'i srog bsgrubs nas: nam yang mi shigs bgres rgud bral ba yi: sra brtan 'khor lo mkha' ltar gnas gyur cig: bsnyen dmigs ni/ thugs kar nyi zla kha sbyor gyi/ /ga'u'i dbus su pad zla'i steng*/ /rdo rje'i lte bar hrīḥyig dmar/ khog par tshe dang srog gi rten/

/āḥhūm̐ spu yi bris ltar gsal/ /tha mar tshe yi snying po ni/ /gsal 'tsher bkrag mdangs ldan par bsgom/ rtsa bsnyen ni/ oṃ ā yur+dzñā na gu h+ya ḍāk+ki hrīḥ sgrub sngags ni/ oṃ a mi dhe wa ā yur+dzñā na gu h+ya ḍāk+ki hrīḥdha ya su khaṃ sid+dhi dzaḥ zhes bsnyen pa ci nus bzlas shing tshe 'gugs pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe 'og min bde chen mkha' spyod du: snang mtha' mgon po gsang ba ye shes gnyis: zab dbyings 'od gsal dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i tshe bsgrubs pas: bgres rgud med pa rig 'dzin 'ja' lus grub: de yi byin rlabs dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: hūm̐: sngon dus tshe yi khungs yang bzang : bar du bka' gtad smon lam zab: da lta rten 'brel gnad kyang 'grigs: phyis 'byung mtshams sbyor 'phro mtha' btsan: de phyir sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin la: skye 'chi bgres rgud med par stsol: mnga' thang longs spyod snyan grags spel: chos dang brgyud 'dzin srid kyang skyongs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi rigs kyi tshe 'dzin ma: sku mdog dkar ser dmar ljang gar: mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin pa mos: lha klu mi yi bcud bsdus nas: skal ldan slob ma'i lus la bstim: tshe yi rig 'dzin myur thob mdzod: de nas rgya gram gyi rgyas gdab pa ni: hūm̐: mi shigs rdo rje'i go khrab la: sra brtan 'gyur med rgya yis gdab: rim bsdus 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor rnams: brtan par gyur cig badz+ra hoḥ dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying mchod bstod bya/ de nas tshogs bya ba ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: tshogs 'khor sbyang phyir yi ge 'phros: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis nyes skyon bsregs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir bsgyur: 'dod yon tshogs kyis snang srid gang : rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ

'og min chos dbyings dag pa'i zhing : rang byung tshe yi dkyil 'khor du: tshe bdag mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnams: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: byin phob mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa tshogs mchod bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: skye med ngang du thugs dam bskang*/ dam tshig 'gal 'khrul tshogs kyis bshags: gu ru dhai wa ḍāk+ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: bzhi pa bsgral bstab ni/ hūm̐: mdun du lcags snod gru gsum nang : dmigs bya'i dgra bgegs myur du khug: gnod byed srog la kī la ya: gtub cing khro rgyal zhal du 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā rak+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na khā hi: lnga pa lhag ma ni/ hūm̐: lhag sdud ging dang laṅka rnams: lhag ma bka' yi pha 'bab bzhes: gsang sngags bstan pa'i srung ma mdzod: dam sri dgra bo cham la phob: uts+tshiṣ+ṭa bha liṃ ta la khā hi: drug pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: chos dbyings ngang nas drag por bzhengs: sngon gyi tha tshig rgyud bskul ba'i: thugs dam ma g.yel phrin las mdzod: bdun pa chad mdo bsgrag pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe zab gsang rdo rje'i dbyings: mā ra ti ka zil chen phug /so sor sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin/ laṅka ma mo shugs 'gro yis: rang rtags srog phul ci bzhin du: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: 'ja' lus tshe yi sgrub grogs mdzod: oṃ baṃ ḍāk+ki mu khā le ma mo rak+ṣa kro ti bha liṃ ta khā hi: brgyad pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: 'jig rten skyong mdzad brtan ma rnams: rgyan ldan dur khrod gnas nyul ma: gtor ma bzhes la bstan pa srungs: ci bcol phrin las rogs dan mdzod: ma ma ma mo ting ting shag shag le le bha liṃ ta khā hi: dgu pa rta bro brdung ba ni/

hūm̐: dpal chen khrag 'thung he ru kas: dam sri bsgral nas rta bro brdung : chem chem dgra bo'i mgo la brdung : mnan no nam yang ma ldang zhig: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ bh+rūm̐ tsakra ya dgra bo nan nan: bcu pa dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐: tshe la dbang ba rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs: tshe chos zas nor srid kyi dngos grub stsol: tshe yi dbang bzhi smin grol mchog thob nas: tshe bsod mnga' thang 'byor rgyas thob gyur cig: rtsa sngags/ oṃ pad+ma hrī dha ā yur+dzñā na ha ri ni sa sid+dhi hūm̐ dza dzaḥ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: bcu gcig pa mchod bstod ni/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral rdo rje'i sku: mnyam bzhag tshe bum 'chi med bcud: mi 'gyur g.yung drung longs spyod rdzogs: 'ja' lus rang byung pad+ma 'byung : rig 'dzin tshe yi lha la bstod: bcu gnyis pa bzod gsol ni/ hūm̐: rtsa gsum yongs 'dus dkyil 'khor du: yo byad ma tshang 'bag btsog shor: cho ga lhag chad ting 'dzin g.yel: 'gal 'khrul nongs pa bzod par gsol: tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs: yig brgya bzlas/ bcu gsum pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ hoḥ rang shar rang grol dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: mtha' nas dbus yal sa bon stong pa'i dbyings: dam tshig gnyis med bskyed rdzogs spros bral ngang : dmigs med ka dag rang byung āḥru ldang : a a āḥ zhes ma bcos rang rig rgya yan thal lam shes par skyongs: bcu bzhi pa bsngo ba ni: hoḥ dpag yas khyon ltar grangs med bsags pa yi: legs pa'i dge tshogs mtha' yas rab spungs nas: yang dag dga' ston theg mchog mngon gyur tshogs: ring lugs sor mar bzhag pa'i rgyur don bsngo: bco lnga pa smon lam ni: hoḥ bdag gi bsgrubs pa'i yon tan sa bcu'i gter:

rab 'byams rtsa gsum dge legs thugs rje'i gar: sgyur mdzad rgyal dbang pad+ma kā ra yis: brgyud 'dzin smin grol dga' ston 'gyed gyur cig: ces bsngo smon gang rung gis legs par rgyas gdab bo/ bcu drug pa bkra shis ni/ hoḥ rtsa gsum 'khor lo pad 'byung mkha' 'gros bskor: zung 'jug tshe la rab gnas dbang ba yi: 'chi med bdud rtsis rtag tu ngoms byas nas: bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog: de ltar tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon gyi yang gsang sgrub pa rdo rje rmang gzhi khrigs su bsdeb pa 'di'ang gsang sgrub rtsa bar/ sngon 'gro la sogs gtong ba ni: rdo rje'i go khrab nang nas blang : zhes gsungs pa bzhin sngon mjug rnams rang lugs tshe sgrub rdo rje'i go khrab dang dbang chen tshe yi las byang sogs las kha bkang ste spros med nyams len la nye bar mkho ba'i cha rkyen du dmigs te man+t+ra shā sa dhā ras sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phan sprul bstan 'dzin 'gyur med kyis bgyis pas 'gro kun dus mi 'chi ba'i g.yul las rgyal te 'chi med mgon po'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // dza)

tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon las/ h+ya ghṛ wa khro rgyal stobs 'dus kyi gsol 'debs tshe 'phrang g.yul rgyal zhes bya bzhugs so/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /chos sku snang mtha' longs sku snying rje'i gter/ /sprul sku pad 'byung mtsho rgyal man+da ra/ /dbang chen bka' bab rgyal ba mchog dbyangs la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs dbang bskur stsol/ /'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin gnubs chen dzñā na'i mtshan/ /sprul pa'i gter 'byin rtsa gsum gling pa dang*/ /chos bdag rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol stsol/ /'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /yi dam yongs 'dus spyi dpal h+ya ghṛ/ /rol pa'i rtsal shar rigs gsum khro bo'i rgyal/ /ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo wā ra hī/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /gzhan yang sgo skyong zhing skyong ḍāk+ki dang*/ /rdo rje'i bka' sdod dam can chos srung sogs/ /snang srid dag pa rab 'byams dkyil 'khor la/ /gsol ba 'debs so tshe 'phrang bar chad sol/ /'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /ci snang dbang chen rol pa'i dā lar sad/ /grags pa thams cad bde stong sngags su dag /sems kyi dran rtog 'od gsal chos skur smin/ /don gnyis lhun grub 'gro don mthar phyin shog / ces pa'ang gu h+yas bskul ngor man+t+ra shā sa dha ras so// // wa) ༈ tshe sgrub yang snying 'chi bdag zil gnon las: h+ya ghṛ wa khro rgyal stobs 'dus kyi las byang bzhugs so: yang gsang bde chen h+ya ghṛ war 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs skal ldan las can bu yi don: yang gsang gud du sbas pa'i man ngag las: kun gyi bcud bsdus yang zab gcig dril te: dbang chen h+ya ghṛ ba'i sgrub thabs bstan:

gsang ba lha lcam ḍāk+kis yi ger thob: dag pa shrī'i nub phyogs gsang phug 'di: mkha' spyod o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling dang mnyam: sngon tshe ru tra thar pa nag po yis: rgya bod kun la sdang zhing 'tshe ba'i tshe: dbang chen khro rgyal 'bar bas rab bsgral nas: dum bu so bdun bgos nas rten 'brel gyi: gnas su byin brlabs phyogs su 'phang ba'i tshe: klad pa gangs can khrod du babs pa las: bod yul ti se gangs kyi sgrub pa'i gnas: lung las grags pa'i gnas chen nyer gcig chags: kun las khyad 'phags 'khor lo lnga yi gnas: de yang thugs kyi gnas mchog tsā ri ṭa: rgya gar gnas mchog kun gyi dbu rtse'i tshul: lte ba rdo rje gdan nas byin rlabs kyi: 'od zer dpag tshad khyab pa gnas 'dir 'brel: dur khrod tsā ri thugs kyi gnas mchog der: ting 'dzin ma bsgom nyams rtogs skye ba'i sa: zab mo snying byang gter kha sbas pa'i yul: gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i gnas chen po: rten 'brel kun gyi zab khyad gnas 'dir gtso: ma 'ongs gangs can gtsug lag gnas rnams kyang : bdud sprul sde bzhi 'joms nas rim par nub: bod mi phal cher gri ru 'chi ba mang : dam med 'byung po'i dmag khrims chu ltar khol: bstan pa'i sa 'dzin sum cha yal ba'i tshe: zab chos 'di yis 'gro don dpag med 'byung : 'chi med rig 'dzin tshe yi sgrub pa 'di: srog sgrub kun gyi yang snying bla na med: 'jigs med khro rgyal stobs 'dus sgrub pa 'di: bdud bzhi tshe 'phrang sgrol ba'i zab khyad che: de bas srog ltar 'dzin te bsgrub par bya: ma 'ongs lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: rig 'dzin pad+ma'i ming dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: dang po sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bca' ba ni: 'jam legs dbang gi dar thig dmar po gdab: dbus su bhan+dha mtshan ldan nang du ni: dbang chen bsgrub pa'i srog rten bla rdo bzhag: bum pa rnam rgyal mdzes pa'i rgyan ldan la:

byang sems dkar dmar sbyar nas sum gnyis bkang : sku 'bag spyan gzigs phyag mtshan sna tshogs bzhengs: rta mchog gtor ma rtsa gsum gtor ma la: mdun du chos 'byung dag gis rab tu mtshan: pad 'dab bzhi dang 'khor rnams las gzhung ltar: drag gtor rgyun gtor thun gtor la sogs bsham: phyi nang mchod pa spyi lung bzhin tu bsham: kun tshang mchod rdzas sna tshogs gtams byas nas: bde ba'i gdan la bag bro lhun chags 'god: tshad med bzhi ldan ting 'dzin rnam gsum ngang : yang gsang chen po'i dal du 'jug par bya: sa ma ya: dang po: e ma hoḥ dran rig mngon gyur yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas: gang shar rol pa'i thugs rje ye shes chos: sna tshogs bdag 'dzin bral ba'i dge 'dun tshogs: ro gcig tha dad 'dzin med skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa: na mo: mtha' yas 'gro drug byams shing brtse ba'i ma: snying rje bskyed do srid pa'i rigs drug tshogs: dga' chen khyod bdag bsten pa'i blo gros kyis: thams cad btang snyoms lam la 'god par bya: gsum pa: oṃ swa bhā w stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du: oṃ āḥhūm̐: 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo sogs? badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li pañtsa hūm̐ phaṭḥ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di nyid: 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni: dpal ye shes kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga: lha chen po brgyad: klu chen po brgyad: gza' chen po brgyad: phyi nang gsang ba'i lha srin sde brgyad: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu: bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis: 'jigs byed chen po dgu bcu rtsa lnga: khyad par gangs ti se: la phyi chu bar: mkha' spyod tsā ri: jo bo gze rgyal chen po: rong btsan gangs gnyan chen po:

sbas yul chen po bco brgyad la gnas pa'i srung ma dam can gter bdag rnams dang : khyad par brag rwa lha: sog ra btsan: chos 'phen klu: ti sgro sman: gtsug na rnam rgyal dkar po la sogs pa: gzhan yang yul ri dben gnas gnyan po 'di nyid la gnas pa'i srung ma dam tshig can: rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bka' dang dam la gnas pa: gtsug lag chos 'khor skyong ba: rnal 'byor bdag la lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: bzhes nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs: dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod: dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs: chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs shig: oṃ sarba lo ka pā la i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: hūm̐: sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' nyan pa: tshangs pa brgya byin lha chen brgyad: dga' bo 'jog po klu chen brgyad: nyi ma la sogs gza' chen brgyad: smin drug la sogs rgyu skar brgyad: dbang chen la sogs sa bdag brgyad: li la sogs te spar kha brgyad: rgyal chen bzhi dang phyogs skyong bcu: lo skor bcu gnyis sme ba dgu: lo rgan drug cu dus 'dzin bcas: 'gyu ba bcu gnyis la sogs pa: khyad par lha klu mthu bo che: sde dpon sum cu so gnyis dang : yul ri dben gnas skyong ba yi: bka' gter srung ma 'khor bcas kyis: rin chen gser skyems gtor ma bzhes: zhi rgyas dbang drag legs nyes kyi: bya ba phra rags ci byas kyang : ko long ru nga phrag dog dang : gnod 'tshe gdug sems zhi bar mdzod: oṃ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: bzhi pa bgegs gtor gtong ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis byin gyis brlab: hūm̐ dzaḥ dbang chen thugs las spros pa pho nya'i tshogs: steng 'og phyogs mtshams bar med khyab par 'phros: tshe yi bar chod glags lta gdon gyi tshogs: gtor ma len phyir gnas 'dir myur du khug: oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha ya dza:

gnod byed 'byung po a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ lnga pa: hūm̐: nyon cig log 'dren 'byung po gdon gyi tshogs: 'dod yon glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la: tshim zhing rang rang gnas su 'gro bar gyis: ci ste mi 'gro glags lta 'tshe byed na: nga nyid khro rgyal stobs 'dus thugs khros te: sku yi rtsal bcu phyag mtshan me char 'bebs: gsung gi rigs sngags 'brug sgra glog dmar 'khyugs: thugs las sprul pa'i rig 'dzin tshwa tshwa 'thor: las kyi pho nya 'jigs byed stong khams g.yo: 'byung po'i tshogs rnams mgo snying lag par 'gas: lus ngag rdul du brlag par gdon mi za: de bas so so rang rang gnas su dengs: oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūm̐: ghṛh+ṇa pa ya mā ra ya bhan+dha bhū ta ra tsa u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ drug pa thun gyis brdeg cing bskrad pa'o: 'byung po rnams mtha' yi rgya mtsho'i pha mthar bskrad de ming yang med par bsam: me bzhi'i 'od tshur 'dus ltar khro bo'i thugs kar phyag mtshan sa bon dang dbyer med gyur te: mi shigs srung khang dang ldan par bsgom mo: hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las spros pa'i phyag mtshan tshogs: nyi zer rdul ltar 'khrigs pa'i gur khang nas: dum bu rim dgu sra mkhregs pha lam ltar: cis kyang mi shigs rlung yang mi thar bsgom: hūm̐: dang po yi ge dmar po grangs med gur: gnyis pa tshe bdag rigs lnga khor yug gur: gsum pa khro chen dkar po nang gzigs gur: bzhi pa g.yung drung dmar po sra brtan gur: lnga pa gnam lcags rdo rje dgu yi gur: drug pa tri shul kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum gur: bdun pa me dbal drag po dbyug to'i gur: brgyad pa ri rab phur bu 'dril 'debs gur: dgu pa dmar nag 'bar ba me yi gur: rim dgu mi shigs rdo rje'i gur khang gsal: glags lta 'byung po sna tshogs mtshams chod cig: oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ tsakra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: oṃ badz+ra ā yur+dzñā na ga ga na rak+ṣa rak+ṣa:

oṃ kro ta la su ta ma hā rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: oṃ rak+ta sha shwa ta tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā: oṃ ga ga mo ha badz+ra tri tra wa na rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: oṃ tri shu la tri na tra ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: oṃ daṇ+ṭa muṃ ra ga ra raṃ bha la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: oṃ pa ra ma ta kī la ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: oṃ rak+ta ka la artsig dz+wa la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: oṃ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha wa na tsakra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: bdun pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: gling bzhi srid pa'i khyon ltar yangs pa yi: rin chen 'khor yug drwa ba'i klong yangs su: mchod sprin lha mo rang rtags phyag rgya can: gzugs mdzes gar mo lang ling bye ba 'bum: spyan gzigs phyi yi mchod sprin sna tshogs rnams: dkyil 'khor dgyes pa bskyed pa'i rdzas su gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da ā hūm̐: brgyad pa: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ ram̐ las grub pa'i: rlung me'i dkyil 'khor dbus su thod sgyed gsum: de'i steng rang byung snod mchog ka pā la: phyi dkar nang dmar mtshan ldan rgya che'i nang : logs gsum 'bru gsum dbus su mi yi sha: ba glang khyi dang glang chen rta mchog sha: byang sems dri chen dri chu dmar chen bkang : gho ku dha ha shu mu bi ra raṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs rang rang yi ges mtshan: shangs nas rlung g.yos yam̐ ram̐ dal la phog: me 'bar mched pas thod pa'i bdud rtsi khol: kha chod nyi zla 'bru gsum 'od du zhu: byis pa'i rdo rjes lan gsum dkrugs pa yis: dam rdzas ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'khyil: rba rlabs rlangs pa'i klong nas mkha' 'gro ma: mchod sprin lha mo nam mkha' 'gengs pa'i tshogs: phyag na nyi zla bhan+dha'i skyogs chen thogs: bdud rtsi blangs nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang : byang sems 'phags tshogs bka' yis 'dus pa'i sde: khyad par dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho mnyes byed pa'i: bla med kun tshang rdzas su 'byung gyur cig: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ

oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ā hūm̐ a haṃ pañtsa gu h+ya pū dza hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: dgu pa: hūm̐: snang srid 'jig rten yangs pa'i gtor gzhong du: ri rab lhun po brjid pa'i dpal bshos btsugs: sha khrag snying dang klad rus nang rol gyis: legs par brgyan cing nyi zla'i thig gdab ste: dmar nag dar gyi gdugs dang cod pan 'phur: byad ma dam sri ru tra'i liṅgas brgyan: zhi rgyas dbang drag rnam bzhi'i gtor kyus bskor: bam ro'i tshogs kyi mchod pa bcal du bkram: bla rten srog 'khor sna tshogs khyon ltar brdal: bskang rdzas spyan gzigs mchod pa'i bye brag rnams: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta oṃ āḥhūm̐: bcu pa: hūm̐: 'og min ka dag chos dbyings klong yangs nas: 'gro mgon thog ma'i mgon pos byin phob cig: sna tshogs zangs thal drwa ba'i klong yangs nas: 'chi med tshe bdag yab yum byin phob cig: lhun grub rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga nas: gsang ba ye shes ḍāk+kis byin phob cig: mi zad khyab brdal 'khor lo'i pho brang nas: rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rjes byin phob cig: rnam dag 'od gsal gter chen pho brang nas: slob dpon shrī singhas byin phob cig: bla med mdzod kyi bka' bab ti ka nas: mkhas mchog 'jam dpal bshes gnyen byin phob cig: lho nub rnga yab dpal ri'i pho brang nas: 'chi med pad+ma 'byung gnas byin phob cig: ke'u ri gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i gnas mchog nas: dzñā na sā ra dza yas byin phob cig: gnas mchog yang rdzong shel gyi brag phug nas: dpal chen sangs rgyas ye shes byin phob cig: tsā ri zil chen gsang phug gnas mchog nas: dbang chen khro rgyal stobs 'dus byin phob cig: brda bzhi'i bka' bab lung gi gnas mchog nas:

e haṃ lo ha badz+ra byin phob cig: nyi 'od gcig la gnyis mched ston pa'i dpal: in+ḍa ma hā badz+ra byin phob cig: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i rten 'brel 'khor lor bsgyur: ā yur+dzñā na dhe was byin phob cig: zab gsang bka' yi bstan skyong mthu bo che: ma hā k+ṣe ṭa pa las byin phob cig: dkyil 'khor gsang ba yongs rdzogs pho brang nas: bka' sdod bye ba 'bum gyis byin phob cig: hūm̐: chos sku'i byin 'bebs sprin tshogs thibs se thib: longs sku'i byin 'bebs sbrang char sha ra ra: sprul sku'i byin 'bebs 'ja' tshon kyi li li: rig 'dzin byin 'bebs smin grol ta la la: mkha' 'gro'i byin 'bebs brda skad di ri ri: khro bo'i byin 'bebs hūm̐ sgra 'u ru ru: khro mo'i byin 'bebs gar dgu shigs se shig: chos skyong byin 'bebs las byed khyugs se khyug: sgrol ging byin 'bebs bdud 'dul nyi li li: ging mo'i byin 'bebs shug sgra 'u ru ru: sa 'dul byin 'bebs gyad 'gros khrigs se khrig: rab gnas byin 'bebs me tog chi li li: bkra shis byin 'bebs rgyan legs pu ru ru: dkyil 'khor byin 'bebs bag dro me re re: mched lcam byin 'bebs dga' spro ya la la: gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin chen myur du phob: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag la dbang bzhi bskur: 'dir 'dus skal ldan dpa' bo mkha' 'gror bsgyur: don gnyis dngos grub deng 'dir stsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra a be sha ya phaiṃ phaiṃ sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

zhes byin 'bebs rtags ma byung bar bskyar: bcu gcig pa: hūm̐: sngon tshe dpal chen lha dang gnyis med kyang : ma rig 'khrul pa'i bag chags rab brtsegs nas: bdag 'dzin ru tra'i dbang gis so sor phyes: deng nas 'khrul bshags brdal khyab ye grol bzung : oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe hoḥ bcu gnyis pa: hūm̐: ma rig log lta srid pa'i sgo bcad nas: ye shes zang thal sku lnga'i sgo phyes te: rang rig lta ba chos sku'i lha zhal mjal: dran rig kun gsal de bzhin ngang gis gnas: oṃ pra be sha phaṭḥ sa ma ya a ti pu hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ bcu gsum pa dam bca' bzung ba ni: dbang chen rol pa'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: ma bcos rang shar lhun grub ji bzhin tu: dran rig gnyug ma bag yod rtse gcig gis: bla med dam tshig mi gtong srog ltar bsgrub: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tsit+ta hṛ da ya hūm̐: dang po: hūm̐: ma skyes rdzogs pa rdo rje'i mkha': gzhal las 'das te rang bzhin stong : 'od gsal chen po ngang gis rdzogs: he ru ka yis de ltar smras: he ru ka dharma hūm̐: gnyis pa: hūm̐: rang bzhin stong pa'i rang rtsal las: zang thal ma 'gags lam gyis shar: mtha' gnyis bral te kun rgyu can: gnyis med mnyam pa nyid kyis rdzogs: oṃ swa bhā ta ra dharma hūm̐: gsum pa: hūm̐: sna tshogs drwa ba'i sgyu 'phrul las: kun tu bskyed pa'i sa bon hūm̐: gnas 'gyur rdo rje rab tu 'bar: mi shigs gdan bcas gsal bar bsgom: oṃ badz+ra hṛ da ya hūm̐: dzñā na bh+rūm̐: bzhi pa: hūm̐: 'byung lnga rdo rje rtsal chen gyis: ma 'gags dbyings la ye shes shar: dran rig lta bas thig gdab bo: oṃ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: oṃ e sa ra ṇa phaṭḥ yam̐ ga ga na hūm̐: ram̐ dz+wa la ṇa hoḥ kham̐ dha ra ṇa taṃ: sum̐ dzñā na ya lhan: keṃ pra ba ta li: bh+rūm̐ maṇ+ḍal hoḥ dhu ti ya ra baṃ: hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ dzñā na hri kro ta ya phaṭḥ lnga pa: hūm̐: e las nam mkha'i klong chen mtha' dbus bral:

yam̐ las rlung lnga bsnol thabs shin tu g.yo: ram̐ las 'byung lnga'i me ri rab tu mched: kham̐ las chags med rak+ta'i rba rlabs 'phyo: sum̐ las dbang chen sa bzhi smug nag brjid: keṃ las thod pa'i gzhal yas dbyings dang mnyam: bh+rūm̐ las ye shes pho brang mtshan nyid rdzogs: oṃ badz+ra dzñā na satwaṃ sa ma ya bh+rūm̐: badz+ra āt+ma ko3 haṃ: hūm̐: rdo rje bh+rūm̐ gyur drag po'i gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi rdo rje'i rmang gzhi ldan: lha brgyad ka ba klu brgyad gdung ma bris: ka zhu zhing chen pho mo gar stabs bsgyur: ka gdan gdol pa pho mo ngar sgra 'byin: gdung g.yogs chu srin 'bar ba'i g.yang gzhis brgyan: rgyu skar nyer brgyad dral lcam za ra tshags: gza' brgyad ki kang thog steng phyag gis brdal: mi mgo skam rlon spel ba'i rtsig pa la: g.yang gzhi sna tshogs zung gi 'dod snam brgyan: khro chu'i pha gus gnam lcags drwa ba bres: ba su ta yi zhags pa'i drwa phyed la: mkhal mkhan rgyu ma brgyus pa'i 'phen rdo 'phyangs: skye rga na 'chi'i thob pa'i mda' yab la: skra yi rnga yab dril bu la sogs brgyan: pu shu srin po'i mgo phreng bsgrigs pa la: mig nas me 'bar kha nas rak+ta 'bab: khro rgyal rigs bzhi'i rta babs gyad dang ldan: chos 'khor za ram dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du: nyi zla'i tog bcas gzi brjid phyogs bcur khyab: dbus su gnam lcags las grub gur khang ni: rdo rje rwa dgu gzengs pa'i tog dang bcas: phyogs bcur khyab pa'i hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: thog steng thams cad zhing chen gdugs kyis brgyan: mi mgo tsit+ta'i thod la me chen 'bar: nang du rak+ta'i zham chu mtsho ltar 'khyil: ru tra'i g.yang gzhi bla bre khor yug bres: don snying lnga yi rgyan dar du ma 'phyangs: phyi rol rdo rje'i rwa ba dur khrod dang : bskal pa'i me ri drag tu 'bar ba'i gur: sra mkhregs gnam lcags ur mo las grub pa'i: rab 'jigs drag po'i pho brang chen por gsal:

hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra tsakra dz+wa la phaṭḥ hūm̐: de dbus zla gam dmar po sgo gcig pa: rdo rje brag dmar pad+ma nyi zla dang : ti ra smug nag gan rkyal snying ga'i steng : dmar nag rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan: dran rdzogs dbang drag pad+ma he ru kaḥ khro rgyal stobs 'dus h+ya ghṛ ba'i sku: zhal gsum khro zhing rngam pa'i skur ston pa: dkar dmar mthing la mi bzad shin tu gtum: dbu skra kham nag nam mkha'i dbyings su bskyod: thod skam rgyan ldan sbrul chings dar nag 'phur: rta dbu gsum ldan spyi bor rigs bdag brgyan: g.yas gsum rdo rje dbyug tho ral gri 'dzin: g.yon gsum bhan+dha kha ṭ+wāṃ phur pa bsgril: ral gri chu gri'i sgro gshog dbyings la brgyangs: thal chen tshom bu seng glang zhing ko dang : khrag zhag thig le sbrul rigs lnga yis brgyan: mgo phreng stag sham rus rgyan g.yer kha 'khrol: sku smad chu srin rngam zhal phur bu brjid: zur gsum thog dang ser ba char du 'bebs: phag mo mthing nag spyi bor phag zhal ngur: gri thod mgul 'khyud dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: zung 'jug ngang du zhabs gnyis sked la 'khril: yab yum thugs kar hūm̐ dang baṃ gyis mtshan: sngags phreng 'khor zhing sku la bya khyung 'phro: rab 'jigs me dpung rab 'bar klong du gsal: oṃ h+ya ghṛ wa kī la ya baṃ kro ti hūm̐ bh+yoḥ hūm̐: g.yas su pad+ma nyi zla baṃ gyi steng : 'jam dpal nag po zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas gsum ral gri dgra satwa rdo rje dang : g.yon gsum bhan dmar lcags kyu phur bu 'dril: dur khrod chas rdzogs sgro gshog dbyings la brgyangs: sku smad chu srin khro zhing phur bu'i dbal: dgra bo'i snying du bsnun cing gtum pa'i tshul: gsang ba'i yum mchog drag mo lcags gdong ma: gri thod 'dzin zhing yab kyi sku la 'khril: yab yum thugs kar hūm̐ dang bh+yo yis mtshan: sngags phreng 'khor zhing gdon bgegs 'byung po bcom:

rab khros sku la bskal pa'i me ri 'bar: oṃ mañdzu shrī kī la ya kro ti hūm̐ bh+yoḥ hūm̐: g.yon du pad+ma nyi zla bam gyi steng : phyag rdor mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas gsum rdo rje gri khug 'khor lo dang : g.yon gsum bhan dmar kha ṭ+wāṃ phur bu 'dril: dur khrod chas rdzogs sgro gshog dbyings la brgyangs: sku smad chu srin khro rgyal phur bu'i dbal: rgyal bsen gdug pa'i snying la bsnun par gsal: gsang ba'i yum mchog thugs rje khros ma nag: gri thod 'dzin zhing yab kyi sku la 'khril: yab yum thugs kar hūm̐ dang bh+yo yis mtshan: sngags phreng 'khor bas bdud bzhi tshar bcad de: shin tu mi bzad me dpung klong du gsal: oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi kī la ya kro ti baṃ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ hūm̐: rgyab tu klu bdud sa bdag bsnol ba'i steng : bya khyung mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas gsum rdo rje ral gri rus sbal dang : g.yon gsum lcags sdig kha ṭ+wāṃ sbrul zhags bsnams: dur khrod chas ldan spu gri'i sgro gshog brgyangs: sku smad chu srin dbal gyi phur zor brjid: gsang ba'i yum mchog khro mo gtum chen nag /gri thod 'dzin zhing yab kyi sku la 'khril: yab yum thugs kar hūm̐ bh+yo tha ma ru/ sngags phreng 'khor bas klu gnyan sa bdag 'joms: dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong du gsal: oṃ khroṃ ga ru ṭa kī la ya hūm̐ bh+yoḥ hūm̐: mdun du chos 'byung ti ra bam gyi steng : zhing skyong mgon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas gsum ru mtshon tho ba ral gri dang : g.yon gsum gtor zor me dpung phur bu 'dril: dur khrod chas rdzogs sgro gshog mkha' la brgyangs: sku smad chu srin khro phur byad mar bsnun: drag mo seng gdong gri thod sku la 'khril: yab yum thugs kar hūm̐ dang bh+yo yi mthar: sngags phreng 'khor bas dgra bgegs byad ma bcom: oṃ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha kī la ya kro ti hūm̐ phaṭḥ

hūm̐: sgo bzhi skyong ba'i las byed mkha' 'gro ma: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu ma: gsal 'tsher sgeg bzhad dgyes pa'i khro gnyer can: g.yas pas rang rtags g.yon pas phur bu thogs: dur khrod chas rdzogs rngam pa'i gad rgyangs can: sku smad chu srin rngam zhal phur bu 'dril: thugs kar srog yig dza hūm̐ baṃ ho'i mthar: sngags phreng 'khor bas sgrub pa'i bar chad bsal: oṃ kro ti tsa tur bh+yo dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis: dbang chen khro rgyal rol pa'i dur khrod nas: 'jigs byed phur bu stobs 'dus lha tshogs rnams: char sprin drag po 'khrigs pa ji bzhin du: skad cig thogs med gnas 'dir spyan drangs gyur: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dang po ni: hūm̐: dbang chen khro rgyal rol pa'i dur khrod nas: stobs 'dus h+ya ghṛ wa gshegs su gsol: sku mchog rtsal chen rab rdzogs pho brang nas: khro rgyal 'jam dpal nag po gshegs su gsol: yang dag bde chen lhun grub pho brang nas: dregs pa phyag na rdo rje gshegs su gsol: klu gnyan sa bdag 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: rab 'jigs khyung gi lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: bka' dang dam tshig dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas: dpal ldan seng gdong mgon po gshegs su gsol: phrin las tshad med sgrub pa'i pho brang nas: sgo skyong ging mo mched bzhi gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gnyis pa: hūm̐: mi bzad rab 'bar me dpung klong yangs dbus: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las 'dus pa'i mchog: stobs 'dul khro rgyal 'bar ba'i lha tshogs rnams: ti ra nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng du: mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: gsum pa: hūm̐: rang byung klong yangs spros pa mi mnga' yang : 'gro ba'i don du khro rgyal skur ston pa: ma rig log lta nyon mongs dbyings su bsgral:

dran rig lhan skyes khro rgyal stobs 'dus sku: yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: oṃ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ bzhi pa: hūm̐: gsang ba'i lha mo brda 'gros gar mo gzugs: phyag na mnyes pa'i sna tshogs mchod 'dzin ma: gar mo sgeg mo glu ma dbyangs ldan ma: bla med gsang mchod lha mo bcu drug 'di: khro rgyal stobs 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye mā l+ye gīrti āḥhūm̐: lnga pa: hūm̐: bhan+dha bum ril yangs shing rgya che'i nang : dza gad sman mchod sna tshogs mtsho ltar 'khyil: sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang ye shes lnga: zag med bde ba bskyed pa'i ting 'dzin rdzas: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bla med bdud rtsi 'di: khro rgyal stobs 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥkha kha khā hi: drug pa: hūm̐: dung dmar shes rab yangs pa'i snod mchog tu: shwa ri rak+ta dbyings phyug mkha' klong khrag: mu la rak+ta shing dang 'byung ba'i khrag: gu h+ya rak+ta gsang ba mkha' lam khrag: pad+ma rak+ta rigs bzang rtsa yi khrag: 'dar ma rak+ta 'dod chags bsre ba'i khrag: du na rak+ta dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag: añdza rak+ta rgyud drug bsgral ba'i khrag: dmar chen rgya mtsho zhag g.yo bcud ldan 'di: khro rgyal stobs 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥkha kha khā hi: bdun pa: hūm̐: phyi snod srid pa'i khyon ltar yangs pa yi: rin chen bhan+dha 'bar ba'i gtor gzhong du: ri rab dpal bshos ma hā ba liṃ ta: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dbang po rnam lnga 'bul: byad ma gdug pa'i liṅga sna tshogs brgyan: dmar nag gur phub las bzhi gtor kyus bskor: 'dod yon lnga ldan gtor chen rgya mtsho 'di: khro rgyal stobs 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ

i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta la kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: bla rten srog 'khor rten rdzas sgrub rdzas dang : 'phan gdugs bla bre mda' mdung dar nag rten: sna tshogs bskang rdzas mdzes pa'i gzugs 'gros dang : rtag gtor rten gtor thun gtor sgrub gtor dang : ga ṇa tshogs mchod rgya mtsho ri ltar spungs: dgyes pa'i rten du mchod sprin dpag med 'di: khro rgyal stobs 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra na sa ma ye swā hā: brgyad pa: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: gsang chen lhun grub 'bar ba'i pho brang nas: 'jigs byed chen po h+ya ghṛ wa che: sku mdog dmar nag me zer ya la la: g.yas dkar g.yon mthing dbus dmar srid gsum sngangs: zhal gdangs dgyes pa'i hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: ljags dmar 'dril nas gdug pa'i snying khrag rol: mche gtsigs drag pos dgra sha dmar la za: shangs nas rlung 'tshubs 'dre rgod 'byung po gtor: spyan gsum sdang mig smin ma glog ltar 'gyu: dbu skra dmar nag stong khams bshig cing g.yo: thod skam dbu rgyan khro bcu zil gyis gnon: rta skad drag pos phyogs bcu'i dregs pa 'dul: a mi dhe wa'i thugs rjes phyogs bcur gzigs: dar nag cod pan dug sbrul 'ching rgyan 'khyugs: dpral bar thal chen tshom bus ma sring sdud: khrag gi thig le zhag gi zo ris ldan: g.yas gsum mtshon chas ma rungs 'dre rgod 'joms: g.yon gsum mtshon chas byad ma thal bar brlag: ral gri'i sgro gshog 'byung po'i dmag tshogs 'joms: seng glang zhing kos srid gsum gdug pa 'joms: sbrul dang mgo phreng stag sham dregs pa sngangs: rus pa'i rgyan ldan g.yer kha 'ur 'ur sgrogs: chu srin zhal bgrad sa bdag klu gnyan 'dul: gnam lcags phur gsham bstan pa'i ru tra sgrol: me dpung klong bzhugs dgra bgegs thul gyis sreg:

khro rgyal stobs 'dus sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum mchog drag mo phag gdong ma: rab 'jigs khro mo mthing nag rngam pa'i sku: stong nyid phag zhal ngur sgra 'ur ru ru: khros pa'i zhal gyis snang srid bred cing sngangs: phyag g.yas gri gug bdud dpung rtsad nas gcod: g.yon pas bhan dmar gdug pa'i snying khrag rol: rus pa'i rgyan ldan snang srid ma mo sdud: yab la zhabs 'khril bde stong zung du 'jug: gzi brjid mdangs mnga' sgrub la 'chi med stsol: bdud 'dul phag gdong ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: me rlung dmar nag 'tshubs pa'i klong dkyil nas: 'jam dpal nag po 'jigs byed he ru kaḥ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum khro zhing rngam: dbu skra bsigs na stong khams mun ltar gtibs: g.yas g.yon mtshon chas dug lnga dbyings su sgrol: dur khrod chas ldan bgegs dpung sa la bsgyel: sgro gshog brgyangs pas 'byung po'i gdon tshogs 'joms: sku smad phur bus ngan song skye rgyud gcod: gsang ba'i yum mchog drag mo lcags gdong ma: skye 'chi spang phyir gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: pha rol phyin drug rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras: yab la 'khril sbyor bde stong zung du 'jug: ye shes lnga ldan me dpung klong du bzhugs: 'jam dpal nag po yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: rab 'jigs khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas: dregs pa 'jigs byed rdo rje gtum po'i sku: dkar dmar mthing ba'i zhal gsum rab tu bgrad: dbu skra dmar nag srid pa'i rtse mor bskyod: g.yas g.yon mtshon cha sde dpon pho nya 'gyed: sgro gshog brgyangs pas stong gsum shig shig g.yo: sku smad phur gsham tshe bdud snying gar gzir: yum mchog khros ma gtum mo mi bzad ma: gri thod 'dzin pas rgyal bsen klad khrag rol: rus pa'i rgyan ldan ma sring las la 'gyed: yab la zhabs 'khril thabs shes 'du 'bral med: sku las skyes pa'i me 'od klong du bzhugs:

gtum po yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rngam drag 'bar ba 'khrigs pa'i dur khrod dbus: yon tan sprul pa ye shes ga ru ṭaḥ mthing dkar dmar zhal mchu brdar rkan sgra rdeb: g.yas g.yon mtshon chas sa bdag klu gnyan bkums: sgro gshog brgyangs pas bar snang rlabs kyis bskyod: dbu skra'i me zer stong khams 'ur gyis 'gengs: dur khrod chas ldan byad zor dgra la 'phen: khro chu'i phur gsham srid pa'i rgya mtsho khol: me char tshwa tshwas nad dal yams rims 'joms: ye shes khro rgyal khyung la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gad rgyangs ha ha drag tu rgod pa'i dbus: ye shes mgon po dpal ldan seṅge'i gdong : mthing dkar dmar ba'i seng zhal nga ro sgrog: dbu skra sprugs pas seng chung skar ltar 'khrugs: phyag drug mtshon gyi sgyogs chen dgra la 'phen: dur khrod chas ldan dregs pa'i dmag tshogs bkums: sgro gshog brgyangs shing stong gsum pho nyas 'gengs: sku smad phur gsham ban bon byad kha bzlog: yum mchog drag mo seng gdong rngam pa mo: gri thod 'dzin pas skye shi rtsad nas gcod: rus pa'i rgyan ldan gson 'dre pho mo sngangs: yab la 'khril sbyor sgrub par dngos grub stsol: me dpung klong bzhugs ma rungs 'joms byed pa: gtum chen seng gdong yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: thogs med las bzhi drag po'i bsgrub pa yi: sgo skyong ging chen 'jigs pa'i khro mo bzhi: dkar ser dmar ljang khro zhal rab tu gdangs: rang rtags phyag mtshan tshad med sgo bzhi skyong : dur khrod chas rdzogs sgrub pa'i bar chad srung : sgro gshog brgyangs pas bgegs srin phye mar brlag: sku smad phur bus nyams pa'i snying la gzir: me rlung 'tshubs pas shes bya'i bud shing sreg: sgo skyong khro mo rigs bzhir phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: bsgrub cing bstod pa'i khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha: deng 'dir thugs dam gnyan po gnad nas bskul:

snang srid gdug pa'i 'dre rgod kha dar bas: stobs 'dus lha tshogs mngon spyod dus la bab: rtsal chen gzi brjid 'gyed pa'i dus la bab: snang srid dbang du sdud pa'i dus la bab: dam sri 'dre rgod 'dul ba'i dus la bab: gdug pa'i g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i dus la bab: bdud 'dul ban bon bzlog pa'i dus la bab: bstan bshig ru tra 'dul ba'i dus la bab: nad kha rkyen ngan bzlog pa'i dus la bab: ma rungs 'dre rgod 'dul ba'i dus la bab: tshe dbang dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab: don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa kī la ya baṃ kro ti hūm̐ bh+yoḥ oṃ ya mān+ta ka kī la ya baṃ kro ti hūm̐ bh+yoḥ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi kī la ya baṃ kro ti hūm̐ bh+yoḥ oṃ khroṃ ga ru ṭa kī la ya hūm̐ bh+yoḥ oṃ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha kī la ya baṃ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ oṃ badz+ra kro ta dza hūm̐ baṃ ho kī la ya tsa tur hūm̐ bh+yoḥ

kun 'dus rtsa sngags ni: oṃ h+ya ghṛ wa mañdzu shrī badz+ra pā ṇi khroṃ ga ru ṭa ma hā kā la kro ti pañtsa kī la ya dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes sngags so sor phral ba gong bzhin la: gcig dril la bsdus pa yang snying gi lugs yin pas kun 'dus so: sham bu nad gdon sogs la rtsa sngags kyi sham bur: bdag gi tshe rabs thog med du bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang nad gdon 'byung po tshe yi bar chad bsam sbyor byad stems thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig: oṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rgyas pa: bdag gi tshe bsod chos dang snyan grags mnga' thang dpal 'byor thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig: oṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: dbang sdud la: bdag gis brtan g.yo snang srid lha 'dre mi gsum thams cad dbang du 'dus par gyur cig: oṃ wā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: tshar gcod la: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la snang srid gdug pa'i pha rol byad gtad dgra bgegs 'byung po thams cad brlag cing tshar bcad par gyur cig: hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭḥ byad sbyor ngan pa spyi la: oṃ kro ta badz+ra kī li kī la ya bigh+nān mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces rtsa sngags las sngags rnams skabs dang bstun te bzlas: de yang sgrub pa'i dus su rtsa sngags sogs dang : las sbyor dus su las sngags bya'o: tshad ni 'bum phrag go: de las ma nyung bar bsgrubs pas dus min 'chi ba las sgrol bar nges 'byung the tshom med: spyir tshe sgrub kyi skabs su: drag po tshar re srod 'phros dus su drag po'i bsnyen pa nyung ngu re bzlas pas: tshe rta kha sprod ces pas byin rlabs che bar bshad kyang sgrub sngags rgyas pa las byang ma lcogs na gsang sgrub kyi mngon rtogs dang bsnyen pa yang bsdus pa las byang du: sa ma ya: zhes skabs su thun gtor 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: khrag 'thung khro rgyal yab yum dbyings nas bzhengs: phyi nang phrin las rnam bzhi'i thugs dam bskul:

dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dbang bzhi mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra ba liṃ ta pū dza ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na la kha kha khā hi: zhes dngos grub len pa sogs tshe sgrub nas byas: yang na 'grub pa'i dbang blang pa ni: sgrub rten bum pa rnams rim bzhin byin rlabs zhus la: hūm̐: dbang chen yab yum ngo bo nyid: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i skal ldan la: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi: dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs stsal du gsol: oṃ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes dbang blangs shing dngos grub la rol: dang po tshogs la 'jug pa ni: tshogs chu gtsang gis bran zhing bsang sbyang legs par bya: spos sreg gar mo sgeg mo sogs sgrig na rab: rol mo dang bcas: hūm̐: chos rnams rgyu med rang byung nyid: nges don ye shes snying po can: drang don bshad pa'i kha las 'das: ma 'gags gter chen 'od zer gyis: sku gsum lhun grub yi ger shar: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dharma shud+dhe satwaṃ swā hā: gnyis pa: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis sbyangs: hūm̐: rang nyid dbang chen thugs ka nas: byin rlabs yi ge 'bru gsum 'phros: dmigs pa'i dkyil 'khor rdzas la phog: ye shes lnga yi bdud rtsi bkug: thim pas 'dod yon lnga ldan gyur: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza sarba dzñā na puñtsa hūm̐: gsum pa: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings ka dag rab 'byams klong : bde chen lhun grub rang byung pho brang nas: bla ma chos sku rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs rnams: 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul drwa ba'i pho brang nas: bla ma longs sku rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: zangs mdog rnga yab dpal ri'i pho brang nas: bla ma sprul sku rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rngam chen me rlung 'khrugs pa'i pho brang nas:

stobs 'dus khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dregs sde las la rngam pa'i pho brang nas: dam can gter srung bka' sdod yongs rdzogs rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: chos sku rgya mtsho gsal stong ta la la: longs sku rgya mtsho 'ja' tshon thibs se thib: sprul sku rgya mtsho byin rlabs spungs se spung : yi dam lha tshogs bag dro me re re: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gar byed shigs se shig: mchod pa'i lha mo glu dbyangs kyu ru ru: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i bro rdung khrigs se khrig: 'dir tshogs skal ldan dga' bro ya la la: tshogs mchod rgya mtsho zad med nyi li li: gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin chen myur du phob: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho a be sha ya a āḥ bzhi pa: hūm̐: sku gsum 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: dbang chen khro rgyal 'bar ba 'khor bcas la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: dgyes shing bzhes la thugs dam bskangs gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sarba ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi: lnga pa: hūm̐: rang byung thugs las dngos 'byor yid sprul pa'i: phyi nang mchod sprin spyan gzigs mthun pa'i rdzas: ma tshang med pa'i rten rdzas sgrub rdzas kyis: khro rgyal stobs 'dus lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag bskang zhing dam tshig sor chud nas: mi sgrib tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐ āḥ drug pa: na mo: rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gsum bden pa'i bka': gsang sngags rig sngags ting 'dzin phyag rgya'i mthus: dkyil 'khor sgrub la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs rnams: sna tshogs sprul pa'i pho nyas liṅgar khug: bskrad gzir 'ching bas rmug cing rengs par gyis: oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha ya byad ma nṛ tri dzaḥ

bdun pa: hūm̐: rab 'jigs khro rgyal thugs las sprul pa'i sras: legs ldan chen po 'jigs byed kī la ya: rang bzhin shugs las myos rdzas sna dgu 'phros: gang la btab kyang thogs med rtsal chen 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i steng du kī la ya: oṃ ma hā kī la ya karma raṃ raṃ ru tra a mu ka bhi ga mā ra ya tshan+dha tshan+dha bhan+dha bhan+dha tsit+ta baṃ ril myog thum ha la ha la hūm̐ phaṭḥ brgyad pa: hūm̐: dbang chen 'bar ba'i lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: dam nyams dgra bgegs ru tra bsgral ba yis: dug gsum rnam dag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: bdud bzhi bar chad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta keṃ ni ri ti i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: dgu pa: ho: gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos: sogs? a la la hoḥ bcu pa: bh+yoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan rol pa'i lhag sdud ma: dbang phyug ging dang laṅka zhing skyong che: gnas nyul ma mo keng rus bye ba 'bum: phyag na bhan+dha'i gzhong thogs lhag sdud ma: tshogs khang 'grim zhing rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul: dam tshig gnyer gtad bka' yi bya ra ma: dam rdzas mchod gtor rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: pha rol bsam sbyor ngan pa'i dgra bo sgrol: bstan pa'i mel tshe phrin las mdzad du gsol: oṃ ma tri ma mo ru lu ru lu dza i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hi: bcu gcig pa: hūm̐ hūm̐: dbang chen khro bo rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: stobs 'dus dbang chen lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: 'jigs pa'i skur ston sa gsum zil gyis gnon: rngam pa'i nga ros drag sngags 'brug ltar ldir: gtum drag shugs kyis snang srid bran du bkol: stobs bcu'i rtsal gyis bgegs dpung sa la bsgyel: mthu chen khro rgyal mngon spyod dus la bab: deng sang snyigs ma lnga brgya dus kyi mtha': bdud bzhi mu stegs nag po'i dpung tshan gyis: gsang sngags bstan pa gnyan la dgra dar bas:

khrag 'thung chen po'i mngon spyod dus la bab: pha rol gdug pa'i g.yul dang byad ma'i tshogs: sna tshogs mtshon cha drag po'i sgyogs chen gyi: char chen phab nas dgra bgegs brlag bcom nas: lhag ma rjes shul tsam yang med par gyis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma rungs cho 'phrul sna dgus dgra yul khong : byad zor phur kha ngan gtad dgra la phob: gdug pa'i dmag tshogs g.yul ngo bzlog tu gsol: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ oṃ h+ya ghṛ wa kro ta kro ti kī la ya baṃ kro ti sarba kro ta kro ti i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: bcu gnyis pa: hūm̐: bdag gis bsgrubs pa'i gtor zor gnyan po 'di: de ring dam nyams dgra bo'i yul la 'phen: mthu ldan chos skyong srung ma dpung la bzhengs: las mkhan shan pa 'bum gyis dmag sna drongs: rbad pa'i lha srung gnyan po mthu ma chung : las byed mtshon gyi zor chen rtsal ma zhan: byad ma lha srung yul zhing mkhar khang rnams: myos bsregs thal bar brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ ya ma kī la ya du pra mo he ta yak+ṣa ghṛ wa zor bh+yo thun bh+yo rbad bh+yo ram̐ bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog: bcu gsum pa: hūm̐: sngon tshe 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: rigs kyi bdag po snang mtha' yab yum gyis: ye shes klong dgu'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dbyings kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tha tshig bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam bca' bzhin du bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: de 'og ma la ri yi rtse mo ru: dbang chen khro rgyal rta phag yab yum gyis: ru tra bsgral zhing dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dbang phyug ging dang laṅka'i tha tshig bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam bca' bzhin du phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de 'og brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas su: rig 'dzin chen po pad 'byung yab yum gyis: dkyil 'khor zhal phyes bka' yi rgya gtad tshe:

dam can rgya mtshos khas blangs tha tshig bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam bca' bzhin du phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de 'og lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: rab 'jigs tsā ri zil chen gsang phug nas: khro rgyal stobs 'dus dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: zhing skyong la sogs srung mas khas blangs bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam bca' bzhin du phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bcu bzhi pa: hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis tshogs: ma mo bzhi dang gnod sbyin sman mo bzhi: yang 'khor sprul pa'i sman phran bye ba 'bum: sna tshogs mdzes pa'i dar tshon pu ru ru: glu len gar byed bshugs sgra ti ri ri: g.yer kha dril bu rol mo si li li: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa'i mel tshe sgrub par mdzod: oṃ ma tri tsa tur ting ting tsa tur yak+ṣa tsa tur ye i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: bco lnga pa: hūm̐: dbang chen rol pa'i dkyil 'khor du: khro rgyal 'dus pa'i bro brdungs pas: phyi nang gdon bgegs 'byung po bcom: las mtha' dmod pa'i dkyil 'khor du: pho nya las mkhan bro brdungs pas: sgab 'dre dam sri thal bar brlag: dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i bro brdungs pas: mtshan ma'i dgra bgegs rang sar grol: sngar yang ye shes chen pos bro: deng 'dir ka dag ngang du rdung : bdag 'dzin ru tra mā ra ya: oṃ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: dgra sri thams cad satwaṃ bha ya nan: bcu drug pa: hūm̐: yang gsang bla med bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: che btsan khro rgyal stobs 'dus 'khor bcas kyis: sku gsum dbyings nas thugs dam rab bskul la: tshe chos zas nor gos dang mchog thun gyi: dngos grub stsol zhing dbang mchog bskur du gsol: oṃ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: bcu bdun pa: hūm̐: chos sku'i bkra shis snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur: gnas lugs rang ngo shes pa'i bkra shis shog:

longs sku'i bkra shis 'chi med tshe dpag med: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung : gsang rgyud smin cing grol ba'i bkra shis shog: yi dam bkra shis khro rgyal stobs 'dus pa: mchog thun dngos grub 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog: mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis ma gcig rnal 'byor ma: brgyud 'dzin phyogs bcur khyab pa'i bkra shis shog: bstan srung bkra shis zhing skyong seṅge'i gdong : gzi brjid mthu rtsal mngon pa'i bkra shis shog: nyin yang bkra shis mtshan yang bkra shis shog: dus drug rtag tu bkra shis 'byung gyur nas: mchog gsum thugs rjes byin rlabs brtan gyur cig: oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: bco brgyad pa: hūm̐: rang byung chos dbyings ka dag rol rtsal gyi: ngang las shar ba ye shes dkyil 'khor lha: srung 'khor gzhal yas 'khor bcas gtso la bsdu: yum yab hūm̐ thim hūm̐ yig stong pa'i dbyings: skye med gnas lugs rig pa āḥl bzhag: a a āḥ bcu dgu pa: hūm̐: hoḥ deng 'dir bdag gis bla med dkyil 'khor gyi: bsnyen sgrub bzlas brjod dge rtsa zang zing dang : nges don ting 'dzin snying po lhur blangs mthus: pha ma rigs drug mtha' yas sems can rnams: kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog: nyi shu pa: hoḥ lhun grub mthar phyin 'bras bu bde dge'i dpal: legs par spyod cing tshe rabs thams cad du: bla med sngags kyi rnal 'byor mchog reg cing : 'gro kun byang chub lam la 'god mdzad de: ma 'ongs 'di nas rnga yab dpal ri ru: rig 'dzin pad+ma'i go 'phang thob gyur cig: ces bsngo smon gyi rgyas gdab cing dmigs med rang byung gdod ma'i gshis la bzhag: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs sems can don slad du: yang gsang bla med khro rgyal stobs 'dus kyi: bsgrub pa'i las rim cha tshang don dril bzhag:

snyigs dus tshe 'phrang sgrol ba'i zab gnad 'di: kun gyi yang snying sa bon gter gcig ma: ma 'ongs 'di la 'brel tshad don dang ldan: de phyir 'bad brtson sgrub pa snying la gcags: lnga brgya tha ma nyi shu'i mgo tshugs tshe: bod khams thams cad dug mtsho'i klong ltar khol: mtshon gyi char pa zla ba bco brgyad 'bab: sa yi me btsa' nyams te dus rtags 'char: zab chos 'di yi 'gro don dus la bab: 'di nyid 'byin pa nga yi sprul pa mchog: pad+ma gter bdag gling zhes grags pa 'byung : de dus zab chos 'di dang 'phrad par shog: bka' yi rgya 'di zhing skyong mgon pos srungs: las ngan bdud rigs lag tu ma shor rgya: zil chen gsang ba'i phug tu a thaṃ rgya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: mi nub rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas me sprel lor: lho gnas mchog tsā ri ṭa zil chen gsang phug nas gdan drangs shing*/ sbas yul gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser zheng la mtho gang sor do dkyus la sor bzhi pa 'dug pa zhig nas zhal bshus so// // zha) ༈ khro rgyal stobs 'dus kyi bdud rtsi lag mchod dngos grub kun 'byung bzhugs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: mchod do 'bul lo phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong gi rtsa bar gyur pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: yi dam rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor dgu yi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos sku snang ba mtha' yas kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: longs sku thugs rje chen po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: gu ru shrī singha'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: mkha' 'gro nyi zla dngos grub zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐:

grub chen nā gardzu na'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: ḍāk+ki tsaṇ+ḍa lī yi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: lha lcam man+da ra ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: bal 'bangs ka la sid+dhi'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: bal mo shākya dhe ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: mon mo bkra shis khye'u 'dren zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: bal po ba su dha ra'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: mu ṭa ā yur dha ra'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: ā yur+dzñā na dhe wa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: dbang chen nā ga klu 'dul zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: drag po lcags gdong nag po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: sprul pa'i phag sdig khyung gsum zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: legs ldan nag po phyag bzhi'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: drang srong gza' mchog rgyal po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnod sbyin btsan rgod chen po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: dkor bdag chos rgyal chen po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: gter bdag klu mo nor skyong zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: gter srung klu yi dge bsnyen zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: dge bsnyen smyon pa lag brgyad zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: klu rgyal mun pa rtag ring zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnyan rgod rgyal ba dug gdong zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: lha gnyen rgyal ba thod dkar zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: gzhan yang bka' gter srung ma'i gnas bdag drag rtsal dang ldan pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: snang srid thams cad dbang chen rta mgrin yab yum gyi skur gsal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: bdud rtsi sku gsum sa bon rnam pa yi: byin rlabs yig 'bru 'od zhu bdag la thim:
bla med mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐:

zhes bdud rtsi myong zhing dngos grub thob par bsam: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdud rtsi lag mchod tshogs mtshams dang las byang gi mchod pa'i mtshams su sman mchod sbyar ba'o// // za) ༈ tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: h+ya ghṛ wa'i hūm̐ sgrub bzhugs so: dbang chen tshe bdag sku la bstod: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: yang dag nges don sgrub pa bstan: spros bcas sgyu mar rig pa'i phyir: kun rdzob tsam du stong gsal lha: ye nas rang shar ci bzhin du: skad cig dran rdzogs wal gyis gsal: 'di nyid sgrub pa'i skal ldan la: 'byung bzhi tshe yi gdon las grol: sde brgyad gdug pa'i cho 'phrul zhi: phrin las don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub: phung po yi dam sku dang mnyam: he ru ka nyid the tshom med: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: de nas dran rdzogs lha bskyed ni: hūm̐: e las rang byung gzhal yas khang : gnam lcags las grub mtshan nyid rdzogs: de dbus chos 'byung baṃ gyi steng : rang nyid pad+ma he ru kaḥ h+ya ghṛ wa dmar nag gtum: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rkan sgra rdeb: sma ra dbu skra me 'od 'khrugs: rta skad hūm̐ sgra phyogs bcur sgrog: spyi bor rigs bdag 'od dpag med: dmar gsal mnyam bzhag skyil krung bzhugs: phyag g.yas rdo rjes bgegs dpung 'joms: g.yon pa'i phur bus tshe bdud sgrol: sgro gshog brgyangs shing dur khrod chas: sku smad gnam lcags phur gsham brjid: rdo rje phag mo yum dang sbyor: 'jigs byed chen po'i sku ru gsal: drag sngags hūm̐ gi 'phro 'du yis: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub: rang byung ye shes lnga ru bsgral: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes spro bsdu mos na spyi dang mthun: 'di nyid spros med sgrub pa ste: dran rig ma bcos stong nyid ngang : hūm̐: zhes ci nus bgrang bar bya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya:

kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas tsā ri zil chen gsang phug nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ maṅga laṃ// // 'a) ༈ tshe sgrub yang snying 'chi bdag zil gnon las: h+ya ghṛ wa khro rgyal stobs 'dus kyi gsang sgrub bzhugs so: yang gsang dbang chen tshogs la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: gsang sgrub khro rgyal stobs 'dus bstan: lha lcam ḍāk+kis yi ger thob: zil chen gsang phug-i atsha rgya: gter bdag gling dang 'phrad par shog: dang po sgrub pa'i rim pa ni: drag po chos 'byung phug pa'am: bkra shis byin chags dge ba'i gnas: dmar smug sa la dal yang bcag: yang na gang rung tshom bu bya: dbus su thod pa mtshan ldan nang : sku 'khor srog yig tshang ba dang : rdo rje phur pa rnams kyang bzhag: phyi nang mchod pa gzhung bzhin bsham: sa ma ya: dang po sku 'khor srog yig bri ba ni: rgya shog gam ni shing shun la: lte ba dmar po chos 'byung du: hūm̐: de'i phyi rol rtsibs bzhi la: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐: oṃ aṇ+ṭa h+ya ghṛ wa ham̐'u: oṃ kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐: oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐: rtsibs mchan la: oṃ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ rak+ṣa: ces bri: mu khyud la: oṃ h+ya ghṛ wa kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ma ma sarba sid+dhi dzaḥ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa bh+rūm̐: de'i phyi rol sku'i 'khor lo bri: sa ma ya: yum gyi lte ba chos 'byung du: bam̐ ces bris: de'i phyi rol rtsibs bzhi la: oṃ badz+ra bha ra hi hūm̐: oṃ pad+ma kro dhi hūm̐: oṃ ḍāk+ki nī dzaḥhūm̐: oṃ baṃ tsaṇ+ḍa li hūm̐: de'i rtsibs mchan la: oṃ ha ri ni sa dzaḥ de'i phyi rol rten 'brel snying pos bskor: phyi la sku 'khor: yab yum la dri bzang sman byug cing bgegs bskrad rab gnas bya: rgyun du sgrub rten mi bya na lus la 'chang : sa ma ya: gzhung ni tshe sgrub nas blang yang chog: de nas gzhal yas bskyed pa ni: stong pa'i ngang las e mthing chos dbyings klong :

ma bcos lhun grub dbang chen pho brang ni: gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid rang bzhin rdzogs: phyi nang zang thal me rlung 'tshub ma 'khyil: sra brtan mi shigs rdo rje brag chen dbus: pad+ma nyi zla baṃ gyi gdan steng du: rdo rje dmar nag lte ba hūm̐ gis mtshan: dran rdzogs gnas gyur pad+ma he ru kaḥ khro rgyal stobs 'dus dmar nag dbang gi sku: zhal gsum phyag drug g.yas dkar g.yon mthing kaḥ dbus dmar rngam la khro zhing rab tu gtum: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa 'khyil zhing gzigs: dbu skra thod phreng spyi bor rta dbu gsum: a mi dhe was rigs bdag cod pan brgyan: g.yas gsum rdo rje dbyug tho ral gri 'dzin: g.yon gsum bhan+dha kha ṭ+wāṃ phur pa bsgril: ral gri'i sgro gshog seng glang zhing chen gos: khrag zhag thal tshom rus pa'i rgyan dang ldan: mi mgo'i phreng ba dug sbrul lhu tshigs dkris: sku smad chu srin khro phur zur gsum rngam: phag mo mthing nag gri thod mgul nas 'khyud: thod skam dbu rgyan phag zhal pheṃ sgra ngur: rus pa'i rgyan ldan zhabs gnyis yab la 'khril: thugs kar hūm̐ dang tha ma sngags kyis bskor: ba spu'i bu gar me yi bya khyung 'phro: tshwa tshwa'i zer 'phro snang srid dbang sdud bsgom: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa kī la ya kro ti bha ra hi hūm̐ bh+yoḥ de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang drag 'bar ba'i lha tshogs spyan drangs: badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod nas: khro rgyal stobs 'dus lha tshogs rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sgrub la dbang bskur byin chen phob: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dzaḥdzaḥ a be sha ya a āḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: pad+ma nyi zla baṃ gdan du: khro rgyal stobs 'dus lha tshogs rnams: dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs nas kyang : sgrub la mchog thun dngos grub stsol:

oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: khro rgyal stobs 'dus yab yum la: gus pas bstod cing phyag kyang 'tshal: che mchog dpal chen rngam mdzad pa: phrin las bzhi ldan 'grub par stsol: oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul pa ni: hūm̐: phyi mchod dbang po'i nyer spyod dang : nang mchod sman raka gtor ma'i tshogs: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med 'di: dbang chen lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: dregs pa pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: srid gsum stobs 'dus pad+ma dbang gi sku: sku mdog dmar po me lce ya la la: dmar ser ral bsigs stong khams shig shig 'gul: rta skad drag po hūm̐ sgra di ri ri: rigs bdag cod pan phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas gtibs: thod skam dbu rgyan khro bcu zil gyis gnon: spyan dgu bgrad pas dregs pa pho mo sngangs: shangs nas rlung g.yo bgegs dpung sa la dgyel: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche gtsigs rgyal bsen 'dul: phyag drug mtshon chas dgra bgegs dum bur gtub: dur khrod chas rdzogs snang srid dbang du sdud: ral gri'i sgro gshog klu gnyan sa bdag 'joms: chu srin rngam zhal byad ma'i snying khrag 'thung : sku smad phur bus bstan pa'i ru tra sgrol: ba spu'i bya khyung dal yams rims nad 'joms: me dpung klong bzhugs ma rungs thul gyis sreg: khro rgyal 'bar ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum mchog rje btsun rnal 'byor ma: sku mdog mthing nag chos dbyings skye ba med: gri thod 'dzin pas nyon mongs rtsad nas gcod: phag zhal pheṃ sgras ma sring dbang du sdud: thod skam cod pan ye shes lnga dang ldan: khro 'dzum dgyes pas bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon:

rus pa'i rgyan chas pha rol phyin drug rdzogs: zhabs gnyis yab 'khril bde stong rgyun chad med: gsang ba'i dbyings phyug rdo rje dpa' mor bstod: hūm̐: dbang chen yab yum thugs dam rgyud bskul la: rang byung snying po sngags kyi spro bsdu rnams: pha rol zil gnon tshar gcod dbang bsdus nas: sgrub la dngos grub char bzhin 'beb tu gsol: yab sngags ni: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ yum sngags ni: oṃ badz+ra baṃ kro ti bha ra hi hūm̐ bh+yoḥ gsang ba gcig sgril ni: oṃ h+ya ghṛ wa kī la ya baṃ kro ti hūm̐ bh+yoḥ yang dril ni: oṃ kro ta kī la ya baṃ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ zhes rtsa sngags rnams 'grub rtags ma byung bar bsgrub: skabs su thun gtor 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: khrag 'thung khro rgyal yab yum dbyings na bzhengs: phyi nang phrin las rnam bzhi'i thugs dam bskul: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dbang bzhi mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra bha ling+ta pū dza ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na la kha kha khā hi: zhes dngos grub len pa la sogs tshe sgrub nas bya: yang na sgrub pa'i dbang blang ba ni: sgrub rten dang bum pa rnams rim bzhin byin rlabs zhus la: hūm̐: dbang chen yab yum ngo bo nyid: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i skal ldan la: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi: dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs stsal du gsol: oṃ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes dbang blangs shing dngos grub rol: bkra shis bsngo smon dang dkyil 'khor rang la bstim: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: khro rgyal dbang chen sgrub thabs bzhag: ma 'ongs skal ldan las can gyi: sgrub cing nyams su len pa yi: phyi nang bar chod dbyings su sgrol: tshe sgrub zhi bas ma thul bas: tshar gcod drag po'i sgrub pa nyid: yang gsang bla med khyad 'phags chos: zil gnon gsang ba'i dbus su sba: yang mtha' nyi shu la nye dus:

gter bdag gling dang 'phrad par shog: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas me sprel lor/ tsā ri zil chen gsang phug gi brag tshe bum 'dra ba'i logs nas gdan drangs shing pad+ma bkod tshal du shog ser nas bsgyur to// // ya) ༈ tshe sgrub yang snying 'chi bdag zil gnon las/ h+ya ghṛ wa khro rgyal stobs 'dus kyi gsang sgrub 'don khrigs bzhugs so/ rang rig bla ma pad+ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ de nas dbang chen h+ya ghṛ wa khro rgyal stobs 'dus kyi gsang sgrub spros med ltar nyams su len pa la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum mo/ dang po la/ thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ e ma hoḥ dran rig mngon gyur yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas: gang shar rol pa'i thugs rje ye shes chos: sna tshogs bdag 'dzin bral ba'i dge 'dun tshogs: ro gcig tha dad 'dzin med skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ na mo: mtha' yas 'gro drug byams shing brtse ba'i ma: snying rje bskyed do srid pa'i rigs drug tshogs: dga' chen khyod bdag bsten pa'i blo gros kyis: thams cad btang snyoms lam la 'god par bya: gsum pa bgegs gtor byin rlob ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa brlabs la/ sarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa dzaḥ sa bkug /na maḥsarbba liṃ d+ye swā hā/ bzhi pa bsngos shing bka' bsgo ba ni/ hūm̐: dbang chen thugs las khro tshogs mtshon char 'phros: dkyil 'khor sgrub la mi dbang glag lta'i rigs: gtor ma khyer la rang rang gnas su dengs: gnod 'tshe brtsam na rdul du brlag par 'gyur: oṃ badz+ra kro ta he ru ka raṃ raṃ kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ lnga pa srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las sprul pa'i gur khang ni: steng 'og phyogs mtshams me ri rdo rje'i klong : dum bu rim dgu sra mkhregs pha lam ltar: nam yang mi shigs badz+ra rak+ṣa bh+rūm̐: drug pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/

ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gling bzhi srid pa'i khyon ltar yangs pa yi: rin chen 'khor yug drwa ba'i klong yangs su: mchod sprin lha mo rang rtags phyag rgya can: gzugs mdzes gar mo lang ling bye ba 'bum: spyan gzigs phyi nang gsang mchod sna tshogs rnams: dkyil 'khor dgyes pa bskyed pa'i rdzas su gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha hūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta āḥhūm̐: de nas dngos gzhi la/ dang po bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ stong pa'i ngang las e mthing chos dbyings klong : ma bcos lhun grub dbang chen pho brang ni: gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid rang bzhin rdzogs: phyi nang zang thal me rlung 'tshub ma 'khyil: sra brtan mi shigs rdo rje brag chen dbus: pad+ma nyi zla baṃ gyi gdan steng du: rdo rje dmar nag lte ba hūm̐ gis mtshan: dran rdzogs gnas gyur pad+ma he ru kaḥ khro rgyal stobs 'dus dmar nag dbang gi sku: zhal gsum phyag drug g.yas dkar g.yon mthing kaḥ dbus dmar rngam la khro zhing rab tu gtum: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa 'khyil zhing gzigs: dbu skra thod phreng spyi bor rta dbu gsum: a mi dhe was rigs bdag cod pan brgyan: g.yas gsum rdo rje dbyug tho ral gri 'dzin: g.yon gsum bhan+dha kha ṭ+wāṃ phur pa bsgril: ral gri'i sgro gshog seng glang zhing chen gos: khrag zhag thal tshom rus pa'i rgyan dang ldan: mi mgo'i phreng ba dug sbrul lhu tshigs dkris: sku smad chu srin khro phur zur gsum rngam: phag mo mthing nag gri thod mgul nas 'khyud: thod skam dbu rgyan phag zhal pheṃ sgra ngur: rus pa'i rgyan ldan zhabs gnyis yab la 'khril: thugs kar hūm̐ dang tha ma sngags kyis bskor: ba spu'i bu gar me yi bya khyung 'phro: tshwa tshwa'i zer 'phro snang srid dbang sdud bsgom: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa kī la ya kro ti bha ra hi hūm̐ bh+yoḥ

de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang drag 'bar ba'i lha tshogs spyan drangs: badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod nas: khro rgyal stobs 'dus lha tshogs rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sgrub la dbang bskur byin chen phob: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dzaḥdzaḥ a be sha ya a āḥ gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: pad+ma nyi zla baṃ gdan du: khro rgyal stobs 'dus lha tshogs rnams: dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs nas kyang : sgrub la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: khro rgyal stobs 'dus yab yum la: gus pas bstod cing phyag kyang 'tshal: che mchog dpal chen rngam mdzad pa: phrin las bzhi ldan 'grub par stsol: oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ lnga pa mchod pa 'bul pa ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod dbang po'i nyer spyod dang : nang mchod sman raka gtor ma'i tshogs: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med 'di: dbang chen lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi:

drug pa bstod pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: dregs pa pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: srid gsum stobs 'dus pad+ma dbang gi sku: sku mdog dmar po me lce ya la la: dmar ser ral bsigs stong khams shig shig 'gul: rta skad drag po hūm̐ sgra di ri ri: rigs bdag cod pan phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas gtibs: thod skam dbu rgyan khro bcu zil gyis gnon: spyan dgu bgrad pas dregs pa pho mo sngangs: shangs nas rlung g.yo bgegs dpung sa la dgyel: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche gtsigs rgyal bsen 'dul: phyag drug mtshon chas dgra bgegs dum bur gtub: dur khrod chas rdzogs snang srid dbang du sdud: ral gri'i sgro gshog klu gnyan sa bdag 'joms: chu srin rngam zhal byad ma'i snying khrag 'thung : sku smad phur bus bstan pa'i ru tra sgrol: ba spu'i bya khyung dal yams rims nad 'joms: me dpung klong bzhugs ma rungs thul gyis sreg: khro rgyal 'bar ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum mchog rje btsun rnal 'byor ma: sku mdog mthing nag chos dbyings skye ba med: gri thod 'dzin pas nyon mongs rtsad nas gcod: phag zhal pheṃ sgras ma sring dbang du sdud: thod skam cod pan ye shes lnga dang ldan: khro 'dzum dgyes pas bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon: rus pa'i rgyan chas pha rol phyin drug rdzogs: zhabs gnyis yab 'khril bde stong rgyun chad med: gsang ba'i dbyings phyug rdo rje dpa' mor bstod: bdun pa dzap bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: dbang chen yab yum thugs dam rgyud bskul la: rang byung snying po sngags kyi spro bsdu rnams: pha rol zil gnon tshar gcod dbang bsdus nas: sgrub la dngos grub char bzhin 'beb tu gsol: brgyad pa bsnyen dmigs ni/ thugs kar pad nyi zla ba'i steng du snang ba mtha' yas/ de'i thugs kar rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ dmar nag gis mtshan pa'i mthar sngags kyis bskor bar

dmigs la/ gsang ba gcig dril ni/ oṃ h+ya ghṛ wa kī la ya baṃ kro ti hūm̐ bh+yoḥ zhes gcig dril sngags 'grub rtags ma byung gi bar bsgrub/ mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying mchod bstod bya/ de nas tshogs bya ba la/ dang po byin gyis rlob pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: tshogs 'khor sbyang phyir yi ge 'phros: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis nyes skyon bsregs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir bsgyur: 'dod yon tshogs kyis snang srid gang : rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ sku gsum 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: dbang chen khro rgyal 'bar ba 'khor bcas rnams: 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: byin chen phob la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa tshogs mchod bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : dbang chen tshe bdag lha tshogs la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: skye med ngang du thugs dam bskang*/ dam tshig 'gal 'khrul tshogs kyis bshags: gu ru dhai wa ḍāk+ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: bzhi pa bsgral bstab ni/ hūm̐: mdun du lcags snod gru gsum nang : dmigs bya'i dgra bgegs myur du khug: gnod byed srog la kī la ya: gtub cing khro rgyal zhal du 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā rak+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na khā hi: lnga pa lhag ma ni/ hūm̐: lhag sdud ging dang laṅka rnams: lhag ma bka' yi pha 'bab bzhes: gsang sngags bstan pa'i srung ma mdzod: dam sri dgra bo cham la phob: uts+tshiṣ+ṭa bha liṃ ta la khā hi: drug pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: chos dbyings ngang nas drag por bzhengs: sngon gyi tha tshig rgyud bskul ba'i: thugs dam ma g.yel phrin las mdzod: bdun pa chad mdo bsgrag pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe zab gsang rdo rje'i dbyings:

mā ra ti ka zil chen phug /so sor sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin/ laṅka ma mo shugs 'gro yis: rang rtags srog phul ci bzhin du: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: 'ja' lus tshe yi sgrub grogs mdzod: oṃ baṃ ḍāk+ki mu khā le ma mo rak+ṣa kro ti bha liṃ ta khā hi: brgyad pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: 'jig rten skyong mdzad brtan ma rnams: rgyan ldan dur khrod gnas nyul ma: gtor ma bzhes la bstan pa srungs: ci bcol phrin las rogs dan mdzod: ma ma ma mo ting ting shag shag le le bha liṃ ta khā hi: dgu pa rta bro brdung ba ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen khrag 'thung he ru kas: dam sri bsgral nas rta bro brdung : chem chem dgra bo'i mgo la brdung : mnan no nam yang ma ldang zhig: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ bh+rūm̐ tsakra ya dgra bo nan nan: bcu pa dbang blang ba ni/ hūm̐: dbang chen yab yum ngo bo nyid: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i skal ldan la: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi: dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs stsal du gsol: oṃ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes dbang blangs shing dngos grub rol/ de nas rjes chog la drug /dang po mchod bstod ni/ om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza ye pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi khā hi: hūm̐: snang srid kun kyang dbang drag dkyil 'khor zhing : snod bcud gzugs rnams rta mchog rol pa'i sku: sgra grags skye med h+ya ghṛ wa'i gdangs: ma 'dres thugs nyid gnas lugs snang mtha' yas: rol pa'i rtsal chen khrag 'thung dgyes pa'i gar: dbang chen tshe bdag lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: gnyis pa bzod gsol ni/ hūm̐: rtsa gsum yongs 'dus dkyil 'khor du: yo byad ma tshang 'bag btsog shor: cho ga lhag chad ting 'dzin g.yel: 'gal 'khrul nongs pa bzod par gsol: tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs: yig brgya bzlas/ brtan bzhugs bya/

gsum pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ hoḥ rang shar rang grol dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: mtha' nas dbus yal sa bon stong pa'i dbyings: dam tshig gnyis med bskyed rdzogs spros bral ngang : dmigs med ka dag rang byung āḥru ldang : a a āḥ zhes ma bcos rang rig rgya yan thal lam shes par skyongs/ bzhi pa bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐: hoḥ deng 'dir bdag gis bla med dkyil 'khor gyi: bsnyen sgrub bzlas brjod dge rtsa zang zing dang : nges don ting 'dzin snying po lhur blangs mthus: pha ma rigs drug mtha' yas sems can rnams: kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog: lnga pa smon lam ni/ hoḥ lhun grub mthar phyin 'bras bu bde dge'i dpal: legs par spyod cing tshe rabs thams cad du: bla med sngags kyi rnal 'byor mchog reg cing : 'gro kun byang chub lam la 'god mdzad de: ma 'ongs 'di nas rnga yab dpal ri ru: rig 'dzin pad+ma'i go 'phang thob gyur cig: ces bsngo smon gang rung gis legs par rgyas gdab bo/ drug pa bkra shis ni/ hoḥ rtsa gsum 'khor lo pad 'byung mkha' 'gros bskor: zung 'jug tshe la rab tu dbang ba yi: 'chi med bdud rtsis rtag tu ngoms byas nas: bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog: ces bkra shis dang bsngo smon gyi mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ de ltar h+ya ghṛ wa'i khro rgyal stobs 'dus kyi gsang sgrub 'di bzhin bsnyen sgrub dang rgyun gyi nyams len la spros pa dang mtshams par byas te/ rang gzhung sor bzhag la kha 'geng dgos pa gzhung dang tshe sgrub lcags rgya sogs rigs mthun gzhan nas mi 'gal bar brgyan te/ tshe dbang rig 'dzin pad+ma'i gnas mchog yang le shod rang gnas su mchog dbyangs rnam 'phrul/ sgo chen rgyal ba'i sprul ming 'dzin pa wa gin+d+ra nā gardzu nar 'bod pas bsgrigs pa'i yi ge'i mthun 'gyur ni 'phan bla bstan 'dzin 'gyur med kyis so// // ra) ༈ tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las:
