h+ya ghṛ wa'i smad las bdud dpung tshar gcod bzhugs so: dbang chen h+ya ghṛ wa'i sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: yang gsang 'chi bdag zil gnon gyi: cha rkyen h+ya ghṛ wa yi: las mtha' bzlog pa'i rim pa bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal brda ltar zungs: ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma la: tshe 'phrang bdud bzhi ldang ba'i tshe: rkyen ngan bzlog pa'i gnyen po che: zor zlog drag po 'di nyid zab: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: dang po lag len rim pa ni: drag po'i snod mchog lcags zangs su: dal bcag ma traṃ chos 'byung brtsegs: 'bru nag zan la dpal gtor ni: che ba gcig la 'khor bcu gsum: rtse mo me ri'i rgyan gyis brgyan: phyi rtsang drug cu rtsa bzhi la: phyag rtsang nyi shu rtsa dgu byas: khrag kyu la sogs lha grangs ltar: dar nag gdugs dang mtshon chas brgyan: rtsang rtse sha dang liṅgas brgyan: zor rdzas sogs ni gzhung bzhin byas: bsgral chas rnams ni spyi mthun ltar: rtag gtor rten gtor thun gtor dang : tshogs dang bskang rdzas la sogs bsags: rol mo sgra bcas tshang bar bya: sa ma ya: dang po bzlog pa'i mdun bskyed bya ba ni: oṃ e ho ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ shud+dhe shud+dha shwa dha na ye swā hā: lan gsum mam bdun bya: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las drag po'i gzhal yas khang : me rlung stobs ldan sbyor ba'i thod mkhar ni: dmar nag rngam 'jigs dur khrod bkod pa tshang : phyi na zhe sdang thog ser bu yug 'tshubs: nang na 'dod chags rak+ta'i rba rlabs phyur: bar na gti mug gdug pa'i mun rub 'khrigs: phyi rol thams cad shan pa rtsang gis bskor: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i mtshon rtse mdung ltar gzengs: gshin rje'i zhags pa bha su ta yis bsdams: rbad pa'i las zor dug rdzas sna dgus spras: dgra sha liṅga rtsang gi rtse la brgyan: dug rlung 'tshub ma bskal pa'i me 'od 'khrugs: de dbus gnam lcags 'khor lo chos 'byung dang :

ti ra smug nag gan rkyal snying kha'i steng : dmar nag rdo rje'i lte ba hūm̐ gis mtshan: dran rdzogs dbang drag pad+ma he ru kaḥ ces sogs bstod pa'i bsnyen pa ma rdzogs bar btang ste bdag mdun bya: sa ma ya: de nas bskang ba bya ba ni: gtor ma dang mchod rdzas bdud rtsis bran la: hūm̐: bde chen dbang drag rol pa'i pho brang nas: rta mchog rgyal po 'jigs byed he ru kaḥ khro rgyal stobs 'dus lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: ti ra baṃ chen bsnol ba'i gdan la bzhugs: brkyang bskum rngam pa'i gar gyis phyag 'tshal bstod: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam skong gyur cig: hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: khro rgyal rta mchog 'bar ba he ru kaḥ sku mdog dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug rngam: sku smad gnam lcags phur bu dbal dang ldan: tshe bdud log 'dren pho mo'i snying khar gzir: gsang ba'i yum mchog phag mo pang du 'khyud: zung 'jug bde stong ye shes ngo bo nyid: sku las bskal pa'i gzi brjid me chen 'bar: khro rgyal rta phag yab yum thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: g.yas su smug nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas: 'jam dpal gshin rje nag po'i thugs dam bskang : g.yon du gru gsum mthing nag dkyil 'khor nas: gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po'i thugs dam bskang : rgyab tu ljang nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas: sprul pa bya khyung 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskang : mdun du smug mthing gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas: dpal 'bar ma hā kā la'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: khro mo lcags gdong nag mo'i thugs dam bskang : nga rgyal ri ltar brtsegs pa'i klong dkyil nas: khro mo khros ma nag mo'i thugs dam bskang : 'dod chags khrag mtsho mer ba'i klong dkyil nas: khro mo gtum chen nag mo'i thugs dam bskang : phrag dog rlung ltar 'tshubs pa'i klong dkyil nas:

khro mo seng gdong nag mo'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: shar phyogs gtum drag 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: khro mo sgo skyong dkar mo'i thugs dam bskang : lho phyogs gad rgyangs sgrog pa'i dur khrod nas: khro mo sgo skyong ser mo'i thugs dam bskang : nub phyogs pad+ma 'khyil ba'i dur khrod nas: khro mo sgo skyong dmar mo'i thugs dam bskang : byang phyogs kī li sgrog pa'i dur khrod nas: khro mo sgo skyong ljang nag thugs dam bskang : phyi nang bar khyams 'khor yug la gnas pa'i: bka' sdod bye ba 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: gzhan yang thugs dam skong ba'i dam rdzas ni: sna tshogs dbang po'i me tog ri ltar spungs: sha chen bsregs pa'i spos dud phyogs bcur khyab: rkang mar zhag gi sgron me nyi ltar gsal: dmar chen khrag gi dri chab mtsho ltar bskyil: dgra bgegs don snying zhal zas ri ltar brjid: sna tshogs sgra snyan rol mo 'brug ltar sgrog: g.yab dar rten dar sna tshogs dbyings la bsgrengs: sgrub rdzas brten rdzas mang po bcal du bkram: g.yang gzhi sna tshogs bla bre mkha' la bres: rgyu rlon lda ldi'i sham bu ba dan 'phyangs: dkar dmar sman mchod rak+ta rba rlabs 'phyur: dmar chen gtor ma dgra bgegs liṅgas brgyan: sku 'bag bla rten srog 'khor spyan gzigs bshams: go khrab mda' mdung gri sogs mtshon cha gzengs: dkyil 'khor mnyes pa'i dam rdzas gnyan po 'dis: dbang chen khro rgyal yab yum thugs dam bskang : 'jam dpal gshin rje yab yum thugs dam bskang : gsang bdag dregs pa yab yum thugs dam bskang : sprul pa khyung chen yab yum thugs dam bskang : dpal chen ma hā kā la'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: rdo rje dbang chen yab yum thugs dam bskang : rat+na dbang chen yab yum thugs dam bskang : pad+ma dbang chen yab yum thugs dam bskang : karma dbang chen yab yum thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: zhi ba zil gnon yab yum thugs dam bskang :

khro bo zil gnon yab yum thugs dam bskang : khro mo zil gnon yab yum thugs dam bskang : khyung chen zil gnon yab yum thugs dam bskang : pho rgyud zil gnon yab yum thugs dam bskang : mo rgyud zil gnon yab yum thugs dam bskang : klu rnams zil gnon yab yum thugs dam bskang : gza' rnams zil gnon yab yum thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: bka' nyan ma mo drug gi thugs dam bskang : dmus long brgyad sbrel rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : pho nya 'dab chags sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : pho nya 'brug chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gdug pa'i rngam khyi brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : sha za ce spyang brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : yang 'khor sprul pa 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: thugs dam gnyan po skong ba'i dam rdzas ni: phyi nang bla med rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang : sgrub pa'i dam rdzas gnyan po yin pa'i phyir: sku 'bag bla 'khor rnams kyis thugs dam bskang : rten pa'i dam rdzas gnyan po yin pa'i phyir: sgrub gtor dpal gtor rten gtor thugs dam bskang : mchod pa'i dam rdzas gnyan po yin pa'i phyir: bdud rtsi sman raka gtor mas thugs dam bskang : 'bod pa'i dam rdzas gnyan po yin pa'i phyir: gri rkang rnga gling rol mos thugs dam bskang : bskul zhing mchod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: tshogs mchod thun gtor rnams kyis thugs dam bskang : rbad pa'i dam rdzas gnyan po yin pa'i phyir: dmar chen gtor zor drag pos thugs dam bskang : g.yab pa'i dam rdzas gnyan po yin pa'i phyir: phyar dar ru mtshon nag pos thugs dam bskang : bsgral ba'i dam rdzas gnyan po yin pa'i phyir: drag po'i mtshon cha sna tshogs thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: bzhugs pa'i dam rdzas gnyan po yin pa'i phyir: pho brang thod mkhar 'bar bas thugs dam bskang : mi 'gyur gnas su sdod pa'i rdzas yin phyir:

nyi zla pad+ma 'bar bas thugs dam bskang : srung ba'i gur khang mi shigs brtan pa'i phyir: me ri smug nag 'bar bas thugs dam bskang : rtag tu dur khrod sha la dgyes pa'i phyir: bam ro lhu dum rnams kyis thugs dam bskang : nyon mongs dug lnga'i rgya mtsho'i skem pa'i phyir: dmar chen zham chu 'khyil bas thugs dam bskang : dur khrod rgyan kun yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir: g.yang gzhi rgyal mtshan rnams kyis thugs dam bskang : brten cing mi 'bral rgyun du 'grog pa'i phyir: phyi nang mchod sprin tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: bskang du med de skye med ngang la bskang : mchod du med de gnyis med rol par mchod: sbyor du med de zung 'jug ngang la sbyor: bsgral du med de ye shes chen por sgrol: ye sbyor ye sgrol chen po'i thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag dag gyur nas: bar chad sel zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol:

de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: dbang chen dkyil 'khor gsan cing dgongs su gsol: bdag cag bag med dam 'gal dbang gyur nas: bskyed rdzogs ma gsal sngags bzlas nyams pa dang : dus kyi skong bshags mchod rdzas chag pa dang : rgyu chung phud nyams lhag ma phri ba dang : dam 'gal le lo bag med ci mchis pa: mthol lo bshags so mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: ces yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang : phyi nang rkyen ngan bar chad sogs: nyams chag thams cad bskang ba yi: gdams pa zab khyad e ma hoḥ sa ma ya: de nas thugs dam bskul zhing gtor ma 'bul: sha dum dang ni liṅga bcas te: hūm̐: mi mngon pho brang lhun grub rang byung dbyings: dbang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas: dpal chen h+ya ghṛ wa skur bzhengs shig: sku mdog dmar nag khros pas snang srid sngangs: phyag drug mtshon gyi sgyogs chen dgra la 'phen: gdug pa'i g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i las la chos: sprul pa btsan gyi dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: sku mdog dmar po me zer ya la la: zangs khrab rmog zhu ru mtshon lhabs se lhab: ral gri ru mtshon thog mda' sha ra ra: zangs rta dmar po 'dur lding chems se chem: yang sprul zangs kyi 'phar ba stong phrag 'gyed: dam nyams dgra bo'i bla 'gugs nyi li li: gsang mchog khro rgyal lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra bo shor ra re: byad zor phur kha bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badz+ra h+ya ghṛ wa kī la ya bha ling+ta khā hi: shu la raṃ tri dgra bo a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ hūm̐: g.yas su smug nag gru gsum dur khrod nas: khro rgyal 'jam dpal nag po skur bzhengs shig: sku mdog kham nag sgeg pas sa gsum g.yo: phyag drug mtshon gyi sgyogs chen dgra la 'phen: gdug pa'i g.yul ngo gzhom phyir las la chos: sprul pa gshin rje'i dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: sku mdog dmar nag mun pa thibs se thib:

lcags khrab rmog zhu ru dar lhabs se lhab: ral gri ru mtshon thog mda' sha ra ra: lcags rta nag po 'dur lding chems se chem: yang sprul lcags kyi spyang mo stong phrag 'gyed: dam nyams dgra bo'i bla 'gugs nyi li li: sku mchog khro rgyal lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs shor ra re: rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ mañdzu shrī kī la ya bha ling+ta khā hi: ya ma raṃ tri dgra bo a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ hūm̐: g.yon du mthing nag gru gsum dur khrod nas: gsang bdag khro rgyal chen po skur bzhengs shig: sku mdog mthing nag gtum pas srid gsum sngangs: phyag drug mtshon gyi sgyogs chen dgra la 'phen: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs gzhom phyir las la chos: yang sprul bdud kyi dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: sku mdog sngo nag nad sprin phyu ru ru: gnam lcags khrab rmog ru dar lhabs se lhab: ral gri ru mtshon thog mda' sha ra ra: gnam lcags rta pho'i 'dur lding chems se chem: yang sprul gnam lcags dom nag stong phrag 'gyed: dam nyams dgra bo'i bla 'gugs nyi li li: thugs mchog khro rgyal lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs shor ra re: ngag mnan gtad khram bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi kī la ya bha ling+ta khā hi: du pra ma raṃ tri dgra bo'i a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ hūm̐: rgyab tu ljang nag gru gsum dur khrod nas: khro rgyal sprul pa'i bya khyung skur bzhengs shig: sku mdog ljang mthing krang kring sgra sgrog pa: phyag drug mtshon gyi sgyogs chen dgra la 'phen: gdug pa'i g.yul ngo gzhom phyir las la chos: sprul pa gnod sbyin dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: sku mdog ljang nag glog zhags khyugs se khyug: mthing khrab rmog zhu ru dar lhabs se lhab: ral gri ru mtshon thog mda' sha ra ra:

mthing rta ljang sngon 'dur lding chems se chem: sprul pa mthing gi rngam khyi stong phrag 'gyed: dam nyams dgra bo'i bla 'gugs nyi li li: yon tan khro rgyal lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs shor ra re: mi rung ltas ngan bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ khrom̐ raṃ kī la ya bha ling+ta khā hi: yak+sha raṃ tri dgra bo a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ hūm̐: mdun du sngo nag gru gsum dur khrod nas: khro rgyal ma hā kā la skur bzhengs shig: sku mdog sngo nag gshe bas dgra bgegs 'joms: phyag drug mtshon cha'i sgyogs chen dgra la 'phen: gdug pa'i g.yul ngo gzhom phyir las la chos: yang sprul rgyal chen dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: sku mdog dkar nag na bun thu lu lu: bswe khrab rmog zhu ru dar lhabs se lhab: ral gri ru mtshon thog mda' sha ra ra: bswe rta dmar po 'dur lding chems se chem: yang sprul bswe yi gzig chen stong phrag 'gyed: dam nyams dgra bo'i bla 'gugs sha ra ra: phrin las khro rgyal lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs shor ra re: dam sri 'dre rgod bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la kī la ya bha ling+ta khā hi: she la raṃ tri dgra bo a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ hūm̐: gsang chen lhun grub gru gsum dur khrod nas: yum chen khro mo rigs bzhi skur bzhengs shig: sku mdog ma nges khros pas bdud dpung 'joms: phyag drug mtshon cha'i sgyogs chen dgra la 'phen: gdug pa'i g.yul ngo gzhom phyir las la chos: sprul pa ma mo'i dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: sku mdog ser nag 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: gser khrab rmog zhu ru dar lhabs se lhab: ral gri ru mtshon thog mda' sha ra ra: gser rta ser po 'dur lding chems se chem: yang sprul gser gyi rgya stag stong phrag 'gyed: dam nyams dgra bo'i bla 'gugs nyi li li:

yum chen khro mo rigs bzhi 'khor bcas kyis: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs shor ra re: 'byung 'khrugs tshe bdud bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ kro ta tsa tur bha ling+ta khā hi: ma tri raṃ tri dgra bo a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ hūm̐: shar phyogs rab 'jigs gru gsum dur khrod nas: sgo skyong khro mo lcags kyu skur bzhengs shig: sku mdog dkar po dgyes pas bgegs srin 'dul: phyag gnyis mtshon cha'i sgyogs chen dgra la 'phen: gdug pa'i g.yul ngo gzhom phyir las la chos: sprul pa lha yi dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: sku mdog dkar nag ser ba chi li li: dung khrab rmog zhu ru dar lhabs se lhab: ral gri ru mtshon thog mda' sha ra ra: dung rta dkar po 'dur lding chems se chem: yang sprul dung seng dkar po stong phrag 'gyed: dam nyams dgra bo'i bla 'gugs nyi li li: shar phyogs sgo skyong khro mo 'khor bcas kyis: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs shor ra re: rmi ltas mtshan ngan bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha kī la ya bha ling+ta khā hi: a dhe wa raṃ tri dgra bo a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ hūm̐: lho phyogs gad rgyangs gru gsum dur khrod nas: sgo skyong ser mo zhags pa skur bzhengs shig: sku mdog ser po bzhad pas log 'dren 'joms: phyag gnyis mtshon cha'i sgyogs chen dgra la 'phen: gdug pa'i g.yul ngo gzhom phyir las la chos: sprul pa dam can dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: sku mdog ser nag rlung dmar 'u ru ru: mchong khrab rmog zhu ru dar lhabs se lhab: ral gri ru mtshon thog mda' sha ra ra: mchong rta smug po 'dur lding chems se chem: yang sprul mchong gi dred mong stong phrag 'gyed: dam nyams dgra bo'i bla 'gugs nyi li li: lho phyogs sgo skyong khro mo 'khor bcas kyis: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la:

gdug pa'i dam sri dgra bgegs shor ra re: mi kha gleng gzhi bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ rat+na pā sha kī la ya bha ling+ta khā hi: oṃ sa dhu raṃ tri dgra bo a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ hūm̐: nub phyogs gtum drag gru gsum dur khrod nas: sgo skyong khro mo lcags sgrog skur bzhengs shig: sku mdog dmar mo 'jigs pas dug lnga 'joms: phyag gnyis mtshon cha'i sgyogs chen dgra la 'phen: gdug pa'i g.yul ngo gzhom phyir las la chos: sprul pa klu yi dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: sku mdog sngo nag dug zer wa la la: g.yu khrab rmog zhu ru dar lhabs se lhab: ral gri ru mtshon thog mda' sha ra ra: g.yu rta sngon po 'dur lding chems se chem: yang sprul g.yu yi lce spyang stong phrag 'gyed: dam nyams dgra bgegs bla 'gugs nyi li li: nub phyogs sgo skyong khro mo 'khor bcas kyis: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs shor ra re: rmi ltas mtshan ngan bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ pad+ma pho ṭa baṃ kī la ya bha ling+ta khā hi: oṃ nā ga raṃ tri dgra bo a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ hūm̐: byang phyogs rab rgyu gru gsum dur khrod nas: sgo skyong khro mo dril bu skur bzhengs shig: sku mdog ljang mo brjid pas yams nad 'joms: phyag gnyis mtshon cha'i sgyogs chen dgra la 'phen: gdug pa'i g.yul ngo gzhom phyir las la bzhengs: sprul pa gza' yi dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: sku mdog smug nag thog 'bebs si li li: rdo rje khrab rmog ru dar lhabs se lhab: ral gri ru mtshon thog mda' sha ra ra: rdzu 'phrul rlung rta 'dur lding chems se chems: yang sprul gza' yi skyes bu mi rgod 'gyed: dam nyams dgra bo'i bla 'gugs nyi li li: byang phyogs sgo skyong khro mo 'khor bcas kyis: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs shor ra re: log 'dren 'byung po bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod:

oṃ karma ghaṇ+ḍe kī la ya bha ling+ta khā hi: ki kang raṃ tri dgra bo a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ hūm̐: dbang chen khro rgyal 'bar ba'i lha tshogs rnams: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje'i skur bzhengs la: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: pha rol byad zor phur kha bzlog bsgyur nas: bstan dang bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs rnams: lo zla zhag dus za mar ma bzhag par: dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad 'khor bcas kyis: myur du sgrol zhing sha khrag don snying bzhes: rnam shes 'od gsal chos sku'i mkha' la stims: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ mañdzu shrī h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra pā ṇi khroṃ raṃ gha ru ṭa ma hā kā la baṃ kro ti tsa tur kī la ya dzaḥhū?m̐ baṃ hoḥ dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog: ces khro tshogs 'bum gyi 'jigs pa'i dmag dpung bskyed nas byad ma bsgral zhing pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad bzlog par bsam: de nas dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i rim pa ni: lcags hoṃ du liṅga bzhag cing bsgral ba'i chas kyis bskor: rnal 'byor pa zhwa gos nag po dmod pa'i chas su zhugs phyar dar dang ru mtshon gzugs: gu gul dang sha chen gyi dud pa btang : las kyi ging dkar nag pho nya dang bcas mdun gyi nam mkhar gser skyems sbreng zhing 'di skad do: hūm̐: mi mngon dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: khyad par dbang chen khro rgyal stobs 'dus kyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gnyan po dgongs su gsol: bdag ni tshul bzhin spyod pa'i rnal 'byor la: thar pa sgrub cing 'gro don sems lags kyang : log 'dren 'byung pos byed du ma ster bas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rig 'dzin grub thob gzu dang dpang po mdzod: ma gnong mkhyen gsol dgra la bka' chad phob: bstan pa'i srog shing gsang sngags bla med la: mu stegs dmag tshogs rnams kyis 'gras btsugs te:

zab chos gnyan gyi bstan pa snub lags pas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: yi dam lha tshogs gzu dang dpang po mdzod: ma gnong mkhyen gsol dgra la bka' chad phob: 'dzam gling mchod sdong sku gsung thugs kyi rten: dam log bdud kyi sprul pas 'gras btsal nas: dben ri gtsug lag gnyan po bcom lags pas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: mkha' 'gro chos skyong gzu dang dpang po mdzod: ma gnong mkhyen gsol dgra la bka' chad phob: rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rig 'dzin bdag cag la: pha rol dgra bgegs rnams kyis brnyas btsugs te: tshe la bar chad 'phrog rtsom glags shom pas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dam can gter srung gzu dang dpang po mdzod: ma gnong mkhyen gsol dgra la bka' chad phob: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor zab mo 'dir: 'dre rgod sna tshogs bdud kyis glags bltas pas: ci bzhin lam du 'gro bar ma ster bas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: las mkhan pho nyas gzu dang dpang po mdzod: ma gnong mkhyen gsol dgra bgegs khug la shog: sdang zhing gdug pa'i byad ma dgra bo 'di: yi dam lha yis mgon skyabs ma mdzad par: bka' yi chad pa le lan drag po phob: deng 'dir 'gugs nas bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ sarba pañtsa pū dza khā hi: de nas khro rgyal stobs kyi phur bu thogs nas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang bcas te: rang nyid ting 'dzin khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis: hūm̐: bdag nyid khro rgyal stobs 'dus he ru kaḥ srid pa kun tu che btsan 'gran zla bral: sku mdog dmar nag stong khams me 'od 'khrugs: zhal gsum khro bas ye shes 'jig rten bsngangs: spyan dgu bgrad pas sa gsum 'dar zhing khol: phyag drug 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrugs: dur khrod chas bcu'i bgegs dpung sa la bsgyel: mi bzad sgro gshog 'bar bas bdud dpung 'joms:

zhabs bzhi gyad kyis gling bzhi dor thabs brdzis: phyag gi mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu bsgril: gnam lcags thog dang ser ba char du 'bebs: byad ma dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i rang bzhin gsal: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa baṃ bha ra hi: badz+ra kī li kī la ya a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sarba bigh+nān hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces sngags nyer gcig gam bdun phrag tsam bzlas shing : dregs pa sde brgyad thams cad dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las su chas par bsam: phaṭḥ mdun du e kaṃ dmar nag las grub pa'i: lcags bsregs kyi khang sgrom nag la 'thug pa: dmar lhang nge ba reg pa tsam gyis thul du sreg pa: gshin rje'i pho brang bdud kyi bsad khang : las mkhan gyi btson ra: srog gcod 'bum gyi brub khung : shan pa 'bum gyi btson khang : zin nas thar pa med pa'i dbus su: nṛ dang tri dmar skya yongs su gyur pa las: yid la dmigs pa'i dgra bo byad ma lus sngo zhing ham pa: nyam thag pa'i gzugs can mgon skyabs kyi lha dang bral ba: bu ga dgu nas khrag 'dzag cing shi skad tse re ba: ngu 'bod cho nge 'debs pa: yan lag lcags sgrog tu bcug ste: las mkhan pho nya rnams kyis bzung nas bros dbang med pa zhig tu gyur: dgra bo a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ de nas bden stobs brjod pa ni: na moḥ drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : khyad par dbang chen khro rgyal stobs 'dus lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang : bka' srung dregs pa gter bdag las kyi pho nya bye ba 'bum gyi bden pa dang : chos nyid de bzhin nyid dang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa rnams kyi bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra:

rnal 'byor pa bdag gi sgos dgra: nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas: gzugs can sdang bar byed pa'i dgra: gzugs med gnod par byed pa'i bgegs: bar du gcod par byed pa'i rkyen: khyad par ban bon sngags pa'i mthu zor: byad kha khram kha rtsis rgyan sho kha 'debs pa'i sde brgyad 'byung po snga dgra yid la 'chang ba: phyi dgra yid la sems pa: da dgra thad du langs pa: phyi yi zhing khang la gnod pa: sgo yi phyugs la gnod pa: khyim gyi mi la gnod pa: 'gro lam du rtsang 'dzugs pa: zas lam du dug sbyor ba: 'phrang lam du rgyug ra byas pa: mi kha gleng gzhi gtong ba: bsam ngan dang sbyor rtsub 'chang ba: sngon nas bskyod dgos zer ba: mdun nas sgug dgos zer ba: rgyab nas 'ded dgos zer ba: 'phrog dgos bcom dgos zer ba: kha 'o ma las 'jam zhing : snying tsher ma las rtsub pa: bslab pa'i slob bu dam log: rus kyi nang tshan rgyab log: bcos pa'i nad pa sos log: gtam pa'i shag rogs mna' gzan: 'grul ba'i mdza' rogs snying ngan: skyabs pa'i yon bdag gzhungs ngan: gsos pa'i le'u lha log: nyos pa'i chung ma snying ring : bsten pa'i mgo dpon khrel med: ngo log rgyab ston byed pa: mi min mi ru brdzu ba: lha min lha ru brdzu ba: mi nga la lha med zer ba: lha khyed la mthu med zer ba: tshad btsugs pa ya bo bzung ba: 'gras 'tshol zhing sdang sems 'chang ba: khyad par nad bdag yams bdag gre bo rgyal bsen the'u rang : 'gong po god sri dbul sri rkyen chag glo bur langs pa: che sri chung sri dar sri rgan sriḥ gzhon sri lam 'dre: lo skag zla skag zhag skag: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad: mi rung than ltas sna dgu: cho 'phrul rmi lam ngan pa: mi mthun dgra gshed phung gyod la sogs pa: mdor na bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa gang yin pa thams cad: dgra gzugs ming rus liṅga 'di la khug cig: oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha ya dgra bo dza dzaḥ
oṃ rat+na pā sha hūm̐ dgra bo ching ching : oṃ pad+ma s+pho ṭa baṃ dgra bo nan nan: oṃ karma ghaṇ+ḍe ho dgra bo myos myos: bhan+dha bhan+dha ya dgra bo gtub gtub: mā ra ya dgra bo myos myos:

zhes lan gsum gyis 'gugs shing bstim: de nas myur mgyogs 'gugs pa'i pho nya 'gyed pa ni: hūm̐: dbang chen thugs las sprul pa'i sras: shar nas 'gugs pa'i pho nya mo: dung gi seṅge mgo dgu la: lcags kyi bud med dkar mos zhon: lag na lcags kyu phur bu thogs: 'khor du mon pa 'bum gyis bskor: yang sprul lcags kyi spyang mo 'gyed: do nub nam gyi gung thun la: dam nyams dgra bo gnyid log gi: bla srog rnam shes khug la shog: rten phur phud la 'ju thag chod: bla snying phrol la srog rtsa chod: rngon pas ri dwags ded pa bzhin: rang dbang med par khug la shog: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha ya dzaḥ dgra bgegs nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ hūm̐: dbang chen thugs las sprul pa'i sras: lho nas 'gugs pa'i pho nya mo: mtshal gyi rgya stag mgo dgu la: bswe yi bud med ser mos zhon: phyag na zhags pa phur bu thogs: 'khor du shan pa 'bum gyis bskor: yang sprul zangs kyi spre'u 'gyed: do nub nam gyis gung thun la: dam nyams dgra bo gnyid log gi: bla tshe 'khyams po khrid la shog: rten phur 'ju thag chod la shog: bla snying phrol la srog rtsa chod: byi'u chung khra yis khyer ba bzhin: rang dbang med par khug la shog: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: oṃ badz+ra rat+na pā sha hūm̐: dgra bo nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ hūm̐: dbang chen thugs las sprul pa'i sras: nub nas 'gugs pa'i pho nya mo: mchong gi dom nag mgo dgu ma: zangs kyi bud med dmar mos zhon: lag na lcags sgrog phur bu thogs: 'khor du las mkhan 'bum gyis bskor: yang sprul dug gi phag rgod 'gyed: do nub nam gyi gung thun la: dam nyams dgra bo gnyid log gi: bla tshe 'khyams po khrid la shog: rten phur 'ju thag chod la shog: bla snying phrol la srog rtsa chod: rwa lug gcan gyis ded pa bzhin: rang dbang med par khug la shog: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: oṃ pad+ma s+pho ṭa baṃ dgra bo nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ

hūm̐: dbang chen thugs las sprul pa'i sras: byang nas 'gugs pa'i pho nya mo: g.yu yi spyang mo mgo dgu la: mthing gi bud med sngon mos zhon: lag na dril bu phur pa thogs: 'khor du srin mo 'bum gyis bskor: yang sprul mun pa'i dred mong 'gyed: do nub nam gyi gung thun la: dam nyams dgra bo gnyid log gi: bla srog rnam shes khug la shog: rten phur 'ju thag chod la shog: bla snying phrol la srog rtsa chod: nya mo sram gyis ded pa bzhin: rang dbang med par khug la shog: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ dgra bgegs nṛ+-i tri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ de nas dgra bo lha dang dbye ba ni: bya rog 'ug sgro thogs nas: hūm̐: khā kha mu kha nag mo bya rog gdong : g.yas g.yon lag na spu gri dug rdzas thogs: gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di: lha dang phyes la byad du bcug par gyis: dgra bo'i pha lha spyi bo'i gtsug nas phyes: dgra bo'i ma lha gsang ba'i gnas nas phyes: dgra bo'i zhang lha lte ba'i gnas nas phyes: dgra bo'i pho lha phrag pa g.yas nas phyes: dgra bo'i yul lha phrag pa g.yon nas phyes: dgra bo'i dgra lha rten mkhar dbus nas phyes: dgra bo'i srog lha snying gi dkyil nas phyes: dgra bo'i ban bon lha srung rgyab nas phyes: dgra bo'i gnyen dang pha tshan nang sde bcas: dgra bo'i mthun gsum gang nye gri ru phob: dgra bo'i rigs rgyud bla rten me ru sregs: dgra bo skyob byed lha rnams thams cad phyes: dgra bo lha med nyam thag dus la bab: 'joms byed khā kha mu kha mthu ma chung : oṃ ha la ha la dgra bo shag phyes: tshin+dha tshin+dha dgra bo shag phyes: bhan+dha bhan+dha dgra bo shag phyes: mā ra mā ra dgra bo shag phyes: myog thum gzer nan dgra bo shag phyes: de nas thun nyung ngu dang bcas nas: hūm̐: hu lu mu kha ser nag 'ug pa'i gdong : g.yas g.yon lag na spu gri dug rdzas thogs: gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs las ngan 'di:

smon lam log pa sngon gyi bdud dang sprod: lhan cig skyes pa phung po'i bdud dang sprod: dug lnga bag chags 'byung bzhi'i bdud dang sprod: las ngan nyon mongs rnam smin bdud dang sprod: dus la bab bo 'chi bdag bdud dang sprod: sdang dgra 'byung po yul gyi bdud dang sprod: bag chags ngan pa rigs drug bdud dang sprod: shin tu thar med ngan song bdud dang sprod: re dogs gnyis 'dzin ru tra'i bdud dang sprod: shag kha phung 'debs gyod zor bdud dang sprod: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan sdig can 'di: bdud dang sprod nas rmug cing ring bar gyis: bsad cing bcad nas mnan zhing bcom par gyis: sgrol byed hu lu mu kha'i dus la bab: oṃ hu lu mu kha ya dgra bo waka thaṃ satwaṃ bha ya nan: mā ra ya gzer thum myog dril rbad ya nan nan: de nas khro rgyal phur pas bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: dbang chen thugs las sprul pa'i sras: las mdzad badz+ra kī la ya: che chung tshad ni ri rab tsam: mgo bo rgya mdud gzhal yas khang : drag sngags 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: 'chang bzung log brgyad pho nya'i mkhar: myur mgyogs glog zhags khyugs se khyug: chu srin shan pa 'tshogs pa'i gling : srog gcod gri thogs hrengs se hreng : zur gsum bsgril 'debs bsnun pa'i rdzas: dgra bgegs rnam shes rten dang phrol: hūm̐: bstab bo badz+ra kī la ya: dgra bgegs dam sri sdig can gyi: yan lag lnga la kī la ya: rnam shes brgyad la kī la ya: dbang po drug la kī la ya: phung po lnga la kī la ya: don snying lnga la kī la ya: skye mched drug la kī la ya: tshogs drug sgo dgur kī la ya: srog rten 'byung lngar kī la ya: dwangs ma gnyis la kī la ya: rtsa rgyus khams la kī la ya: 'byung 'jug rlung la kī la ya: gnas 'gyu sems la kī la ya: steng gi pho la kī la ya: 'og gi mo la kī la ya: mchan gyi bu la kī la ya: yul mkhar khyim la kī la ya: longs spyod phyug la kī la ya:

dkar nag srog gi dwangs ma de: rlung sems 'od kyi gong bu can: 'gyu 'ong 'bar mched ldan pa de: rang dbang med par kī la ya: bsgral zhing ming yang med par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs kyi srog la rbad rbad: snying la rbad rbad: sha la rbad rbad: rus la rbad rbad: bla tshe rnam shes la rbad rbad: byad ma nṛ trig nan: e hur thum rbad ya: de nas rnam shes spar ba ni: hoḥ khyod kyi rnam par shes pa de yi ge āḥdakar po gcig tu gyur nas phur pa'i khong seng nas don te thog ma'i mgon po snang ba mtha' yas kyi thugs kar 'phos shig: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces rnam shes mi dmigs par mkha' la bstim: de nas thun brdeg pa ni: hūm̐: nyungs dkar rgyal po shwa ri raṃ: lha rnams yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku: mtshon cha bu yug si li li: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: hū'um̐: rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrugs: ma mo yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku: nad yams dal kha chi li li: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: hūm̐?: dug thun nag po phyu ru ru: bdud rnams yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku: shwa kha nag po tha ra ra: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: hūm̐: rdo thun rbab rgod sha ra ra: shel ging yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku: smyo 'bog snying gzer thibs se thib: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: hūm̐: me thun tshwa tshwa tho ro ro: btsan rnams yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku: gzer mda' nag po wa la la: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: hūm̐: mtshon thun bu yug tshubs se tshub: gshin rje yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku: khram kha nag po yugs se yug: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: hūm̐: mtshe thun skar ltar sha ra ra: klu rnams yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku: mdze nad me ltar wa la la: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: hūm̐: zangs thun glog dmar chi li li: gnod sbyin yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku:

drag sngags ser ba hri li li: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: hūm̐: lcags thun myur mgyogs si li li: dam can yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku: zi ra bu yug chi li li: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: hūm̐: phur thun drag po thog ltar 'gyu: gza' rgod yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku: gting grib sna tshogs char ltar phab: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ raṃ ha la bhan+dha mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog nan tri sham long rbad rbad dun mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs 'byung po shig shig: de nas ral gri dang phur bu thogs te gtub pa ni: hūm̐: nga ni dbang chen he ru kaḥ phyag na ral gri phur bu bsnams: ral gris gtub la phur bus thob: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa kī la ya dgra bgegs mā ra ya rbad: dgra satwa dang lcags kyu thogs la: hūm̐: nga ni 'jam dpal nag po'i sku: phyag na dgra satwa lcags kyu bsnams: dgra satwas gtub la lcags kyus zungs: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ mañdzu shrī kī la ya dgra bgegs mā ra ya rbad: gri gug dang kha ṭ+wāṃ thogs la: hūm̐: nga ni gsang bdag gtum po'i sku: phyag na gri gug kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams: gri gug gtub la kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnun: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi kī la ya dgra bgegs mā ra ya rbad: rdo rje dang sbrul zhags thogs la: hūm̐: nga ni bya khyung nag po'i sku: phyag na rdo rje sbrul zhags 'dzin: rdo rjes brdung zhing zhags pas chings: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ khroṃ raṃ gha ru ṭa kī la ya dgra bgegs mā ra ya rbad: thog mda' dang me dpung thogs la: hūm̐: nga ni ye shes mgon po'i sku: phyag na tho ba me dpung bsnams: tho bas brdung zhing me yis sreg: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ ma hā kā la siṃ ha kī la ya dgra bgegs mā ra ya rbad: rdo rje dang gtun khung thogs nas:

hūm̐: nga ni khro mo rigs bzhi'i sku: phyag na rdo rje gtun khung bsnams: rdo rjes brdung zhing gtun khung skyil: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ badz+ra kro ti tsa tur kī la ya dgra bgegs mā ra ya rbad: ces gtub cing hoṃ gzar gyi nang du spungs te bdud rtsis bran: bzlog pa'i nang du gtor 'bul rnams bstab: hūm̐: dbang chen yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: gnam sa'i zhal gdangs gangs ri'i mche ba gtsigs: glog dmar ljags brkyangs bde chen mgrin par drongs: ldog med chos dbyings sprul pa'i 'khor lor skyil: dgra bgegs ka dag ye sangs rgyas par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta kha kha khā hi: zhes bdud rtsis bran zhing slar yang mchod pa sogs gsar pa bshams: rkang gling rol mo rgyas par bya zhing : khro tshogs rnams go gyon mtshon thogs te zhal phyir la bstan nas bzlog pa'i las byed par bsam: hūm̐: dbang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas: che btsan khrag 'thung pad+ma he ru kaḥ rab 'jigs dregs chen bsnol ba'i gdan la bzhengs: sku yi stobs kyis sa bcu zil gyis gnon: gsung gi drag sngags hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar ldir: thugs rje'i dgongs pas ye shes dbyings la khyab: yon tan dpa' bar 'gro ba'i chas kyis brgyan: phrin las rdzu 'phrul gar dgu'i gzi byin 'phro: stobs ldan dpal 'bar khros pa'i bzhin mdangs ni: dmar nag sku la me zer ya la la: dpa' ba'i stobs kyis bgegs dpung sa la sgyel: phyag drug mtshon chas log 'dren tshe bdud 'joms: dur khrod chas ldan gdug pa'i dmag tshogs zlog: sku smad dbal gsham srid gsum zil gyis gnon: pha rol phyin drug phag mo'i sku la 'khril: rtsal chen khro rgyal yab yum 'khor bcas kyis: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las dus la bab:

mthu ldan dmag dpung bskul lo phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: khro rgyal chen po'i pho brang lcags ri la: myur mgyogs shan pa phur bu rtsang gis bskor: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i mtshon cha sna tshogs gzengs: drag po'i thun rdzas du ma char ltar 'bebs: dmar chen zham chu dug khrag mtsho ltar 'khyil: rab tu 'jigs pa'i dur khrod tshogs kyis bskor: rtsang phur rang bzhin 'jigs pa'i gzhal yas khang : zlog byed khro bo'i dmag tshogs rten pa'i mkhar: thogs med rtsal chen rdzas su mnga' gsol lo: mi mthun rkyen ngan bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: dpal gyi rtsang phur dang po gang nas byung : dpal gyi rtsang phur ye shes dbyings nas byung : drag po'i rtsang phur khrag 'thung zer las byung : bzlog pa'i rtsang phur mu stegs yul nas byung : las kyi rtsang phur ru tra'i rgyu las byung : hūm̐: dbang chen 'bar ba rta mchog he ru kas: ma ṭaṃ ru tra bsgral ba'i pags pa la: drag po'i mdos kyi g.yang gzhi dkyil 'khor byas: ru tra'i thod pa drag po'i snod mchog tu: ru tra'i tsit+ta dpal gyi gtor ma bsham: ru tra'i mche ba zhing phung rtsang phur bcos: ru tra'i rgyu ma bha su'i zhags pas dkris: ru tra'i dbang po drug gi liṅgas brgyan: ru tra'i khams phung lnga'i zor chen bsgril: ru tra'i gzhong pa dug mda' rtsang gis brgyan: ru tra'i skra dang lag pa g.yab pa'i rdzas: ru tra'i 'gram dang rkang brgyad bsgral ba'i mtshon: ru tra'i rtsib ma mchog chen zor gyi gzhu: ru tra'i lto chen chos 'byung tho ba gtun: de phyir bzlog pa'i rdzas chen ru trar tshang : rang byas rang la smin pa'i ru tra 'di: bsgral te bzlog pa'i rdzas su mnga' gsol bas: rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad bzlog tu gsol: sngon tshe drag po'i bzlog byung de bzhin du: de ring las mkhan pho nya'i dmag tshogs rnams: rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: pha rol byad ltas bzlog pa'i dus la bab:

hūm̐: rno dbal drag po'i rtsang gi phur bu ni: che chung ri rab rgya khyon chos kyi dbyings: myur mgyogs glog la drag rtsal thog rgod shugs: mang nyung rtsi shing rno dbal me yi zer: gang la btab kyang thogs med drag po'i rtsang : thabs dang shes rab rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse la khro bos drag sngags ldir: mar gyi rtse la drag mos bh+yo sgra sgrog: sked pa rgya mdud zung 'jug gzhal yas khang : sku gsum phrin las yongs rdzogs rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la thob: ma rungs gdug pa'i tshe bdud bar chad zlog: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur zhe sdang rang bzhin can: rtse mor gshin rje'i dmag tshogs nye re re: rtsa bar ma mo'i nad sprin thu lu lu: sked pa rgya mdud sna tshogs gzhal yas khang : 'chi bdag las la mngags pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: log 'dren tshe yi bar chad rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur nga rgyal rang bzhin can: rtse la sgrol ging mtshon cha zangs se zang : rtsa bar ging mos gar thabs khyugs se khyug: sked pa rgya mdud rdo rje'i gzhal yas khang : gtum chen pho mo 'khrugs pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: snang srid lha srin dal kha rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur 'dod chags rang bzhin can: rtse mor bdud kyi dmag tshogs nyi li li: rtsa bar gnod sbyin srog len khyugs se khyug: sked pa 'od zer lnga ldan gzhal yas khang : srog bdag las la chas pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: sngon las 'phral rkyen skag rigs rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur phrag dog rang bzhin can: rtse mor rgyal chen dpe dkar tshubs se tshub: rtsa bar klu bdud mdze nad thibs se thibs: sked pa gnyis med gsal stong khro lo lo: dmod pa las sngags sbyor ba'i gtsang phur 'di:

dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: pha rol bsam sbyor ngan pa bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur gti mug rang bzhin can: rtse la lha dmag ru tshon lhabs se lhab: rtsa bar btsan gyi cho 'phrul sha ra ra: sked pa 'od gsal gzhal yas khrigs se khrig: mthu chen stobs ldan sngags pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: gling bzhi'i mi kha dmod tshig bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur sgrol 'debs rang bzhin can: rtse mor gza' rgod thog mda' sha ra ra: rtsa bar dam can sgra 'dzin khyugs se khyug: sde brgyad yang 'khor tshang ba'i rtsang phur 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: pho nya dmod pa'i rig sngags rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: zhe sdang rtsang phur me lce wa la la: nga rgyal rtsang phur thog ser sha ra ra: 'dod chags rtsang phur khrag mtsho me re re: phrag dog rtsang phur rlung dmar tshubs se tshub: gti mug rtsang phur mun rub chi li li: dug lnga ru tra'i kha rlangs nag po 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: dgra bgegs mi nor yul zhing rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: las mkhan pho nya gdug pa'i rtsang phur la: rtse mor srin byas ku 'debs lhangs se lhang : rtsa bar 'dre bya sreg pa kyi li li: sked pa bdud bya lcung ka tshubs se tshub: drwa mig wa la sprel zhon tha ra ra: gru rnams gzugs med lag pa na ra ra: logs su 'dre mo wa zhon zhungs se zhung : yang 'khor than ltas sna dgu 'gyed pa 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: dgra la than ltas sna tshogs char du phob: hūm̐: rtsang phur drag po'i gar stabs khrigs se khrig: rtsang phur rngam byed sha za ljibs se ljib: rtsang phur gtum drag khrag 'thung kyu ru ru: rtsang phur dgra rtsal rus 'cha' khrums se khrum: rtsang phur rbad bskul las byed sha ra ra: rtsang phur zlog sngags dmod pa lhangs se lhang : rtsang phur dgra la rbad do mthu ma chung :

rtsang la gnas pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: pha rol g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: pho rgyud khro bo'i drag sngags rtsang gis zlog: mo rgyud ma mo'i thun sngags rtsang gis zlog: ma yams brtan ma'i sun kha rtsang gis zlog: log 'dren tshe yi bar chad rtsang gis zlog: ban bon sngags pa'i phur kha rtsang gis zlog: byad dang mnan gtad ngan pa rtsang gis zlog: gling bzhi'i dmod pa'i mi kha rtsang gis zlog: the'u rang 'gong po'i bar chad rtsang gis zlog: gshin rje'i khram kha btab pa rtsang gis zlog: lha yi bka' chad babs pa rtsang gis zlog: lha min mtshon cha 'khrugs pa rtsang gis zlog: ma mo'i nad yams rims kha rtsang gis zlog: btsan gyi jag sna ngan pa rtsang gis zlog: klu yi gtad khram ngan pa rtsang gis zlog: sa bdag zha grum ngan pa rtsang gis zlog: rgyal po'i smyo 'bog ngan pa rtsang gis zlog: gnod sbyin phung shig ngan pa rtsang gis zlog: bdud kyi zhags pa nag po rtsang gis zlog: dmu yi gnam rdo lhung ba rtsang gis zlog: gnam thel bar chod gtong ba rtsang gis zlog: srin mo mi ru brdzu ba rtsang gis zlog: 'dre mos mi bla khyer ba rtsang gis zlog: pho nyas bla tshe rku ba rtsang gis zlog: 'byung gzhi 'gram 'khrug ngan pa rtsang gis zlog: lo zla zhag dus skag rigs rtsang gis zlog: sngon las 'phral rkyen ngan pa rtsang gis zlog: mi rung ltas ngan cho 'phrul dgra la phob: bzlog bsgyur dus la bab bo sa ma ya: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa baṃ badz+ra kī la ya pha rol byad ma gnod byed thams cad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog:

ces drag po rtsang gi lha tshogs rnams kyis pha rol kyi byad ma thams cad bzlog par bsam: de nas spyi bzlog chen mo drag po thog gi phreng ba ni: hūm̐: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dur khrod dbus: ru tra pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng nas: 'jigs byed che mchog dbang chen he ru kaḥ log 'dren 'byung po 'dul phyir las la bzhengs: sku mdog dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas dkar g.yon mthing dbus dmar khros pa'i zhal: g.yas gsum rdo rje dbyug to ral gri phyar: g.yon gsum bhan dmar kha ṭ+wāṃ phur bu bsgril: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog mkha' la brgyangs: sku smad phur gsham 'dod khams dbyings la brjid: mthing nag rdo rje phag mo sku la 'khril: 'jam dpal phyag rdor khyung dang dpal mgon che: dbang chen rigs bzhi sras 'khor bka' sdod bcas: khro rgyal stobs 'dus lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis: dgra sha khrag mchod dmar po 'di bzhes la: ma rungs dpung tshogs bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: dpal chen che mchog pad+ma he ru kas: sgrub pa'i bar chad rkyen ngan bzlog tu gsol: gsang ba'i yum mchog drag mo phag gdong ches: 'byung bzhi'i rtsa rlung nyams pa bzlog tu gsol: rigs bdag cod pan snang ba mtha' yas skus: byang chub lam gyi bar chad bzlog tu gsol: 'jam dpal nag po 'jigs byed he ru kas: snang srid pho rgyud byad kha bzlog tu gsol: gsang ba'i yum mchog drag mo lcags gdong mas: snang srid mo rgyud byad kha bzlog tu gsol: gsang bdag gtum po dregs pa 'joms byed ches: yi dam lha yi bka' chad bzlog tu gsol: yum chen khro mo khros ma nag mo ches: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i sun ma bzlog tu gsol: sprul pa'i khro rgyal bya khyung 'bar ba'i skus: gnam thel dkar nag khra gsum bzlog tu gsol: gsang ba'i yum mchog gtum mo khyung gdong mas:

gnam sman bar sman sa sman bzlog tu gsol: ye shes mgon po legs ldan seṅge'i gdong : tshe bsod dpal 'byor nyams pa bzlog tu gsol: yum chen drag mo khro gnyer seṅge'i gdong : snyan grags mnga' thang zad pa bzlog tu gsol: shar sgo'i khro mo lcags kyu dkar mo yis: zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i bar chad zlog: lho sgo'i khro mo zhags pa ser mo yis: rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i bar chad zlog: nub sgo'i khro mo lcags sgrog dmar mo yis: dbang gi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i bar chad zlog: byang sgo'i khro mo dril bu ljang mo yis: drag po'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i bar chad zlog: hūm̐: dbang chen pho brang nang gi phyogs bzhi ru: nyi zla pad+ma ru tra'i gdan steng du: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las ngo bo nyid: dbang chen rigs bzhi 'jigs byed he ru kaḥ bzlog bsgyur phrin las gnyan po'i dus la bab: rdo rje dbang chen khro rgyal chen po yis: ban bon byad kha dgra la bzlog tu gsol: rat+na dbang chen khro rgyal chen po yis: mu stegs sngags zor dgra la bzlog tu gsol: pad+ma dbang chen khro rgyal chen po yis: mnan gtad gzer gsum dgra la bzlog tu gsol: karma dbang chen khro rgyal chen po yis: mi kha dmod tshig dgra la bzlog tu gsol: gsang ba'i yum chen khro mo rigs bzhi yis: chag che nyam nga dgra la bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: zhi ba zil gnon mi pham yum dang sbyor: lha yi bka' chad babs pa dgra la zlog: khro bo zil gnon khro gnyer yum dang sbyor: snang srid pho rgyud dmod pa dgra la zlog: ma mo zil gnon ro langs yum dang sbyor: snang srid mo rgyud dmod pa dgra la zlog: khyung rnams zil gnon spyan gzigs yum dang sbyor: sras rgyud dmod pa'i drag sngags dgra la zlog: pho rgyud zil gnon rdo rje las byed sbyor: bdud bzhi tshe yi bar chad dgra la zlog: mo rgyud zil gnon las byed yum dang sbyor:

lo gshed bdud bzhi 'phrad pa dgra la zlog: klu rnams zil gnon las byed yum dang sbyor: spar sme dur du tshud pa dgra la zlog: gza' rnams zil gnon gnod sbyin las byed sbyor: rlung rta'i srog shing chag pa dgra la zlog: sgo skyong khro mo las byed rigs bzhi yis: rtsa rlung 'byung ba rgud pa dgra la zlog: hūm̐: pho brang chen po'i bar khyams 'khor yug la: gnas pa'i bka' nyan las byed pho nya'i tshogs: de ring bzlog bsgyur phrin las dus la bab: sku las sprul pa'i dung dred mgo gsum mas: lha min mtshon cha 'khrugs pa dgra la zlog: gsung gi sprul pa'i zangs 'phar mgo brgyad mas: rgya 'dre 'gong po'i cho 'phrul dgra la zlog: thugs las sprul pa'i lcags spyang mgo dgu mas: gshin rje'i khram kha nag po dgra la zlog: yon tan sprul pa'i g.yu spyang mgo gsum mas: btsan gyi jag sna btang ba dgra la zlog: phrin las sprul pa'i gser seng mgo gsum mas: ma mo'i yams rims gtong ba dgra la zlog: gnyis med sprul pa'i dung phag mgo bcu mas: bdud kyi zhags pa nag po dgra la zlog: shar phyogs long ba dkar po rgyab sbrel gyis: dri za'i gnod pa'i bar chad dgra la zlog: lho yi long ba ser po rgyab sbrel gyis: grul bum 'tshe ba'i bar chad dgra la zlog: nub kyi long ba dmar po rgyab sbrel gyis: me lha'i bar chad gtong ba dgra la zlog: byang phyogs long ba ljang sngon rgyab sbrel gyis: klu yi mdze nad gtong ba dgra la zlog: bco lnga bco lnga dmus long drug cu yis: sa bdag zha grum gtong ba dgra la zlog: pho nya dkar po zla ba'i 'dab can gyis: gnod sbyin za kha ston pa dgra la zlog: pho nya dmar po nyi ma'i 'dab can gyis: bgegs kyis 'tshe ba'i bar chad dgra la zlog: pho nya dmar po me yi 'dab can gyis: 'byung pos bar chad brtsam pa dgra la zlog: pho nya sngon po chu yi 'dab can gyis: dmu yi gnam rdo 'phen pa dgra la zlog:

pho nya ljang gu rlung gi 'brug chen gyis: gza' nad steng grib nag po dgra la zlog: pho nya dmar nag me yi 'brug chen gyis: the'u rang 'gong po'i bar chad dgra la zlog: pho nya sngon po chu yi 'brug chen gyis: srin mos 'tshe ba'i bar chad dgra la zlog: sna tshogs khro bo sprul pa'i 'brug chen gyis: gre bo gre mo'i gnod pa dgra la zlog: 'jigs pa'i kha gdong rngam pa'i khyi brgyad kyis: lo skag zla skag zhag skag dgra la zlog: myur mgyogs 'dur rgyug gtum pa'i spyang brgyad kyis: dus tshod pho nya thams cad dgra la zlog: hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog: glo bur brgya cu rtsa gcig zlog: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad zlog: rbad 'dre rbad gtong phur kha zlog: yas kyi bdud du g.yos pa zlog: mas kyi sri chen langs pa zlog: bar nas gri btsan rgyug pa zlog: rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa zlog: pho bdud dal kha g.yas su zlog: mo bdud dal kha g.yon du zlog: spyi bdud dal kha mkha' la zlog: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badz+ra ya ma ra tsa ging ka ra h+ya ghṛ wa a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya gnod byed thams cad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: de nas bzlog 'brel gtong ba ni: hūm̐: dbang chen khro rgyal che mchog he ru kaḥ de ring bzlog bsgyur phrin las dus la bab: pho tshogs dmod pa'i drag sngags thams cad yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: mo rgyud ma mo'i thun sngags thams cad yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: rgya gar chos kyi yi ge'i dmod pa yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: rgya nag khrims kyi bsgyur gto byed pa yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: zhang zhung bon gyis mthu sgrub byed pa yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: mu stegs nag po'i ngan sngags gtong ba yang :

de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: stag gzig rgyal po'i zor mda' zug pa yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: sum pa rnams kyis glang zor 'phen pa yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: sngags pa rnams kyis hoṃ zor 'phen pa yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: li yi spar sme gdan bgos byed pa yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: za hor rnams kyis sog mo bkod pa yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: kha che tho gar dril glud gtong ba yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: dus 'khrug mtshon gyi char pa 'bebs pa yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: gri btsan shan pas bsha' gri brdar ba yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: skyes pa rnams kyis mda' zor 'phen pa yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: bud med rnams kyis dmod zor 'phen pa yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: yul mi khyim mtshes mi kha gtong ba yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: gnam nas bdud kyis 'bod pa thams cad yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: sa nas dug mda' langs pa thams cad yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: bya khyung dkar pos gshog sgra brdeb pa yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: dur phag nag pos ro la 'khun pa yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: lo khyim zhig dang rten phur phud pa yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: klung rta chag dang tshe rgya ral ba rnams: de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: steng nas lha dang lha min 'khrugs pa yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: 'og nas klu dang sa bdag 'khrugs pa yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: bar nas btsan dang rgyal po 'khrugs pa yang :

de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: mtshams nas sman dang ma mo 'khrugs pa yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: sa sgo dur sgo gshed sgo bye ba rnams: de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: pha mes dur sri langs pa thams cad yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: phyug gi g.yang kha nyams pa thams cad yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: nor gyi god kha gyod shur thams cad yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: yul dang khyim la 'dre rgod chags pa yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: srid dang mi rabs chad pa thams cad yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: phyogs nas phung ba'i dgra bzhi langs pa yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: mtshams nas glo bur byur bzhi langs pa yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: phug nas 'chi bdag bdud bzhi langs pa yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: mo rtsis rgyan dang pra rtags ngan pa yang : de ring dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: bsgyur ro ltas ngan sna tshogs dgra la sgyur: bzlog bsgyur dus la bab bo sa ma ya: oṃ badz+ra ma tri ma tri ru ru rag mo rak+ṣa mā ra du dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad zlog zlog: de nas dmod pa sogs gang rgyas bya: than bzlog 'dra byed na skabs 'dir bya: sa ma ya: de nas srung 'khor gur khang bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid dbang chen khro rgyal gsal ba yi: thugs kar hūm̐ yig dmar po'i klong dkyil du: bdag dang bsrung bya thams cad tshud nas kyang : sngags phreng 'khor bas phyi nang 'khor yug kun: bskal pa'i me dpung dum bu gcig tu gyur: su yang bgrod du med pa'i rang bzhin bsgom: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa mañdzu shrī badz+ra pā ṇi khroṃ ga ru ṭa ka la siṃ ha mu kha kro ti tsa tur baṃ: badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ

bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa srungs shig rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swā hā: zhes bsrung ba po rnams gur khang du tshud par bya: de nas bzlog pa ni: hūm̐: mdun du khro rgyal 'bar ba'i sku smad na: zur gsum dbal la gnam lcags tsakra 'khor: de 'og zangs kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug: bar du dgra bgegs pho mo'i bla gzugs bkug: bzlog pa'i sngags phreng drag tu 'dren pa'i tshe: las kyi rlung gis bskyod pas g.yas g.yon 'khor: phye mar 'thag ste sha khrag dum bur gtub: dregs pa rnams kyi hab hab ljib ljib gsol: lhag ma rdul phran tsam yang med par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra kro ti kī la ya kro ti hūm̐ bh+yoḥ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya dgra bgegs byad ma nṛ tri trig nan gzer thum myog thum e hur thum mā ra mā ra bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces bsad 'khor rnams drag tu 'khor te dgra bo ming med du btang bar bsam: sa ma ya: de nas gser skyems gtong ba ni: rnga brdung dung bus: dar mdung gzengs: zhwa nag gyon: gdong la khrag zhag gi tshom bus brgyan: gser skyems dang dkar gtor rnams bdud rtsis bran zhing byin gyis brlabs la: hūm̐: phyogs bcu rab 'byams zhing khams rgya mtsho na: bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'dzin tshogs: gzhan yang yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang : dam can gter bdag yul lha gzhi bdag tshogs: rnal 'byor bdag la gsan cing dgongs su gsol: zol zog med pa'i rig 'dzin sngags 'chang la: dam nyams dgra bo rnams kyis snyad btsal te: mi rung bar chad sna dgu rtsom lags pas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dus gsum sangs rgyas bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: de ring dam nyams dgra la zor 'debs ya: hūm̐: bstan gnyis gtso bo shākya thub pa la: ma rungs lha sbyin bdud kyis snyad btsal te: nang pa'i chos kyi bstan pa snub lags pas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la:

drang srong rig 'dzin bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: de ring dam nyams dgra la zor 'debs ya: hūm̐: 'gro ba'i mgon po pad+ma 'byung gnas la: mu stegs log lta can gyis snyad btsal te: gsang sngags chos la sdang zhing 'tshe lags pas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: yi dam lha tshogs bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: de ring dam nyams dgra la zor 'debs ya: hūm̐: ma rgyud ḍāk+ki'i snyan brgyud zab lam la: dam nyams grub mtha' can gyis snyad btsal te: gdug sems sgro skur snying nas smad lags pas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: ma sring mkha' 'gros bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: de ring dam nyams dgra la zor 'debs ya: hūm̐: mi dbang bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gdung brgyud la: so skye chags sdang can gyis snyad btsal te: g.yul gshom dmag gis mtha' nas bskor lags pas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: chos skyong dam can bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: de ring dam nyams dgra la zor 'debs ya: hūm̐: nyes med bdag cag rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag la: 'byung po 'dre rgod rnams kyis glags btsal te: 'byung bzhis tshe yi bar chad gtong lags pas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: gter srung pho nyas bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: de ring dam nyams dgra la zor 'debs ya: hūm̐: yul bcu 'bras bu sa nas smin 'dod kyang : rgyal 'gong bse rag dam sris snyad btsal nas: dus 'khrug lo nyes dbul sri ldang lags pas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dkar phyogs skyong bas bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: hūm̐: lha srin sde brgyad gzhi bdag gnyan po dang : lo zla zhag dus 'gyu ba sa bdag bcas: gdong la gnas pa'i lha 'dre yid gzugs can: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: zhi rgyas dbang drag bya ba gang bcol yang : ko long ru nga phrag dog ma sdang la: dgra bgegs ma gtogs g.yas g.yon sku bzur cig:
drag po'i gtor zor 'phros nas reg srid pas: shag kha 'gyed pa'i ma nyes ma len gtam: go bar gyis shig lha srin dam tshig can: deng 'dir dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod:

ces gser skyems gtong zhing bla ma yi dam chos skyong rnams bdag gi rgyab rten rogs dan mdzad nas phrin las bsgrubs par bsam: de nas nang gi gser skyems gtong ba ni: mdos kyi phyogs bzhi'i sgo dbye dang bcas nas: hūm̐: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: shar phyogs shel gyi sku mkhar nas: sgo skyong dkar mo lcags kyu ma: thabs shes mtshon pa'i lde mig bsnams: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: pho brang shar gyi shel sgo phyes: ye shes 'jig rten dmag dpung drongs: shar gyi lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: rig 'dzin bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ hūm̐: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: lho phyogs gser gyi sku mkhar nas: sgo skyong ser po zhags pa ma: thabs shes mtshon pa'i lde mig bsnams: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: pho brang lho yi gser sgo phyes: ye shes 'jig rten dmag dpung drongs: lho yi lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: rig 'dzin bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: oṃ rat+na pra be sha ya phaṭḥ hūm̐: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: nub phyogs zangs kyi sku mkhar nas: sgo skyong dmar mo lcags sgrog ma: thabs shes mtshon pa'i lde mig bsnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: pho brang nub kyi zangs sgo phyes: ye shes 'jig rten dmag dpung drongs: nub kyi lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: rig 'dzin bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: oṃ pad+ma pra be sha ya phaṭḥ hūm̐: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: byang phyogs g.yu yi sku mkhar nas: sgo skyong ljang mo dril bu ma: thabs shes mtshon pa'i lde mig bsnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: pho brang byang gi g.yu sgo phyes: ye shes 'jig rten dmag dpung drongs: byang gi lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: rig 'dzin bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: oṃ karma pra be sha ya phaṭḥ hūm̐: pho brang 'bar ba'i lha tshogs rnams:

mi mngon dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: khro rgyal 'dus pa'i lha tshogs bskul: rtsal chen gzi brjid 'gyed pa'i tshe: spyi bor rig 'dzin dmag dpung gtibs: g.yas su yi dam dmag dpung bskyed: g.yon du mkha' 'gro'i dmag dpung bskyed: mdun du pho nyas zor sna drongs: phyogs mtshams chos skyong sprin ltar gtibs: nyams pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs tshogs: bkug cing bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: oṃ badz+ra kro ti sha ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ zhes phyogs bzhi'i sgo phyes la gtor ma dpag: de nas srin mo za lam gtong ba ni: gtor ma ma mo'i gzugs la dpal 'bar btsugs te: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yoḥ srin mo za lam gom pa bdun cu 'das pa'i pha rol na: snang srid kun gyi stobs la dbang ba yi: las kyi ma mo dmar nag bzhugs pa ni: 'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba'i cha lugs 'chang : ye shes grub kyang las kyi mkha' 'gro ma: bzlog pa'i las mdzad zor gyi sna 'dren ma: phyag g.yas dmar chen gtor zor wa la la: g.yon pas kong zor dmar nag yugs se yug: 'khor du las kyi sha za 'bum gyis bskor: thams cad thun rdzas dug mda' sha ra ra: khrag mchod bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: rbad do las kyi ma mo dgra la chos: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ rdo rje'i shugs 'chang las byed sha za 'bum: khrag mchod bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: shar phyogs mdos zor gtor ma'i sna drongs shig: dgra bgegs gdug pa'i dmag tshogs bzlog tu gsol: bh+yo bh+yo ma mos bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ rin chen shugs 'chang rngam byed sha za 'bum: khrag mchod bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: lho phyogs mdos zor gtor ma'i sna drongs shig: dgra bgegs gdug pa'i dmag tshogs bzlog tu gsol: bh+yo bh+yo ma mos bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ pad+ma'i shugs 'chang gtum byed sha za 'bum: khrag mchod bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la:

nub phyogs mdos zor gtor ma'i sna 'dren ma: dgra bgegs gdug pa'i dmag tshogs bzlog tu gsol: bh+yo bh+yo ma mos bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ las kyi shugs 'chang dregs byed sha za 'bum: khrag mchod bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: byang phyogs mdos zor gtor ma'i sna drongs shig: dgra bgegs gdug pa'i dmag tshogs bzlog tu gsol: bh+yo bh+yo ma mos bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: pha rol byad zor phur kha zlog: tshe bdud log 'dren bar gcod zlog: gling bzhi'i mi kha rgyangs glu zlog: mi rung ltas ngan sna dgu zlog: longs spyod phywa g.yang nyams pa zlog: chag chen nyam nga thams cad zlog: lo skag zhag dus skag rigs zlog: ye 'drog glo bur brgyad cu zlog: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad zlog: gdug pa'i dmag tshogs g.yul ngo zlog: mi rung sna dgu dgra la phob: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: oṃ rak+mo bh+yoḥ rak+sha bh+yo bh+yoḥ ma tri bh+yo bh+yoḥ du tri bh+yo bh+yoḥ na tri bh+yo bh+yoḥ mā ra ya: dgra bo byad ma'i steng du zor bh+yo thun bh+yo rbad bh+yo zlog zlog: ces gom pa bdun cu'i mtshams su bskyal: 'di'i mtshams su dgra bgegs lan gsum 'gugs la: drag po'i gtor zor rnams rgyas pa 'don nas las bskul dang sbrags te 'phang kyang rung : hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dbang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas: 'jigs byed che mchog pad+ma he ru kaḥ sku mdog dmar po me zor ya la la: g.yas gsum mtshon chas gdug pa'i g.yul ngo zlog: g.yon gsum mtshon chas byad ma'i snying khrag dkrug: dur khrod chas dgus log 'dren dmag tshogs 'dul: gnam lcags phur gsham bstan pa'i ru tra bsgral: h+ya ghṛ wa'i thugs dam dus la bab: dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma 'di nyid kyi: bla srog snying gi dkyil du zor 'debs ya: mā ra ya yi phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

oṃ h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra kī la ya baṃ kro ti hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs byad ma hur thum mā ra ya zlog: gtor zor thogs la: hūm̐: smug nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i pho brang nas: srog bdag chen po 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: sku mdog kham nag mun pa chi li li: phyag drug mtshon cha dbal ldan zor mda' 'phen: drag sngags gzir 'debs nag po'i dmod pa 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la mā ra ya: oṃ badz+ra mañdzu shrī badz+ra baṃ kro ti kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs byad ma hur thum mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: gtor zor thogs la: hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i pho brang nas: khro rgyal che btsan gsang bdag dregs pa 'dul: sku mdog mthing nag tshwa tshwa tho ro ro: phyag drug mtshon cha dbal ldan zor mda' 'phen: rig sngags gzir 'debs nag po'i dmod pa 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la mā ra ya: oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi baṃ kro ti kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs byad ma hur thum mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: gtor zor thogs nas: hūm̐: ljang nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'joms byed chen po bya khyung khro bo'i rgyal: sku mdog mthing nag shwa rbud 'u ru ru: phyag drug mtshon cha dbal ldan zor mda' 'phen: rtsal chen gzir 'debs nag po'i dmod pa 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la mā ra ya: oṃ khroṃ raṃ gha ru ṭa kī la ya baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs byad ma hur thum mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: gtor zor thogs la: hūm̐: sngo nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: legs ldan 'bar ba 'jigs byed seṅge'i gdong : sku mdog mthing nag seng skad 'u ru ru: phyag drug mtshon cha dbal ldan zor mda' 'phen: ngan sngags gzir 'debs nag po'i dmod pa 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la mā ra ya: oṃ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha baṃ kro ti kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs byad ma hur thum mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog:

gtor zor thogs nas: hūm̐: rab 'jigs sgo bzhi 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: za byed las kyi ma mo mched bzhi ni: sku mdog sna tshogs las byed sha ra ra: phyag drug mtshon cha dbal ldan zor mda' 'phen: smyo 'bog gzir 'debs nag po'i dmod pa 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la mā ra ya: oṃ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ma tri kī la ya hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs byad ma hur thum bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: de nas las kyi zor dgu 'phen pa ni: nyungs zor thogs la: hūm̐: yungs dkar rgyal po shwa ri raṃ: lha yi dregs pa yongs rdzogs sku: lha dmag bye ba 'bum gyis bskor: gdug pa'i zor mda' sha ra ra: rbad do dregs pa mthu ma chung : dgra bgegs snying la mā ra ya: hūm̐: dhe wa u gra dharba mā ra ya dgra la bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: khrag zor thogs la: hūm̐: rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrugs: ma mo dregs pa yongs rdzogs sku: ma mo'i dmag tshogs 'bum gyis bskor: gdug pa'i zor mda' sha ra ra: rbad do dregs pa mthu ma chung : dgra bgegs snying la mā ra ya: hūm̐ ma tri dar+pa rak+ta mā ra ya dgra la bh+yo zlog: dug thun thogs la: hūm̐: dug mda' nag po phyu ru ru: bdud kyi dregs pa yongs rdzogs sku: bdud dmag bye ba 'bum gyis bskor: gdug pa'i zor mda' sha ra ra: rbad do dregs pa mthu ma chung : dgra bo snying la mā ra ya: hūm̐ du pra ma dar+pa ha la mā ra ya dgra la bh+yo zlog: rdo zor thogs nas: hūm̐: rdo zor rbab rgod sha ra ra: rgyal po dregs pa yongs rdzogs sku: rgyal 'gong dmag tshogs 'bum gyis bskor: gdug pa'i zor mda' sha ra ra: rbad do dregs pa mthu ma chung : dgra bo'i snying la mā ra ya: hūm̐: ru sha la dar+pa sha la mā ra ya dgra la bh+yo zlog: me zor thogs la: hūm̐: me zor tshwa tshwa tho ro ro: btsan gyi dregs pa yongs rdzogs sku: btsan dmag bye ba 'bum gyis bskor: gdug pa'i zor mda' sha ra ra:

rbad do dregs pa mthu ma chung : dgra bo'i snying la mā ra ya: oṃ tsa shu la dar+pa raṃ dz+wa la mā ra ya dgra la bh+yo zlog: gri zor thogs la: hūm̐: mtshon zor bu yug tshubs se tshub: gshin rje dregs pa yongs rdzogs sku: gshin rje'i dmag tshogs 'bum gyis bskor: gdug pa'i zor mda' sha ra ra: rbad do dregs pa mthu ma chung : dgra bo'i snying la mā ra ya: oṃ ya ma dar+pa khaḍ+ga mā ra ya dgra la bh+yo zlog: mtshe zor thogs la: hūm̐: ke tshe shang tshe nyi li li: klu yi dregs pa yongs rdzogs sku: klu dmag bye ba 'bum gyis bskor: gdug pa'i zor mda' sha ra ra: rbad do dregs pa mthu ma chung : dgra bo'i snying la mā ra ya: oṃ nā ga dar+pa he tha na mā ra ya dgra la bh+yo zlog: lcags zangs thun zor thogs la: hūm̐: lcags zangs thun zor nyi li li: gnod sbyin dregs pa yongs rdzogs sku: gnod sbyin dmag tshogs 'bum gyis bskor: gdug pa'i zor mda' sha ra ra: rbad do dregs pa mthu ma chung : dgra bgegs snying la mā ra ya: oṃ yak+sha dar+pa lo ha na mā ra ya dgra la bh+yo zlog: de nas zor mda' thogs te: hūm̐: nga ni legs ldan seṅge mdong : ru tra'i mchog chen rtsib gzhu la: gri rgod rgyus pa'i gzhu breng byas: hūm̐ bh+yo bzlog rtsis yi ges brgyan: g.yon gyi phyogs nas lan gsum bskor: dug mda' nag po myur 'bebs la: bdud srin 'dre gsum bya sgros brgyan: gri lcags ngar ma'i dbal mdel sprad: srin po'i khrag gis mtshal kyang byugs: mā ra ya yi seṅges brgyan: g.yas kyi sor mos lan gsum bsgril: ma gza' btsan du byin gyis brlabs: gnyis med thabs kyi rbad pa'i tshe: ki kang nag po las la chos: dgra bgegs srog la mā ra ya: oṃ hriḥgra pa rā hu la dar+pa na ṇa mā ra ya dgra la bh+yo zlog: zor rnams thams cad dmigs pa dang bcas te 'phang : de nas zor chen thogs la 'phen pa ni: ho dgongs su gsol: gsan du gsol lo:

gzigs su gsol lo: dbang chen che mchog sprul pa'i zhing khams: dur khrod dmar nag 'bar ba'i klong chen: me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i pho brang chen po nas: 'jigs byed khro rgyal stobs 'dus: yab h+ya ghṛ wa stobs ldan dregs byed: yum dbyings phyug tsan+ḍa li chen mo: snang srid kun la dbang ba'i khro rgyal chen po gsan cing dgongs su gsol: khyad par sku gsung thugs kyi gnas mchog chen po nas: srid gsum gar gyi dbang phyug 'jam dpal nag po: dpal chen dregs pa kun 'dul: stobs ldan ye shes khyung chen: las mgon seṅge'i gdong can: drag shul srid pa'i ma bzhi: sras mchog dbang chen rigs bzhi: zil gnon khro bo mched brgyad: khams brgyad las kyi ma drug: sprul pa'i dmus long rgyab sbrel: pho nya 'dab can rigs bzhi: drag po 'brug chen rigs bzhi: za byed yang sprul khyi brgyad: bla 'gugs lce spyang rigs brgyad: pho bdud gri thogs stong : mo bdud khram thogs stong : las byed shan pa 'bum phrag la sogs pa rnams gsan cing dgongs su gsol: ye shes lha dang srung ma khyed rnams la zhu ba gsol zhing phrin las su bcol ba ni: spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo: dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad pa'i dam nyams: rnal 'byor bdag la 'tshe ba'i sgos dgra: dben ri gnyan po bshig pa'i bdud sprul: ma nyes kha yog 'gel ba'i gdug can: bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba'i bstan bshig: dge bdun phung dkrug byed pa'i dam log: khyad par du yang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan la sdang zhing gdug sems 'chang ba'i byad ma: rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bka' la smad par byed pa: mi min mi ru brdzu zhing lha min lha ru brdzu ba: 'gras ya dang rtsod ya byed cing : gdong la shag kha 'debs pa: 'phrog bcom sngon rgyug rgyab 'ded byed pa: snga dgra phyi dgra lam nas sgug pa: da dgra gnod cing tshad la btsugs pa:

chibs rta mchod g.yag mchod zhing 'phrog pa: dmag sna jag sna rkun sna ston pa: lam mgron bcom zhing sgrog tu bcug pa: za lam du dug sbyor ba: 'gro lam du rtsang 'dzugs pa: bkag pa'i ri rgya klung rgya gtor ba la sogs pa: khyad par bslab pa'i slob bu dam log: gtam pa'i shag rogs mna' zan: 'grul ba'i mdza' rogs snying ngan: bsten pa'i mgo dpon khrel med: bzhag pa'i bran g.yog bsam ngan: nyos pa'i chung ma snying ring : slob ma dam med dred po: bdud sprul skal ngan sdig can la sogs pa: rig 'dzin sngags 'chang bdag la sdang pa'i dgra thams cad mtho srid pa'i rtse mo: dma' na rag dmyal khams gang du gnas kyang : las kyi srung ma chen mo bskal pa'i me dpung las ngad tsha ba: btsan dug mda' nag po las gzir 'debs pa: spu gri ngar ma las dbal rno ba: gnam lcags thog rgod las shugs che ba: 'chi bdag pho nya las rtsal drag pa khyed rnams kyi steng nam mkha' mthon po la tshad ma btsugs: 'og sa gzhi ser po la rkang rjes ma gtod pa: dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs 'di bkug cing myur du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod cig: las byed pho nya rbad pa las la chos shig: zor mda' pho nya 'di dgra bo pho rgyud la phog na dbyar sos kyi gangs ri nyil ba lta bur thongs shig: za ma mo rgyud la phog na sran phung la dbyug pas brabs pa bzhin du thongs shig: ma sring gnyen lam la phog na: bye skya rlung gis khyer ba bzhin du thongs shig: skyes pa dar ma la phog na rgyud chen gyis sa ded pa ltar thongs shig: khyim 'dzin mo gzhon la phog na rtswa phung la me stag brgyab pa lta bur thongs shig: mngal dang mi rabs la phog na: bya sgong brag la brgyabs pa lta bur thongs shig: phyug dang sgo nor la phog na thal zhag chu la spur ba lta bu thongs shig: yul zhing khang la phog na bya sgro zhun mar 'phrod pa ltar bur thongs shig: 'og rta rkang phran la phog na rgya mtsho than pas bskams pa bzhin du thongs shig:

dgra bo'i pho rgyud thams cad gri ru 'chi bar gyis shig: mo rgyud thams cad smyo 'bog snying gzer gyis 'chi bar gyis shig: dgra bo'i rigs rgyud thams cad dmar nad khrag skyug gis 'chi bar gyis shig: dgra bo'i sgo nor thams cad glo gor lhog rgod kyis 'chi bar gyis shig: dgra bo'i lo tog thams cad btsa' sad ser gsum gyis khongs shig: dgra bo'i mkhar khang thams cad rmang gzhi rten brlag tu thongs shig: dgra bo'i pha sde nang tshan phung gyod gyis brlag par gyis shig: dgra bo'i lha srung mgon skyabs thams cad gtor te ming yang med par gyis shig: hoḥ ye shes kyi srung ma chen po dregs pa sde brgyad 'bum gyis bskor ba khyed rnams kyis: gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdongs la gangs ri tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs: glog dmar tsam gyi ljags rkyongs la: dgra bo byad ma 'di lo dang zla bar ma bzhag dang za ma dus tshod tshes grangs la ma bzhag par bka' yi gtor ma 'di dang mnyam du bzhes shig: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa mañdzu shrī badz+ra pā ṇi siṃ ha mu kha khroṃ ga ru ṭa kro ti wa na kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog:

ces lag rdeb bya zhing dar nag kyang g.yab dgra bo'i ming shul til 'bru tsam yang med par bsgoms: gtor chen rdzong : gtor bro bya: yar log cing gom pa dgu'i mtshams su tho cog byas la: hūm̐: bya khyung mthing nag me yi gshog pa can: zhal sder bgrad cing spu gri'i gshog pa brkyangs: sgab 'dre dam sri 'gyu ba'i lam chod cig: oṃ khroṃ raṃ ka la pa khying hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed thams cad nan bh+yoḥ rbad ching lam lam nan: zhes khyung nag bzhag cing gom pa bcu gsum mtshams su phye mar dang bkra shis chang gsol te ha ha lha rgyal lo zer zhing nang du log gtang rag gtong : dngos grub blang bkra shis brjod bsngo smon gyis: rgyas gdab ste tha ma ting 'dzin de bzhin nyid kyi ngang la 'jog pa gces: e ma dran shes bag yod gsum ldan sngags pa yis: bde stong phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshon btab pas: dgra bsad nyes pas mi gos 'tshengs pa yin: yi dam bsnyen sgrub byed pas rnal 'byor 'tshengs: bar chad bdud dgra bcom pas sbyin bdag 'tshengs: rnam shes chos skur drangs pas dgra bgegs 'tshengs: sha khrag tshogs su rol bas chos skyong 'tshengs: phyin chad 'khor ba stongs pas las 'phro 'tshengs: shes rab ral gris rma med mi kha 'tshengs: dkon mchog bden mthus stong med sngags pa 'tshengs: dgra shi sdug bsngal mi dgos blo bde 'tshengs: rnam smin 'khor dogs mi dgos phyi ma 'tshengs: dgra med snang sos dal bas 'gro sdod 'tshengs: gnyis 'dzin sngangs skrag mi dgos nyal bas 'tshengs: mthu chen mi kha thob pas snyan grags 'tshengs: 'di ni 'tshengs pa'i rten 'brel bcu gnyis te: theg chen gong ma rnams kyi spyod yul yin: dper na lugs ldog sangs rgyas 'khor lo 'dra: theg pa 'bring po rnams kyi bogs 'don yin: tha ma zhe sdang sngags nag dug sbrul gyis: lugs 'byung zhen chags srid pa'i 'khor lo 'dra: rgyu gcig lam gnyis 'bras bu so sor phyes:

stong nyid snying rje'i bskyed rdzogs bzlog pa yis: dgra yang rang yal rnam smin shugs las zad: za 'dod dmigs gtad can gyi bzlog pa yi: ngan sngags mang na smon lam shugs kyis log: de phyir bzlog pa'i gnad 'gag shin tu che: dam tshig med pa'i chos skyong bsten 'dod kyang : grogs su mi 'gro rang gi gshed du babs: brtul zhugs med pa'i dmar chen gtor zor gyis: rkyen ngan mi bzlog lha srin gdong thug 'khu: bskyed rdzogs med pa'i phur 'debs bsgral 'dren gyis: nyams mtshar ltad mos liṅgar tshud kyang srid: thugs rje med par gzhan gyi mgon byed des: sngags pa mi khyim rang srog phung yang srid: bsnyen sgrub med pa'i 'dre rgod 'phud pa des: gzhan la mi phan rang gi sgab 'dre byed: chad lhag mang ba'i gtor mdos rdzong ba des: phyi ma rang nyid dbang po ma tshang skye: bka' med lung chad drag las mang ba des: tha ma mchod yon gnyis ka phung ba'i rgyu: slob dpon ma bsten rang tshod bca' 'don gyis: chos kyi ngad yal srung mas bka' chad 'khu: gdeng med rang mtho can gyi kha bshad kyis: rgyud lung rang mtho gshe skur nyo ba'i rgyu: phyi nang grub mtha' ma chod sngags pa des: rdo rje theg pa'i snyan brgyud dbyangs su len: bsnyen sgrub spre'u 'dra ba'i sngags pa des: mi tshe dkor 'khyams rang don yud la zad: phag tshang phe gu 'dra ba'i sngags pa des: 'dre mchu mang bcings bse rag go khar 'khor: ba glang dred po 'dra ba'i sngags pa des: bsod nams zad pas lha la yi chad brdar: sngags log mgo stong snying med chang smyon des: bka' yi ser bcug gsang sngags khrom du 'khyer: de phyir phyi rabs rjes 'jug sngags 'chang rnams: khungs btsun mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla mar bsten: dbang khrid bka' gtad lung gis phyug par gyis: 'khrul med dkyil 'khor bca' gzhi lag len khrid: gab 'khrugs gnad 'gag zab khyad zhal las dris:

dbang bskur dkyil 'khor dam tshig mig ltar srungs: bsnyen sgrub las gsum kha skong tshad du skyol: phyi nang bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gnad du bsnun: rgyud bskang dus mchod gsol 'debs chag med brtson: lo zla dus su rang srung sgrub par 'bad: sha chang longs spyod tshogs su shes par gyis: gnod byed dgra bgegs rnams la snying rje bskyed: mtshams sbyor phan dge bzang pos bsngo smon gyis: dkon mchog thugs kyis khrel med dam tshig srungs: nor rdzas za gyon tsam la chog shes bskyed: gnad 'gag che chung med par zor ma rgyag: mtshon byed dgos kyang gtor 'bul tshul du 'phongs: khyad par snyan grags che ba'i sde dgon sogs: sku rim mang na gzhan gyi byad khas sdang : khyad par ngan sngags gdams ngag tho co gsum: rnam grangs mang na rang nyid phung ba'i rgyu: rdo rje theg chen phyi nang bden gnyis la: bsgral 'dren man ngag rnam grangs mang yod kyang : theg chen rnams kyis theg dman blor mi bstun: theg dman rnams kyis theg chen lam mi bgrod: dper na seṅge khyi la bsnyegs pa dang : stag mchong wa mchong rtsal 'gyed byed dang mtshungs: rdo rje theg chen bkag pa yid skyo na: yang dag grub thob rig 'dzin spyod 'gros la: bag med 'dra yang 'chug med gnad kyis 'dzin: so skye rnams kyis cher rlom tho co yis: gnad du mi phan sgro skur gshe ba'i rgyu: de bas sngags kyi chos sgor zhugs lags kyang : yin lo byas lo tsam gyis gnad mi khel: theg pa mtho dman drod tshad rtags kyis 'byed: de phyir rang yid lan gsum ma ches par: gzhan la bshad na kun gyis khrel ba'i rgyu: bla med zab lam nyams len sngags pa rnams: rang mtshang phog pa'i skyon du ma lta bar: zhal gdams 'chang la slob dpon mkhas par bsten: nyams len zhal shes gnad bsdus sa ma ya: e maḥ kho bo bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: yang zab snying po khro rgyal stobs 'dus kyi:

las mtha' bar chad bzlog pa'i man ngag bzhag: 'di ni tshig nyung don 'dus byin rlabs myur: kun gyi nang nas bar chad bzlog pa gtso: bar chad med na rkyen bral rig 'dzin 'grub: tshe ring chos dang ldan te kun gyi mchog: de phyir bzlog pa 'di nyid shin tu zab: mang du ma spel snying ltar 'chang bar gyis: sangs rgyas bstan dang rang don ma gtogs par: shin tu bka' gnyan bca' bar mi rigs so: gar thod sa ru dpe yang bstan mi rung : dbang chen khro rgyal yang gsang chos skor 'di: ma 'ongs lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: rig 'dzin pad+ma'i ming dang 'phrad par shog: bka' yi rgya 'di zhing skyong mgon pos srungs: dam med bdud rigs 'tshe ba'i dbang po snubs: zil chen gsang ba'i phug paṛ atsha rgya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: gnyan rgya: rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma gter bdag gling pas/ me sprel lor tsā ri zil chen gsang phug nas gdan drangs shing*/ lcags glang lor sbas yul pad+ma rong du shog ser nas dag par zhal bshus so// // la) ༈ tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las/ 'chi bslu tshe bdud zhags gcod bklag chog tu bkod pa bzhugs so/ 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lhar/ /btud de 'chi ba bslu ba'i thabs/ /tshe bdud zhags gcod man ngag rmad/ /nyams su len bder bklag chog spel/ de la'ang tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon gyi las tshogs tshe bdud zhags pa gcod pa'i gdams pa bklag chog tu spel ba la gnyis/ 'chi ba'i ltas dang bslu ba'i thabs bshad pa'o/ /dang po gter gzhung las/ gang phyir 'chi ltas phog gam rtsub rtags shar: 'byung bzhi mi snyoms nad rtags rmi lam dang : nyin mo phal cher lus zing shin tu skyo: phyi dro phal cher mi rtag lhang lhang dran: nub mo phal cher dngangs skrag mang du 'byung : sngar gyi lus gshis spyod 'gros phal cher 'gyur: don med mi rnams kun la dpyad ris byed:

rang gshis rgod po 'jam na 'chi ba'i rtags: 'jam po rgod cing sdang na 'chi ba'i rtags: phal cher bzhin gyi bkrag mdangs nyams na 'chi: rgyun du snying rtsa 'phar na 'chi ba'i ltas: pho rtsa mo yis 'phrog na 'chi ba'i ltas: mo rtsa pho gdon zhugs na 'chi ba'i ltas: 'byung ba tsha grang go ldog 'chi ba'i ltas: mkhal rtsa mchin par ldang na 'chi ba'i ltas: snying rtsa mtsher par ldang na 'chi ba'i ltas: glo rtsa rgyu mar ldang na 'chi ba'i ltas: srog rtsa mkhris par ldang na 'chi ba'i ltas: srin rtsa pho khar ldang na 'chi ba'i ltas: rus bcud khrag la thim na 'chi ba'i ltas: mkhris pa khu bar thim na 'chi ba'i ltas: de phyir ma nges 'chi rtags sna tshogs kyis: lus kyi 'byung bzhi 'khrugs nas 'chi ltas phog: glo bur bar gcod bdud dang bsdong ba'i tshe: tshe bdud zhags pa gcod pa'i gdams pa gces: tshe zad dus la bab kyang ring du bsring : dus min 'chi ba'i bdud las rab tu bsgral: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ rang gi 'chi ltas brtag pa dang*/ sman pas bla rtsa 'phar sdod la dpyad de kha mar gdags pa dang gzhan yang mo rtsis sogs zhib tu brtags la/ 'tshubs ltas byung na 'phral du bslu ba'i thabs la 'bad par bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'chi ba bslu ba'i thabs la sbyor dngos gnyis las/ de'ang gter gzhung las/ dang po bca' gzhi lag len ni: shin tu 'jam pa'i sa dag la: stegs bu 'dom bskor tshad du bya: de la thig chen bcu drug gdab: de steng srid pa'i rus sbal bkod: spar sme lo zla'i mtshon yang bsgyur: dbus su mañdzi khri yi khar: 'bru nag dpal gyi gtor ma bsham: de la mar rgyan rtsang yang 'dzugs: rus sbal mgo la phung bdud ser: rtsib g.yon nyon mongs bdud dmar po: mjug mar 'chi bdag bdud nag po: rtsib g.yas lha bu'i bdud dkar po: mtshams bzhir skye rga na 'chi bzhi: yan lag bzhi la sku glud bzhi: shar lhor pho nya lo yi gzugs: lho nub pho nya zla ba'i mgo:

nub byang pho nya zhag gi mgo: byang shar pho nya dus kyi mgo: gzugs kyi yan lag de bzhin no: de yi phyi rol rim pa bzhin: pho mo gang yin glud dang ni: mar me changs bu ting lo dang : gtor chung sha dum 'brang rgyas rnams: thams cad bcu drug bcu drug go: de yi phyi rol rim pa bzhin: nam mkha' rgyang bu mda' dang 'phang : gri khram shing ris bcas pa rnams: thams cad bcu drug bcu drug go: de yi phyi rol mdos dkris rgyab: mdos gzhi de yi mdun du ni: snam bu 'dom pa bcu drug pa: dkar nag mtshams nas dmar pos sbrel: snam bu dkar po de yi steng : sngon mo 'bru yi g.yung drung bris: dkar po'i steng na rim pa bzhin: g.yung drung brgyad du dod par bya: nag po'i gdan gyi steng du ni: hom gzugs khram gyis bskor ba bris: nag po'i steng du rim pa bzhin: hom yang brgyad po 'bru nag bya: pho mo gang yin sbyin bdag ste: hom khung de yi mdun du nyal: snam bu dkar nag mtshams de ru: zangs ngam shing gi gzhong pa ru: zam pa phyed dkar phyed nag bya: zam pa dkar po de yi khar: nad pa'i bla rtags gang yin bzhag: zam pa nag po de yi khar: mi lus lo shing mgo can bzhag: bla rtags de yis 'khyer tshul gyis: zhags pa bzung ste 'khrid par bya: gzhan yang bla 'bod byed pa yi: g.yas g.yon pho mo mang du 'tshogs: shel tshig khri dkar stong nag dang : khram shing pho mtshan mo mtshan dang : shwa rdel dkar nag la sogs pa: brgya yi grangs las ma nyung bya: gdan nag steng du nad pa'am: ma lcogs gzugs 'gros dkar po bzhag: gzhi dkar steng gi g.yung drung la: tshe dpag med kyi sku bshams nas: dar dkar thag pa'i bla rten bzung : tshe yi mda' dar de la btags: phye mar zas dkar sna tshogs bsham: gzhan yang mdos kyi phyogs bzhi na: snal ma bzhi yi thag pa ni: nad par btags pa'i tshul du bya: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ yar gzhi dkar po'i steng du tshe sgrub dang rta mgrin sogs kyi dkyil 'khor tshe dbang bcas gzhung bzhin bsham pa'i mdun/
