stegs bu gru bzhi che legs khar rus sbal gan rkyal du nyal zhing mgo bo lhor bstan pa'i gzugs bris pa'am/ bcas kyang rung la 'khos lcogs dang bstun/ gab rtse dgur spar sme'i rang mdog bzhin tshon gyis bsgyur/ rus sbal gyi dbus su rkang gsum mam mañdzi'i khar/ 'bru nag gi zor gtor rtsang dmar dang drag rgyan can dgod/ rus sbal gyi mgo bor phung bdud ser po g.yas ral gri dang g.yon khram shing 'dzin pa/ rtsib g.yon du nyon mongs pa'i bdud dmar po g.yas ral gri dang g.yon nad rkyal thogs pa/ mjug mar 'chi bdag gi bdud nag po g.yas ral gri dang g.yon shwa rde'u thogs pa/ rtsib g.yas su lha bu bdud dkar po g.yas ral gri dang g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa/ mtshams bzhir skye rga na 'chi bzhi la/ dang po shar lho ru bud med nag mo skye ba'i sdug bsngal phru gu btsas pa/ lho nub tu las kyi khyo gzugs rgas shing 'khog ste 'khar ba thogs pa/ nub byang du na ba'i sdug bsngal gzhogs phab nas nyal ba/ byang shar shi ba'i sdug bsngal bam ro gan rkyal du byas pa/ rus sbal gyi yan lag bzhi la/ lo zla zhag dus kyi ngar glud rim pa bzhin lag g.yas nas brtsam dkar ser dmar nag bzhi bzhag /shar lhor zon nam gab rtse ljang gu'i steng du lo'i pho nya lo bdag gi mgo can/ lho nub tu pho nya zla bdag gi mgo can/ nub byang du pho nya zhag bdag gi mgo can/ byang shar du pho nya dus tshod kyi mgo can/ de'i phyi rol pho mo gang yin gyi ngar glud bcu drug dang*/ de bzhin mar me/ changs bu/ ting lo/ gtor chung*/ sha dum/ 'brang rgyas so sor bcu drug re dang*/ de'i phyi rol du nam mkha' bcu drug dang*/ yang de bzhin rgyang bu/ mda' bkra/ 'phang bkra/ gri/ khram shing*/ shing ris sogs bcu drug re 'dzugs/ de'i phyi rol tshon skud sna lngas mdos chings brgyab/ mdos gzhi'i mdun du snam bu dkar po 'doms pa brgyad dang*/ nag po 'doms pa brgyad kyi dkar nag mtshams nas dmar pos sbrel/

snam bu dkar po'i steng 'bru dkar gyi g.yung drung bcu drug rim par bris/ de bzhin nag po'i steng du'ang 'bru nag gis hom gzugs khram gyis bskor ba bcu drug bri/ de nas nad pa hom khung de'i mdun du bzhag /snam bu dkar nag mtshams der zangs ngam shing gi gzhong par chus bkang ba'i steng*/ zam pa phyed dkar phyed nag bya zhing*/ zam pa dkar po'i du steng nad pa'i bla rtags so sor yod na 'jog /med tshe spyi la mar gyi bla lug bzhag srol 'dug /zam pa nag po'i khar mi lus gnam lo'i lo bdag gi mgo can zhags pa thogs pa bla rtags 'khrid tshul bya/ gzhan yang g.yas g.yon du bla 'bod byed mkhan pho mo rnams dang*/ rdzongs 'debs shel tshig khri dkar dang*/ khram shing*/ pho mtshan mo mtshan/ shwa rdel dkar nag brgya las ma nyung bar bya/ gdan nag steng du nad pa dngos sam/ min kyang 'dra gzugs bzhag /gzhi dkar g.yung drung bris pa'i steng du tshe dpag med kyi sku bsham/ bla rtags la dar thag dkar po brgyab pa'i sne mo mda' dar la btags/ phye mar zas dkar sna tshogs bsham/ gzhan yang mdos kyi phyogs bzhir snal ma bzhi'i thag pa nad par btags pa'i tshul bya'o/ /de nas dngos gzhi'i tshe sgrub bsnyen pa grub nas tshe 'gugs dang mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying mchod bstod bar bya/ de nas rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi mchod pa byin rlabs nas gzhung bsrangs shing bsnyen pa bzla/ de nas bum pa bsgrubs la mchod bstod 'od zhu sogs spyi ltar bya'o/ /de nas rang lugs gsol kha dang tshogs mchod drang ba'i bar song la/ skabs 'dir mdos gzhi chu gtsang gis bran la/

oṃ sarba pra phywaṃ shwa dha na ye swā hā: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: de nas mdun bskyed ni: oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i mdun du: gling bzhi ri rab rol mtsho de la 'byung ba lnga yis bskor ba de la yongs su rdzogs pa: de yi dbus su ma hā gser sbal chen po gan rkyal du nyal ba'i mgo bo lhor bstan pa: de yi dbus su khro rgyal tshe bdag nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: shin tu khro zhing dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa: phyag g.yas dbyug pa dang g.yon pas lcags sgrog 'dzin pa: zhabs dor stabs dang ldan zhing bskal pa'i me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong du bzhugs pa: tshe bdud 'byung po thams cad dbang du bsdus shing zil gyis gnon par gyur: oṃ badz+ra tsan+ḍa aḥyu ṣe ma hā kro ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ hoḥ srid pa'i rus sbal chen po'i glo g.yas shing las grub pa'i steng du: lha'i bdud dkar po ral gri dang zhags pa 'dzin pa: mgo bo me las grub pa'i steng du: phung po'i bdud ser po ral gri dang khram shing 'dzin pa: glo g.yon lcags las grub pa'i steng du: nyon mongs pa'i bdud dmar po ral gri dang nad rkyal thogs pa: mjug ma chu las grub pa'i steng du: 'chi bdag gi bdud nag po g.yas ral gri dang g.yon shwa rde'u thogs pa: shar lhor srid pa'i bud med nag mo skye ba'i sdug bsngal phru gu btsas pa: lho nub tu las kyi khyo gzugs rgas shing 'khog ste 'khar ba thogs pa: nub byang du na ba'i sdug bsngal gzhogs phab nas nyal ba: byang shar shi ba'i sdug bsngal bam ro gan rkyal: rus sbal gyi lag pa g.yas su lo rgyal po'i glud dkar po: lag pa g.yon du zla ba blon po'i glud ser po: rkang pa g.yas su zhag dmag mi'i glud dmar po: rkang pa g.yon du dus tshod mtshon cha'i glud nag po: de yi shar lhor lo bdud kyi pho nya lo bdag gi mgo can:

'di nas lo gang yin kha bsgyur dgos so: g.yas satwa re dang g.yon khram baṃ thogs pa: lho nub tu zla ba bdud gcod pho nya zla ba'i mgo can: gong bzhin: g.yas zor ba dang g.yon nad rkyal thogs pa: nub byang du zhag gi bdud gcod kyi pho nya zhag gi mgo can: gong ltar: g.yas tho ba dang g.yon zhags nag thogs pa: byang shar du dus tshod bdud gcod kyi pho nya dus tshod kyi mgo can: gong ltar/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon mi lag thogs pa: de'i phyi rol du sku glud rin chen bcu drug: mtshams rnams su rim pa bzhin mar me changs bu ting lo gtor chung sha dum 'brang rgyas te bcu drug bdun gyis bskor ba: de'i phyi rol du nam mkha' rgyang bu mda' bkra 'phang bkra gri dmar khram nag bzlog pa'i shing ris sna tshogs bcu drug bdun gyis bskor ba: de yi phyi rol du 'byung lnga'i rgya chings dang ldan pa: gzhan yang srid pa'i gtor glud yas la dbang ba'i mgron rnams kyis bskor ba gsal bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra ṭāk+ki rā dza hūm̐ dzaḥ de nas bden stobs brjod cing lan gsum 'gugs: na moḥ mchog gsum rtsa brgyud bla ma dang : yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam tshig can: sgrub pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya'i ting 'dzin gyi: bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs nus pa yis: bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag la: gnod par byed pa'i tshe bdud bar chod dang : lo zla zhag dus za ma dus tshod kyi: 'chi bdag las kyi pho nya bgegs rigs rnams: gtor glud gzugs brnyan 'di la mchis par gyur: oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ rat+na pā sha hūm̐: pad+ma s+pho ṭa baṃ: karma ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ lan gsum gyis dgug la/ bden stobs brjod pa ni/ hūm̐: nga ni thog ma'i sangs rgyas snang mtha' yas: nga ni mgon po 'chi med tshe yi bdag: nga ni dus gsum sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung : nga ni dbang chen khro rgyal he ru kaḥ nga ni srid gsum gdug pa sgrol ba'i mchog:

nga ni snang srid kun gyi gnyen po che: 'chi bdag zhag dus lo zla'i pho nya rnams: mchog gsum dkon mchog bden pa'i bka' la nyon: ting 'dzin bla med sngags kyi don la ltos: sangs rgyas rkang gnyis gtso ste bden pa'i mchog: chos nyid chags dang bral te bden pa'i mchog: tshogs gnyis dge 'dun 'dus te bden pa'i mchog: deng 'dir 'dus pa'i rig 'dzin bden pa'i tshig: rtsa gsum bka' la mi nyan gang yang med: zab mo don la mi sems gang yang med: mna' dang khrims la mi 'dzem gang yang med: rgyu 'bras las la mi gzhig gang yang med: skye 'gro lam la mi bgrod gang yang med: rgya mtsho'i chu la mi 'thung gang yang med: 'phang ba'i srog la mi 'dzem gang yang med: byams pa'i tshig la mi mgu gang yang med: gdung ba'i gnyen la mi skyo gang yang med: de bas dam tshig bka' las 'da' ma byed: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bden pa'i tshig brjod/ de nas bdud bzhi'i lan du smra ba ni/ zhu ba po dngos su bskos pa'am min kyang g.yon gral gyis zhu len tshul du 'di skad do/ kyaiḥ dpa' bo chen po snyan gsan 'tshal: nged bdud bzhi dus kyi pho nya ste: sngags 'chang rgyal pos bos phyir 'ong : dus gsum sangs rgyas sgra tshig la: log par lta ba ma yin kyang : rnam rtog srid pa'i skye bo rnams: tshogs drug 'khrul par a 'thas te: tshul bzhin spyod par ma lags na: rnam rtog sems kyi bdud bzung pas: de phyir nged rnams dgra ru langs: rjes shes bag yod ma ldan pas: dug lnga 'khrul rgyun so mar spyad: dge ba'i las dang mi ldan pas: le lo bag med yon bdag 'di: nged kyi gnas su gtong bar zhu: mi 'os kha 'dzin mi mdzad 'tshal: zhes zhus par slob dpon dang dbu mdzad sogs kyis lan gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: tshogs drug 'khrul pa'i bdud rnams legs par nyon: bdag ni 'chi med khro rgyal he ru kaḥ bdud bzhi gcod pa'i ral gri rno dbal mchog:

bar chod khyod kyis dbang du mi gtong nges: yon bdag 'di yi bla srog tshur thongs la: phyin chad 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig: de nas bdud tshogs sam g.yon gral kyis zhu ba ni/ kyaiḥ dpa' bo chen po gsan cing dgongs su gsol: nged rnams bdud kyi dpung tshogs chen po ste: bka' dang dam la gnas par mi 'os kyang : sngon nas da bar rgyal ba'i dka' ma nyan: dus drug bdud kyi dpung 'dis 'tshe ba'i khung : mu stegs nag pos sangs rgyas bka' mi nyan: brgya byin nag pos rgyal ba'i gsung mi rtsi: ru tra sde dgus mna' dang khrel mi 'dzem: thar pa nag pos rgyu 'bras don mi sems: bya rigs sna tshogs skye 'gro'i lam mi snyegs: mkha' lding rgyal pos yur ba'i chu mi 'thung : snang srid rlung gis 'phang ba'i srog mi 'dzems: log lta can gyis byams pa'i chos mi nyan: khrel med rnams kyis nye ba'i gnyen mi skyong : bdud bzhi'i bar chad sngags 'chang bshol mi thebs: dus la bab pas sdod pa'i yul ma mchis: bdud bzhi nged kyis dbang du gtong bar gyis: lan gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: nyon cig rig 'dzin sngags 'chang tshig la nyon: nga ni dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos: nga yi tshig 'di mi shigs rdo rje'i gsung : rgyu 'bras las 'di 'khor 'das kun la khyab: mu stegs rnams kyang g.yung drung gtam la nyan: brgya byin nag pos tshangs pa'i gsung la rtsi: ru tra sde dgu dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal 'jigs: thar pa nag pos tha ma rgyu 'bras bsam: bya rigs sna tshogs grib ma thang la 'gro: mkha' lding rgyal pos srid pa'i chu la 'thung : sgra gcan rlung gis nyon mongs rlung yang gcod: log lta can yang rgyu 'bras chos kyis grol: khrel med rnams kyang rang 'dod gnyen rnams skyong : bdud bzhi'i bar chad 'jal lan grub ste zhi: dus la bab kyang bden pa'i tshig gis bsring : 'od gsal snying rjes bdud bzhi'i dpung rnams 'joms:

ma rig rkyen dbang bdud la ngas mi gtong : de bas bdud bzhi bden gnyis tshig la nyon: ma rig 'joms pa'i dam chos nyi 'od gsal: 'khrul gzugs bdud rnams lta bas rang sar grol: kun brtags rang gi lus la dpe longs la: bdag med gzhan la gnod par ma byed cig: ces snying rje yang dag gi ngang la bstan par bya'o/ zhu ba ni/ kyaiḥ dpa' bo chen po snyan gsan 'tshal: bdag gis ci nas bka' nyan gyi: mi las lhag pa'i tshab thongs 'tshal: nor las lhag pa'i phyugs thongs 'tshal: zas las lhag pa'i bcud thongs 'tshal: zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ yon bdag bslu rin sbyin par thag bcad nas mdos kyi byung khungs bshad pa ni/ hūm̐: nyon cig bdud bzhi pho nya rnams: glud dang mdos kyi byung khungs bzang : 'dzam gling 'di yi bkod pa las: de ring bshams pa'i glud 'di che: sngon tshe 'og min zhing mchog tu: lha bu don gsal legs 'byung la: sna tshogs 'gyu ba'i bdud bzhi byung : ma rig dus kyi pho nyas sdang : 'chi ltas bar chad brtsams pa'i tshe: thog ma'i sangs rgyas snang mtha' yis: gti mug rnam rtog bdud bzhi rnams: snying rje bla med byams sems kyis: ye shes bzhi sbyor dkyil 'khor bshams: kun gzhi klong yangs sems bskyed byas: gang shar 'dzin med mchod sbyin gyis: ma rig bdud bzhi dbyings su grol: de bas sngon gyi tha tshig nyon: de 'og tshangs pa'i gnas mchog tu: lha yi dbang po brgya byin la: nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa yis: rtag lta bar chod bdud bzhi byung : 'dzin pa dus kyi pho nyas sdang : 'chi ltas bar chad brtsams pa'i tshe: longs sku 'dzin med dbang phyug gis: kun shes ye grol dkyil 'khor bshams: ma 'gags 'dzin med ting 'dzin bsgoms: du ma ro gcig sems kyang bskyed: dran rig lta ba'i mchod sbyin gyis: bag chags bdud bzhi rang sar grol: de bas sngon gyi tha tshig nyon: de 'og dpal gyi bsam yas su: chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan la:

rnam g.yeng 'khrul ba 'byams pa yi: bag chags 'khrul gzugs bdud bzhi byung : nyon mongs rlung gi pho nyas sdang : 'chi ltas bar chod brtsams pa'i tshe: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: 'od gsal gnyug ma'i dkyil 'khor bshams: dbyings rig ka dag ting 'dzin bsgoms: nyag gcig theg chen sems bskyed nas: zang thal dmigs med mchod sbyin bsngos: le lo rnam g.yeng bdud bzhi grol: de bas sngon gyi tha tshig nyon: ma 'ongs da lta'i dus bskal du: skal ldan yon gyi bdag po 'di: phra rags rtog par ngar 'dzin pa'i: dug lnga hrag pa'i bdud bzhi byung : rlung lnga ma snyoms pho nyas sdang : 'chi ltas bar chad brtsams pa la: rig 'dzin sngags 'chang rnal 'byor gyis: kun snang 'phrul gyi dkyil 'khor bshams: dran rig rang shar ting 'dzin bsgom: tshad med bzhi ldan sems bskyed de: spros bsgyur du ma'i mchod sbyin gyis: deng nas kun rtog re kha khengs: bdud bzhi bdag med chos kyis grol: sbyin bdag bsod nams tshogs kyis bslu: de bas bdud bzhi pho nya rnams: chos nyid rang byung tshig la nyon: phan sems byang chub ldan gyur cig: de nas spyi glud bsngo ba ni: hūm̐: srid pa'i mdos glud chen po 'di: de ring gtong ba'i yul smos pa: shar phyogs dung mkhar ldem pa nas: srid pa'i lha bdud mi bo dkar: 'chi bdag lo yi pho nya dang : srid par skyes pa'i mya ngan can: shar phyogs bdud kyi tshogs bcas la: sbyin bdag bla tshe bslu ba yi: 'dod yon yas stags sna tshogs bsngo: snang gsal 'od kyi sgron me 'di: yon bdag sems kyi tshab tu gtong : changs bu lo skor tshang ba 'di: yon bdag ngag gi tshab tu gtong : dkar nag spel ba'i 'brang rgyas 'di: yon bdag bla dwags tshab tu gtong : ro mchog rgyan gyi ting lo 'di: yon bdag lus kyi tshab tu gtong : bcud ldan sha khrag dum bu 'di: yon bdag nor gyi tshab tu gtong : sna tshogs mdzes pa'i nam mkha' 'di:

yon bdag rgyan gyi tshab tu gtong : rgyang bu 'od zer ldan pa 'di: yon bdag yul zhing tshab tu gtong : mda' bkra 'ja' ris 'khyugs pa 'di: yon bdag pho yi glud du 'bul: 'phang bkra ldem zhing khyug khyug 'di: za ma mo yi glud du gtong : go mtshon ral gri 'bar ba 'di: yon bdag go mtshon tshab tu gtong : las kyi khram shing nag po 'di: lo yi bar chad tshab tu gtong : dmod pa'i shing bkra nag po 'di: dus la bab pa'i tshab tu gtong : sku glud rin chen rgyan ldan 'di: yon bdag bslu ba'i tshab tu gtong : gling bzhi tshang ba'i mdos gdan 'di: de ring bdud dang pho nyar bsngo: deng phyin yul la ma chags shig: bla med mchod sbyin 'di bsngos pas: 'chi bdag zhags pa nag po chod: bla tshe yal ba myur du khug: tshe yi 'ju thag dbyings la mthud: srog gi rten phur sa la tshugs: tshe yi g.yung drung brtan gyur cig: oṃ aḥhūm̐ hrīḥswā hā: hūm̐: srid pa'i mdos glud chen po 'di: de ring gtong ba'i yul smos pa: lho phyogs gser mkhar ldem pa nas: phung po bdud kyi rgyal po ser: 'chi bdag zla ba'i pho nya dang : rgas pa'i sdug bsngal nyon mongs pa: lho phyogs bdud kyi tshogs bcas la: sbyin bdag bla tshe bslu ba yi: 'dod yon yas stags sna tshogs bsngo: snang gsal 'od kyi sgron me 'di: yon bdag sems kyi tshab tu gtong : changs bu lo skor tshang ba 'di: yon bdag ngag gi tshab tu gtong : dkar nag spel ba'i 'brang rgyas 'di: yon bdag bla dwags tshab tu gtong : ro mchog rgyan gyi ting lo 'di: yon bdag lus kyi tshab tu gtong : bcud ldan sha khrag dum bu 'di: yon bdag nor gyi tshab tu gtong : sna tshogs mdzes pa'i nam mkha' 'di: yon bdag rgyan gyi tshab tu gtong : rgyang bu 'od zer ldan pa 'di: yon bdag yul zhing tshab tu gtong : mda' bkra 'ja' ris 'khyugs pa 'di: yon bdag pho yi glud du 'bul: 'phang bkra ldem zhing khyug khyug 'di:

za ma mo yi glud du gtong : go mtshon ral gri 'bar ba 'di: yon bdag go mtshon tshab tu gtong : las kyi khram shing nag po 'di: lo yi bar chad tshab tu gtong : dmod pa'i shing bkra nag po 'di: dus la bab pa'i tshab tu gtong : sku glud rin chen rgyan ldan 'di: yon bdag bslu ba'i tshab tu gtong : gling bzhi tshang ba'i mdos gdan 'di: de ring bdud dang pho nyar bsngo: deng phyin yul la ma chags shig: bla med mchod sbyin 'di bsngos pas: 'chi bdag zhags pa nag po chod: bla tshe yal ba myur du khug: tshe yi 'ju thag dbyings la mthud: srog gi rten phur sa la tshugs: tshe yi g.yung drung brtan gyur cig: oṃ aḥhūm̐ hrīḥswā hā: hūm̐: srid pa'i mdos glud chen po 'di: de ring gtong ba'i yul smos pa: nub phyogs zangs mkhar ldem pa nas: nyon mongs bdud kyi rgyal po dmar: 'chi bdag zhag gi pho nya dang : na ba'i sdug bsngal gzhogs phab pa: nub phyogs bdud kyi tshogs bcas la: sbyin bdag bla tshe bslu ba yi: 'dod yon yas stags sna tshogs bsngo: snang gsal 'od kyi sgron me 'di: yon bdag sems kyi tshab tu gtong : changs bu lo skor tshang ba 'di: yon bdag ngag gi tshab tu gtong : dkar nag spel ba'i 'brang rgyas 'di: yon bdag bla dwags tshab tu gtong : ro mchog rgyan gyi ting lo 'di: yon bdag lus kyi tshab tu gtong : bcud ldan sha khrag dum bu 'di: yon bdag nor gyi tshab tu gtong : sna tshogs mdzes pa'i nam mkha' 'di: yon bdag rgyan gyi tshab tu gtong : rgyang bu 'od zer ldan pa 'di: yon bdag yul zhing tshab tu gtong : mda' bkra 'ja' ris 'khyugs pa 'di: yon bdag pho yi glud du 'bul: 'phang bkra ldem zhing khyug khyug 'di: za ma mo yi glud du gtong : go mtshon ral gri 'bar ba 'di: yon bdag go mtshon tshab tu gtong : las kyi khram shing nag po 'di: lo yi bar chad tshab tu gtong : dmod pa'i shing bkra nag po 'di:

dus la bab pa'i tshab tu gtong : sku glud rin chen rgyan ldan 'di: yon bdag bslu ba'i tshab tu gtong : gling bzhi tshang ba'i mdos gdan 'di: de ring bdud dang pho nyar bsngo: deng phyin yul la ma chags shig: bla med mchod sbyin 'di bsngos pas: 'chi bdag zhags pa nag po chod: bla tshe yar ba myur du khug: tshe yi 'ju thag dbyings la mthud: srog gi rten phur sa la tshugs: tshe yi g.yung drung brtan gyur cig: oṃ aḥhūm̐ hrīḥswā hā: hūm̐: srid pa'i mdos glud chen po 'di: de ring gtong ba'i yul smos pa: byang phyogs lcags mkhar ldem pa nas: srog bdag bdud kyi rgyal po nag: 'chi bdag dus kyi pho nya dang : shi ba'i sman chung gzhon nu ma: byang phyogs bdud kyi tshogs bcas la: sbyin bdag bla tshe bslu ba yi: 'dod yon yas stags sna tshogs bsngo: snang gsal 'od kyi sgron me 'di: yon bdag sems kyi tshab tu gtong : changs bu lo skor tshang ba 'di: yon bdag ngag gi tshab tu gtong : dkar nag spel ba'i 'brang rgyas 'di: yon bdag bla dwags tshab tu gtong : ro mchog rgyan gyi ting lo 'di: yon bdag lus kyi tshab tu gtong : bcud ldan sha khrag dum bu 'di: yon bdag nor gyi tshab tu gtong : sna tshogs mdzes pa'i nam mkha' 'di: yon bdag rgyan gyi tshab tu gtong : rgyang bu 'od zer ldan pa 'di: yon bdag yul zhing tshab tu gtong : mda' bkra 'ja' ris 'khyugs pa 'di: yon bdag pho yi glud du 'bul: 'phang bkra ldem zhing khyug khyug 'di: za ma mo yi glud du gtong : go mtshon ral gri 'bar ba 'di: yon bdag go mtshon tshab tu gtong : las kyi khram shing nag po 'di: lo yi bar chad tshab tu gtong : dmod pa'i shing bkra nag po 'di: dus la bab pa'i tshab tu gtong : sku glud rin chen rgyan ldan 'di: yon bdag bslu ba'i tshab tu gtong : gling bzhi tshang ba'i mdos gdan 'di: de ring bdud dang pho nyar bsngo: deng phyin yul la ma chags shig:

bla med mchod sbyin 'di bsngos pas: 'chi bdag zhags pa nag po chod: bla tshe yar ba myur du khug: tshe yi 'ju thag dbyings la mthud: srog gi rten phur sa la tshugs: tshe yi g.yung drung brtan gyur cig: oṃ aḥhūm̐ hrīḥswā hā:

de nas bla glud gtong len gyi zhu lan bya ba ni/ bla 'bod byed pa'i pho mo rnams 'tshogs shing slob dpon gyi phyogs nas/ hūm̐: bdud bzhi'i pho nya sdug bsngal zhi: rten 'brel bcu gnyis bdag po'i tshogs: sngags 'chang rig 'dzin bdag la nyon: sbyin bdag tshe 'di bslu ba yi: dgyes pa'i yas stags sna tshogs tshang : chags pa'i bu lon sha 'khon 'khor: mi dang yas gnyis brje ba'i dus: bla dang glud gnyis brje ba'i dus: dkar nag gdan sa bgo ba'i dus: bla 'bod pho nya 'gyed pa'i dus: bdud bzhi'i zhal kha bsgyur ba'i dus: 'chi bdag zhags pa gcod pa'i dus: tshe bdud dur kha bzlog pa'i dus: sbyin bdag tshe thar gtong ba'i dus: 'chi bdag bdud kyi sde tshogs kyis: sbyin bdag 'di yi bla thongs 'tshal: de nas bdud kyi tshogs rnams bslu ba'i yon gyis ngoms shing tshims nas slad phyin yon bdag tha tshig la gnas nus min 'dri ba ni/ nged rnams las kyis grub pa'i bdud: sbyin bdag bshol ba'i rdzongs yag go: sbyin bdag bshol ba'i rdzongs mdzes so: gal te bla 'di gtong lags na: sbyin bdag byang sems ldan lags sam: phyi 'phro chos la bskyal lags sam: srog gcod sdig par 'dzem lags sam: tshe yi dam tshig bsrung lags sam: nges par skal ba ldan lags na: sngags 'chang slob dpon bka' bzhin mchis: 'on kyang skal ngan sdig can rigs: bla 'di gtong bar mi rigs kyi: nged rnam dus gsum sangs rgyas la: skal yod tshe sring skal med bkums: de ltar tha tshig bgyis pa ste: ma rig gti mug myos pa yis: dkar po khyad du gsod pa'i rigs: zang zing rgyu yis bslus pa rnams: lha bdud nga dang 'bral glags med: le lo can gyi bdud yin pas: lo yi pho nyas de ltar sdang : ma rig dbang gis srid par skye: sdug bsngal shugs kyis rang bzhin grub: snying ring de yi bla mi gtong : zhe sdang nga rgyal las dbang gis: srog gcod gtub dang mtshams med las:

mi dge'i zas la longs spyod rnams: phung bdud nga la 'bral blag med: khong khro can gyi bdud yin pas: zla ba'i pho nyas de ltar sdang : bag med las la rgas shing 'khog: mya ngan phung bdud shugs la 'byung : rigs ngan de yi bla mi gtong : 'dod sred chags pa'i las dbang gis: chags 'dzin ser sna 'khrig cing sbyor: dug lnga kho nar spyod pa rnams: nyon mongs bdud la 'bral glags med: bdag 'dzin can gyi bdud yin pas: zhag gi pho nyas de ltar sdang : gnyis 'dzin rnam rtog rkyen dbang gis: nyam thag zug rngu shugs las 'byung : dam med de yi bla mi gtong : khro 'khrug phrag dog las dbang gis: rgyu 'bras dkar nag tshad du bor: mtshams med bcu la spyod pa rnams: 'chi bdud nga la 'bral glags med: khengs sems can gyi bdud yin pas: dus tshod pho nyas de ltar sdang : sngon las 'phral rkyen dbang gi 'chi: rigs drug duḥkha'i thag pa myong : skal med de yi bla mi gtong : de ltar sngags 'chang rgyal po yi: yon bdag 'di yi gdeng len 'tshal: de nas slob dpon gyis yon bdag la 'dri ba ni/ hoḥ sbyin bdag skal bar ldan nam: zhes dris par/ sbyin bdag gis/ ldan lags: zhes dang*/ de bzhin du/ sbyin bdag chos dang mthun nam: mthun lags: sbyin bdag tshe srog gcod par 'dzem mam: 'dzem lags: sbyin bdag mi dge bcu por 'dzem mam: 'dzem lags: mtshams med pa lngar 'dzem mam: 'dzem lags: las ngan pa'i dbang du gyur par 'dzem mam: 'dzem lags: tshe bdud bar chad kyi dbang du mi 'gro bar byed dam: mdzod lags: 'chi bdag bdud kyi dbang mi gtong bar 'gyur ram: legs zhu: bla rang gnas su 'gug gam: skyel lags: 'chi bdag bdud kyi zhags pa gcod dam: chod lags: khyod kyi srog gi glud du tshe thar mang po gtong ngam: gtong lags: dge bcu'i sna thag bsring ngam: legs par bgyi'o: de nas slob dpon phyogs kyis bdud tshogs la lan gdab pa ni/ hūm̐:

nyon cig tshe bdud bar chad rnams: skal ba ldan pa'i sbyin bdag 'di: legs lam dge bcu dag dang ldan: bskal pa yar ldan bzang po'i mi: rten 'brel sna tshogs 'dzoms pa'i lus: tshe tshad stong phrag dag dang ldan: dus gsum sangs rgyas smon lam gyis: tshe 'phrang dbang du mi 'gyur zhing : 'ja' lus rdo rje'i srog dang ldan: dam tshig ldan pa'i yon bdag 'di: mi tshe ring ste chos ring nas: skal ldan 'di yi bla 'di thongs: khyed rnams dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi: spyan sngar khas blangs dam ma bkral: dam tshig gnyan gyi grogs po rnams: skye med ting 'dzin don yang bstan: snying rje drag po'i rdzongs btab nas: phyogs med chos sku'i klong du skyol: de bas ji ltar khas len 'tshal: de nas bdud tshogs rnams snang ba dge la gyur zhing dam tshig khas len par zhu lan 'bul ba ni/ kyaiḥ sngags 'chang rig 'dzin snyan gsan 'tshal: phun sum tshogs pa'i sbyin bdag rnams: nged rnams sngags 'chang bka' la nyan: rgyu 'bras las kyi chos la brtsi: khas blangs dam tshig don dang ldan: ting 'dzin chos kyi brda la nyan: bla 'di nga yis btang ba yis: phyogs med gnas su 'khyams srid pas: pho nya bskul la ming nas bos: zhags pa gcod pa'i ral gri phyungs: hom khung bcu drug gdan 'di spos: las ngan 'khor ba'i zam pa shobs: rgyu 'bras dkar nag sa mtshams phyes: rnam rtog lo dgra gnas su rdzongs: g.yung drung gdan du bzhag khrus gsol: rang mal gnas su skyel bar gyis: nged rnams bla med lam ston 'tshal: mi zad longs spyod rdzong 'debs 'tshal: rang rang mthun pa'i chas bstan 'tshal: 'og min zhing du ma sleb bar: grogs dang ra mda' skyel ma 'tshal: ci ltar bka' stsal bgyis lags so: de nas bla 'gugs pho nya 'gyed pa ni/ rigs bzang pho mo gnyis kyis rigs lnga dang rgyan chas spras la/ lag tu tshe mda' dang rdo rje gtad la/ mtshams rnams su mda' dar g.yab/ gser skyems sbreng zhing mi mang rnams kyis phyi rol nas bla 'bod gtong*/

hūm̐ bh+yoḥ mi mngon nam mkha'i klong yangs nas: ma yum chen thugs las sprul pa'i sras: tshe bdag rdo rje rnam 'byor ma: tshe 'dzin dpa' bo dpa' mos bskor: yang sprul rigs bzhi pho nyar 'gyed: dbu skra thor tshugs shigs se shig: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: rus pa'i rgyan cha khro lo lo: g.yer kha dril bu si li li: myur mgyogs gar stabs khyugs se khyug: byin rlabs 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: thugs rje'i glog dmar tshubs se tshub: nus rtsal gzi brjid spungs se spung : bla 'gugs mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum: thugs dam bzhengs bskul dus la bab: phud rgod gser skyems 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag gi: bla tshe bdud kyis 'phrog pa rnams: da lta nyid du khug la shog: lha srin 'byung po'i rigs rnams kyis: bla 'di sba 'am brkus pa rnams: phyogs bcur khyab pa'i pho nya yis: gab skung phud de khug la shog: rgyal bsen sman mo 'dre rgod kyis: bar du gcod cing gnod srid na: rtsal chen drag pos chad pa phob: las kyi mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum: mi bla bdud la ma bskur 'tshal: bla rten srog mkhar 'di la khug: don med bla 'khyams ma 'ded par: dmod pa'i bla 'di khug la shog: ming dang gzugs phung 'di la khug: gnas dang mal sa 'di la khug: srog dang rten phur 'di la khug: tshe yi dar thag rgyud nas khug: srog gi mda' mo'i rgyud nas khug: bla yi rdo rje'i rgyud nas khug: ming gi mtshan byang rgyud nas khug: ma sring mkha' 'gro mthu ma chung : rbad pa'i pho nya rtsal ma zhan: mngags pa'i ra mda' bang ma bul: 'khyams pa'i bla 'di khug la shog: steng 'og phyogs bcu'i bdud gzhom pa'i: me dpung tshwa tshwas khongs la shog: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: oṃ badz+ra muṃ wā ra hī ḍāk+ki nī ha ri ni sa dzaḥ ā yur+dzñā na ṇi badz+ra aṃ ku sha ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes mda' dar g.yab cing mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum gyis phyogs bcur khyab ste:

bla tshe yal ba thams cad bsdus shing : chaig la bstim par bsam: de nas nad pa'i glud gzugs de hoṃ re re'i kha nas drangs la/ hūm̐: ma sring rgyal mo tshe 'dzin ma: de ring skal ldan rigs kyi bu: 'chi bdag nyon mongs tshang nas bshig: bdud zhags chod la tshe 'phrang sgrol: dang po 'chi dal nag po nas: gdan bgos yar la spo bar gyis: 'chi bdag zhags pa nag po chod: gnyis pa bdud kyi lag nas spo: 'chi bdag zhags pa nag po chod: gsum pa btsan gyi lag nas spo: 'chi bdag zhags pa nag po chod: bzhi pa klu yi lag nas spo: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa chod: lnga pa gnod sbyin lag nas spo: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa chod: drug pa ma mo'i lag nas spo: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa chod: bdun pa rgyal po'i lag nas spo: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa chod: brgyad pa srin po'i lag nas spo: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa chod: dgu pa lha bdud lag nas spo: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa chod: bcu pa sman mo'i lag nas spo: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa chod: bcu gcig dmu yi lag nas spo: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa chod: bcu gnyis gza' yi lag nas spo: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa chod: bcu gsum the'u rang lag nas spo: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa chod: bcu bzhi bgegs kyi lag nas spo: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa chod: bco lnga dri za'i lag nas spo: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa chod: bcu drug gshin rje'i lag nas spo: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa chod: bcu bdun bdud kyi yul nas thar: de nas 'chi bdag bdud bzhi'i zhags pa bcad pa ni/ mdos kyi phyogs bzhir nad par btags pa'i thag pa bcad la/ hūm̐: ma rig nyon mongs lha yi bdud: rtag par lta ba'i zhags pa chod: nga rgyal khengs sems phung po'i bdud: chad par lta ba'i zhags pa chod: nyon mongs 'dod chags srid pa'i bdud: dngos por lta ba'i zhags pa chod:

phrag dog khengs sems 'chi bdag bdud: rmongs par lta ba'i zhags pa chod: tshe 'phrang bdud kyi zhags pa chod: de nas bla rtags la lo bdud kyi zhags pa btab pa bcad cing*/ hoḥ tshe bdud nag po mgo bo can: de ring sbyin bdag bla thongs la: 'chi bdag dus kyi pho nya zlog: 'dzin pa'i zhags pa nag po chod: oṃ raṃ raṃ ṭa ṭa phaṭḥ ces bcad cing de nas dar dkar gyi sne mo 'then la g.yung drung gi gdan la dgod/ hūm̐: tshe 'dzin srung ma 'khor bcas kyis: bla rtags sor chud yar la khrid: pha rol bdud kyi lag nas thar: tshe yi dar thag yar la 'then: mi 'gyur g.yung drung gdan la bzhugs: ā yur+ṣe tiṣ+ṭha lhan: zam bgo gdan bgo bya ba ni/ dkar nag srid pa lha yi zam: lhan cig skyes pa lha dang bdud: rgyu 'bras dkar nag las kyi gdan: de ring bgo ba'i dus la bab: lhan cig skyes pa'i srung ma lha: lha zam dkar po yar la 'then: bdud kyi zam pa mar la ldog: 'byung ba me yis mtshams chod cig: srung ma tshe 'dzin mkha' 'gro ma: lha gdan dkar po yar la 'dzin: bdud kyi bshos gdan mar la ldog: 'byung ba chu yis mtshams chod cig: dgra gshed sprad pa'i mtshams bcad do: tshe yi bdud gcod bzlog tu gsol: oṃ raṃ tsakra khaṃ tsakra ye swā hā: zhes lha zam yar 'then la mes mtshams bcad/ zam pa nag po mar bsdus la mtshams chus bcad/ gdan nag po ldog /zam nag de mdos nang 'bul/ de nas dpon slob tshang mas mgrin gcig tu 'di skad do/ hoḥ bla thar ro: tshe thar ro: zhes brjod/ nad pa'am 'dra gzugs de gdan dkar g.yung drung khar spo/ gdan nag po de mdos lam du dpyangs shing sne mor dkar gtor bzhag /chab kyis bran la sde brgyad gser skyems 'don zhing gtor ma mdos lam du 'bul/ gdan nag steng du lo bdag gi pho nya de bzhag la 'don tshig dang bstun zhing glud rnams rim gyis phyogs so sor dgod/ de nas mdos sgo phyes shing bsngo ba ni/

shar phyogs lha bu'i bdud tshogs la shel tshig sogs rdzongs su gdab la/ hūm̐: gling bzhi'i pho brang la gnas pa'i: mdos dang yas kyi bdag po rnams: rdzongs 'debs drag po 'di khyer la: sgo phyes lam bstan dus la bab: shar phyogs pho brang bdag po mchog: lha bu'i bdud kyi tshogs bcas rnams: shel tshig khri dkar stong nag 'bul: sgo phyes shar du lam bstan no: shar phyogs srid pa'i yul rtse ru: dung mkhar ldem pa'i nang shed na: dung las grub pa'i 'jig rten chags: 'dod yon zang zing zad pa med: ting 'dzin zag med de ru mngon: gnas der khyod kyi lam bstan no: mun pa'i steng du gdan spo 'tshal: zhes lha bdud 'khor tshogs dang bcas pa gdan nag gi shar phyogs su bskyal/ de nas lhor phung po'i bdud tshogs la khram shing sogs rdzongs su gdab la/ hūm̐: lho phyogs pho brang bdag po mchog: phung po bdud kyi tshogs bcas rnams: dkar nag khram shing stong nag 'bul: sgo phyes lho ru lam bstan no: hūm̐: lho phyogs srid pa'i yul de ru: gser mkhar ldem pa'i nang shed na: gser las grub pa'i 'jig rten chags: khengs sems nga rgyal zad mtha' med: mnyam nyid ye shes de ru mngon: gnas der khyod la lam bstan no: mun pa'i steng du gdan spo 'tshal: zhes phung bdud 'khor tshogs dang bcas pa gdan nag gi lho phyogs su bskyal/ nub phyogs nyon mongs pa'i bdud tshogs la pho mtshan mo mtshan sogs rdzongs su gdab la/ hūm̐: nub phyogs pho brang bdag po mchog: nyon mongs bdud kyi tshogs bcas rnams: pho mtshan mo mtshan stong nag 'bul: sgo phyes nub tu lam bstan no: hūm̐: nub phyogs srid pa'i yul rtse ru: zangs mkhar ldem pa'i nang shed na: zangs las grub pa'i 'jig rten chags: chags 'dzin sbyor ba zad mtha' med: sor rtog ye shes de ru mngon: gnas der khyod la lam bstan no: mun pa'i steng du gdan spo 'tshal: nyon mongs bdud g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa gdan nag gi nub tu bskyal/

byang phyogs 'chi bdag gi bdud tshogs la shwa rde'u dkar nag sogs rdzongs su gdab la/ hūm̐: byang gi pho brang bdag po mchog: 'chi bdag bdud kyi tshogs bcas rnams: shwa rde'u dkar nag stong nag 'bul: sgo phyes byang du lam bstan no: hūm̐: byang phyogs srid pa'i yul rtse ru: lcags mkhar ldem pa'i nang shed na: lcags las grub pa'i 'jig rten chags: phrag dog bkol spyod zad mtha' med: rtog med shes pa de ru mngon: gnas der khyod kyi lam bstan no: mun pa'i steng du gdan spo 'tshal: 'chi bdag bdud g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa gdan nag gi byang du bskyal/ de nas rdzongs 'debs bya ba ni/ hūm̐: nga ni rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung : nga ni rdo rje bdud 'dul rtsal: nga yi bka' la ma 'da' bar: rdzongs 'debs drag po 'di khyer la: bdud bzhi rang rang gnas su bskyal: shel tshig khri dkar stong nag 'di: ye shes ting 'dzin zas yin no: de yang khyod la rdzongs su 'debs: 'chi bdag pho nya bzlog tu gsol: khram shing dkar nag stong nag 'di: sna tshogs sgyu ma'i rgyan yin no: de yang khyod la rdzongs su 'debs: 'chi bdag pho nya bzlog tu gsol: 'jig rten srid pa'i mtshan rtags 'di: chags med ye shes rdzas yin no: de yang khyod la rdzongs su 'debs: 'chi bdag pho nya bzlog tu gsol: dkar nag shwa rde'u stong nag 'di: bslu brid bral ba'i rdzas yin no: de yang khyod la rdzongs su 'debs: 'chi bdag pho nya bzlog tu gsol: mi kha chod pa'i yas stags 'di: snang srid re kha kheng ba'i rdzas: de yang khyod la rdzongs su 'debs: 'chi bdag pho nya bzlog tu gsol: rgyan dang shing bkra sna tshogs 'di: bag chags sbyong ba'i rdzas yin no: de yang khyod la rdzongs su 'debs: 'chi bdag pho nya bzlog tu gsol: sku glud rin chen rgyan ldan 'di: yon bdag phung po bslu ba'i rdzas: de yang khyod la rdzongs su 'debs: 'chi bdag pho nya bzlog tu gsol:

mun pa'i lam 'di 'od gsal rgyu: de yang khyod la rdzongs su 'debs: 'chi bdag pho nya bzlog tu gsol: lo bdag lo gshed sna khrid mkhan: de yang khyod la rdzongs su 'debs: 'chi bdag pho nya bzlog tu gsol: me chu gnyis yang mtshams gcod rdzas: de yang khyod la rdzongs su 'debs: dmar nag gtor ma 'dod pa'i rdzas: de yang khyod la rdzongs su 'debs: 'chi bdag pho nya bzlog tu gsol: snang srid re kha kheng du gsol: tshe bdud dal kha dgra la sgyur: bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog:

de nas lam bstan zhing chos 'chad pa ni/ hūm̐: bstan pa'i lam de ma gtogs par: sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid kyi: g.yas g.yon phyogs mtshams thams cad kun: me ri mtshon cha rdul ltar 'khrigs: tshe bdag khro bos drag sngags ldir: rbad pa'i pho nya skar ltar 'khrugs: khro chu khol ma'i zhun ma 'khyil: gdon bgegs gab pa'i srid khung skem: ci ste gdug sems sdang gyur tshe: dus gsum sangs rgyas bka' yang bcag: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dam yang 'gal: na raka ngan song dmyal bar ltung : de bas dam las ma 'da' cig: hūm̐: bdud bzhi 'jigs byed tshogs rnams kun: khyed rnams byang sems ma mchis na: rigs drug pha ma'i rang bzhin ste: ro gcig dri med sems la ltos: khyed rnams snying rje ma mchis na: bdag gzhan rten 'brel rgyu gcig pas: bdag med 'od gsal sems la ltos: khyed rnams dga' ba ma mchis na: dug lnga sor rtog bde stong ngang : chags med gnyug ma'i rang bzhin skyongs: khyed rnams bde stong ma mchis na: thig le chen po mtha' dbus med: khyab brdal dmigs med ngang la zhog: khyed rnams lam mchog ma mchis na: zang thal phyogs bcu 'od gsal zhing : 'gro 'ong bral ba'i shes pa skyongs: bdud bzhi sems kyi cho 'phrul khyod: ye nas ma grub stong pa la: nam mkha' gzugs su ga la reg: sgyu ma'i sprul bsgyur zhig pa bzhin: khyed rnams phyogs med klong du gshegs: lhan skyes ye shes don rtogs shog: ces bdud bzhi chos nyid kyi klong du grol te/ snying rje phan sems kyi ngang du 'gro bar sems so/ mdos rnams khyer la phyogs so sor 'bul/ de nas rjes gcod zor bzlog btegs shing*/ hūm̐: khyab brdal rol pa drag po e yi klong : gru gsum thod mkhar 'bar ba'i pho brang nas: tshe bdud zlog byed khro bo las la bskul: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdud bzhi bar chod sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod:

hūm̐ bh+yoḥ ma rig las gyur bslu brid lha bu'i bdud: de ring mdos dang dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa phung po'i bdud: de ring mdos dang dmar nag gtor mas zlog: 'dzin chags srid pas bcings pa nyon mongs bdud: de ring mdos dang dmar nag gtor mas zlog: phrag dog bsad bcad gtub pa 'chi bdag bdud: de ring mdos dang dmar nag gtor mas zlog: ma dag mngal du skye ba lan chags bdud: de ring mdos dang dmar nag gtor mas zlog: sdug bsngal tshe ring smon lam log pa'i bdud: de ring mdos dang dmar nag gtor mas zlog: lus la gcong nad tshe rabs bsags pa'i bdud: de ring mdos dang dmar nag gtor mas zlog: dus min 'chi ba bar chod rkyen gyi bdud: de ring mdos dang dmar nag gtor mas zlog: lo bdud pho nya 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i bdud: de ring mdos dang dmar nag gtor mas zlog: zla bdud pho nya rnam rtog 'khrugs pa'i bdud: de ring mdos dang dmar nag gtor mas zlog: zhag bdud pho nya grib dang 'bag pa'i bdud: de ring mdos dang dmar nag gtor mas zlog: dus bdud pho nya lha srin 'gyu ba'i bdud: de ring mdos dang dmar nag gtor mas zlog: hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: sdug bsngal srid pa bcu gnyis kyis: bar chod dgra ru sdang ba zlog: dbyug gu drug cu re bzhi yis: rtsis dang khram la btab pa zlog: bdud po mtshon thogs bcu gsum gyis: dur kha gshed kha sdang ba zlog: srid pa'i bskos mkhan mi brgyad kyis: tshe bdud za kha ston pa zlog: gab rtse thogs pa'i ma mo dgus: bla tshe byad du bcug pa zlog: dmag mi sum brgya drug cu yis: za kha rtsis kha ston pa zlog: hūm̐: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog: glo bur dgu bcu rtsa gcig zlog: skag rigs bdun rgya nyer lnga zlog: dus min 'chi ba bco brgyad zlog: pho bdud dal kha g.yas su sgyur:

mo bdud dal kha g.yon du sgyur: spyi bdud dal kha mkha' la zlog: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba kro dha ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ raṃ bh+yoḥ drag bh+yoḥ gzer bh+yoḥ thun bh+yoḥ ya ma bh+yoḥ mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog: gnod byed 'byung po tshe bdud thams cad u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ ces brjod la thun gyis brdeg cing dar nag g.yab/ drag rol dang bcas khro bo'i lha tshogs rnams kyis gnod byed gdon bgegs thams cad bsregs shing ded nas/ rang gnas phyogs med rgya mtsho'i pha mthar bskrad par bsam mo/ bdud bzhi rang rang phyogs su bskyal/ lo bdud dang gtor zlog rnams phyogs gtsang du 'bul zhing phyi mig mi lta bar nang du log /sgo mtshams su tho cog bya zhing khyung dmigs dang bcas/ oṃ khroṃ ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las phyag mtshan sa bon 'phros: khor yug bar khyams srung ba'i gur khang ni: nang rnams gzhal yas 'ja' tshon lug rgyud gtibs: phyi rol mtshon cha me dpung khyab par 'khrigs: phra mo rlung yang 'gyu ba mi rigs pa'i: sra mkhregs gnam lcags sprul pa'i gur khang bsgom: oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ maṇ+ḍal tsaṇ+ḍa tsakra tsakra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: oṃ khaḍ+ga ka ra ti ka daṇ+ṭa muṃ ra ga ā yu dha ka la rak+ṣa raṃ dz+wa la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: zhes brjod la mi shigs pa rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi gur khang du gyur par bsgom/ de nas nad pa'am bla'i 'dra gzugs dkar po g.yung drung steng du bzhag nas khrus bstsal/ gsham gyi tshig bstun bzhin/ g.yung drung gdan rim pa bzhin yas rim du spos bzhin khrus bya ba'am/ ma nus dkyus bzhin chog /de nas rim bzhin/ hūm̐: dang po bla tshe 'gugs pa yi: 'chi med g.yung drung gyen la 'dzegs: gnyis pa bla tshe gso ba yi: mi 'gyur dar thag gyen la 'dzegs: gsum pa chad pa rab mthud pa'i: tshe mda' sgro dkar rgyas kyis btab:

bzhi pa gas pa sbyor ba yi: dam tshig rdo rje spyi bor reg: lnga pa yo ba bsrang ba yi: tshe zan longs spyod rgyan la rol: drug pa mi 'gyur brtan pa yi: tshe chang bdud rtsi bcud la myong : bdun pa 'chi med thob pa yi: rin chen phye mar myong zhing byug: brgyad pa rab tu gnas pa yi: 'bru mchog nas kyi me tog 'thor: dgu pa bkra shis bgyis pa yi: lus la dri spos sman bzang byug: bcu pa rdo rje'i sku 'thob phyir: rin chen bum pas dbang bskur ro: bcu gcig 'byin 'jug brtan pa'i phyir: grags stong sngags kyis dbang bskur ro: bcu gnyis 'ja' lus srog bsgrub phyir: dkyil 'khor me long dbang bskur ro: bcu gsum yon tan mthar phyin phyir: rmad byung gtor mas dbang bskur ro: bcu bzhi phrin las yongs rdzogs phyir: rgyan dang phyag mtshan dbang bskur ro: bco lnga dge legs 'byung ba'i phyir: sna tshogs rdo rjes rgyas btab bo: bcu drug mi 'gyur gdeng ldan phyir: smon lam g.yung drung gdan du 'khor: 'jigs med rdo rje'i tshe ldan shog: oṃ āḥbh+rūm̐: tshe bh+rūm̐: g.yu bh+rūm̐: g.yu tshe bh+rūm̐: ā yur+dzñā na sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: g.yung drung gi gdan che ba'i thog nad pa bzhag la khrus bya ba ni/ bum pa thogs nas/ hūm̐: 'di ni 'chi med lha yi chu: dag byed gaṅgā bsil ba'i rgyun: skal ldan bu la khrus bstsal bas: pha rol bdud kyis bla 'phrog pa'i: bag chags ngan pa dag gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: sbyin bdag la khrus bstsal zhing bla gzugs dkar po de khang pa'i thog tu bskyal/ skabs 'dir tshe dbang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang rung zhus la/ bla ma la yon kyang tshe'i rdzas rin po che snam dkar ma gtogs chag gas grum pa dang*/ nag po sogs ming ngan pa yod pa'i rdzas mi 'bul/ spyir ni rten 'brel gtso che'o/ dar dkar dmar de tshe mdud brgyab la tshe rten du 'chang*/

tshe mda' dang snam dkar mi la sbyin mi rung*/ khyad par bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro kun mnyes pa'i tshogs skong la 'bad/ dam tshig ni/ gzhung las/ zhag gsum la chu chen mi brgal: bud med mi spyod: 'thab rtsod kyi sa ru mi 'gro: srog gcod nam yang spang : zhag gsum la shig tsam yang mi gsod: sdig can las ngan rnams kyang lo gsum la 'dzem sdig pa ma spangs pa la 'di yi dkyil 'khor mi bsham: byas kyang bka' chad 'ong : sa them pa dgu yod sar mthur du mi 'gro: mi mang po shi dur du mi nyal: gos nag po mi gyon: gdan nag po mi 'ding : rdzun dang phra ma'i mna' mi bya: de rnams zhib tu 'bad pa gal che'o/ rjes kyi bya ba tshogs drangs pa nas bsngo smon bkra shis bar las gzhung mtha' dbyung bar bya'o/ /de ltar bgyis pa'i phan yon yang*/ tshad las 'das te dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba las rnam par grol bar smos ci dgos/ gter gzhung las/ tshe zad dus la bab kyang ring du bsring : dus min 'chi ba'i bdud las rab tu bsgral: zhes gsungs pa bzhin rang gzhan bstan 'gro'i don bsgrub par 'dod pa dag la/ tshe bdud bar chad zhi zhing tshe mthar phyin pa ni shin tu gal che'o/ /de ltar na tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon gyi cha lag /tshe bdud zhags pa gcod pa'i gdams pa dang*/ bdud bzhis zhu lan sogs gab sprad shin tu mang zhing lag tu len dka' bar snang bas/ shar mar bklag chog par zhig tu byung na rang gzhan mang por phan rlabs che bar mthong nas rtsa ba gter gzhung gi dgongs pa 'khrul med blangs shing*/ man ngag lag len gyis mtshams sbyar dang bcas legs par bkod pa 'di'ang rab byung bcu bdun pa/ me khyi lo'i dbo zla ba'i yar tshes dgu la bal yul nyi ma khud kyi mtsho dang nye bar/ sngon tshe slob dpon pad+mas bdud kyi bu mo rdo rje ya byin ma sogs dam la bzhag pa'i gnas/ a su ra zhes rtse mor brag ri rdo rje dgu brtsegs dgung la zug pa/

sked par nags tshal tshang tshing stug pos khebs shing stag gzig gis ngar sgra dir dir sgrogs pa/ rtsa bar mu stegs pa rnams kyis/ kā li nag mor dmar mchod phul bas chu rgyun yang khrag zhag gi rba klong 'khrugs te rngam zil chags shing*/ 'jigs su rung ba'i dur khrod kyi bkod pa ma tshang ba med pa yongs su rdzogs pa gang der/ gnas bcas pa'i sngags 'chang hūm̐ nag drag rtsal gyi brgyud 'dzin du rlom pa/ snyigs dus kyi sngags nag nyams len gto mdos la re zhing*/ 'tsho ba dkor nag la spyod ba'i sprang nag gu h+ya'i ming gis bgyis pa'i/ yi ge pa ni 'brong pa rdo shul gyi ban+de gi li gsang sngags 'gro 'dul gyis bgyis pa 'dis kyang bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu rnams kyi sku tshe'i bar chad zhi zhing*/ 'gro kun bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ // sha) ༈ tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las: glud rab nyams chag lam bsgyur bzhugs so: 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: sku glud gtang ba'i rim pa ni: bra zan nam ni gang rung la: sbyin bdag de yi 'dra 'bag bzo: dbang po lnga yi rdzas rnams bzhag: gos dang rgyan dar phyug par byed: mar me lnga dang ting lo drug: changs bu brgya dang sha dum dgu: gtor chung bcu gnyis 'brang rgyas lnga: gzhan yang mi kha'i yas stags brdzang : rang nyid dbang chen lha gsal nas: bgegs dang 'byung po lan gsum bkug: bsngo zhing lam bstan brdzang bar bya: sa ma ya: dang po bsang sbyang bskyed pa ni: oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃḥ stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid dbang chen khro rgyal stobs 'dus gsal ba'i mdun du: srid pa'i rus sbal rgya bo'i steng du: yi ge tri kham nag yongs su gyur pa las: bgegs kyi rgyal po bī na ya ka sku mdog kham nag mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa: de yang mthing gi skra lo: shel gyi klad pa:

lang thang gi mig: ru bya'i sna: mgron bu'i so: byu ru'i lce: rna ba g.yas pa dung : g.yon pa mchong : dar skud kyi rtsa: mu tig gi byang sems: zho sha'i snying : a ru ra'i sha: mtshal gyi khrag: chu shel gyi rus pa: me shel gyi drod: rlung lnga'i dbugs: dzā ti'i glo ba: li shi'i mchin pa: gi waṃ gi mkhris pa: ka ko la'i mkhar nag: ga pur gyi mkhal dkar: gser me'i mtsher pa: tsan+dan gyi rgyu ma: lang thang rtse yi pho ba: dbyar rtsa dgun 'bu'i mtshan ma: dar tshon sna lnga'i na bza': lag g.yas gser: lag g.yon dngul: rkang g.yas lcags: rkang g.yon zangs: sku gsung thugs la mar me lnga: dbang po drug la ting lo drug: rnam shes brgyad la sha dum brgyad: khams lnga la 'brang rgyas lnga: rten 'brel bcu gnyis la gtor chung bcu gnyis: 'ja' tshon lnga yi rgyan gos sna tshogs: mdor na ma tshang ba med cing : snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyi gdong lon cing shag gral ba: skyes pa pho yi glud du 'bul ba: mgo rmog phod: lus khrab dkar: sked 'khor gsum: rkang swag lham: zhon rta cang shes: za ma mo yi glud du: mgo la gser g.yu mu tig: lus la dar zab rgyan gos: rkang la 'ja' ris dar lham: sgo nor phyugs kyi glud du: shel tshig khri dkar stong nag: rta nor lug sogs khri 'bum bye ba: zhing dang bang ba'i glud du: yas stags sna dgu'i longs spyod: lo zla zhag dus kyi glud du: mda' 'phang nam rgyang la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa'i sku yi glud du gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes lan gsum gyis byin rlabs bya: de nas 'gugs gzhug ni: na mo: drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi bka' bden pa dang : bden pa chen po la brten nas: rnal 'byor dpon slob yon mchod mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la:

gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i lo rgyal po'i skag: zla ba blon po'i skag: zhag dmag mi'i skag: dus tshod mtshon cha'i skag: gzhan yang skag rigs sum stong drug brgya: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu: byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu: glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad: bdud bzhi tshe yi bar gcod: rgyal bsen dam sri the'u rang : mo 'dre bse rag chung sri god sri dbul sri dgra sri: nad rims yams kyi bdag po: sgab 'dre yul 'dre 'khyams po: la sogs pa gnod byed 'byung po thams cad rang dbang med par yas stags glud kyi gzugs brnyan 'di la mchis par gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra ṭāk+ki rā dza hūm̐ dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sarba bigh+nān: aṃ ku sha ya dzaḥ zhes lan gsum gyis bstim: de nas changs bu bsngo ba ni: hūm̐: nga ni dbang chen he ru kaḥ nga ni rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung : nga yi bka' las ma 'da' bar: bgegs kyi tshogs rnams legs par nyon: snying rje byams sems chos kyang bshad: 'dod yon sna tshogs yas stags bsngo: khyod kyang byang chub thar lam bstan: nges pa'i don chen byang bar nyon: hūm̐: khyod la yas rdzas bsngo ba ni: 'dod yon changs bu 'brang rgyas dang : gtor chung sha dum tshwa ram g.yer: gtsong sgog la phug rug pa dang : ja chang zho sogs ma legs pa: mi kha'i yas stags sna tshogs bsngo: chags sems gnod 'tshe byang gyur nas: bla med byang chub reg gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐:

de nas changs bu re re bzhin: hūm̐: gdon chen rnams la rang rtags yas bsngos pas: lha yi gdon rnams mi'i skra'i ba dan 'dod: skra yi glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: lha min gdon gyis mi yi klad pa 'dod: klad pa'i glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: ma mo'i gdon gyis mi yi thig le 'dod: byang sems glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: gza' yi gdon rnams mi yi rtsa khams 'dod: rtsa khams glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: grul bum gdon rnams mi yi rna ba 'dod: rna ba'i glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: mkha' lding gdon rnams mi yi mig 'bras 'dod: mig 'bras glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: dri za'i gdon rnams mi yi sna bug 'dod: sna bug glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: mi min gdon rnams mi yi so 'gram 'dod: so 'gram glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: nam gru'i gdon rnams mi yi lce rkan 'dod: lce rkan glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: rgyal po'i gdon rnams mi yi srog snying 'dod: srog snying glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: gri btsan gdon gyis mi yi glo ba 'dod: glo ba'i glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: gnod sbyin gdon gyis mi yi snying khrag 'dod: snying khrag glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: phung byed ma mos mi yi khrag skyes 'dod: khrag skyes glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: bdud rje rgyal pos mi yi mchin pa 'dod: mchin pa'i glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: gshin rje'i gdon gyis mi yi pho ba 'dod: pho ba'i glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: klu mo spus 'gros mngal gyi rak+ta 'dod: mngal khrag glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: me lha'i gdon gyis mi yi mkhris pa 'dod: mkhris pa'i glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: sa bdag gdon gyis mi yi mtsher pa 'dod: mtsher pa'i glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: rlung lha'i gdon gyis mi yi mkhal ma 'dod:

mkhal ma'i glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: lam 'dre 'khyams pos mi yi rgyu ma 'dod: rgyu ma'i glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: the'u rang gdon gyis mi yi lgang pa 'dod: lgang pa'i glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: chung sri rnams kyis nag mo'i bu ra 'dod: bu ra'i glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: bse rag rnams kyis mi yi nu ma 'dod: nu ma'i glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: srin mo rnams kyis mi yi pho mtshan 'dod: pho mtshan glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: sde brgyad gdon gyis mi yi bshang lam 'dod: bshang lam glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: dam sri dmar pos bud med mtshan ma 'dod: mtshan ma'i glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: nam gru nag mos bud med 'og sgo 'dod: 'og sgo'i glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: sman mo rnams kyis mi yi rtsa rgyus 'dod: rtsa rgyus glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: 'byung po rnams kyi mi yi dbugs rnams 'dod: dbugs kyi glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: gling bzhi'i gdon gyis mi yi gzug bzhi 'dod: gzug bzhi'i glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: ma bdud gdon gyis sha dang pags pa 'dod: sha lpags glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: bgegs srin gdon gyis mi yi rus pa 'dod: rus pa'i glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: snang srid yongs kyis kun tshang dbang po 'dod: sku gzugs glud du zan gyi changs bu bsngo: skye mched bcu gnyis dbang po tshang ba 'di: de ring rgyu sbyor yon bdag glud du bsngo: bzung ba yod na btang bar gyis: bcings pa yod na khrol bar gyis: mnan pa yod na yar la khyogs: phyin chad gnod pa ma byed cig: zhi ba byams sems ldan par mdzod: de nas mdos la lam bstan pa ni: hūm̐: da ni yas la lam bstan 'tshal: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: lcags ri mun pa'i pha rol na: rin chen gser gyi pho brang na: longs spyod mi zad dkor nor yod:

yid mtshar pho mo grangs med yod: de ru khyod kyi lam bstan no: bgegs kyi sa yul de na che: bgegs kyi 'du 'tshogs de ru bzang : ya kha dmod pa'i mi rnams kyis: bgegs rgyal de ru byon zhes zer: mgron dang ston mo grab yod skad: de ru bgegs la lam bstan no: 'di na sdod pa'i yul ma mchis: yul yang drag po e yi klong : phyi nang khyab pa'i me dpung 'khrigs: mi rnams khro bo khro mo mthong : drag sngags hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar ldir: chas rnams dur khrod drag po'i chas: bgegs dpung 'joms pa'i mtshon char 'bebs: de ru chags pa'i gnas ma mchis: gdug pa'i bsam pa zhi bar mdzod: de nas snang srid la 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: srid pa'i lha srin sde brgyad dang : glud dang yas la dbang ba yi: bgegs rigs 'byung po'i tshogs bcas la: sku glud brgyan can bsngo ba ni: ya mtshan ltad mo 'di ltar lags: mthing gi skra lo nyi khri stong : mgo bsigs ral pa yings se ying : shel gyi klad la long thang mig: lta stangs mig 'gyur hrigs se hrig: ru bya'i sna la mgron bu'i so: sna mdzes bzhad gad ya la la: byi ru'i lce la rna ba dung : smra brjod sgra snyan lams se lam: dar skud rtsa la mu tig byam: mnyen lcug dri med snyigs se snyig: zho sha'i snying la a ru'i sha: bsam dang bkrag mdangs ya la la: mtshal gyi khrag la chu shel rus: bcud dang zhag g.yo me re re: me shel drod la rlung gi dbugs: bag dro sna bshugs kyu ru ru: rin chen sman sna'i nang rol ldan: kun tshang dbang po nyi li li: lag g.yas gser dang lag g.yon dngul: phyag rgya pad kor kyi li li: rkang pa g.yas g.yon zangs dang lcags: rdog bro gar stabs khyugs se khyug: sku gsung thugs la mar me lnga: sku lnga rang byung ta la la: dbang po rnams la ting lo drug: tshogs drug ma 'gags sha ra ra: rnam shes brgyad la sha dum brgyad: skye gnas rnam bzhi brgyad dang ldan:

phung khams lnga la 'brang rgyas lnga: 'byung ba'i bcud ldan khrigs se khrig: skye mched gtor chung bcu gnyis te: srid pa'i spyod 'gros kun kyang tshang : 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i na bza' gsol: snang srid kun gyi sems yid 'phrog: dkor nor shel tshig khri 'bum dung : mnga' thang rgyal po chas pa 'dra: bang ba khyim gyi yas stags glud: tshong dpon lam la chas pa 'dra: gri khrab go mtshon rgyan dang ldan: dpa' bo dgra la chas pa 'dra: gser g.yu dar zab khro lo lo: sman chung bag ma chas pa 'dra: bzhad bgad rtse gar khrigs se khrig: lha phrug rtse ra 'tshogs pa 'dra: de bas ya mtshan ldan pa'i glud: mi bas glud 'di ngo mtshar che: mi la ya mtshan gang yang med: khog stod dug lnga me ltar 'bar: khog smad mi gtsang mtsho ltar 'khyil: tshe rabs bag chags mun ltar gtibs: sdig sgrib can gyi mi bo skyur: yon tan ldan pa'i glud 'di longs: snang srid lha 'dre'i phyag tu phul: lan chags bu lon 'khor gyur cig: sha 'khon sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: bla med byang chub thob gyur cig: ces mar btegs thun gyis brdeg: snying rje phan sems med pa rnams tshar gcod par bsam: hūm̐: nga ni dbang chen he ru kaḥ bka' la mi gnas bgegs kyi rigs: ci ste mi 'gro 'dug gyur na: thogs med drag po'i mtshon char gyis: mgo lus phye mar dum bur gtub: de bas rang rang gnas su dengs: oṃ badz+ra kro ta kī la ya baṃ kro ti sa ma ya hūm̐ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags thun gyis brab ste mtha' yi lcags ri nag po'i logs su ded par bsam: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: 'byung bzhi tshe bdud bzlog pa'i phyir: sprul bsgyur yas kyi rim pa bzhag: sngon las 'phral rkyen dbang gyur te: bsdus bya 'byung bzhi 'khrugs pa'i tshe: man ngag gdams pa 'di nyid zab: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya:
gtad rgya: dam rgya: mi nub rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos me sprel lor tsā ri zil chen gsang phug nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// //
